title: Senior Key Accounts Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.</span></p></div><p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong>The Community You Will Join:</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;">The Airbnb Hotels team is a fun, fast-growing group leading Airbnb’s expansion into the hotel sector. Operating with an entrepreneurial spirit, this team combines the simplicity, product excellence, and guest-centered ethos that define Airbnb. This team’s mission is to deliver the smoothest, most intuitive hotel booking experience for guests, while helping hotels easily drive incremental bookings so they can focus on delivering the best hospitality. The ultimate aim is to help more people discover high-quality hotels, creating value for guests and our hotel partners.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong>The Difference You will Make:</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;">As a Senior Key Account Manager on the Hotels Enterprise team, you will own the commercial relationship with a portfolio of global and multinational hotel groups in your region. Your goal is to turn introductions into signed agreements then into live, healthy, growing inventory by increasing participation, bookings and revenue across Airbnb and HotelTonight. You will lead the account planning cycle with each partner, negotiate and renew commercial terms, and be the single point of contact between their executives and many Airbnb teams including Connectivity, Product, Legal and Market Management teams.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong>A Typical Day: </strong></span></p> <ul> <li>Be accountable for the end-to-end lifecycle from prospecting, to acquisition, contracting, rollout and performance management  of Key Account partnerships</li> <li>Execute a global win-win strategy for your portfolio that drives value to all parties and position Airbnb as a top strategic partner across all distribution channels.</li> <li>Through the creation of mutual account plans with your partners you will design clear actions which deliver on the Objectives and KPIs of Airbnb and our Key Account Partners</li> <li>Negotiate agreements with partners to unlock new opportunities for both parties & promote long term mutual success</li> <li>Leverage data to make decisions and design projects to best expand and enhance availability and revenue through existing partnerships.</li> <li>Monitor & analyze over/underperformance, market trends, growth opportunities or anomalies and regularly communicate performance to Executives leveraging available production data and global market insight.</li> <li>Work with partners to ensure that the partnership is held to the highest industry standards and that commercial agreements as well as operational SLAs are met.</li> <li>Develop close working relationships with key internal teams and individuals to ensure that they  provide appropriate levels of support to these key partnerships and key enhancements are made to unlock revenue for the business.</li> <li>Conduct regular business reviews, formal presentations for internal and external purposes.</li> <li>Work cross-functionally to execute changes at scale while collaborating with Market Management as a subject matter expert in Key Accounts accounts to drive local property performance. </li> <li>Proactively contribute to the development and standardization of Enterprise team processes, playbooks, and best practices across the global function</li> </ul> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong>Your Expertise:</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>8+ years of Travel IndustryAccount Management experience; including 5 years in a Key Account Manager role with at least 2 years  being responsible for a global partner base. </li> <li>Proven track record of executing on strategic priorities</li> <li>Experience in analyzing, structuring and negotiating complex deals that align across multiple business unit needs</li> <li>Strong negotiation skills with a proven ability to structure and close high-value, complex deals that establish long-term, strategic partnerships.</li> <li>Comfortable performing data analysis and making decisions based on the results</li> <li>Ability to balance time spent between strategic initiatives and operations while diving into the details when necessary.</li> <li>Experience developing and selling complex business solutions at the C-Suite level</li> <li>Strong executive presence and the ability to effectively influence top leaders internally and within the industry</li> <li>Have a passion for redefining travel, Airbnb, and being the best!</li> <li>Proactive self-starter able to prioritize and manage work autonomously</li> <li>Excellent verbal/written communication and presentation skills</li> <li>Ability to travel at least 50% of the time.</li> </ul> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong>Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;">Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.</span></p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><span style="font-size: 16px;"><strong><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">How We'll Take Care of You:</span></strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 16px;">Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.</span></p></div><div class="title">France Annual Pay Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€74.000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>€92.000 EUR</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p> </p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Reasonable Accommodations:</strong> We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong>A Note on Recruiting Scams:</strong> Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @<a href="http://airbnb.com">airbnb.com</a> or @<a href="http://ext.airbnb.com">ext.airbnb.com</a> email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing.  We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.</span></p> <p> </p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: AI Applied Scientist
description: About the Science and AI Team The Science and AI team is at the heart of Maki People. It builds the science and AI behind our platform, from job analysis and assessments to AI interviews and predicting performance. Led by our Head of Science, Aiden Loe, and working closely with our COO, Paul-Louis Caylar, the team brings together business psychologists, psychometricians and AI scientists. Together, they make sure every hiring decision on our platform is accurate, consistent and fair. As Maki grows, the Science and AI team’s job is to show, with evidence, that our approach leads to better hiring decisions. About the Role The AI Applied Scientist turns our science into results for clients. Most of your time goes on client projects: adapting our AI scoring to each client’s roles, analysing their data, and showing them what it means. The rest goes on improving the scoring systems that every client relies on. 1. Client projects Adapt AI scoring for structured interviews, job-specific skills and multilingual proficiency to each client’s roles and needs. Analyse client assessment and performance data to show how scores relate to job performance and retention. Set and review cut-offs and thresholds with clients, backed by evidence. Present findings and recommendations directly to clients, in a way non-technical audiences can act on. Work closely with implementation and customer success teams from setup to go-live. 2. Testing scoring quality Compare AI scores with expert ratings to check accuracy and reliability before anything goes live. Test robustness to prompt variation, input noise and adversarial behaviour such as prompt injection. 3. Fairness in practice Run bias checks across demographic groups for each client project. Apply mitigation techniques such as reweighting and calibration without losing model performance. Support fairness reports and compliance documentation for clients. 4. Improving our scoring systems Help choose the right models and prompts for production, balancing accuracy, speed and cost. Support the move onto self-hosted open-weight models, including fine-tuning on expert-rated data. Work with engineering to roll out scoring changes safely. As one of Maki People’s early employees, you’ll help shape the team’s future. Our Ideal Candidate Required MSc or PhD in data science, machine learning, psychology or a related field, or equivalent industry experience. Hands-on experience with LLM-based scoring or evaluation. Strong Python or R skills, with solid statistical analysis. Experience presenting data-driven findings to clients or senior business stakeholders. Able to manage several projects at once and keep to deadlines. Preferred Experience in consulting, people analytics or assessment. Working knowledge of psychometric concepts such as reliability, validity and IRT. Experience testing AI systems for fairness and bias. Experience fine-tuning language models, for example with LoRA. Working knowledge of ethical AI and compliance, such as the EU AI Act. Insgesamt dauert unser Bewerbungsprozess in der Regel zwischen 15 und 25 Tagen. Wir haben dir möglichst viele Informationen über den Zweck, die Aufgaben und das Umfeld dieser Position gegeben. Jetzt bist du gefragt: Zeige uns, ob du dich in dieser Position sowohl wohlfühlen als auch einen echten Beitrag zu unserem Unternehmen leisten kannst. Falls du noch unsicher bist, ermutigen wir dich trotzdem, dich zu bewerben. Im schlechtesten Fall investierst du ein paar Minuten, im besten Fall beginnt damit eine sinnvolle und langfristige Zusammenarbeit. Wir möchten außerdem betonen, dass wir Vielfalt voll und ganz unterstützen und unser Bestes tun, um ein sicheres und inklusives Arbeitsumfeld zu schaffen. Wir setzen uns für Chancengleichheit ein, unabhängig von Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Herkunft, Behinderung oder anderen persönlichen Merkmalen. title: Strategic Account Manager – Enterprise Hospitality (Nice)
description: Lightspeed is looking for an experienced, strategically minded Strategic Account Manager to develop, engage, and closely support our most important enterprise customers in the hospitality segment over the long term. This role is remote-based in Nice, France, with occasional travel to our Paris office. In this role, you will act as the primary point of contact for our largest hospitality customers in France. You will be responsible for driving growth, product adoption, and stakeholder management within your portfolio, with the goal of building true business partnerships. You will leverage data, customer feedback, and your SaaS expertise to create value at the enterprise level, while collaborating closely with teams across the business. What you’ll do Act as the main point of contact for our largest and most strategic hospitality customers Develop and execute strategic account plans to drive growth, retention, and product adoption Proactively work on increasing product usage and ensure Net Revenue Retention (NRR) grows across your portfolio Plan and lead quarterly business reviews and success plans Analyze usage data, go-live milestones, and health scores to identify and mitigate risks early Build strong, trusted relationships with C-level and operational stakeholders, positioning Lightspeed as a long-term strategic partner Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Customer Success, Implementation, and Support teams to deliver an excellent customer experience Collect customer feedback and proactively share it with relevant teams to identify product gaps and optimize the overall customer journey What you bring 3–5+ years of experience in Account Management or Strategic Customer Success within a B2B SaaS environment, ideally with enterprise customers A strong understanding of SaaS metrics (NRR, product adoption, expansion, renewals, churn) and the ability to use them to manage your portfolio A strong sense of ownership; you are hands-on, data-driven, and highly skilled in relationship management Experience managing complex, multi-level stakeholder structures and confidently engaging with C-level, operations, and technical teams Fluent business-level French and English Experience in the hospitality, POS, or hospitality tech industry is a plus, but not required What’s in it for you? Come live the Lightspeed experience… Genuine career opportunities in a company that’s creating new jobs every day Work in a team large enough for growth but lean enough to make a real impact Exposure to modern and proven technology Ability to work and grow in a truly flexible environment Opportunity to learn, expand your skill set, forge wonderful relationships and make your mark within the diverse and inclusive Lightspeed culture, a true Canadian tech success story … and enjoy a range of benefits that’ll keep you happy, healthy and (not) hungry: Lightspeed equity scheme (we are all owners) Health & Wellness Credit- expense up to 400 EUR per year towards your gym membership, yoga classes, a new bike or whatever else you do for your health Mental Health Support through the Modern Health App- whether it is meditation, coaching or counseling you need - each employee gets access to this platform People Experience - Our PX benefit allows you to work from pretty much anywhere in the world for 60 days a year Time off to volunteer and give back to your community Health insurance with attractive guarantee plans We know that people are more than what’s on their CV. If you’re unsure that you have the right profile for the role... hit the ‘Apply’ button and give it a try! To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. Where to from here? Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here . Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs. Who we are: Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks. Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries. title: Senior Nuclear Theorist - Few-Body Physics (gn) @ Fusion Energy Venture, Munich
description: This is an Atlantic portfolio venture. About the Venture Snap Fusion develops a fundamentally new approach to controlled fusion energy. We are a small team of physicists and engineers. The work is early, the questions are real, and the standard is high. Our findings feed into research in fusion energy, scientific discovery, advanced simulation, AI for Physics and quantum technologies. Some problems are too important not to solve. Your mission Lead the nuclear theory behind a new approach to fusion energy. At Snap Fusion, we are pursuing a bold mission: developing a fundamentally new approach to controlled fusion energy. Parts of our roadmap rest on questions of low-energy nuclear physics. Some of these have clear answers in the literature; others turn out, on close reading, to be less settled than they first appear. Knowing which is which matters to us, because it shapes what we build and what we test. We are therefore establishing an in-house nuclear theory effort, and we are looking for a senior few-body theorist to lead it. Your job will be to decide which of our questions current theory can actually answer, to answer those at a standard that would hold up to expert review, and to say plainly where the uncertainties lie. This is an unusual setting for a theorist, in a good way: the questions are concrete, the team is small, and your conclusions will be acted on. What you will do You will work directly with the founders as theory lead. Your responsibilities may include: • Leading theory projects from problem definition to a clear recommendation • Judging which questions current nuclear theory can answer, and with what uncertainty • Carrying out and supervising few-body scattering and reaction calculations • Setting the benchmarks and cross-checks against which results are accepted • Working with our computational physics lead on the numerical implementation of the methods you specify • Reviewing theoretical and experimental claims that bear on our roadmap • Building collaborations with academic groups, including for independent confirmation of key results • Helping the rest of the team understand the physics behind your conclusions Your assessments will directly inform Snap Fusion's technology roadmap. What we’re looking for You will probably hold a PhD in theoretical nuclear physics or a closely related field, with research experience beyond it. Ideal candidates will have strong experience in several of the following areas: Nuclear theory • Quantum scattering and reaction theory • Few-body or ab initio methods • Realistic nuclear interactions • Resonances, thresholds, and continuum physics • Low-energy charged-particle reactions • Fusion cross sections and astrophysical S-factors Scientific leadership. You should be comfortable: • Running a research program with milestones and honest go/no-go decisions • Saying that a question cannot be answered with current theory, when it cannot • Writing clearly for readers who are not few-body specialists • Reviewing other people's derivations, and having your own reviewed Like most few-body theorists, you will have done a good deal of numerical work, and that experience will be valuable here. But this is a physics role first: we have a computational physics lead, and implementation is a collaboration rather than the core of your job. Industry experience is not required. Bonus Points Experience with any of the following is a plus: • Light-nuclei reaction calculations • R-matrix or related continuum methods • Nuclear astrophysics • Benchmark comparisons between methods or codes • Close collaboration with experimentalists • Refereeing and reviewing • Teaching or mentoring Who thrives here? You may be a great fit if: • You like physics questions with practical consequences • You would rather establish a modest result firmly than a striking one loosely • You are comfortable saying “we don't know yet” and explaining why • You enjoy making difficult material clear to colleagues from other fields • You want to see your work used This role suits someone who wants to keep doing serious theory while seeing it put to use. Why join Snap Fusion? The questions you settle will feed into research in: • Fusion energy • Scientific discovery • Advanced simulation • AI for Physics • Quantum technologies You will work alongside physicists and engineers on problems where careful theory has direct consequences. The work is early, the questions are real, and the standard is high. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne , c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable . Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain . Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif. L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain. Bienvenue dans l’univers des matériaux du futur ! Au centre Science des Matériaux et des Structures (SMS), rattaché au Laboratoire Georges Friedel (unité mixte de recherche CNRS), on décortique la matière pour mieux la maîtriser. Alliages métalliques, céramiques, composites… ici, on explore le lien entre procédés, microstructures et propriétés des matériaux. Grâce à des outils de caractérisation avancée et des modèles multi-échelles, nos enseignants-chercheurs inventent le concept de « Material by design » : concevoir les matériaux dès l’atelier de recherche, pour une performance sur-mesure. 🧠 Vous aimez la science fondamentale qui change le réel ? C’est ici que ça se passe. 🎯 Description du poste - ce que nous attendons de vous Le Laboratoire Georges Friedel (LGF) est une Unité Mixte de Recherche du CNRS (UMR 5307). Situé à l’École des Mines de Saint-Étienne et porté par deux tutelles (Mines Saint-Étienne et CNRS), le laboratoire regroupe tout le potentiel de recherche de Mines Saint-Étienne dans les domaines des matériaux, de la mécanique et des procédés. Le centre SMS - Sciences des Matériaux et des Structures - est l’un des cinq centres d’enseignement et de recherche de Mines Saint-Etienne. Au sein du LGF, il développe des recherches en science des matériaux, mécanique et procédés avancés de fabrication, pour le transport et la production d'énergie, avec un objectif d’accroître la durabilité des matériaux. Ce post-doc s'inscrit dans le cadre de la chaire « SIRA », un partenariat de cinq ans entre Mines Saint-Etienne et les sociétés Framatome et EDF, co-financé par l'Agence Nationale de la Recherche, portant sur le vieillissement des aciers faiblement alliés (16MND5) utilisés dans les composants du circuit primaire des réacteurs nucléaires à eau pressurisée. Les travaux de la chaire incluent plusieurs doctorats et post-doctorats visant à faire progresser la connaissance du phénomène de ségrégation intergranulaire dans les aciers faiblement alliés et de la fragilisation associée, ainsi qu’à développer de nouvelles méthodologies de mesure de la ségrégation intergranulaire, ou à améliorer les méthodologies existantes. Le post-doc proposé ici, financé par EDF, vise à déterminer l'effet de l'irradiation neutronique sur la ségrégation intergranulaire, pour les matériaux suivis dans le cadre du programme de surveillance des effets de l'irradiation sur les matériaux des cuves REP d'EDF. Il est en effet important de savoir si de la fragilisation intergranulaire peut intervenir à forte fluence pour prévoir correctement l'évolution des propriétés de rupture. C'est donc une caractérisation qui vient en appui de l'interprétation des fragilisations mesurées dans le cadre du programme de surveillance. Le travail consistera à mesurer les états de ségrégation intergranulaire dans les états non irradié et irradié en utilisant la microscopie électronique en transmission (STEM-EDX). Contrairement à la spectroscopie Auger, la microscopie électronique ne nécessite pas l'obtention d'une surface de rupture sous ultra-vide, ce qui constitue un avantage pour des matériaux dont la tendance à la rupture intergranulaire est faible. L'acier de cuve a une certaine hétérogénéité de composition chimique locale à cause de la présence de mésoségrégations enrichies en solutés majeurs et en impuretés fragilisantes comme le phosphore. Pour juger des seuls effets de l'irradiation, les zones d'analyse en microscopie électronique devront donc être équivalentes en termes d'intensité de mésoségrégation dans les états non irradié et irradié. Ceci nécessitera une caractérisation préalable des mésoségrégations et un prélèvement ciblé des lames minces en zone ségrégée ou en zone non ségrégée par faisceau d'ions focalisés (FIB). Les travaux de microscopie électronique seront réalisés à Saint-Etienne (microscope Jeol NeoARM) pour l’état non irradié, et au laboratoire d'analyse des matériaux irradiés d'EDF à Chinon (microscope FEI Osiris) pour l’état irradié. Une méthodologie d'analyse des ségrégations intergranulaires a été développée pour ce type de microscope au cours de la thèse de C.Y. Hsu (2023) et fait actuellement l’objet d’un développement dans le cadre d’un des post-docs de la chaire (mesure de la ségrégation intergranulaire du carbone par STEM-EDX). Le poste est basé sur le campus de Saint-Étienne, avec des déplacements réguliers au LIDEC d’EDF (CNPE de Chinon, 37420 Avoine). 🔍 Ce que nous recherchons Vous êtes : · Titulaire d'un doctorat en Sciences des Matériaux ou Physique ou Chimie Vous êtes doté(e) des compétences, connaissances et expériences suivantes : · Bonne connaissance de la science des matériaux · Expérience en microscopie électronique en transmission et FIB Vous vous reconnaissez dans les capacités et aptitudes suivantes : · Capacité à travailler en équipe · Capacité à dialoguer avec des interlocuteurs académiques et industriels 📩 Candidatez dès maintenant ! title: Senior Product Marketing Manager (m/w/d)
description: Die Energiewirtschaft steckt mitten in der größten Transition ihrer Geschichte. AI ist für dich kein Knopfdruck: Die Logik dahinter entwickelst du selbst. Unsere Junior Product Marketing Managerin führst du fachlich und begleitest sie in ihrer Entwicklung. Strategy, Produktmanagement, Sales, Customer Success, Campaign & Growth sowie Event Marketing schätzen dich als Sparringspartner:in. Das bringst du mit Mehrjährige Erfahrung im B2B-SaaS-Marketing , idealerweise im Product Marketing. Positionierung und Messaging hast du schon selbst verantwortet. Am liebsten baust du eigene Workflows, statt dich auf fertige Lösungen zu verlassen. Neugier auf die Energiewirtschaft ist entscheidend. Das bieten wir dir Flexibles Arbeiten: Remote arbeiten, wann immer es passt, und regelmäßig in Köln zusammenkommen, wenn persönlicher Austausch zählt. title: Technical Support Engineer, Zero Trust
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>Lisbon, Portugal </p> <h4><strong>About the Department</strong></h4> <p>The Cloudflare Customer Support Team solves complicated problems and answers technical questions via phone, email, chat and social media. Whether it is a Wordpress blogger using our services for free or a global Enterprise business with petabytes of web traffic, we are always eager to assist. We are the eyes and ears of Cloudflare, acting as the real-time voice of the customer to help communicate their needs and real-world use cases back to the rest of the company - for better service and future product development.</p> <h4><strong>About the role</strong></h4> <p>Do you love solving complex technical issues and interacting with people? Are you passionate about providing premium-level support to customers and are a standout colleague? Cloudflare is seeking an experienced <strong>Technical Support Engineer for Zero Trust </strong>to join our team. You will work with our largest and most technically sophisticated customers on a variety of technical support issues to ensure they can deploy and operate Cloudflare's Zero Trust solutions with confidence.</p> <h4><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Serve as a trusted technical advisor, providing advanced support for enterprise customers using Cloudflare’s Zero Trust platform, including products like Access, Gateway, Cloudflare Tunnels, Cloudflare WAN and the Cloudflare One client (formerly known as Cloudflare WARP client).</li> <li>Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues related to identity, device security, and secure application access.</li> <li>Communicating and working directly with the customers via phone, video conference (ie Zoom, Google Meet), chat and tickets in Salesforce</li> <li>Work directly with customers to diagnose and remediate configuration and integration challenges with authentication protocols (e.g., SSO, SAML, OIDC) and network security settings.</li> <li>Create and maintain knowledge base articles, technical guides, and troubleshooting documentation for internal and customer use.</li> <li>Partner with Cloudflare’s Product, Engineering, and Security teams to escalate and resolve advanced customer issues.</li> <li>Provide feedback based on customer interactions to drive product improvements and ensure alignment with user needs.</li> <li>Assist customers in identifying and responding to security incidents, leveraging Cloudflare’s threat intelligence and security tools.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Availability to work the weekend shift (Saturday & Sunday)</li> <li>You have a minimum of 3 years experience working as a Support Engineer / Sr. Support Engineer supporting networking or web security products.</li> <li>Exceptional troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts for customers.</li> <li>Strong customer service orientation and communication skills, both written and verbal.</li> <li>Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.</li> <li>You have experience supporting and troubleshooting multi-factor mechanisms (TOTP, SMS, FIDO, U2F, WebAuth, EMAIL, Push MFA, etc).</li> <li>Hands-on experience with identity and access management (IdP, IAM, SCIM) systems, such as Okta, Microsoft Entra, Ping, etc. Strong knowledge of authentication protocols (SAML, OIDC)</li> <li>Proficiency in networking fundamentals, including DNS, VPNs, firewalls, and traffic routing.</li> <li>Experience supporting cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and SaaS application integrations.</li> <li>You have worked with PostgreSQL, MySQL, MS SQL or other database servers.</li> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, or a related field (or equivalent experience). This may also include specialized bootcamps. </li> <li>Relevant certifications such as Cloudflare Certified Zero Trust Specialist, CISSP, or CCSP.</li> <li>Experience with building projects on Cloudflare or using Cloudflare Products.</li> </ul> <h3 class="" data-path-to-node="0"><strong data-path-to-node="0" data-index-in-node="0">Compensation</strong></h3> <ul data-path-to-node="1"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="1,0,0">For Portugal based hires: Estimated annual salary is between €37,000 - €51,000.</p> </li> </ul> <h3 data-path-to-node="2"><strong data-path-to-node="2" data-index-in-node="0">Equity</strong></h3> <ul data-path-to-node="3"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="3,0,0">This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare's equity plan.</p> </li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Werkstudent (m/w/d) - AI Enablement & Adoption
description: Über XCNT XCNT baut Software mit einem digitalen Herzen und einer industriellen Seele als digitaler Produktbuilder der PARIGROUP SE. Die Ideen entstehen innerhalb dieser europäischen Herstellergruppe und werden so gestaltet, dass sie darüber hinaus skalieren. Wir bei XCNT arbeiten daran, künstliche Intelligenz im Unternehmensalltag nutzbar zu machen. Gemeinsam mit den Unternehmen unserer Gruppe identifizieren wir passende Anwendungsfälle, entwickeln unsere KI-Angebote weiter und unterstützen Mitarbeitende dabei, sie sinnvoll einzusetzen. Dabei geht es nicht darum, möglichst viele Tools vorzustellen. Wir wollen konkrete Probleme lösen und KI dort in Arbeitsabläufe integrieren, wo sie wirklich hilft. Dafür suchen wir dich: Du hast Freude an Technologie, gehst offen auf Menschen zu und möchtest gemeinsam mit ihnen herausfinden, wie KI ihre tägliche Arbeit verbessern kann. Deine Aufgaben im Bereich AI Enablement & Adoption Du machst aus ersten KI-Experimenten eine hilfreiche Routine. Ob im persönlichen Austausch, in abteilungsspezifischen Workshops oder gemeinsam mit unseren AI Champions: Du hilfst Mitarbeitenden, passende Anwendungen zu finden, Hürden zu überwinden und KI selbstständig einzusetzen. Gleichzeitig bringst du ihre Erfahrungen und Anforderungen in die Weiterentwicklung unserer internen KI-Plattform auf Basis von OpenWebUI ein. AI Enablement & Adoption – rund 70 % Im Alltag unterstützen: Du bist Ansprechperson für Fragen zur KI-Nutzung. Du hilfst bei konkreten Problemen und bindest bei Bedarf die richtigen Fachleute ein. Abteilungsspezifische Workshops gestalten: Du bereitest Workshops auf Deutsch und Englisch vor und führst sie durch – mit echten Aufgaben der jeweiligen Teams statt allgemeiner Tool-Demos. AI Champions unterstützen: Du begleitest engagierte Mitarbeitende, die KI in ihren Bereichen voranbringen, und unterstützt ihren Austausch untereinander. Anwendungsfälle gemeinsam entwickeln: Du findest mit den Teams heraus, wo KI sinnvoll unterstützen kann, erprobst passende Ansätze und begleitest die ersten Schritte im Alltag. Wissen zugänglich machen: Du bereitest hilfreiche Beispiele, Anleitungen und Best Practices so auf, dass andere sie direkt nutzen können. Dranbleiben: Du fragst nach, ob Lösungen tatsächlich helfen, und erkennst, wo weitere Unterstützung nötig ist. Dazu gehört auch der gelegentliche Austausch vor Ort in den Unternehmen unserer Gruppe. Die Stelle ist also mit Reisen verbunden (DE/Europa). Nutzerbedürfnisse & Produktanforderungen – rund 30 % Bedarf verstehen: Du sammelst Feedback aus Workshops, Support-Anfragen und Gesprächen mit unseren AI Champions. Anforderungen für OpenWebUI formulieren: Du beschreibst nachvollziehbar, welches Problem gelöst werden soll, für wen es relevant ist und was eine hilfreiche Lösung leisten muss. Muster erkennen: Du unterscheidest zwischen einzelnen Rückfragen, Schulungsbedarf und wiederkehrenden Produktanforderungen. Verbesserungen begleiten: Du stimmst Anforderungen mit dem technischen Team ab, testest neue Funktionen aus Nutzersicht und erklärst sie den Mitarbeitenden. Du musst dafür keine vollständigen Softwarelösungen allein entwickeln. Wichtig ist, dass du technische Zusammenhänge verstehst und zwischen Anwendern und Entwicklung vermitteln kannst. Dein Profil Du bist eingeschrieben, idealerweise am Anfang deines Masterstudiums – beispielsweise in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang im ersten oder zweiten Semester. Du nutzt generative KI bereits praktisch und kannst erklären, wo sie hilfreich ist und wo ihre Grenzen liegen. Du gehst gerne auf Menschen zu, hörst aufmerksam zu und fragst nach, bevor du eine Lösung vorschlägst. Du kannst technische Themen verständlich vermitteln und hast Freude daran, andere beim Lernen zu unterstützen. Du arbeitest strukturiert und eigenständig und behältst offene Fragen im Blick. Du bringst ein grundlegendes Verständnis für Software und webbasierte Anwendungen mit. Du kommunizierst sehr gut auf Deutsch und Englisch. Ein Plus, kein Muss: Erste Erfahrungen mit OpenWebUI, Workshops, Anwendersupport, Anforderungsmanagement oder Automatisierung. Deine ersten Monate Woran du merkst, dass du einen guten Job machst Mitarbeitende kommen bei ihren konkreten Aufgaben weiter – durch deine Unterstützung oder weil du sie an die richtige Stelle vermittelt hast. Teams nutzen KI nach einem Workshop eigenständig und sinnvoll weiter. Unsere AI Champions können ihre Kolleginnen und Kollegen besser unterstützen. Wiederkehrende Hürden werden sichtbar und fließen als klare Anforderungen in die Weiterentwicklung unserer KI-Plattform ein. Kurz: Nicht die Zahl deiner Workshops zählt, sondern ob deine Arbeit den Alltag der Menschen verbessert. Was die Rolle besonders macht Du verbindest Technologie, Zusammenarbeit und praktische Problemlösung. Du gestaltest mit, wie KI in unterschiedlichen Unternehmen und Fachbereichen eingesetzt wird. Du bekommst direktes Feedback und siehst, was deine Arbeit bewirkt. Du kannst eigene Ideen einbringen und Schritt für Schritt Verantwortung übernehmen. title: Senior Project Manager Digital (m/w/d)
description: About WPP Production We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world. About WPP WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com . Was macht ein Senior Project Manager Digital (m/w/d) bei WPP Production? Als Senior Project Manager Digital (m/w/d) in Hamburg oder Berlin übernimmst du die eigenverantwortliche Steuerung von Kundenprojekten – von komplexen Digital-Kampagnen bis hin zu Omnichannel-Produktionen. Du hast Zeit, Budget und Qualitätsstandards fest im Blick, planst Ressourcen vorausschauend und steuerst die Abläufe souverän. Du agierst als zentrale Schnittstelle für interne wie externe Stakeholder und gestaltest hybride Produktions-Workflows aktiv mit. Deine Aufgaben Eigenverantwortliche Erstellung von Kostenvoranschlägen und Bestellungen für Digital-Produktionen Kalkulation, Planung und Steuerung von integrierten Projekten inkl. Budget- und Ressourcenverantwortung Durchführung von Qualitätskontrollen und fachliche Begleitung der Umsetzung (z. B. digitale Werbemittel, Social Media Assets, DOOH) Erstellung von Timings, Überwachung von Deadlines sowie proaktive Problemlösung und Optimierung von Produktions-Workflows Administrative Jobanlage und -pflege in Projektmanagementsystemen Du steuerst das Data Handling und Asset-Management sicher über verschiedene Systeme und CMS hinweg Du prüfst und schärfst Agentur-Briefings und leitest diese zielgerichtet an unsere Produktionseinheiten weiter Erstellung von Reportings und Unterstützung des Finance-Teams bei der Abrechnung Strategische Kundenberatung und Weiterentwicklung von Kundenbeziehungen mit Fokus auf effiziente, kanalübergreifende Produktionsansätze Zentrale:r Ansprechpartner:in für interne und externe Stakeholder inklusive souveränem Erwartungsmanagement Enge Zusammenarbeit mit lokalen Produktionseinheiten sowie Nearshore- und Offshore-Teams Das bringst du mit Umfassende Berufserfahrung im Projektmanagement digitaler Projekte, idealerweise ergänzt durch Print- und Bewegtbild-Expertise Weitreichendes technisches Verständnis für Produktionsprozesse im Digitalbereich (Web-Technologien, Social Media Formate, Standard-Werbemittel) Umfassendes Zahlenverständnis für Kalkulationssicherheit und Budgetkontrolle Hohe digitale Affinität und die Fähigkeit zur schnellen Einarbeitung in neue CMS- oder Asset-Management-Systeme Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeit, Verhandlungsgeschick und sicheres Auftreten gegenüber internen wie externen Stakeholdern Sicheres Zeitmanagement, ausgeprägtes Organisationstalent und eine lösungsorientierte, pragmatische Arbeitsweise Fließende Deutsch- und fundierte Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift für unser internationales Arbeitsumfeld Lernbereitschaft, Neugier und Offenheit für den Einsatz von KI-gestützten Technologien Das bieten wir Bei uns findest du nicht nur spannende Aufgaben, sondern auch ein Arbeitsumfeld, das deine Entwicklung, Flexibilität und dein Wohlbefinden in den Mittelpunkt stellt. Entdecke unsere vielfältigen Vorteile: Arbeitskultur & Perspektiven: Spannende, vielseitige Projekte in einem schnell wachsenden, internationalen Unternehmen Offene Vertrauenskultur mit flachen Hierarchien und viel Raum für Eigenverantwortung Regelmäßige Feedback-Gespräche zur Talentförderung und Karriereentwicklung Umfassende Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten über unser globales WPP Netzwerk (Trainings, Webinare, E-Learning) Flexibilität & Work-Life-Balance: Hybrid Working und flexible Arbeitszeiten Cross-Border Working (europaweit) – Arbeite flexibel auch jenseits der Landesgrenzen Ein zusätzlicher bezahlter Urlaubstag pro Jahr für ehrenamtliche Tätigkeiten bei einer eingetragenen Wohltätigkeitsorganisation Moderne Arbeitsausstattung für eine produktive Umgebung 28 reguläre Urlaubstage pro Jahr, plus einem zusätzlichen freien Tag an deinem Geburtstag Gesundheit & Extras: Umfassende Gesundheits- und Wellness-Angebote (z.B. psychologische Beratung, Fitness, Prävention) Attraktives Corporate-Benefit-Programm mit Rabatten bei zahlreichen Marken Unterstützung bei der Altersvorsorge (inkl. vermögenswirksamer Leistungen / VWL) Beteiligung am Deutschland Ticket Möglichkeit zur Nutzung eines Job Bikes Du würdest deine Fähigkeiten gerne in einer internationalen Agentur weiter ausbauen? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung unter Angabe deiner Gehaltsvorstellung und schnellstmöglichen Verfügbarkeit! We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You'll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP's unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment. title: People Operations Working Student (m/f/d)
description: Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world. GET TO KNOW US At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we're on a mission to make every company a wellness company. We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you'll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally. Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing! Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing! THE OPPORTUNITY We are hiring a People Operations Working Student for a 6-month contract to our People Operations team in Berlin, Germany ! This role is to join our People Operations team, dedicated to delivering an exceptional employee experience across Europe. In this role, you will contribute to meaningful People initiatives and gain valuable exposure to key HR topics(e.g. employment law and payroll). You will also gain valuable exposure to driving efficient operations at scal e. You will have the opportunity to learn and apply analytical problem-solving, a process-oriented mindset, stakeholder management and AI automation to elevate our HR systems (e.g., Personio) and workflows… all within a dynamic, international environment. Whilst you will be based in Germany, you will be working on operations across European markets. YOUR IMPACT Employee Care: Respond thoughtfully to employee queries, ensuring quick, effective resolutions and an exceptional day-to-day experience for our team. Process Mindset & Execution: Ensure high accuracy and operational efficiency in core HR processes (e.g. maintaining Personio data, payroll) by following clear procedures. Solution-Oriented Problem Solving: Challenge the status quo by focusing on solutions rather than getting bogged down in problems. Use data and a process mindset to proactively identify ways to optimize workflows and leverage automation to better serve our employees at scale. Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness. WHO YOU ARE You are currently enrolled in a university, your specific degree subject matter does not matter but an interest in HR, Finance and operations is a plus You are available at least 15h/week (max. 20 hours) A fluent communicator with C1+ level proficiency in both written and spoken German and English. A Berlin-based candidate who can work on-site from our Head Office 2–3 times per week. A discreet professional with a proven ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with high integrity. A self-driven, adaptable, and collaborative team player with excellent organizational skills and strong attention to detail. A proactive learner passionate about employee experience, eager to develop skills in data-driven problem solving, project management, stakeholder management, and operations across Europe. We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that current university enrollment and fluency in German and English (C1+) are mandatory requirements. WHAT WE OFFER YOU With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life. Our benefits include: WELLHUB: Free Gold membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you. FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a one-time reimbursement to set up their home office equipment and a monthly work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home. FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn't just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines. PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is to take time away from work to recharge. PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled. CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success. CULTURE: You'll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here. Want to see what it's really like to work here? Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and watch our team video on YouTube ! Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong. At Wellhub, we welcome and celebrate your authentic self. Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. Our commitment to inclusion also extends to how we recognize and reward our people. title: ML Hydrologist, Flood Forecasting
description: About the Role Global ML flood models now outperform traditional approaches on large rivers, but they still break down in the small, fast catchments where flash floods happen. Riverkin, a VC-backed ETH Zürich Spin-off, is closing that gap. We start from hydrological models trained across thousands of catchments worldwide and make them accurate locally, using a sensor network we deploy ourselves in exactly the places public datasets don't reach. We are looking for an ML hydrologist to own that work. You will report to the CTO and work directly with our other hydrologist, who covers rainfall radar and short-term nowcasting. Why this is interesting Data nobody else has: Our own field-deployed sensors give you live streamflow observations in small, previously ungauged catchments. An open problem: Whether large-sample models can be made reliable at flash-flood scale is unsolved, and you would be working on it with real data and real users. Built to protect lives and critical infrastructure: Your models will power early flood warning systems safeguarding hydropower plants and giving first responders more time to protect communities Publishing and open source: We encourage publishing results and contributing to open tools such as NeuralHydrology and Caravan. Compute: GPU resources are available for training and experimentation. What You'll Do Bring global flood models to the local scale Take state-of-the-art hydrological ML models (LSTMs, Transformers) trained on large-sample datasets and adapt them to the catchments our customers care about. Use our own sensor data alongside public gauge, reanalysis and radar data to fine-tune and validate those models locally. Tackle prediction in ungauged and data-scarce basins through transfer learning and regionalisation. Own hydrological modelling end to end: set the technical direction, decide when to adapt pre-trained models or train our own, and lead the work from experimentation through validation to production. Work as one modelling team Make practical trade-offs between forecast accuracy, model complexity and development effort to build a reliable product that meets customer needs. Work side by side with our hydrologist specialising in rainfall radar and nowcasting to directly integrate rainfall nowcasts into your flood models. Work with software engineers to put models into production and monitor their performance. Identify and test advances in ML flood forecasting, turning promising research into more accurate and reliable forecasts for our customers. Stay close to the real world We believe the best modellers understand the world behind their models. We encourage you to join field deployments and customer conversations to build that understanding firsthand. You are an opinionated contributor to key technical decisions. Who You Are You’ve built and validated hydrological ML models across many catchments and have experience taking modelling work into real-world use. You combine scientific rigour with product judgement: you test assumptions, understand uncertainty and focus on improvements that matter to customers. You take ownership from an open question to a working solution. You set priorities, make decisions and keep moving without waiting for perfect information. You care deeply about the quality of your work. You dig into why models fail, follow problems through and stay invested in how your forecasts perform after deployment. You communicate clearly in writing and in person, can explain your reasoning and trade-offs, and work closely with people across hydrology, software, hardware and field operations. Technical Requirements MSc or PhD in hydrology, water resources, or atmospheric sciences . Hands-on experience training or fine-tuning ML streamflow or flood models across many catchments at once (regional, continental or global), for example on CAMELS or Caravan. Experience with single-catchment models alone is not sufficient. Experience transferring such models to new or data-scarce catchments through fine-tuning, regionalisation, or prediction in ungauged basins. Strong understanding of rainfall-runoff processes and the limitations of hydrological observations and input data. Experience validating models across unseen catchments and time periods, including assessing flood-peak magnitude, timing and predictive uncertainty. Strong Python skills, with experience writing maintainable code for data processing, modelling and reproducible experiments. Practical depth in deep learning for time series, including developing, training and debugging models in PyTorch or a comparable framework. Nice to Have Publications or open-source work on large-sample hydrology, transfer learning, or ungauged-basin prediction. Experience with NeuralHydrology, ERA5 or similar global forcing datasets. Experience with sub-daily or event-based flood modelling. Experience processing large hydrometeorological datasets with tools such as xarray and Dask, and formats such as Zarr. Previous early startup experience. Role Details Contract: Permanent, full-time (100% FTE). Start date: immediately Reports to : CTO. Compensation : Commensurate with experience + equity Growth : a key early hire with the opportunity to shape Riverkin's flood modelling as the team grows. Location: Four days per week in our Zurich office and one day working from home. Work authorisation : Swiss or EU/EFTA citizenship, or a valid Swiss work permit, is required. Working language: English. German is not required. About Riverkin We are a well-capitalized Swiss startup building real-time sensing and data infrastructure for rivers. Our own field-deployed sensors collect live water-level and sediment data, while our platform turns that data into decision-ready insights for customers. We work directly with the hydropower sector, where predicting flash floods is needed for daily operations. As we prove ourselves in this field, we will move towards the first responders market. We are a small, hands-on team working across hydrology, hardware, field engineering, software and market development. Apply with the button on this page. Links to papers or code are welcome. title: Head of Region
description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Help make the world more hospitable </strong></h4> <p>The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.</p> <p>You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.</p> <p>If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.</p> <h4><strong>About the role</strong></h4> <p>Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:</p></div><p>What if you could own an entire region, from the first customer conversation to long-term growth?</p> <p>At Mews, we’re creating a new leadership role for each of our EMEA regions, and we’re hiring the Head of Region for:<br>Benelux, Italy, Spain, Nordic, UK&IRE, France and DACH.</p> <p>You’ll bring commercial growth, onboarding and customer success together under one regional strategy, accountable for performance, customer outcomes and the regional P&L within the plan you agree with our VP of EMEA.</p> <p>This isn’t just about hitting a sales target. It’s about building a regional business where every part of the customer experience works together, from winning a hotel to helping it succeed on Mews.</p> <p>You’ll report to our VP of EMEA, lead teams across commercial, onboarding and customer success, and have a real say in how we grow, operate and deliver value in the region. </p> <p>It’s a rare chance to combine commercial leadership, operational ownership and genuine influence over how we scale.</p> <h4>What you’ll do</h4> <p>Drive growth across the region</p> <p>Own the regional go-to-market plan, new ARR and revenue from customers going live. You’ll run Business Development, SMB and Mid-Market Sales, Onboarding and Customer Success to win new customers, grow existing relationships and open up opportunities across the region.</p> <p>Own the entire customer experience</p> <p>Bring sales, onboarding and customer success together around one goal: making customers successful. From signature and go-live to adoption, renewal and expansion, you’ll make sure hotels experience one connected Mews journey, with a named owner at every hand-off. You’ll build executive relationships with the region’s largest hotels and groups, own recovery plans when a customer is at risk, and work with Product, Marketing and the central support and delivery teams to turn what you hear from customers into better outcomes.</p> <p>Run the region like a business</p> <p>Take ownership of the regional P&L within the plan agreed with the VP of EMEA, balancing revenue growth, headcount, capacity and controllable costs. You’ll work closely with Finance and RevOps to make sound commercial decisions and deliver steady performance.</p> <p>Build and empower exceptional teams</p> <p>Lead through team leads and senior specialists across commercial, onboarding and customer success. Some of those teams are shared with other regions, so you’ll set up how they work together with the other regional leaders. You’ll create alignment, develop the next layer of leaders and build a culture where teams collaborate, take ownership and deliver results.</p> <p>Help shape an AI-native business</p> <p>We’re serious about using AI to change how we work. You’ll lead by example, building AI systems, tools and standards that help your team spot opportunities, make better decisions and spend more time on what matters. You’ll coach others, raise AI fluency across the region and decide where a person has to make the call.</p> <h4>What you would bring</h4> <p>We’re looking for a commercially minded leader who enjoys building businesses, developing people and connecting growth to customer success.</p> <ul> <li><strong>A track record of commercial success.</strong> 8+ years in B2B SaaS or hospitality commercial roles, including at least 3 years leading teams, consistently taking teams to and beyond target. You’ve owned a commercial number and built the go-to-market plan behind it.</li> <li><strong>End-to-end customer leadership.</strong> You’ve led onboarding, customer success, implementation or delivery teams, accountable for time to go-live, adoption, retention and net revenue retention, and you’ve led a team spanning more than one discipline.</li> <li><strong>Business acumen.</strong> You’ve owned a P&L or budget, including controllable costs, headcount and margin trade-offs, ideally across commercial and customer delivery teams, and you collaborate on the plan and numbers with Finance and RevOps.</li> <li><strong>An ability to bring people together.</strong> You’ve developed talent, built a bench and guided teams through growth or change. You’re fluent in English and the primary language of the region, and comfortable building relationships with customers, colleagues and senior stakeholders.</li> <li><strong>An AI-first mindset backed by action.</strong> AI Fluency Level 4, or equivalent hands-on experience: you’ve built AI tools, systems or standards that changed how a team operates, and you can show us what you built, who uses it and what changed.</li> </ul> <h4>Even better if you have</h4> <ul> <li>Experience in hospitality or hotel technology, with an understanding of the challenges hotel operators face.</li> <li>Experience working in a matrix organisation, collaborating with shared teams and influencing stakeholders across regions.</li> </ul> <h4>How we think about AI</h4> <p>This role requires <strong>AI Fluency Level 4</strong>. That means going beyond using AI tools yourself. You’ve built systems, standards or ways of working that others rely on, you coach others on the craft, and you decide what the region acts on when AI flags patterns across it, keeping human oversight in place where it matters.</p> <p><em>For more information on AI fluency at Mews, please refer to <a href="https://mews.atlassian.net/wiki/external/YWI5ZGUyMGQ3MjU2NGRmNjlkZGEyYTg2NTVmZGE0OTU">AI Fluency at Mews: A Comprehensive Guide for Candidates</a> on Confluence.</em></p> <h4>Why this role matters</h4> <p>We believe the best customer experience comes from shared ownership of the whole journey. As Head of Region, you’ll make that real shaping not just how we grow, but how we deliver for our customers.</p> <p data-pm-slice="1 1 []"><strong>Please note:</strong> This role is open to both internal and external candidates. Internal applications are already being considered, and both processes will run in parallel. All candidates will be assessed fairly against the requirements of the role.</p> <p> </p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">Spain</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€84.500</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>€121.500 EUR</span></div></div><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">UK</div><div class="pay-range"><span>£91,500</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>£118,500 GBP</span></div></div><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">Netherlands</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€103.500</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>€125.000 EUR</span></div></div><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">France</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€105.000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>€141.000 EUR</span></div></div><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">Germany</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€115.500</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>€155.000 EUR</span></div></div><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">Sweden</div><div class="pay-range"><span>983 500 kr</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>1 662 000 kr SEK</span></div></div><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">Ireland</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€103.500</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>€132.000 EUR</span></div></div><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">Italy</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€80.000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>€102.000 EUR</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>Pay Transparency at Mews</strong></h4> <p>Salary ranges are provided in good faith and reflect current market conditions and internal pay structures. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:</p></div><p>You will own the agents, skills and standards that let a tribe of product builders move quickly on payments without the architecture fragmenting. Hotels take payments across regions and through providers that each behave differently, and Payment Interfaces exists to give customers one coherent payment experience on top of several PSPs. Embedded payments at this depth is rare among European SaaS companies, so the problems here are ones few engineers get to work on.</p> <p>You will be a Staff Engineer in the Payment Interfaces team, part of the Fintech tribe. You will report to the Director of Product and Engineering, sit in the tribe’s leadership group, and work alongside product builders, other staff engineers and product managers. No one reports to you, so your influence comes from the architecture, tools and standards that other people choose to work in.</p> <p>The team integrates several PSPs depending on region and conditions. When integrations drift apart, builders slow down and quality suffers. This role exists to keep them coherent by encoding what good looks like into tools and agents, so every builder meets the standard by default.</p> <h4><strong>What you would do</strong> </h4> <ul> <li>Own the tribe’s engineering agents, skills and context, and encode architectural standards, review logic and quality gates into them so the standard is met by default.</li> <li>Build an AI first responder for customer tickets about payment issues, with clear rules for when it answers and when it hands over to a person.</li> <li>Stay hands-on for the hardest technical problems: migrations, system-wide refactors and long-lived architecture decisions across PSP integrations.</li> <li>Keep Payment Interfaces integrations coherent as PSPs and regional requirements change, collaborating with builders who own their own work.</li> <li>Coach builders and fix off-standard outcomes at the cause, so the lesson sticks.</li> </ul> <p><strong>AI Fluency Level 4:</strong> in this role, that means you build the AI systems the tribe works in, not only use them. You design the agents, skills and evaluations that builders rely on every day, make the engineering decisions about how they behave, and set the rules for when an AI answer can stand and when a person must step in.</p> <p><em>For more information on AI fluency at Mews, please refer to “<a href="https://mews.atlassian.net/wiki/external/YWI5ZGUyMGQ3MjU2NGRmNjlkZGEyYTg2NTVmZGE0OTU">AI Fluency at Mews: processors.</li> <li>Deep engineering craft and architectural judgment, including a sense of what is worth codifying and what is a one-off.</li> <li>AI Fluency Level 4 or the equivalent hands-on experience: you have built agents, skills, evaluations or tooling that other engineers use, and you can explain where human oversight stays non-negotiable.</li> <li>A systems mindset that turns hard-won knowledge into reusable architecture and tooling rather than documentation.</li> <li>Comfort with influence as your main way of getting things done, working with builders, product managers,
