title: Senior Software Engineer, Inference Performance
description: <h3>About Tensordyne </h3> <p>AI is transforming our world. It can perform cognitive functions that previously only humans could do, such as perceiving interactions across different modalities and environments - with the ability to quickly learn and then solve complex problems. Tensordyne is an AI system solution company that builds very high-performance, low-power generative AI inference systems. Our mission, through the creation of custom silicon, hardware and software, is to enable multimodal Generative AI inference acceleration at scale, with safe, sustainable, high-performance systems for our hyperscaler and neocloud data center customers. We are at the leading edge of advancing the latest research and product improvements for generative Al inference solutions that will make Al even more advantageous for compelling new generative AI applications.Tensordyne is a well funded, fast-paced startup company with headquarters in both Sunnyvale, CA, and Munich, Germany. We also have many talented team members working remotely across North America and Europe. We take care of our people and their families with comprehensive benefits, competitive compensation, flexible spending options, and recognition programs, because building category-defining technology starts with a healthy, supported team. Come join us as we shape the future of multimodal generative artificial intelligence!</p> <h3>The role</h3> <p>You’ll build the software stack that takes a model from code down to the hardware: the abstractions, kernels, libraries, and tools that engineers and agents use to reach peak performance. Help optimize the latest AI models on our silicon.</p> <p>Our hardware is designed to be straightforward to program, so the goal is not to hide it. The goal is to expose the right level of control at each layer, from our compiler-driven Python SDK to our low-level Rust programming stack, and to make every performance gap measurable and every fix permanent.</p> <p>We’re looking for a builder who understands hardware deeply and develops with agents by default. You’ll own substantial parts of one of these layers and work closely with engineers across models, compilers, runtime, and hardware. Your focus is performance: where cycles, bandwidth, and communication go, and how to win them back. Number formats and model accuracy are owned by our conversion and emulation team; you’ll partner with them where precision and speed meet.</p> <h3>What you’ll do</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Build the stack.</strong> Design APIs, kernel abstractions, and libraries in our Python SDK or Rust stack so model engineers and agents can reach high performance at the layer that fits their problem.</li> <li><strong>Make models fast.</strong> Take priority workloads, from LLMs to multimodal models, to peak performance on real silicon. Profile, find the bottleneck across kernels, compiler, runtime, and parallelism, and fix it at the right layer.</li> <li><strong>Close the gap between model and measurement.</strong> Compare measured performance against analytical models and simulation. Explain every material gap, and turn the explanation into a fix or a better model.</li> <li><strong>Build the agentic performance loop.</strong> Give agents the profilers, traces, counters, and benchmark harnesses to form a hypothesis, change code, and measure the result in minutes. Make the results trustworthy enough to act on.</li> <li><strong>Set the bar for performance.</strong> Define how we measure, track regressions, and report results.</li> <li><strong>Build for the next chip.</strong> Design abstractions that carry forward to future hardware generations. Work with hardware architects to test how architectural choices affect real workloads.</li> </ul> <h3>What we need from you</h3> <ul> <li><strong>You understand hardware performance.</strong> You’ve optimized AI workloads on GPUs or custom accelerators and can reason about compute utilization, memory hierarchy, latency hiding, synchronization, and multi-chip scaling.</li> <li><strong>You build excellent software.</strong> You’ve owned substantial systems from design through production. You’re strong in Python and/or at least one systems language such as Rust, C++, or C, and rigorous about interfaces, abstractions, and testing. We care about engineering quality more than a specific language.</li> <li><strong>You understand LLM inference end to end.</strong> You can read a new model’s implementation and reason about prefill, decode, attention variants, KV caches, MoE, and parallelism, and how they map to compute, memory, and communication.</li> <li><strong>You build with agents.</strong> Agentic development is how you work, not an experiment. You’d rather build the loop that finds the optimization than find it by hand, and you know when the loop still needs a human.</li> <li><strong>You build things others succeed with.</strong> You’ve designed APIs, libraries, or performance tooling that other engineers adopted.</li> <li><strong>You drive problems to resolution.</strong> You form clear hypotheses, measure, and follow the evidence across software and hardware boundaries. You take ownership of the result.</li> </ul> <p>If you hit a few of those boxes, we’d like to speak to you.</p> <h3>We’d be thrilled if you had</h3> <ul> <li>Experience with embedded, bare-metal, or low-level runtime programming.</li> <li>Experience with MLIR, other compiler frameworks, or kernel DSLs such as Triton, Pallas, NKI, or CuTe.</li> <li>Contributions to LLM serving stacks such as vLLM or SGLang, or a track record of taking end-to-end inference workloads to competitive performance on a hardware target.</li> </ul> <h3>Why join us</h3> <p>Your code will decide how fast models run on our hardware, and how easy it is for the next engineer, or the next agent, to make them faster. You’ll own a layer of a new programming model, work directly with the people designing the hardware, and see your decisions tested on real silicon and carried into the next generation.</p> <h3>Tensordyne Values</h3> <ul> <li>Think big. Pursue ambitious technical and business goals.</li> <li>Aim for excellence. Quality matters in everything we build and deliver.</li> <li>Own it and get it done. Take responsibility and drive results.</li> <li>Operate with integrity. Be direct, transparent, and respectful.</li> <li>Win as a team. Make the people around you more effective.</li> <li>Value different perspectives. The strongest teams challenge assumptions and bring diverse experience to difficult problems.</li> </ul> <p></p> <p><strong>Tensordyne is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams are better equipped to solve complex problems and build exceptional technology. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, race, religion, pregnancy, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.</strong></p> <p><strong>A note to recruitment agencies: Please do not contact Tensordyne employees or leaders regarding this role. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and are not responsible for fees associated with unsolicited submissions.</strong></p> <p> </p> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Software Engineer - Quicksilver - Distributed Key Value
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3>Available Locations</h3> <ul> <li>Atlanta, US</li> <li>Austin, US</li> <li>Denver, US</li> <li>New York, US</li> <li>Seattle, US</li> <li>Washington DC, US</li> <li>Amsterdam, Netherlands</li> <li>London, UK</li> </ul> <p><strong>Applications will be accepted until November 19, 2026.</strong></p> <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>Quicksilver is Cloudflare’s globally distributed key-value store. It replicates our data all around the world, over tens of thousands of servers and over 500 data centers. It handles all kinds of network conditions and serves billions of keys per second. In this role, you can expect to see challenges like unexpected network issues, hardware failures, kernel bugs and still have to deliver the data to the edge in a fast and reliable way. Along with the rest of the team, you will own and support the whole stack: the code base, the unit and integration test, deployment and rollback plans, operations, monitoring, alerting, debugging and on-call. Quicksilver is written in Go and C. If working at this scale excites you and you are intrigued by very tricky bugs, rather than being scared by them, you might be a match for this role.</p> <p>This role may require flexibility to be on-call outside of standard working hours to address technical issues as needed.</p> <h4><strong>What you'll do</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Work on our distributed large scale key-value store, you will write new features in Go and reviewing pull request</li> <li>Improve performance, CPU, memory usage, etc.</li> <li>Improve our monitoring and our tools, all written in Go</li> <li>Help with debugging and investigating hard to reproduce problems</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:</strong></h4> <ul> <li>You have previous experience writing robust systems, code quality, performance and technical debt. You understand the tradeoffs that doing rigorous engineering requires.</li> <li>You have proven experience with storage systems, peer to peer systems, large scale distributed systems or simply system programming in general.</li> <li>You have previous experience of chasing problems through multiple layers of our software stack. You can be flexible and you are very curious.</li> <li>You are flexible and very autonomous. You won’t be micromanaged in this role and will be looked to have experience thinking out of the box and coming up with simple and smart designs for complex issues.</li> <li>You have a previous track record of being pragmatic and believe in the value of simple solutions.</li> <li>You equally enjoy low-level and high-level programming. You have a taste for programming languages.</li> <li>You enjoy being a part of a team that challenges each other's designs -- you are good at taking and giving constructive criticism with a goal of producing the best solution.</li> <li>You are not afraid of engaging in outages on anti-social hours.</li> </ul> <h3>Compensation</h3> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>For Colorado based hires: Estimated annual salary of $168,000 - $231,000</li> <li>For New York City based hires: Estimated annual salary of $185,000 - $254,000</li> <li>For Washington based hires: Estimated annual salary of $185,000 - $254,000</li> <li>For Washington DC based hires: Estimated annual salary of $185,000 - $254,000</li> </ul> <h3>Equity</h3> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare's equity plan.</p> <h3>Benefits</h3> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time Off</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. description: About Airwallex Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. Multi-product cross-sell experience across cards, spend, FX, billing or embedded finance. Experience working with multi-entity or international customers. You're not selling a feature. You're helping founders and finance leaders replace fragmented financial operations with one global system that actually scales. You get real autonomy to create value, build relationships, and move opportunities forward. Hire, manage, coach, and develop a high-performing regional partner sales and development team. Set individual and team goals, provide regular feedback, manage performance, and support career growth. A track record of owning regional or segment-level business outcomes and delivering measurable pipeline, revenue, and customer growth through partners. Demonstrated direct people management experience in partner sales, enterprise sales, alliances, or a related GTM function, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and team development. Deep familiarity with cloud providers, global systems integrators, consulting firms, or technology partner ecosystems, and an understanding of how their field organizations sell and deliver. Experience creating opportunities and leading complex partnerships or customer engagements from discovery and qualification through commercial execution, launch, adoption, and expansion. Strong enterprise sales fundamentals, including account planning, opportunity qualification, stakeholder mapping, negotiation, pipeline management, and forecasting. The ability to earn trust with Sales leaders, partner executives, technical teams, and peers, and to resolve disagreements constructively in a matrixed organization. description: About the Team OpenAI’s Applied AI Engineering team helps organizations turn frontier AI capabilities into safe, reliable, and high-impact production systems. You will combine deep technical judgment, hands-on engineering, and customer leadership to take ambitious ideas from workflow and use-case selection through prototyping, evaluation, production rollout, and scaled adoption. You will help customers make technical decisions involving model behavior, agentic workflows, developer environments, security, reliability, evaluation, and operational readiness, while ensuring deployments translate into measurable improvements in engineering productivity and software delivery. You will work closely with OpenAI Product, Research, Engineering, Security, Sales, and the broader Codex organization, translating real-world deployment experience into high-signal product and model feedback. title: Inside Sales Representative
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: London, the UK</strong></p> <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>The Inside Sales Representative (ISR) is a critical sales role responsible for driving high-volume, high-velocity net new business acquisition sales in a remote selling model within the commercial segment across EMEA, specifically META. Operating as full-cycle territory owners similar to an AE, ISR manages the end-to-end sales process from self-sourcing pipeline, qualifying opportunities and closing deals in partnership with SE and Partner Organisation.</p> <h4><strong>What you'll do</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Build your own pipeline:</strong> Find new business across your assigned territory (META) through high-volume outreach by phone, email, LinkedIn and social selling, using tools like Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo and AI outreach</li> <li><strong>Run the whole sales cycle remotely:</strong> Lead discovery and qualification calls using MEDDPIC, give engaging virtual presentations and live product demos, and negotiate and close new business against an ACV quota.</li> <li><strong>Explain the value of Cloudflare's platform:</strong> Connect commercial-segment customers' business and technical problems to the right Cloudflare products, such as Application Security and Performance, Zero Trust/SASE and the Developer Platform, and show the value they'd get.</li> <li><strong>Work closely with other teams:</strong> Partner with Solutions Engineers on technical validation, and with the Partner Organisation to co-sell and close deals faster. Work with Marketing and BDR teammates on campaigns and events that create pipeline.</li> <li><strong>Run your territory with data:</strong> Keep your Salesforce pipeline accurate and your forecasts reliable, track your activity and conversion numbers, and use what you learn to consistently meet or exceed your targets</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:</strong></h4> <ul> <li>1 - 3 years of experience in a sales role, preferably in SaaS or tech sales, such as: </li> <ul> <li>BDR/SDR background with strong outbound experience in a high-paced environment</li> <li>SMB or Transactional sales experience with high volume, high velocity sales motion</li> </ul> <li>Strong track record of meeting or exceeding quota </li> <li>Strong discovery and qualification skills using frameworks like BANT, MEDDIC </li> <li>Excellent presentation and interpersonal communication skills (verbal and written) as well as time management skill</li> <li>Experience using CRM like Salesforce, outbound/prospecting sales tools (e.g. LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Salesforce Sales Engagement Outreach etc)</li> <li>Tech-savvy and technically curious - quick to learn technical products, comfortable to run live demos independently, data-driven mindset  </li> <li>Highly accountable and self-driven, customer-centric individuals</li> <li>Multilingual abilities (depending on the coverage regions)</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: hbo-stage Bedrijfskunde: Digitalisering en Procesoptimalisatie van communicatie
description: hbo- afstudeerstage, vanaf februari 2027 Ben jij die enthousiaste hbo-student die het leuk vindt om organisatievraagstukken te onderzoeken en processen te verbeteren? Dit is jouw uitdaging Het Centraal Bureau voor de Statistiek (CBS) wil het gebruik van papieren post verminderen en de mogelijkheden voor digitale communicatie verder uitbreiden. Dit geldt zowel voor de communicatie met bedrijven als met personen. Tijdens deze stage richt je je specifiek op de communicatie met individuele onderzoekspersonen. Op dit moment benadert het CBS onderzoekspersonen in eerste instantie vrijwel altijd via een brief op het huisadres. Digitale communicatie, bijvoorbeeld via e-mail, biedt kansen om dit proces efficiënter, flexibeler en toekomstbestendiger in te richten. Er lopen binnen het CBS al verschillende initiatieven om meer gebruik te maken van e-mailadressen, maar er zijn ook nog belangrijke vraagstukken die onderzocht moeten worden. Denk bijvoorbeeld aan de volgende vragen: Hoe kan het CBS op een effectieve manier e-mailadressen van onderzoekspersonen verzamelen en beheren? Welke juridische en privacyvoorwaarden gelden voor het opbouwen en gebruiken van een e-maildatabase? Welke technische aanpassingen en voorzieningen zijn nodig om digitale communicatie mogelijk te maken? Hoe moeten de bestaande werkprocessen worden aangepast om digitale communicatie goed te ondersteunen? Hoe kunnen we ervoor zorgen dat onderzoekspersonen op een toegankelijke en betrouwbare manier digitaal benaderd worden? Samen met het Waarneeminnovatie Team en collega's van de afdeling Dataverzameling ga je dit vraagstuk onderzoeken. Je brengt de huidige situatie in kaart, onderzoekt mogelijkheden voor verbetering en werkt toe naar concrete aanbevelingen voor het CBS. Dit is jouw stageplek bij CBS Heerlen Je gaat aan de slag in het Team Waarneeminnovatie. Dit team valt binnen de afdeling Dataverzameling. We zijn een jong, divers en vooral enthousiast team dat als doel heeft de waarneming van het CBS te vernieuwen en te verbeteren. Dit breng jij mee Je volgt een hbo-opleiding Bedrijfskunde of een soortgelijke opleiding. Je hebt interesse in procesoptimalisatie, digitalisering en organisatieverandering. Je bent nieuwsgierig, onderzoekend en neemt graag initiatief. Je vindt het leuk om met verschillende betrokkenen binnen een organisatie in gesprek te gaan. Je hebt een proactieve, positieve en assertieve houding en denkt in oplossingen, staat open voor feedback en gaat uitdagingen met enthousiasme aan. Omdat tijdens de stage alle communicatie – zowel mondeling als schriftelijk – in het Nederlands plaatsvindt, is een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal noodzakelijk. Dit kun je van ons verwachten Een fijne leeromgeving waarin je: samen met ervaren vakmensen bestaande processen analyseert en verbeterkansen herkent; zelfstandig een praktijkgericht onderzoek of experiment opzet; aan de slag gaat met het in kaart brengen van verschillende organisatorische, juridische en technische belangen en randvoorwaarden rondom digitale communicatie; leert om onderzoeksresultaten te vertalen naar concrete, onderbouwde en uitvoerbare aanbevelingen voor het CBS. Voor jouw inzet ontvang je een stagevergoeding van € 800,- bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur per week). Samen met je stagebegeleider stem je af hoe je hybride kunt werken, met flexibele werktijden en de optie om deels vanuit huis aan jouw stageopdracht te werken. Dit zijn onze voorwaarden Het betreft een stageopdracht en geen werkervaringsplek. Voordat je aan de stage begint verwachten we dat je vanuit de onderwijsinstelling een stagebegeleider hebt, waarmee de stage is afgestemd en concrete leerdoelen zijn afgesproken. Deze stageopdracht is bedoeld voor studenten die momenteel staan ingeschreven bij een onderwijsinstelling; afgestudeerden komen niet in aanmerking. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Backend Developer (Python, Java)

title: HYROX Nutrition Activation Manager (m/f/d)
description: HYROX is a global sports event series that combines running and functional fitness training in a unique race format. Founded in Germany in 2017, HYROX has evolved into a worldwide fitness movement with events across five continents, attracting millions of athletes every season. We are building the premier global fitness racing brand, empowering people of all backgrounds to train and compete together. As HYROX Nutrition Activation Manager (m/f/d), you will be the driving force behind bringing our sports nutrition category to life directly on the global race floor! You will lead the charge in planning and executing high-energy event activations, immersive sampling setups, and live consumer touchpoints that fuel our athletes and captivate thousands of spectators worldwide. If you thrive in fast-paced event environments, love building unforgettable brand experiences, and want to own our global field activation strategy, this is your arena! YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Event Activation & On-Site Execution: Plan, direct, and execute all HYROX Nutrition category activations, store setups, and sampling stations across key regional markets, prioritizing European events as the foundation for broader international expansion. Manage end-to-end event logistics for the nutrition brand, including inventory, booth infrastructure, branding assets, and supplier coordination. Lead on-site staff during event weekends to ensure high-energy execution, perfect brand presence, and excellent customer engagement. Sampling & Engagement Strategy: Develop and optimize targeted sampling strategies to maximize product trial, consumer education, and conversion among athletes and spectators. Create interactive, high-impact activation concepts that drive product sales, social media buzz, and direct-to-consumer (D2C) lead generation during events. Coordinate on-site influencer and ambassador activations in close alignment with the HYROX Nutrition Marketing Manager and wider marketing team. Stakeholder & Partner Coordination: Serve as the main point of contact on-site for external brand partners and sponsors participating in HYROX Nutrition event activations. Work in close cross-functional collaboration with internal departments (Direct Sales, Operations, Partnerships) to ensure smooth event delivery. Coordinate with venue teams and local suppliers to meet safety, layout, and operational requirements. Budget & Process Management : Manage, track, and optimize the allocated activation budget for all event-related nutrition initiatives. Streamline event preparation workflows, tools, and timelines using project management platforms (e.g., Monday.com). Evaluate post-event performance through KPI tracking (sampling volume, sales conversion, lead capture) to continuously refine future event setups. YOUR PROFILE Experience: 3+ years of hands-on experience in event marketing, experiential marketing, or field activation, ideally within Sports Nutrition, FMCG, Fitness, or Lifestyle brands. Event & Onsite Expertise: Strong track record in planning and executing large-scale live event activations, pop-ups, or trade show setups from concept to tear-down. Hands-On Leadership: Energetic personality with proven experience leading on-site teams, brand ambassadors, and event personnel in high-tempo event environments. Logistics & Organization: Process-driven with strong operational skills; experienced in managing project workflows (e.g., Monday.com) and managing event budgets. Flexibility & Travel: High flexibility and readiness to travel frequently for weekend event execution across key markets. Languages: Business-fluent English skills (written and spoken) are required; German or additional languages are a plus. WHAT WE OFFER The opportunity to take on responsibility in a fast-growing, international company with a strong sports DNA. Flat hierarchies, quick decision-making processes, and plenty of room for your ideas. A motivated, international team with a genuine passion for sports and events. A healthy work-life balance thanks to flexible, trust-based working hours. A modern office in a top location – right in Hamburg Altona with excellent transport connections. 28 vacation days to recharge and reset. A Wellpass membership and discounted lunch options in-house. Your Deutschlandticket is fully covered by us – nationwide mobility, 100% on us. Employee discounts in our HYROX stores. INTERESTED? Then we look forward to receiving your application. Simply upload your CV as a PDF (no photo required) and answer the questions in the application form. Your contact person is Lotte (HYROX People). We are committed to creating an inclusive and respectful work environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to ethnicity, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, or any other protected characteristic. We value diversity and are committed to fostering equal opportunity for all. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Software Engineer, Cloudflare Queues
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Available Locations: Austin, TX | New York, NY | San Francisco, CA | Lisbon, Portugal OR London, UK</strong></h3> <div class="flex-1 overflow-y-auto"> <div class="mx-auto max-w-3xl px-4 py-4"> <div> <div data-index="3"> <div class="pb-5"> <div class="flex justify-start"> <div class="max-w-[85%] min-w-0 space-y-1.5"> <div class="prose-chat text-sm text-foreground"> <div class="doc-section"> <h3>About the role</h3> <p class="doc-paragraph">Emerging Technologies & Incubation (ETI) is where new and bold products are built and released within Cloudflare. Rather than being constrained by the structures which make Cloudflare a massively successful business, we are able to leverage them to deliver entirely new tools and products to our customers. Cloudflare’s edge and network make it possible to solve problems at massive scale and efficiency which would be impossible for almost any other organization.</p> <p class="doc-paragraph">The <a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/queues/"><strong>Cloudflare Queues</strong></a> team builds a managed, global message queuing service for developers. Queues allows customers to send, buffer, and reliably deliver messages between Workers with at-least-once delivery, batching, and configurable delivery guarantees, without managing infrastructure or paying bandwidth egress fees. Deeply integrated with Cloudflare Workers, Queues supports event-driven and asynchronous applications across the Developer Platform. Generally available since September 2024, Queues runs at global scale on Cloudflare’s edge network and is a foundational building block for event-driven and asynchronous applications.</p> <p class="doc-paragraph">In this role, you will help design and build <a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/queues/"><strong>Cloudflare Queues</strong></a>, improving reliability, performance, and delivery guarantees while shipping new features at global scale. You will own your work from design through release and contribute across the software stack. This role is AI-first, and you will be expected to use AI tools thoughtfully throughout the development lifecycle without compromising security, reliability, or quality.</p> </div> <div class="doc-section"> <h3>Responsibilities</h3> <ul class="doc-bullets"> <li>Design and build Cloudflare Queues as part of Cloudflare’s developer platform.</li> <li>Maintain and improve a global-scale message queuing service.</li> <li>Ship new features and product improvements.</li> <li>Improve reliability, performance, and delivery guarantees.</li> <li>Own code from inception through release.</li> <li>Work across all layers of the software stack.</li> <li>Write design documents to propose and communicate solutions.</li> <li>Improve message buffering and delivery behavior.</li> <li>Improve producer and consumer scalability under load.</li> <li>Debug and fix user-facing bugs.</li> <li>Use AI tools responsibly throughout development.</li> </ul> </div> <div class="doc-section"> <h3>Desirable skills, Knowledge & Experience</h3> <ul class="doc-bullets"> <li>4+ years of experience with distributed systems and data.</li> <li>Experience using AI-assisted development tools across the software development lifecycle.</li> <li>Strong judgment for when to rely on AI tools and when to validate independently.</li> <li>Strong ownership of correctness, security, and quality.</li> <li>Willingness to share knowledge and mentor others.</li> <li>Excellent oral and written communication skills.</li> <li>Ability to document complex ideas clearly and concisely.</li> <li>Solid understanding of TypeScript/JavaScript.</li> <li>Strong systems-level programming skills.</li> <li>Understanding of security issues and responsibilities.</li> <li>Experience monitoring, alerting, and debugging high-volume production systems.</li> <li>Experience with continuous integration workflows and git.</li> <li>Ability to analyze data sets such as logs.</li> <li>Experience designing and building APIs.</li> <li>Commitment to continuous learning and improvement.</li> </ul> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <h3>Compensation</h3> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>F<span data-sheets-root="1">or Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $194,000 - $266,000</span></li> <li>For New York City, New Jersey, Washington, Washington DC, and California (excluding Bay Area) based hires: Estimated annual salary of $185,000 - $254,000</li> </ul> <p data-path-to-node="1">● For Portugal based hires: Estimated annual salary is between €66,000 - €91,000.</p> <ul data-path-to-node="2"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="2,0,0">The final offer will be inclusive of time exemption, in alignment with the applicable law and collective bargaining agreements.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Equity</h3> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <h3>Benefits</h3> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <h3>Health & Welfare Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <h3>Financial Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <h3>Time Off</h3> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style=

title: Field Marketing Specialist
description: About Dust Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it. With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done. With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast. We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026. Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50 . This Role The French market is one of Dust’s most important growth levers, and the Marketing team plays a central role in supporting pipeline generation through events, content and account-based activations. As field marketing specialist, France, you will be the execution owner for Dust’s local Marketing activities. Working closely with the France Marketing Lead, you will turn defined priorities into high-quality events, localized webinars, social media, content and partner marketing activations that support Sales, BDRs and pipeline generation. The France Marketing Lead owns the strategy, budget, programme selection and priorities. You will own execution, coordination, content delivery and continuous improvement across the French Marketing motion. You will be part of a growing Marketing team across the US, UK and France, managed by the Global Head of Marketing. Key Responsibilities Own the execution of the French event and webinar programme Execute conferences, Dust-owned events and localized webinars selected and scoped by the France Marketing Lead. Coordinate the preparation, stakeholders, content, landing pages and logistics needed for a smooth delivery. Work closely with Sales and BDRs to prepare target accounts, follow-up plans and event-related content. Collect feedback, measure performance and document learnings after each activity. Own French social media and content activation Own social media execution for Dust around events, campaigns and key French-market topics. Support AEs with relevant content and messaging for their LinkedIn activity. Coordinate with Global Marketing, Product, Customer Success, Design and external media partners to deliver relevant content for French enterprise audiences. Turn events, customer conversations and market insights into reusable content, including customer stories, blog posts, videos, YouTube content and Sales assets. Support partner marketing and Growth programmes Provide execution and logistical support for regional partner marketing activities within the strategy, selection and budget defined by the France Marketing Lead. Support Growth with French-market content for ABM, webinars and paid campaigns. Produce or reformat assets such as e-books, landing pages, customer content and campaign materials. Connect event, content and partner marketing activities to target account engagement and pipeline generation. Coordinate cross-functional Marketing initiatives Identify opportunities to automate repetitive Marketing tasks , Build Dust agents and workflows to support research, event preparation, content repurposing, Sales enablement, reporting and follow-up. Requirements 3+ years of experience in B2B Marketing , ideally across Field Marketing, Event Marketing, Content Marketing or Product Marketing, preferably in SaaS or technology. End-to-end event ownership with the ability to plan and deliver conferences, executive events and Dust-owned events, from preparation through execution and post-event follow-up. Strong content and social media skills with experience creating or repurposing content for enterprise audiences across social media, landing pages, customer stories, YouTube, Sales enablement and executive LinkedIn profiles. Commercial and pipeline mindset with a clear understanding of how events, content and account-based activities support Sales, BDRs, direct pipeline and partner-led growth. Excellent communication skills in French and English , both written and spoken. You can write clearly and accurately, adapt your tone to different audiences and communicate credibly with enterprise executives. Generalist and hands-on approach . You are comfortable moving between event ownership, content creation, Sales preparation, webinars, campaign assets and operational coordination. Strong organisational skills and attention to detail . You anticipate needs, manage deadlines reliably and ensure that projects, events and content are properly prepared before launch. Self-starter mentality . You take initiative, make decisions, solve problems and own outcomes rather than waiting to be told what to do. Strong cross-functional collaboration skills . You know how to find and coordinate the right people across Marketing, Sales, BDRs, Customer Success, Partnerships and external partners. Nice to have: Experience marketing to French enterprise or CAC 40 audiences, working with agencies or media partners, supporting paid campaigns, producing webinars or video content, and working with tools such as HubSpot, Google Workspace and Figma. Location and travel: Based in Paris, comfortable working on-site and willing to travel occasionally for events in France. What Makes This Role Unique Direct pipeline impact: Your work will directly support Sales and BDRs through events, content and ABM activations. Execution ownership in France: You will turn the priorities defined by the France Marketing Lead into high-quality events, content, social media and partner marketing activations in France. AI-native Marketing: You will use Dust to automate research, preparation, content production, reporting and follow-up. Generalist scope: The role combines events, content, social media, webinars, Sales enablement and ABM. Market-shaping opportunity: Help establish Dust as a leading voice in the French enterprise and agentic AI market. Location We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together. We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect. title: Inbound Sales 🇫🇷
description: Health can’t wait . Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. ⚡ The Inbound Sales 🇫🇷 role We're growing our Inbound Sales team in France. Our Inbound Sales team is in charge of closing inbound requests from leads with 1 to 5 employees (Independent workers, very small companies, individuals). You’ll be in charge of the whole sales cycle from qualification to closing by educating prospects and providing inspiring arguments to transform them into convinced customers. At the same time, we expect you to understand, embrace and apply the Alan Smart & Soft selling method . This method stems from the concept that the prospect experience is an inseparable piece of the overall Alan customer experience. You are expected to make this experience pleasant, instructive and delightful by leveraging the most relevant messaging and materials (Smart) and by defining the high-touch strategy that suits best each prospect (Soft). We also expect you to look at the big picture and help us grow and improve as a company. For that, you’ll have to be real team players even beyond your role. You’ll be expected to challenge us to improve our product(s), our methods, and our strategy, and get involved in other projects and initiatives relevant to growing our customer base. What does make this role exciting : You will close deals every single day of the year, which is very stimulating! The Inbound Sales team is quite recent: You will contribute to building a new practice within the Sales Community, getting involved in tooling and process improvements You will help building the playbook of best practices to close deals in one shot You will contribute to making our products even better by sharing feedback and improving the self-serve experience for our members You will become an insurance expert and learn to master our products in order to confidently answer questions & objections from prospects We invest heavily in AI to transform the Sales practice. You'll have the opportunity to become one of the most modern Sales professionals in the market! ⭐ You will be a great fit for this role if you: Have 1-2 years of experience in a Sales role including closing experience Have full working proficiency in French (C2 and above), and advanced level in English Are highly organized with exceptional follow-up skills Show a great balance between Active Listening and Assertiveness when interacting with your prospects Have natural empathy and are passionate about understanding and solving prospects' problems Have a positive attitude and ability to collaborate in a small team Have a desire to learn fast and make an impact from day 1 Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz. For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the A2-B1 level range . Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team. 🙌 Perks & Benefits At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. Therefore, we offer: Fair rewards . Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only. Flexible office with hybrid setup . Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz. All the tools you need . Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones. Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours . Organize your time as you wish. Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only). Transport . Generous transit benefit Learning & Training opportunities . A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises. Personal growth through coaching : At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture . Parental leave . Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only. Important note: we hire people not roles. After reading this job description, if you feel like you don’t have all the necessary prerequisites but that it matches where you are now or what you'd like to grow into in your next position, we encourage you to apply ! Not everybody will enter our recruitment process, but all, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success. 🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium , blog and Glassdoor page for more info. description: De afdeling Lenen, Sparen en Retailbeleggen (LSR) houdt toezicht op financiële producten en diensten voor consumenten, zoals hypotheken, kredieten, sparen, betalen en beleggen. We zorgen dat informatie duidelijk is en dat online dienstverlening goed toegankelijk is. Samen zorgen we dat het klantbelang centraal staat, vooral voor kwetsbare groepen. Ons toezicht richt zich op het herkennen en aanpakken van risico’s voor consumenten. We willen dit zo snel en effectief mogelijk doen. Om meer impact te maken, gebruiken we data op een slimme manier. Daarbij zoeken we continu naar signalen, toetsen we aannames en brengen we risico’s en mogelijke blinde vlekken in beeld. Zo kunnen we sneller inspelen op veranderingen in de financiële sector. De vraagstukken waar je aan werkt zijn vaak nieuw, complex en actueel. Denk aan risico’s rond Buy Now Pay Later, online beleggingsplatformen, AI-toepassingen of ontwikkelingen in de cryptomarkt. Jouw analyses dragen direct bij aan keuzes die de AFM maakt in haar toezicht. Dit ga je doen: Samenwerken met toezichthouders om risico’s voor consumenten tijdig te signaleren. Ontwikkelen van dataproducten die inzichten vertalen naar gerichte acties. Implementeren van betrouwbare en schaalbare oplossingen voor effectiever toezicht. Visualiseren van resultaten in dashboards die toezichthouders ondersteunen. Kansen signaleren om processen slimmer in te richten en repetitief werk te automatiseren. Experimenteren met nieuwe technieken zoals AI om toezicht slimmer, sneller en effectiever te maken. Team Team Data Analyse & Innovatie is één van de vijf teams binnen de afdeling LSR. Dit team is verantwoordelijk voor het verder ontwikkelen en uitvoeren van de Datagedreven Toezicht Strategie (DGT) van LSR. Dit betekent dat het team toezichtsvragen vertaalt naar oplossingen met data. We bouwen aan een stevige basis en een duidelijke planning (roadmap) voor de hele afdeling. Ook helpt het team om data echt te gaan gebruiken in het toezicht. Zo kunnen we straks beter controleren of instellingen zich aan de regels houden, risico’s inschatten en slimme technologie zoals AI inzetten om ons werk sneller en efficiënter te maken. title: Senior Fullstack Developer .NET
description: Bij OrtaX, onderdeel van Centric, werk je aan software die gemeenten ondersteunt bij het efficiënt, betrouwbaar en transparant uitvoeren van het WOZ-proces. Onze ambitie gaat verder dan het onderhouden van bestaande software. We ontwikkelen OrtaX continu door en investeren daarbij in nieuwe technologie, data, automatisering en een toekomstbestendige architectuur. Als Senior Fullstack Developer speel je daarin een belangrijke rol. Je beweegt je vanzelfsprekend tussen frontend en backend, bouwt zelf mee aan nieuwe functionaliteit en helpt tegelijkertijd onze applicatie stap voor stap te moderniseren. Daarbij kijken we nadrukkelijk naar jou om technische richting en structuur te helpen aanbrengen . Niet door keuzes alleen te maken, maar juist door technische vraagstukken scherp te krijgen, verschillende perspectieven bij elkaar te brengen en samen met het team tot goede, gedragen oplossingen te komen. 1. Wat ga je doen? Als Senior Fullstack Developer werk je samen met developers, analisten en andere specialisten aan de verdere ontwikkeling van OrtaX. Je bent daarbij niet alleen verantwoordelijk voor je eigen code, maar kijkt ook naar de samenhang en kwaliteit van de oplossing als geheel. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: ontwikkelen van nieuwe backendfunctionaliteit in C#/.NET ; ontwerpen en ontwikkelen van frontendfunctionaliteit met één van de grote frontend frameworks ontwerpen en verbeteren van API's, integraties en dataoplossingen; maken van technische ontwerpen die frontend, backend en data met elkaar verbinden; schrijven en stimuleren van onderhoudbare, testbare en kwalitatief goede code; bijdragen aan CI/CD, automated testing en DevOps ; analyseren van complexe technische vraagstukken en deze vertalen naar pragmatische oplossingen; aanbrengen van technische structuur en bewaken van samenhang tussen verschillende onderdelen van de applicatie; richting geven aan architectuur- en ontwerpkeuzes en inzichtelijk maken van de consequenties van verschillende opties; begeleiden van technische discussies en ervoor zorgen dat kennis en ideeën van andere teamleden worden meegenomen; ondersteunen van collega-developers bij complexe technische vraagstukken; herkennen en bespreekbaar maken van technische schuld, risico's en mogelijkheden voor verbetering; stap voor stap moderniseren van bestaande onderdelen van OrtaX. Je werkt aan een volwassen product waarin continu de afweging wordt gemaakt tussen vandaag waarde leveren en bouwen aan de architectuur van morgen . Als senior developer help je het team om die afweging bewust te maken. Soms betekent dat investeren in een structurele technische verbetering, soms juist kiezen voor een pragmatische oplossing die past bij de situatie. 2. De technische uitdaging OrtaX heeft een bestaand softwarelandschap én een duidelijke moderniseringsopgave. Daardoor werk je niet alleen aan de vraag: “Hoe bouwen we deze feature?” maar juist ook aan vragen als: “Hoe past deze oplossing in de rest van onze architectuur?” “Welke keuze helpt ons niet alleen vandaag, maar ook over een paar jaar?” “Hoe voorkomen we dat verschillende onderdelen van de applicatie ieder hun eigen richting opgaan?” En misschien nog belangrijker: “Hoe komen we als team tot een technische keuze waar verschillende inzichten goed in zijn meegenomen?” Als Senior Fullstack Developer neem je hierin het voortouw. Je kunt een technisch vraagstuk structureren, alternatieven onderzoeken en een richting voorstellen. Tegelijkertijd begrijp je dat de beste technische oplossing zelden door één persoon wordt bedacht. Je zoekt actief de discussie met andere developers, luistert naar argumenten en gebruikt de expertise binnen het team om de uiteindelijke oplossing beter te maken. Bij OrtaX gebruiken we AI als een belangrijk hulpmiddel bij het ontwikkelproces. Daarbij geloven wij ook dat de developer verantwoordelijk is dat we goede code en een duidelijke architectuur opleveren. Ook op lange termijn willen we beschikken over een goed onderhoudbaar product. Daarbij is AI inmiddels een essentieel hulpmiddel, maar niet zonder input van de developer. Technisch leiderschap betekent bij ons dus niet bepalen wat anderen moeten bouwen, maar richting geven, structuur aanbrengen en het team helpen betere technische keuzes te maken. 3. Wie zoeken we? We zoeken een ervaren developer die zich daadwerkelijk thuis voelt aan beide kanten van de stack . Voor deze seniorrol zoeken we dus niet naar een backenddeveloper die af en toe frontendwerk doet, of andersom. Je hoeft niet overal dezelfde diepgang te hebben, maar je bent in staat om zelfstandig aan zowel frontend als backend te werken en kunt technische vraagstukken over de volledige keten overzien. Je: hebt een hbo- of wo-werk- en denkniveau op het gebied van Software Engineering, Informatica, Computer Science of een vergelijkbare richting; hebt ruime professionele ervaring met C# en .NET ; hebt ruime ervaring met moderne frontendontwikkeling en kunt zelfstandig werken met één van de grote frontend frameworks hebt ervaring met het ontwerpen en bouwen van API's en integraties; hebt gedegen kennis van databases en begrijpt hoe keuzes in de datalaag doorwerken naar backend en frontend; kunt technische oplossingen ontwerpen over meerdere lagen van een applicatie; hebt een goed begrip van softwarearchitectuur en kunt architectuurprincipes toepassen zonder de pragmatiek uit het oog te verliezen; hebt oog voor aspecten als onderhoudbaarheid, testbaarheid, performance, security en technische schuld; bent gewend te werken met CI/CD, automated testing en een Agile/Scrum-werkwijze; kunt complexe technische vraagstukken structureren en terugbrengen tot heldere keuzes; durft besluiten te nemen wanneer dat nodig is en kunt duidelijk uitleggen waarom een bepaalde richting wordt gekozen; staat tegelijkertijd open voor andere inzichten en bent bereid je eigen oplossing ter discussie te stellen; helpt minder ervaren developers groeien door kennis te delen, feedback te geven en samen naar oplossingen te zoeken; communiceert gemakkelijk met developers, analisten en andere collega's. Wat maakt jou senior? Voor ons zit senioriteit niet alleen in het aantal jaren ervaring of hoeveel technologieën je beheerst. We zoeken iemand die over de grenzen van een individuele feature heen kijkt . Je ziet patronen en afhankelijkheden, herkent wanneer een technische keuze gevolgen heeft voor andere onderdelen van het systeem en brengt structuur aan wanneer een vraagstuk complex wordt. Je bent bovendien iemand naar wie collega's toe kunnen stappen wanneer een technisch vraagstuk vastloopt. Niet omdat je altijd direct het antwoord hebt, maar omdat je kunt helpen om het probleem scherp te krijgen en gezamenlijk tot een goede oplossing te komen. Daarbij kun je leiden zonder alles zelf te willen bepalen . Je geeft richting wanneer dat nodig is, maar creëert ook ruimte voor discussie, andere ideeën en de expertise van je collega's. 4. Waarom OrtaX? OrtaX ondersteunt gemeenten en samenwerkingsverbanden bij het WOZ-proces en richt zich op consistente, uitlegbare waarderingen en slimme automatisering. Daarbij investeren we in technologieën zoals data-analyse, AI, automatisering en integratie. Je werkt daardoor aan software waarvan de maatschappelijke toepassing heel concreet is. Tegelijkertijd kom je in een omgeving waarin technisch nog veel te ontwikkelen en te moderniseren valt. Voor een Senior Fullstack Developer betekent dat dat je niet alleen aansluit bij een bestaande technische omgeving, maar daadwerkelijk invloed kunt hebben op hoe OrtaX zich technisch verder ontwikkelt . Je krijgt de ruimte om structuur aan te brengen, technische keuzes te helpen maken en verbeteringen in gang te zetten. Tegelijkertijd blijf je zelf dicht bij de techniek en bouw je mee aan de oplossingen die daaruit voortkomen. Je krijgt daarmee de combinatie van een volwassen product, een stevige technische moderniseringsopgave en de mogelijkheid om samen met het team de technische koers verder vorm te geven. 5. Wat bieden we jou? Het salaris ligt tussen € 5600,- en € 7200,- per maand (daarnaast ontvang je een variabele beloning, vaste 13e maand en 8% vakantiegeld), afhankelijk van je rol, competentieprofiel en ervaring. Verder bieden we je uitstekende voorwaarden, waaronder: deelname aan een goede pensioenregeling 27 vakantiedagen (gebaseerd op een fulltime contract) mogelijkheid om extra vakantiedagen te kopen Hybride werken vanuit huis en het kantoor in Amsterdam (uiteraard ben je welkom om elke dag op kantoor te werken) reiskostenvergoeding voor je dagelijkse woon-werkverkeer en evt. zakelijke reizen mogelijkheden om jezelf te ontwikkelen met een trainingsprogramma en wekelijkse onderzoeks- en kennisbijeenkomsten je start met een jaarcontract, daarna is er uitzicht op een vast contract, omdat we streven naar een langdurige samenwerking een prettige werkomgeving met enthousiaste en leuke collega's! 6. Over OrtaX OrtaX ondersteunt gemeenten en samenwerkingsverbanden bij het efficiënt, betrouwbaar en transparant uitvoeren van het WOZ-proces. De ambitie is om taxateurs te ondersteunen met slimme automatisering en tegelijkertijd te investeren in nieuwe technologie, procesautomatisering en integratie. Daarbij werken we niet alleen aan wat OrtaX vandaag nodig heeft, maar ook aan hoe het product er technisch morgen uit moet zien. Wil jij als Senior Fullstack Developer niet alleen aan OrtaX bouwen, maar ook helpen bepalen hóé we verder bouwen? Dan maken we graag kennis met je. Als stagiair werk je aan het verbeteren van processen binnen domeinen zoals sales, projecten in nieuwbouw en finance. Je analyseert hoe processen vandaag werken en vertaalt dit naar slimme oplossingen met behulp van Power BI en Power Automate. Je levert concrete procesverbeteringen, procesbeschrijvingen, automatiseringen en Power BI dashboards voor operationele en financiële sturing aan alsmede werkende Power Automate flows. Opgericht in 1952, vervult en overtreft Heras de beveiligingsbehoeften van klanten in heel Europa. Het is dankzij deze staat van dienst, samen met het blijvend groeiende vakmanschap van onze medewerkers, dat wij ons experts in perimeter protection kunnen noemen. Onze cultuur, werksfeer & waarden Wij hebben binnen Heras een informele, open en toegankelijke cultuur. We zijn trots op ons werk, producten en dienstverlening. We hebben een no-nonsense mentaliteit, tonen ondernemerschap, zijn energiek en werken allemaal gedisciplineerd volgens de drie kernwaarden; betrokkenheid, betrouwbaarheid en deskundigheid. Heras is gewaardeerd op een Ecovadis Zilveren Ster en dat plaatst ons bij de duurzaamste 15% bedrijven van Nederland. Onze doelstelling is streven naar Goud in de komende jaren en volledig CO2 neutraal zijn in 2050. title: Product Designer (m/f/x)
description: UP42 was founded in 2019 with a clear purpose: to transform how organizations order, access, and analyze Earth observation data. Our platform brings together the world’s leading geospatial providers, and offers a single touchpoint to access, manage, and process data at scale. From vegetation management and infrastructure monitoring to disaster response, UP42 helps organizations across industries find solutions to complex problems through Earth observation. Our expert support team and detailed documentation guide our users through every step. Since July 2025, UP42 has been a part of Neo Space Group. We are looking for a Product Designer (m/f/x) to join our Design Team in Berlin. You will be the design partner for one of our product teams, working alongside a Product Manager and engineers to take work from an early idea through to something people use. You will own your projects, hold a high quality bar on complex, data-rich interfaces, and work inside a design system you help keep healthy. You will enjoy this role if you want real ownership of a product area without carrying a whole platform, and if you like going deep into a genuinely complex domain. Our team is complementary, so your work is visible and the feedback loop is short. What you will do: Take design work from an early idea through to delivery, proposing solutions to blockers rather than only reporting them. Be the reliable design partner for your product team: the person your PM and engineers come to first. Design for complexity: dense data tables, long-running processes, and workflows where the edge cases matter as much as the main path. Look for evidence before you design: talk to users, read what support and sales already know, look at how the product is actually used, and run tests on your own work. Push to understand the problem before designing a solution, and say so when a brief arrives already shaped as one. Scope your own features, break them into pieces, be roughly right about how long they will take, and flag delays early with a plan B rather than a warning. Contribute to our design system, as everyone on our team does: propose and build components, not only use them. Share your work cross-functionally, take feedback, and iterate; notice improvements inside your area and act on them, instead of waiting to be asked. Here is a good summary of what we are looking for: Experience delivering product design work end-to-end inside a cross-functional team. Solid interaction (IxD) and visual/UI design skills, with the ability to make complex data and workflows understandable. Strong Figma skills, and a working understanding of how a design system is actually built: how a component is structured, how it behaves, and the rules it has to respect. You will be a contributor to ours, not only a user of it. Experience using research and product evidence to make design decisions: usability tests, customer conversations, support tickets, product data. We are not looking for one particular method. Comfortable telling the difference between what we know and what we are assuming, and willing to say which is which. Comfortable with ambiguity: able to make progress when the picture is still incomplete, and to adjust when what you learn changes the direction. Able to scope your own work and communicate honestly about time, collaborative, feedback-driven, and proactive about the problems you can see. Fluent in English and based in Berlin with hybrid work capability. Bonus points if you bring: Experience designing geospatial, enterprise, or data-heavy B2B products. Background in UX research, data visualization, or complex workflow design. Knowledge of accessibility and inclusive design. Experience with interactive prototyping. Awareness of current AI tools and emerging opportunities in UX processes, with an understanding of how AI can enhance user outcomes without adding unnecessary complexity. Let us tell you why UP42 is a good choice: Let’s disrupt the industry: You get the chance to shape the state-of-the-art geospatial processing platform and create a completely new planetary perspective Let’s stay flexible: We practice a hybrid working model - you can choose when to work from the comfort of your home or join your colleagues in our modern office in the heart of Kreuzberg, or even from a global place of your choice up to 90 days per year Let’s win as a team: We’re an inspiring international team working in a fun and productive environment Let’s be fair: We offer a competitive salary package and other perks such as wellbeing initiatives, sponsored fitness subscriptions, an educational budget for your personal development and public transportation discount - just to name a few Let’s enjoy the good side of life: Gather in regular team events as well as our global company parties twice a year Let’s think outside of the box: There are challenges and enough space for creativity and taking ownership Does this sound like a good next step into your geospatial career? If so, we look forward to receiving your application in English. Our culture is one of belonging, where everyone feels welcome and where differences are celebrated. We seek to recruit the best talent regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background and/or belief—and strongly encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply. We also value more than the skills and experiences outlined in this job description. Even if you think you only fill 60% of the requirements for this role - we would still like to consider your application. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow
