title: Named Account Executive, Thailand
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>Singapore</li> </ul> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>The Cloudflare APAC sales organisation operates as one integrated revenue system. Account Executives, Customer Engineers, Partner Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, Customer Experience Managers, Professional Services and Revenue Operations work as a continuous engine - winning, deploying, adopting, expanding, and scaling platform commitments across the full customer lifecycle.</p> <p>The system is supported by an AI-embedded operating model. The work itself, however, remains human. The role of every seller at Cloudflare is to bring critical thinking, judgment, and trust to customer relationships and outcomes.</p> <p>In this role, you will be responsible for driving significant growth by landing and expanding a portfolio of assigned customers in <strong>Enterprise accounts of the Thailand market</strong>. The ideal candidate possesses a strong blend of sales acumen and technical understanding, enabling them to engage effectively with both technical and non-technical buyers. As an Account Executive, you will drive revenue velocity by utilizing foundational sales data layers for accurate forecasting, proactive pipeline management, and consistently exceeding attainment targets.</p> <p>You are the kind of operator who uses AI as a force multiplier every day, cares more about customer outcomes than job boundaries, and demonstrates curiosity, judgment, and high agency.</p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>Own and execute a comprehensive territory plan to consistently achieve and exceed sales and revenue targets.</li> <li>Cultivate long-term strategic relationships with key accounts and partners. Lead executive-level transformation narratives that earn the right to be in the architecture conversation.</li> <li>Leverage top partners as an extension of the sales team to co-sell alongside where they bring customer relationships, services capability, or procurement leverage. Drive regular forecast & pipeline cadences with top partners.</li> <li>Understand customer network architectures, the problems that Cloudflare can solve and effectively translate Cloudflare’s solutions to drive successful platform sales, ensuring clients can secure and scale their own AI-driven workloads.</li> <li>Manage contract negotiations and structure platform-level commercial commitments (multi-year, multi-product, outcome-anchored) rather than point-product deals.</li> <li>Stay engaged through onboarding, adoption, and the first renewal. Partner with Customer Engineers, Professional Services on a deployment plan with milestones tied to measurable outcomes.</li> <li>Proactively build and manage a robust sales pipeline by leveraging internal tools, AI-assisted research and pipeline sources (BDR, Channel, Marketing).</li> <li>Maintain high standards in pipeline discipline, CRM hygiene and forecasting accuracy.</li> </ul> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <ul> <li style="font-weight: bold;"><strong>Experienced sales professional with deep relationships with C-level executives from the largest enterprises in Thailand</strong></li> <li style="font-weight: bold;"><strong>Experienced sales professional who has closed strategic deals with the largest enterprises in Thailand</strong></li> <li>Bachelor's degree required.</li> <li>Experience selling technology solutions in high-growth technology firms.</li> <li>Demonstrated track record of consistently meeting and exceeding multi-million dollar quota targets.</li> <li>Proficient in discovery, positioning, competitive selling, negotiation, closing, and multi-threaded land and expand strategies.</li> <li>Strong understanding of computer networking, cloud security technology, and how enterprise infrastructure adapts to automated data workflows.</li> <li>Exceptional interpersonal communication skills and value selling skills.</li> <li>Proficiency in modern sales software, customer data environments, and core systems (e.g., Salesforce, Tableau, G-suite).</li> <li>Thinks critically rather than reacting, exercises judgment under uncertainty, names risks honestly, shows genuine empathy for customers as people, can point to relationships built over time on trust, and demonstrates visible curiosity in how they prepare, sell, and learn.</li> <li>Willingness to actively engage with AI tools and experiment.</li> <li>Ability to travel as required.</li> <li>The portfolio for this role consists of customers based in Thailand. Proficiency in Thai to communicate with these customers would be required.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Branch Support Manager - Europe
description: About Rain for Rent International Rain for Rent International provides innovative tank systems for liquid management applications. As an internationally operating rental and service company, expertise centers on rental, logistics, and services around the tank, focusing on the core competencies of renting storage tanks, containment systems, pumps, and filtration units. Your role We are looking for a hands-on Branch Support Manager ( m/f/d ) to help our teams across Germany, the United Kingdom, the Netherlands and France get the best from our business systems, processes and support functions. This is not a traditional IT Manager position. It is a highly business-facing role combining business systems, operational processes, user support, training, continuous improvement and team leadership . You will work closely with our branches and Shared Services teams to understand how people work, where they encounter challenges and how technology and better processes can make their jobs easier and our business more effective. What you will do Become a Business Systems Expert You will develop strong expertise in the applications supporting our European operations and become a trusted point of contact for our business users. A major focus will be our ERP environment, supporting processes such as: Purchasing and purchase orders Goods and invoice receipt Rental contracts Equipment on-hire and off-hire Recurring and final billing Credit notes and ad-hoc invoicing Customer, supplier and item master data You will also support the effective use of CRM, Microsoft 365 and other operational applications. Experience with inspHire, Zoho or Twinfield would be advantageous, but previous knowledge of our specific applications is not essential if you have strong ERP/business systems experience and learn quickly. Help People Get the Best From Technology You will work directly with colleagues across our branches to understand challenges, answer questions and identify better ways of working. That includes: Providing practical systems and process support Training new and existing users Developing SOPs, quick-reference guides and training materials Creating screen recordings and short training videos Building a structured, version-controlled knowledge library Identifying recurring problems and addressing their root causes Most importantly, you will explain the why , not only the how . Connect Systems With Business Reality Good systems only create good information when they are used correctly. You will therefore work closely with Operations, Sales, Finance, Fleet and other Shared Services functions to improve the quality and consistency of the processes behind our data. You will help us ensure that operational information, CRM pipelines, rental transactions, margins and management KPIs accurately reflect what is happening in the business. Listen, Challenge and Improve Our branches know their business and will bring you ideas and requirements. Your job is not simply to say yes. You will listen, understand the underlying need and assess whether the best answer is a change to a system, process, training or something else. For larger initiatives, you will help structure requirements, assess benefits, costs, effort and risks, and make clear recommendations to leadership. Lead a Small Team You will lead a developing Branch Support function, expected to include approximately three team members across business support and IT/helpdesk activities . This remains a hands-on role. You will lead the team while actively participating in support, training, problem solving and improvement initiatives yourself. Stay Curious Technology is changing quickly and we want to take advantage of it. You do not need to be an AI expert, but you should be curious about tools such as Microsoft Copilot , automation and new ways technology can help colleagues work more effectively. The Person We Are Looking For Systems knowledge matters, but how you work with people matters just as much. You are someone who: Listens before proposing a solution Is patient and enjoys explaining things Can train and support colleagues with different levels of systems experience Builds credibility and strong working relationships Can persuade and influence without relying on hierarchy Is comfortable constructively challenging a request Is pragmatic and realistic about priorities, resources and costs Learns new business processes quickly Enjoys solving problems Is comfortable being visible and close to the operational business Is curious about technology and AI You should be equally comfortable discussing a process with a branch administrator, working through a systems problem with IT, understanding a commercial requirement from Sales or presenting a recommendation to leadership. European Scope The role supports operations across Germany, the United Kingdom, the Netherlands and France . Regular interaction with the branches is a fundamental part of the position. You should therefore be willing to travel across our European locations , build strong relationships with local teams and spend time understanding how our operations work in practice. Regular office presence is also expected, currently anticipated at up to three days per week at our office in Potsdam. Why This Role? This is an opportunity to shape a developing European support function rather than simply inherit an established helpdesk. You will have the opportunity to influence: How we use our business systems How we support and train users How processes are standardised across countries How knowledge is documented and shared How new technology and AI are adopted How Branch Support develops as our European organisation evolves If you enjoy bringing together people, processes and technology and want a role where you can see the practical impact of your work across the business, we would like to hear from you. Rain for Rent International is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive working environment and welcome applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of gender, age, disability, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We provide the information they need to optimize athletes' health, game-day readiness, and performance, as well as in-game tactics. Catapult is a sports technology company that empowers professional teams to make data-driven decisions. We deliver health, performance, video, and AI insights from the locker room to competitive environments, ensuring every decision is an opportunity to gain an advantage, sharpen performance, and build lasting success. WE WANT PEOPLE WHO ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT SOLVING HARD PROBLEMS We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to help build, operate and improve the infrastructure, platforms and tools that enable our teams to develop, deliver and run reliable software at scale. Based in Cologne, you will join a team with broad ownership of our technical environment. We take a cloud-agnostic approach, combining cloud services and self-hosted infrastructure to meet the needs of our products and engineering teams. Our responsibilities span the full lifecycle, from provisioning and deployment to observability, security and ongoing operation. You will combine infrastructure expertise with automation and software engineering to improve how our software is built, deployed and operated. This includes streamlining development workflows, integrating and maintaining shared tools, and supporting demanding workloads across data processing, media and machine learning. Working closely with engineering teams and colleagues across the business, you will build practical solutions that support our expanding product portfolio. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving a wide range of technical problems, takes ownership from initial idea through to production, and thrives in a fast-growing environment where priorities and requirements evolve quickly. You will help shape how our infrastructure, platforms and tools adapt as the business grows. WHAT YOU'LL DO Design, operate, and continuously improve our Kubernetes platform across both self-hosted clusters and AWS Own our infrastructure as code using Terraform and Ansible, driving a GitOps workflow to ensure all changes are versioned, reviewed, and reproducible Build and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI) and shared templates that empower product teams to build, test, and deploy reliably Operate and scale specialized infrastructure for demanding workloads, including GPU clusters for computer vision models, media engines, and data analytics platforms Evolve our observability stack to proactively monitor system health, define meaningful alerting, and ensure high availability Drive platform security and compliance through continuous vulnerability scanning, automated image screening, robust secrets management, and strict access controls Collaborate closely with software engineers, data scientists, and product teams to design scalable architectures and act as a strategic technical partner for new infrastructure initiatives Help define technical direction, engineering best practices, and quality standards within the infrastructure domain WHAT YOU'LL NEED 5+ years of professional experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or Platform Engineering, with a proven track record of designing and scaling highly available production environments Strong hands-on experience running Kubernetes in production, including upgrades, networking and troubleshooting Solid understanding of cloud infrastructure (AWS) combined with experience operating bare-metal or self-hosted environments Proven experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible) and modern container build or GitOps workflows Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to evaluate technical trade-offs between reliability, scalability, and maintainability Experience collaborating across engineering and product teams to deliver secure and robust infrastructure solutions Deep understanding of Linux operating systems and strong programming or scripting skills (e.g., Python, Go, or Bash) focused on automation and tooling. Nice to have – and what would make you exceptional: Experience operating GPU workloads on Kubernetes or Machine Learning infrastructure Familiarity with specialized Kubernetes ecosystem tools such as FluxCD, Rancher, or RKE2. Experience working with large-scale video/streaming workflows or AWS media services Experience managing and scaling messaging or event-streaming systems (e.g., Kafka) Experience operating and optimizing relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL) Experience building internal developer platforms or self-service tooling for engineering teams WHAT YOUR SUCCESS WILL LOOK LIKE In 6 months time… You know our clusters and pipelines, handle incidents and upgrades on your own, and have shipped your first improvements to reliability, automation or security. You contribute confidently to architecture discussions. In 12 months time… You own major parts of the platform, have delivered measurable improvements (faster deployments, better observability, stronger security), and help shape the roadmap of our hybrid cloud. WHY CATAPULT? We have amazing people. We promise you'll work with some of the most ambitious, intelligent people in an exciting industry, and do some of the best work of your life. We encourage our people to engage in constructive, open, and honest communication to make Catapult extraordinary. We work in a collaborative yet challenging environment to consistently improve our performance, which in turn impacts our customers' performance. Our workforce spans more than 20 countries. You'll have the opportunity to work with people from multiple nationalities and cultures, and to build your global awareness. We value improvement and development. We are challenging ourselves to continuously grow and become a high-performance company. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do, and our people are always looking for ways to improve. There is an unlimited opportunity to grow, do more, and do better. Whether you're interested in sports or not, you'll have the satisfaction of knowing your work is supporting some of the most successful teams and athletes on the planet! Research shows that while men apply for jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized groups tend only to apply when they check every box. So if you have what it takes, but don't meet every single point in our job ad, please still get in touch! We would love to have a chat and see if you could be a great addition to our team. We are building the future of sports performance. Our priority is to find the brightest talent who can add to our team culture, actively contribute, and be excited about what they do. Debug complex distributed systems issues, including performance bottlenecks, capacity constraints and production reliability challenges. Build infrastructure automation and self-healing capabilities that reduce operational toil and improve platform resilience. Strong coding ability in Java, Go, Python or similar languages, with a focus on reliable, maintainable production systems. Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work across platform, infrastructure and product engineering teams. Nice to have Experience contributing to Kafka or related open source distributed systems. Experience with Redpanda, WarpStream, AutoMQ, Pulsar or similar streaming technologies. Experience with JVM tuning, broker tuning, partition management or Cruise Control. Experience with tiered storage, diskless streaming architectures or multi-region event streaming platforms. title: AI/ML Researcher
description: Über YLAB Wir bauen die KI, die wir unseren eigenen Kindern geben würden. Kinder wachsen heute mit KI auf. Wir sorgen dafür, dass diese KI neugierig macht statt süchtig, sicher ist statt datenhungrig und für Kinder gebaut wird statt für Erwachsene. Wir sind YLAB, ein kleines KI-Lab aus Köln-Ehrenfeld. Wir entwickeln Software und Hardware aus einer Hand, vom Sprachmodell bis zum Gehäuse. Unser erstes Produkt ist Onoo, ein Lernbegleiter ohne Bildschirm für Kinder ab vier. Onoo fragt zurück, lässt raten und denkt mit. Er hat keine Kamera und kein Display, zeigt keine Werbung und verkauft keine Daten. Warum YLAB Deine Arbeit landet im Kinderzimmer, nicht in einem Dashboard. Software & Hardware: KI, App, Firmware und Gerät entstehen bei uns zusammen. Du siehst, wie aus Code etwas wird, das ein Kind in die Hand nimmt. Du arbeitest an echten offenen Fragen, zum Beispiel wie KI Kinderstimmen versteht und Fünfjährigen die Welt erklärt. Tech, Pädagogik und Forschung sitzen bei uns an einem Tisch. Ehrlichkeit statt Hochglanz: Vieles bauen wir zum ersten Mal. Wenn dich das reizt, sollten wir reden. Was wir bieten Verantwortung ab Tag eins: Du bekommst echte Themen und Probleme statt Tickets, und deine Entscheidungen haben Gewicht. Top Arbeitsmaterial: Du arbeitest mit dem Setup und den Tools, die du brauchst. Flexible Weiterbildung: Konferenz, Kurs oder Workshop – du sagst uns, was dich weiterbringt. Hybrid mit Herz: Remote, wenn du Ruhe brauchst, und im Office, wenn wir gemeinsam tüfteln. Über die Rolle Wie versteht ein Sprachmodell eine Vierjährige? Und wie erklärt es ihr die Welt, ohne sie zu überfordern? Dazu gibt es kaum Paper und keine Benchmarks. Genau da setzt du an. Du bist unsere erste dedizierte Research-Stelle. Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle von KI, Sprache und Pädagogik, mit echten Familien statt Laborbedingungen und mit direktem Draht ins Produkt. Was dich erwartet: offene Fragen mit Substanz, ein Fachbeirat aus Bildung und Psychologie und die Freiheit, Studien so zu bauen, wie sie sein müssen. Wie du uns helfen kannst Du entwirfst und machst Studien mit Kindern und Familien. Von der Beobachtung im Wohnzimmer bis zum strukturierten Test. Du baust Methoden, um altersgerechte Antworten zu bewerten: Was heißt verständlich, was heißt zu viel? Du übersetzt Erkenntnisse in Modell- und Produktentscheidungen, zusammen mit Engineering und Pädagogik. Du behältst die Forschung im Blick (Child-Computer Interaction, Speech, LLM-Evals) und holst rein, was uns weiterbringt. Du teilst, was wir lernen. Wir forschen nicht für die Schublade. Melde dich, wenn: Du hast einen Research-Hintergrund, etwa HCI, Psychologie, Linguistik oder ML. Du hast schon mit Nutzer:innen geforscht, am besten mit Kindern. Du kannst beides: Interviews auswerten und saubere Metriken bauen. Du schreibst klar. Für Paper genauso wie für Produktentscheidungen. Du magst es, wenn deine Forschung nächste Woche im Prototyp steckt. Eher nicht, wenn: du Forschung als Selbstzweck siehst oder zwei Jahre Vorlauf brauchst, bevor etwas testbar ist. title: Founder Associate
description: Über YLAB Wir bauen die KI, die wir unseren eigenen Kindern geben würden. Kinder wachsen heute mit KI auf. Wir sorgen dafür, dass diese KI neugierig macht statt süchtig, sicher ist statt datenhungrig und für Kinder gebaut wird statt für Erwachsene. Wir sind YLAB, ein kleines KI-Lab aus Köln-Ehrenfeld. Tech, Pädagogik und Forschung sitzen bei uns an einem Tisch. Ehrlichkeit statt Hochglanz: Vieles bauen wir zum ersten Mal. Wenn dich das reizt, sollten wir reden. Was wir bieten Verantwortung ab Tag eins: Du bekommst echte Themen und Probleme statt Tickets, und deine Entscheidungen haben Gewicht. Top Arbeitsmaterial: Du arbeitest mit dem Setup und den Tools, die du brauchst. Flexible Weiterbildung: Konferenz, Kurs oder Workshop – du sagst uns, was dich weiterbringt. Founder Associate heißt bei uns: Du bist die Feuerwehr. Wo es brennt, bist du zuerst da, egal ob Investor-Update, Prototypen-Logistik oder der Messestand am Freitag. Geht in Vollzeit oder als Werkstudent:in. Uns ist egal, was auf deinem Vertrag steht, solange du Verantwortung willst. Wie du uns helfen kannst Du räumst weg, was die Gründer bremst: Recherchen, Entscheidungsvorlagen, Angebote, Ämterpost, Orga. We primarily use Go, Kotlin, Ruby, Python — while prior experience in these specific languages is beneficial, a strong foundation in modern backend engineering and a willingness to learn is what matters most.</li> <li>Experience with event streaming platforms like Kafka, Apache Flink, or others for real-time data processing and message queueing.</li> <li>A track record working with search engines, information retrieval and ranking optimisations technologies (e.g., Vespa, Elasticsearch, OpenSearch) is a high advantage. If not, we expect you to have a strong willingness and motivation to learn.</li> <li>You are enthusiastic about AI technologies, use AI tools daily in your work, and proactively learn and experiment with how to adopt AI to boost engineering outcomes.</li> <li>Strong understanding of continuous integration and deployment pipelines, with experience in tools like Jenkins for automating builds and deployments.</li> <li>Experience with observability and monitoring tools (we use Grafana, Kibana, and others) to keep services healthy and define SLIs/SLOs.</li> <li>Experience working with relational and in-memory databases.</li> <li>Strong collaboration and communication skills, with experience working with cross-functional peers (Product, Analytics, SRE).</li> <li>Experience in mentoring other engineers, providing constructive feedback, and promoting engineering best practices within your team.</li> <li>Excellent written and spoken English.</li> </ul> <h2 programme</li> <li>25 days of paid annual leave</li> <li>Newest MacBook models</li> <li>Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family</li> <li>Frequent team-building events</li> <li>Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture</li> <li>A daily lunch allowance</li> <li>Company bike leasing scheme</li> <li>Monthly budget for a flexible benefits platform</li> <li>Work from Home allowance</li> <li>Collective Defined Contribution Pension plan</li> <li>A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted</li> <li>An NS mobility card</li> <li>A dog-friendly office</li> </ul> </div> <h2 class="JobsDescription_sectionTitle__ZlnGI"><strong>Working at Vinted </strong></h2> <div class="JobsDescription_sectionContent__jYQtX"> <p><strong>Workation policy</strong></p> </div> <div class="JobsDescription_sectionContent__jYQtX"> <p>Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.</p> </div> <div class="JobsDescription_sectionContent__jYQtX"> <p><strong>Individual learning budget</strong></p> </div> <div class="JobsDescription_sectionContent__jYQtX"> <p>Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.</p> </div> <div class="JobsDescription_sectionContent__jYQtX"> <p><strong>Hybrid work</strong></p> </div> <div class="JobsDescription_sectionContent__jYQtX"> <p>Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.</p> </div> <div class="JobsDescription_sectionContent__jYQtX"> <p><strong>Equal opportunity</strong></p> </div> <div class="JobsDescription_sectionContent__jYQtX"> <p>We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!</p> </div><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">The annual gross salary range for this position excluding 8% holiday pay is:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€76.800</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>€104.000 EUR</span></div></div></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

English</li> </ul> <p><strong>Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities often apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. If you don’t recognise yourself in all of the above, you might still be an excellent candidate for this position. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply.</strong></p> <h2><strong>Work perks  </strong></h2> <ul> <li>The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme</li> <li>30 days of paid annual leave</li> <li>Newest MacBook models</li> <li>Digital mental and emotional health support and Employee Assistant Program (EAP)</li> <li>Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture</li> <li>Lunch benefit per your workday</li> <li>Frequent team-building events</li> <li>A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted</li> <li>Access to a discounted gym membership plan</li> <li>Pension Plan with Vinted matching 150% of your chosen contribution</li> <li>Supplemental Private Health Insurance</li> <li>Life and Disability insurance</li> <li>A subsidised Deutschlandticket for your commute to the office by public transport</li> <li>A dog-friendly office</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Working at Vinted </strong></h2> <p><strong>Workation policy</strong></p> <p>Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.</p> <p><strong>Individual Learning Budget</strong></p> <p>Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.</p> <p><strong>Hybrid Work</strong></p> <p>Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.</p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity</strong></p> <p>We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. title: Senior Software Engineer, Roku UI
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif; color: #662d91;">Teamwork makes the stream work.</h2> <p> </p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>Roku is changing how the world watches TV</strong></h3> <p>Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.</p> <p>From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.</p> <p> </p></div><h2 data-section-id="1wcrfjg" data-start="176" data-end="193"> </h2> <h3 class="mt-6 mb-2 font-semibold text-xl" data-streamdown="heading-3"><strong><span class="font-semibold" data-streamdown="strong">What does the team work on?</span></strong></h3> <p class="text-neutral-900 dark:text-neutral-200 my-2.5 last:mb-0 first:mt-0 ">At Roku, the UI team builds the foundational frameworks, tooling, and high-performance UI components that power experiences across millions of devices. We own the middleware and UI layers that enable smooth navigation, responsive interactions, rich animations, and consistent developer workflows across the platform.</p> <p class="text-neutral-900 dark:text-neutral-200 my-2.5 last:mb-0 first:mt-0 ">Our work spans graphics rendering, layout and animation systems, performance optimization, and developer APIs that make it easy to create reliable, visually compelling applications at scale. We operate in a collaborative, high-trust environment and partner closely with firmware, platform, and product teams to ensure the end-to-end experience is fast, robust, and future-ready.</p> <p class="text-neutral-900 dark:text-neutral-200 my-2.5 last:mb-0 first:mt-0 "> </p> <h3 class="mt-6 mb-2 font-semibold text-xl" data-streamdown="heading-3"><strong><span class="font-semibold" data-streamdown="strong">What is the role?</span></strong></h3> <p class="text-neutral-900 dark:text-neutral-200 my-2.5 last:mb-0 first:mt-0 ">As a Senior Software Engineer on the UI team, you'll design, implement, and optimize systems that underpin Roku's user experience and developer platform. You'll work on performance-critical code paths across graphics rendering, animation, layout, and UI frameworks, ensuring smooth visuals and highly responsive interactions across a wide range of devices.</p> <p class="text-neutral-900 dark:text-neutral-200 my-2.5 last:mb-0 first:mt-0 ">At Roku, AI agents do most of the keystroke-level coding. Engineers act as the technical leads for those agents — setting context, planning work, verifying outputs, and recovering when the agent goes off course. You'll play a key role in shaping core architecture, working across the stack with hardware, firmware, and application teams, and delivering solutions that directly impact tens of millions of users. This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy deep technical problem-solving, care about performance at a systems level, want to build the foundational layers that power great user experiences — and are energized by the shift to agentic engineering. If you are excited about working this way, we want to talk to you.</p> <p class="text-neutral-900 dark:text-neutral-200 my-2.5 last:mb-0 first:mt-0 "> </p> <h3 class="mt-6 mb-2 font-semibold text-xl" data-streamdown="heading-3"> </h3> <h3><strong>How will I use AI at Roku?</strong></h3> <p>At Roku, we don’t just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We’re looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they’ve used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact. <br>We value your AI skills if have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks. And you can describe projects where you shipped real work with these tools. You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you.</p> <p> </p> <h3 class="mt-6 mb-2 font-semibold text-xl" Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.</p> <p> </p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>What are some of the benefits?</strong></h3> <p>Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. title: Senior Software Engineer, Java
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif; color: #662d91;">Teamwork makes the stream work.</h2> <p> </p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>Roku is changing how the world watches TV</strong></h3> <p>Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.</p> <p>From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.</p> <p> </p></div><h3><strong>About The Team</strong></h3> <p>The Roku Enterprise Engineering team is at the forefront of building a robust, integrated, and scalable platform that powers critical business processes across the organization. As a cornerstone of Roku's corporate strategy, this team is instrumental in automating workflows across all Business Systems, including Supply Chain, Finance, Sales Operations, and Human Resources. By challenging traditional approaches to workflow automation, the team leverages cutting-edge Engineering practices and API-driven design to streamline internal processes, boost efficiency, and deliver innovative solutions.</p> <p>The team's expertise spans a wide range of technologies, including Java and Python-based MicroServices, AWS/GCP cloud backend systems, Big Data technologies like Hive and Spark, and modern Web applications. With a globally distributed presence across the US, India and Europe, the team thrives on collaboration, bringing together diverse perspectives to solve complex challenges. At the heart of their success is a shared commitment to technical excellence, creativity, a strong sense of ownership, and a collaborative spirit that drives impactful results for Roku's business operations.</p> <p> </p> <h3><strong>About The Role</strong></h3> <p>As a senior technical lead, you consider yourself a platform services developer and developing innovative solutions using modern software frameworks and paradigms. You are self-driven and problem solver, with a strong background in building large-scale software platform and applications. You are execution focused and would develop a reputation for repeatedly delivering projects on-time.</p> <p> </p> <h3><strong>What you'll be doing</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Design, develop and deploy scalable web applications and services, being part of everything from contributing to web technology and framework stack, to use case and data model design</li> <li>Drive architecture discussions, take ownership and responsibility over new projects, and deliver high quality software with tight timeline</li> <li>Partner with security and compliance teams to ensure the application meets compliance, security and audit requirements</li> <li>Participate in the continual improvement of engineering tools, cloud-based technologies/services, and process</li> <li>Define and participate in Agile development process, including scoping, technical design, estimation effort, coding, testing, debugging, code reviews, maintenance and support</li> <li>Collaborate with cross-function teams and demonstrate great communication skills</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3><strong>We're excited if you have</strong></h3> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience in delivery multi-tier, highly scalable, distributed web application</li> <li>Deep understanding in software architecture, object-oriented design principles, and data structures</li> <li>Extensive experience in developing microservices using Java, Python</li> <li>Good experience in Test driven development and automating test cases using Java/ Python</li> <li>Experience in SQL / NoSQL (Oracle, Cassandra) database design</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to be proactive, self-driven, and make practical trade-offs based on business needs, entrepreneurial spirit</li> <li>Excellent verbal and written communication skills</li> <li>BS or MS degree in Computer Science or equivalent</li> <li>Experience in distributed computing frameworks like - Hive/Hadoop, Apache Spark</li> <li>Experience in developing Finance or HR related applications</li> <li>Experience with following cloud services: AWS Elastic Beanstalk, EC2, S3, CloudFront, RDS, DynamoDB, VPC, Elastic Cache, Lambda</li> <li>Working experience with Terraform</li> <li>Experience in creating workflows for Apache Airflow</li> </ul> <h6>#LI-GL1</h6><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong><span style="font-family: GothamBold, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;">What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?</span></strong></h3> <p>Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.</p> <p> </p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>What are some of the benefits?</strong></h3> <p>Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.</p> <p> </p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>Accommodations</strong></h3> <p>Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to <a ---------- <p> </p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>What should I know about Roku's culture?</strong></h3> <p>Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. </p> <p>We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002. </p> <p>To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit <a href="https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet">https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet</a>.</p> <p>By providing your information, you acknowledge that you want Roku to contact you about job roles, that you have read Roku's <a href="https://www.weareroku.com/roku-job-applicant-privacy-notice-for-job-applicants">Applicant Privacy Notice</a>, and understand that Roku will use your information as described in that notice. If you do not wish to receive any communications from Roku regarding this role or similar roles in the future, you may unsubscribe at any time by emailing <a ----- ----- Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <p><strong>About Team & Role</strong><br><br>Rubrik's sales organization helps hospitals, banks, schools and government agencies stay resilient against cyberattacks, malicious insiders and operational disruption, and you'll do it for one of the fastest-growing corners of the data estate: unstructured data on NAS. As the Sales Specialist for NAS Cloud Direct, you own the number for this product in your territory. You'll be the go-to expert in the field, with the tools, enablement and One Rubrik selling motion to take your career, and your earnings, as far as your results allow.<br><br>You'll work alongside Core Account Executives, Sales Engineers, Sales Development, Channel Development and our partners, and you'll be the consolidated voice of the field and customer back to Product Management, Product Marketing and PnP.<br><br><strong>What You'll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own bookings growth for NAS Cloud Direct across new and existing accounts, building and executing a territory plan that meets and exceeds quota</li> <li>Drive daily pipeline generation to land net new logos, opening doors with customers who need to protect massive volumes of unstructured data without adding more on-prem backup <ul> <li>5+ years of field technology sales experience, ideally selling data protection, storage, cloud infrastructure or NAS-related solutions</li> <li>A consistent track record of landing net new logos and consistently overachieving quota</li> <li>Strong experience building and managing pipeline across many accounts and verticals</li> <li>Comfort positioning a technical product in complex data center and cloud environments, and building champions across technical and business buyers</li> <li>Experience working with channel partners, distributors and resellers to co-sell and grow a territory</li> <li>A driven, goal-oriented "get it done" mindset and the self-direction to generate your own momentum</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Exposure to unstructured data challenges and enterprise NAS platforms</li> <li>Experience selling complex, multi-stakeholder solutions into mid-enterprise accounts</li> <li>Background in product-specialist or overlay sales models</li> <li>Familiarity with the competitive landscape in data protection and cloud storage</li> <li>Understanding of MEDDPICC for sales qualification & COtM sales methodology</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h2>Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation</h2> <p>Rubrik (NYSE: RBRK) is the Security and AI Operations Company, delivering one platform built at the intersection of data, identity, and AI. The platform enables agentic cyber resilience and trusted AI operations for enterprises worldwide, built to recover before disruption strikes and stay a step ahead, so security is never the reason ambition stalls.</p> <p><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/rubrik-inc/mycompany/verification/">Linkedin</a> | <a href="https://twitter.com/rubrikinc">X (formerly Twitter)</a> | <a href="https://www.instagram.com/rubrikinc/" target="_blank">Instagram</a> | <a href="https://www.rubrik.com">Rubrik.com</a></p> <h2>Inclusion @ Rubrik</h2> <p>At Rubrik, we are dedicated to fostering a culture where people from all backgrounds are valued, feel they belong, and believe they can succeed. Our commitment to inclusion is at the heart of our mission to secure the world’s data.</p> <p>Our goal is to hire and promote the best talent, regardless of background. We believe in empowering everyone to bring their authentic selves to work and achieve their fullest potential.</p> <h3>Our inclusion strategy focuses on three core areas of our business and culture:</h3> <ul> <li> <p style="line-height: 1;">Our Company: We are committed to building a merit-based organization that offers equal access to growth and success for all employees globally. title: Director, Field & Channel Marketing - EMEA
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Who is Tenable?</strong></p> <p>Tenable® is the Exposure Management company. Over 40,000 organizations around the globe rely on Tenable to understand and reduce cyber risk. Our global employees support 65 percent of the Fortune 500, 50 percent of the Global 2000, and large government agencies. Come be part of our journey!</p> <p><strong>What makes Tenable such a great place to work?</strong></p> <p>Ask a member of our team and they’ll answer, “Our people!” We work together to build and innovate best-in-class cybersecurity solutions for our customers; all while creating a culture of belonging, respect, and excellence where we can be our best selves. When you’re part of our #OneTenable team, you can expect to partner with some of the most talented and passionate people in the industry, and have the support and resources you need to do work that truly matters. We deliver results that exceed expectations and we win together!</p></div><p><strong>Your Role:</strong></p> <p>As Senior Director, EMEA Marketing, you have the opportunity to shape the strategy and execution of full stack marketing in Tenable’s fastest growing theater. This is a unique opportunity to operate as the region's marketing lead across: field and demand generation, channel marketing, advertising, communications, and social. title: Director, EMEA Professional Services | Luma
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Our Why At Dotmatics </strong></p> <p>At Dotmatics, a Siemens company,  we believe science, data, and decision-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive. Our Portfolio includes Luma, LumaLab Connect, ELN Platform, Graphpad Prism, Geneious, SnapGene, Protein Metrics, OMIQ, FCS Express, LabArchives, NQuery, EasyPanel, SoftGenetics and Virscidian.</p> <p><strong>We have a vision for a new Lab of the Future that will change the future of scientific research.</strong></p> <p>We have created the world’s most comprehensive digital science platform – best-of-breed software applications already used by more than 2 million scientists, together in a single ecosystem united by a powerful, flexible enterprise data platform. This is not flat data buried away in digital graveyards. This is dynamic, multi-dimensional decision-making.</p> <p>Scientific enterprises need a new level of effectiveness to achieve tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Illness will not wait. The biosphere will not wait. We are tireless in our vision, because the time for innovation is now.</p> <p><strong>Shaping the Future of Science At Dotmatics </strong></p> <p>Our global team of more than 800 colleagues are dedicated to supporting our customers in over 180 countries. Together, with our scientific community of users, we accelerate scientific innovation in order to make the world a healthier, cleaner, and safer place to live.</p> <p>You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation.  Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. We offer a dynamic, remote-friendly environment that fosters high integrity and collaboration, empowering you to excel. Dotmatics is a company built by scientists, for scientists. Combined, we are now the world’s largest cloud-based scientific research R&D platform. We need your help to keep growing and pioneering the future.</p> <p><strong>We are Science Driven. We are Customer Centric. We are Better Together. </strong></p></div><div class="iCIMS_InfoMsg iCIMS_InfoMsg_Job"> <div class="iCIMS_Expandable_Container"> <div class="iCIMS_Expandable_Text"> <div class="iCIMS_InfoMsg iCIMS_InfoMsg_Job"> <div class="iCIMS_Expandable_Container"> <div class="iCIMS_Expandable_Text"> <p><strong>What do we need</strong></p> <p>We are seeking a Director, EMEA Professional Services to delivery organisation through a management layer, initially comprising Application Scientist Managers and an India Services Manager responsible for both direct hires and outsourced delivery capability.</p> <p>You will be accountable for regional delivery execution, commercial performance, customer governance, organisational capability and delivery excellence across EMEA, while helping shape the evolution of Professional Services as we continue our transition to Luma.  This is a regional business leadership role with accountability for services revenue, utilisation, margin, forecasting, delivery quality, customer outcomes and people leadership.</p> <p>In this role you will, </p> <p><strong>Lead the EMEA Services Organisation</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead and develop a high performing management team across scientific implementation and regional delivery.</li> <li>Build a culture of accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement.</li> <li>Develop an organisation capable of supporting both established Platform implementations and next generation Luma solutions.</li> <li>Build management capability and succession across the region.</li> <li>Lead offshore resources </li> </ul> <p><strong>Drive Commercial Performance</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own regional services bookings, revenue, utilisation, margin, forecasting and delivery predictability.</li> <li>Partner with Sales, PreSales, Support and Customer Success to shape, scope and govern services engagements.</li> <li>Ensure strong commercial discipline across Statements of Work, change control, financial management and resource planning.</li> <li>Identify delivery risks early and drive practical mitigation plans.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Deliver Customer Success</strong></p> <ul> <li>Act as the senior Professional Services leader for strategic EMEA customer engagements.</li> <li>Build trusted executive relationships with customer stakeholders.</li> <li>Lead executive governance, steering committees and major delivery escalations.</li> <li>Ensure programmes consistently deliver quality outcomes, customer value and commercial success.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Strengthen Delivery Operations</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead regional resource planning across Application Scientists, India-based teams and partner delivery.</li> <li>Develop scalable delivery capacity through offshore teams and strategic partners.</li> <li>Partner closely with the Global PMO to ensure consistent delivery governance, forecasting and project management standards.</li> <li>Drive continuous improvement in delivery quality, operational maturity and implementation predictability.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Partner Across the Business</strong></p> <ul> <li>Work closely with Sales, PreSales, STS, Support, Customer Success, Product, Finance, Legal and Partner teams.</li> <li>Provide implementation insight that helps shape product evolution and service offerings.</li> <li>Represent Professional Services in planning for Luma, partner enablement and regional growth.</li> <li>Support the evolution of repeatable, scalable delivery models across the Platform business.</li> </ul> <p><strong>We're looking for</strong> an experienced Professional Services leader who combines commercial thinking with strong operational execution. You will bring experience in Scientific software, R&D informatics, ELN, LIMS, SDMS, lab automation and orchestration, data platforms or scientific workflow software or similar industry.  Ideally you will hold experience working in/with the Life sciences, pharma, biotech, chemicals, CROs or regulated research environments. </p> <p>You will have a deep understanding of services delivering enterprise SaaS, cloud platforms, data platforms, digital transformation with complex workflow implementation</p> <p><strong>The key skills we are looking for</strong></p> <p> </p> <ul> <li>Scientific software, R&D informatics, ELN, LIMS, SDMS, laboratory orchestration/automation or scientific workflow platforms.</li> <li>Life sciences, Lab Automation, biotechnology, pharmaceutical or chemicals industries</li> <li>Significant leadership experience within Professional Services, consulting or enterprise software delivery..</li> <li>Experience leading managers and building high performing regional organisations.</li> <li>Ownership of commercial metrics including revenue, utilisation, margin, forecasting and capacity planning.</li> <li>Experience leading complex customer implementations and executive governance.</li> <li>Strong understanding of Statements of Work, project governance, scope management and change control.</li> <li>Experience working closely with Sales, PreSales, Support, Product, Customer Success and Finance.</li> <li>Experience building offshore, partner or blended delivery models.</li> <li>Strong executive presence and the ability to influence senior stakeholders across a global organisation.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>You may also have;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Enterprise SaaS, cloud platforms or digital transformation programmes.</li> <li>Partner-led delivery or systems integrators.</li> <li>PSA, CRM and project governance platforms such as OpenAir, Salesforce or Jira.</li> <li>Regulated environments, including GxP.</li> </ul> title: Director of Sales, RM, Switzerland
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>ABOUT SOTHEBY'S</strong></p> <p>Established in 1744, Sotheby’s promotes access and ownership of exceptional art and luxury objects through auctions, private sales and retail. Our deep expertise across 70 selling categories is supported by a leading technology platform and a global network of specialists spanning 40 countries. Selling categories include Contemporary Art, Modern and Impressionist Art, Old Masters, Chinese Works of Art, Jewelry, Watches, Wine and Spirits and Design, as well as collectible cars and real estate through RM Sotheby’s and Concierge. Sotheby’s Financial Services is a leading art lender and provides capital solutions for collectors around the world, having originated more than $12 billion in loans since its inception. Sotheby’s new global headquarters is now open at the iconic Breuer building at 945 Madison Avenue in New York City.</p></div><p><strong>ABOUT RM SOTHEBY’S</strong></p> <p>RM Sotheby’s is the world's leading collector car auction house, specializing in the sale of the world's most exceptional automobiles. title: Praktikum AI & Automation – Virtual Power Plant (m/w/d)
description: Unser Ziel ist eine Solaranlage auf jedem Dach, ein Speicher in jedem Haus und ein E-Auto in jeder Garage. Enpal macht das möglich mit einer integrierten Gesamtlösung für dezentrale Energie – von Solaranlage und Batteriespeicher über Wallbox, Smart Meter bis zur Wärmepumpe. Herzstück ist unsere KI-gestützte Plattform Enpal.One +, die tausende Systeme intelligent vernetzt und Strombezug sowie -einspeisung effizient am Energiemarkt optimiert. Omniwatt Energy ist die Strom-Unit von Enpal und macht saubere Energie für jeden Haushalt zugänglich – vom günstigsten Stromtarif Deutschlands bis hin zu intelligenten Energielösungen, die Erzeugung, Speicherung und Verbrauch optimal vernetzen. Mit ambitionierten Wachstumszielen und einem schnell wachsenden Kundenstamm bauen wir ein Team, das den deutschen Energiemarkt aktiv mitgestaltet. Dabei verbinden wir Startup-Geschwindigkeit mit der Skalierung eines Marktführers – über alle Bereiche hinweg, von Operations und Technologie über Finance und Customer Support bis hin zu Produktentwicklung. Deine Aufgaben Als Praktikant:in im Tech Venture Development bei Enpal Energy arbeitest du an einer zentralen Frage: Wie können wir unser Geschäft mit smarter Technologie skalieren? Im Mittelpunkt steht unser Virtual Power Plant. Wir vernetzen Haushalte mit ihren Solaranlagen, Speichern und Wärmepumpen zu einem intelligenten Kraftwerk und handeln ihren Strom smart am Energiemarkt. Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle von Business, Ops und Tech. Dabei bringst du AI-Lösungen, die unser virtuelles Kraftwerk skalierbar machen, vom Prototyp in den echten Betrieb. Eigene Projekte: Du übernimmst End-to-End-Verantwortung für eigene Projekte, von der Problemanalyse über die Lösungsfindung bis zum Go-live. AI Agents & Automatisierung: Du übersetzt Business Needs in konkrete Lösungen. Du baust Agents, Workflows und Automatisierungen mit No-Code-, Low-Code- und AI-Tools und bringst sie in den Betrieb. Impact messbar machen: Du bereitest Daten auf, baust Dashboards und lieferst damit die Grundlage für Entscheidungen. Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit verschiedenen Abteilungen zusammen, unter anderem Ops und Tech, und treibst Initiativen über Teamgrenzen hinweg voran. Dein Profil Du studierst an der Schnittstelle von Business und Tech, z. B. Wirtschaftsinformatik oder Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, oder hast in Studium und Praktika beide Welten kennengelernt. Du hast mindestens ein relevantes Praktikum abgeschlossen, z. B. in einem Start-up, in der Beratung oder im Venture Building. Du arbeitest gern mit Tools wie Claude, Cursor, Airtable, Make, n8n, Power BI, Snowflake oder SQL oder arbeitest dich schnell in neue Technologien ein. Du denkst analytisch und findest pragmatische Lösungen, die auf Fakten beruhen. Du übernimmst Ownership und wartest nicht auf perfekte Rahmenbedingungen. Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch. Du bist mindestens 4 Monate verfügbar. Du bist interessiert, auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst? Bewirb dich trotzdem! Wir freuen uns darauf, dein Potenzial zu entdecken - unabhängig davon, ob deine Erfahrung jede einzelne Voraussetzung erfüllt. ☀️ Darauf kannst Du Dich freuen Arbeite in Deutschlands erstem grünen Unicorn - Gestalte aktiv die solare Energiewende mit. Die Sonne scheint auf der ganzen Welt - Bei Enpal arbeitest du mit einem hochmotivierten, diversen Team aus über 65 Nationalitäten. Grown-up Business & Startup Spirit - In unserem modernen Office in Berlin-Friedrichshain findest du von höhenverstellbaren Tischen, Tischtennisplatte bis gefüllten Getränkekühlschränken und Barista-Coffee alles was das Herz begehrt. Dein Kick-start bei Enpal - Onboarding-Tag mit Welcome Bag, Buddy-Programm und einem Team, das dich wirklich abholt. Bleib auf dem Laufenden & gestalte mit - Transparente All-Hands, kurze Entscheidungswege und eine offene Feedback-Kultur, denn ohne Fehler gibt es keinen Fortschritt. Energiewende geht nur gemeinsam - Bei Enpal erwartet dich ein legendärer Teamspirit und unvergessliche Team- und Companyevents. Dein Extra-Boost - 20 + 2 Urlaubstage, vergünstigte Mitgliedschaft bei Wellhub und Corporate Benefits. Alles, was dir hilft, Arbeit und Leben gut zu verbinden. Mache dein Zuhause smart – Nachhaltigkeit fängt in den eigenen vier Wänden an. Als Teil des Teams profitierst du von dauerhaften 25% Rabatt auf das gesamte Bosch Smart Home Sortiment – für ein noch effizienteres und vernetzteres Zuhause. Wir bei Enpal sind stolz auf die Vielfältigkeit unseres Teams. Weder bei der Einstellung noch während des Beschäftigungsverhältnisses werden Entscheidungen auf Basis von Hautfarbe, Religion oder religiösen Glaubens, ethnischer oder nationaler Herkunft, Nationalität, Geschlechteridentität, sexuelle Orientierung, Behinderung oder Alter getroffen. title: Solutions Engineer - Paris
description: About Us Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar. Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes. 2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR , with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler. We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law. Joining Legora means three things. We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions. We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback. We grow together: as a team and with our customers. Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts. If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place. The Role As a Solutions Engineer at Legora , you’ll act as a technical and strategic partner to our sales team, engineering team and prospective clients. You’ll help customers understand how Legora’s solutions solve their most complex technical challenges, lead technical discovery, create custom demonstrations, and support the end-to-end sales process. This role is ideal for someone with strong technical expertise, excellent communication skills, and a passion for working with customers to drive value. Your work will directly influence Legora’s growth and customer satisfaction. What You'll Do Lead technical discovery discussions to understand customer pain points, use cases, and requirements. Collaborate with our Legal Engineers to create demos and proof-of-concepts that clearly illustrate how Legora’s solutions address customer challenges and create value. Facilitate technical workshops and proof-of-value sessions. Respond to technical questions, security concerns, RFI/RFP responses, and implementation feasibility discussions. Act as a trusted advisor and technical liaison throughout the sales cycle from early engagement to contract negotiation. Design and propose scalable technical solutions based on customer needs and Legora’s product capabilities. Translate complex requirements into clear architecture diagrams, implementation roadmaps, and proposal documentation. Collaborate with Product and Engineering to validate feasibility, share customer feedback, and influence roadmap priorities. Partner with Go-to-Market teams to shape deal strategy and shape technical strategy early in the sales process. Support onboarding of technical sales content (demos and demo scripts, battlecards, case studies) that improve sales efficiency. Work closely with Technical Delivery and Customer Success to ensure smooth transition from pre-sale to implementation. What You Bring Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent experience). 5+ years of experience in technical pre-sales, solutions engineering, sales engineering, or a customer-facing technical role (preferably B2B). Experienced with having technical delivery discussions, responding technical questions coming from clients. Experience delivering technical presentations and demos to both technical and business decision-makers. Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical topics clearly. Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. title: AI Workflows Engineer - UK
description: About the role Neural Concept's Vertical Solutions team turns the most common engineering use cases into streamlined, production-grade workflows empowered by leading AI technologies. As an AI Workflows Engineer , you will own the design and delivery of AI-powered, Python-first engineering solutions for a specific industry application. You will collaborate with the Vertical Solutions Product Manager and key customers to define the roadmap and build workflows that integrate design, simulation, and machine learning—helping to shorten product development cycles and amplify impact. As the primary developer, you will work closely with CAD and CAE specialists to implement, maintain, and evolve these solutions. You will also identify reusable components that can be integrated into the Neural Concept platform, ensuring consistency, driving innovation, and accelerating adoption across applications. What you will do Lead the design and delivery of AI-powered engineering workflows for specific industry applications and integrate them into the Neural Concept platform for scalable adoption. Build & integrate: act as primary Python developer — define clean interfaces with CAD/CAE specialists; own coding, testing, CI, packaging, and releases Upstream reusable components to the Neural Concept platform. Standardize: stay close to active projects; spot recurring pain points and patterns, and turn them into reusable templates, presets, and best practices. Engage reference customers and end users to gather feedback, and drive adoption. Help define and review documentation, playbooks and hands-on training sessions. Who you are Must have: Experience building and shipping production Python tools in fast-moving, cross-functional teams. Hands-on Python engineer with strong software practices: packaging, testing (pytest), CI, code review, docs, and git. Hands-on 3D CAE experience: 3D CFD and/or FEA (e.g., STAR-CCM+, Fluent, OpenFOAM, Abaqus, ANSYS Mechanical, LS-DYNA, NASTRAN) Contribute to technical direction and architecture while acting as a hands-on developer for vertical workflows; comfortable integrating external tools and defining clean data/interfaces for specialists. Background in physics or engineering, or equivalent experience. Clear, concise communicator who collaborates effectively across teams. Location: Cambridge (UK), or willing to relocate; hybrid setup with up to 2 remote days/week. Nice to have: Industry exposure in an engineering-intensive sector (e.g., turbomachinery, energy, aerospace, automotive) and familiarity with product design processes is a strong plus. Familiarity with CAD Familiarity with ML and common libraries (scikit-learn, PyTorch, Tensorflow...) Experience with agentic AI orchestration What You Get Work with a world-class technology team – our engineers are top-notch, and we always aim for excellence. Benefit from a competitive salary and rewarding opportunities as we continue to scale. Thrive in a collaborative, multicultural environment where your work is visible and recognized. Develop professionally alongside talented colleagues who share knowledge freely and support one another. Make a global impact by helping customers shift to AI-assisted design, making innovation faster, smarter, and more sustainable. Balance life and work with a hybrid model and flexible hours—we care about results, not rigid schedules. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we're committed to building a diverse and inclusive environment where you can thrive.
