title: Senior Response Engineer - Cloudflare Managed Defense Center (CMDC)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Location: Singapore</strong></p> <h2><strong>About the Department</strong></h2> <p><strong>Cloudforce One</strong> is Cloudflare's threat operations and research team, responsible for identifying and disrupting cyber threats ranging from sophisticated cyber criminal activity to nation-state sponsored advanced persistent threats (APTs). Cloudforce One works in close partnership with external organizations and internal Cloudflare teams, continuously developing operational tradecraft and expanding ever-growing sources of threat intelligence to enable expedited threat hunting and remediation.</p> <p>Members of Cloudforce One are at the helm of leveraging an incredibly vast and varied set of data points that only one of the world's largest global networks can provide. The team analyzes these unique data points at massive scale and efficiency, synthesizing findings into actionable threat intelligence to better protect our customers.</p> <h2><strong>About INTERDICT</strong></h2> <p><strong>I.N.T.E.R.D.I.C.T.</strong> (Identify, Neutralize, Triage, Engage, Respond, Disrupt, Integrate, Contain, Threat Hunting) is Cloudforce One's unified operational security organization responsible for identifying, analyzing, and responding to threats targeting Cloudflare and its customers. INTERDICT encompasses three main sub-functions:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Cloudflare Managed Defense (CMD):</strong> Network and application security monitoring for 'Under Attack' mitigation support.</li> <li><strong>PhishGuard:</strong> Managed email threat detection and response service.</li> <li><strong>Detection Engineering:</strong> ML model development and detection optimization.</li> </ul> <p>Together, INTERDICT provides comprehensive <strong>24×7×365 protection</strong> across email, application, and network threat surfaces.</p> <h3><strong>Role Summary</strong></h3> <p>As a <strong>Senior Response Engineer</strong> within the Cloudflare Managed Defense Center (CMDC), you will serve as a subject-matter expert and technical escalation point for threat mitigation across Cloudflare’s strategic enterprise customer base. In this role, you will lead the response to sophisticated, multi-vector cyberattacks spanning OSI Layers 3, 4, and 7, operating beyond standard playbooks to diagnose anomalies, engineer custom mitigations, and stabilize mission-critical infrastructure under fire.</p> <p>Beyond active incident command, you will act as a force multiplier: architecting customer-specific defense strategies, authoring and refining automated detection logic, mentoring Tier 1 and Tier 2 engineers, and collaborating directly with Cloudflare Product and Engineering teams. We are looking for an experienced, high-ownership technical leader who excels during high-stakes incidents and is passionate about mentoring others while advancing threat mitigation at scale.</p> <p>CMDC operates 24×7×365. <strong>This role participates in a regional shift rotation and on-call escalation rota including periodic weekend and public-holiday coverage as part of a follow-the-sun model across AMER, EMEA, and APAC.</strong></p> <h3><strong>Role Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Act as the technical lead and incident commander during high-impact, multi-vector security events, designing and deploying bespoke mitigation strategies when standard runbooks do not suffice.</li> <li>Perform deep-dive forensic analysis into complex Layer 3/4 and Layer 7 traffic anomalies, identifying zero-day attack patterns, sophisticated bot networks, and novel evasion techniques.</li> <li>Apply advanced mitigation strategies and filter malicious traffic using Cloudflare’s core security suite, including Magic Transit, Web Application Firewall (WAF), and Advanced Rate Limiting.</li> <li>Lead technical communications and incident bridge calls with enterprise C-level executives, principal network engineers, and security teams during critical events, clearly articulating root causes, impact assessments, and remediation paths.</li> <li>Monitor and investigate proactive security alerts across internal telemetry systems to rapidly triage incoming events, assess blast radius, and validate threat severity.</li> <li>Adhere to and champion strict customer SLAs for alert response times, event analysis, and clear executive reporting.</li> <li>Mentor and elevate Tier 1 and Tier 2 engineers through structured shadowing, technical post-mortems, and internal training.</li> <li>Partner with internal Engineering and Product teams to translate operational attack trends into prioritized platform enhancements, tool feedback, and automated detection logic.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Role Requirements (Must-Have Skills)</strong></h3> <ul> <li>A minimum of 6–8 years of hands-on experience in a high-volume Security Operations Center (SOC), Managed Detection and Response (MDR), network engineering, or incident response environment dealing directly with live threat mitigation.</li> <li>Comprehensive knowledge of networking principles and internet infrastructure, including TCP/IP, UDP, ICMP, DNS, BGP routing mechanics, and edge network design.</li> <li>Deep expertise in Layer 7 protocols and web architectures (HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, HTTP/3, TLS handshakes/ciphers, reverse proxy models, and API security).</li> <li>Experience analyzing network traffic data for anomaly detection and designing, tuning, and executing advanced mitigation strategies against L3/L4 and L7 attacks, including bespoke countermeasures when standard playbooks are insufficient.</li> <li>Advanced proficiency in packet capture and network traffic analysis using tools such as tcpdump, Wireshark, or tshark to isolate anomalies and dissect malformed or novel payloads.</li> <li>Practical experience analyzing and mitigating security incidents using AI and machine learning tools, paired with the hands-on capability to build and integrate custom tooling that improves operational workflows, accelerates log telemetry analysis, and defends against AI-driven botnets and adversarial edge attacks.</li> <li>Proficiency in using the command line (Bash shell) alongside general system administration literacy across Linux, Mac, or Windows environments.</li> <li>Proven experience commanding incident bridges, making decisive risk-tradeoff decisions, and maintaining composure while managing enterprise stakeholders during high-pressure crises.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice-to-Have Skills</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Direct experience querying large-scale distributed logging and analytics systems using SQL, GraphQL, ClickHouse, or SIEM platforms (Splunk, Elastic, Sumo Logic).</li> <li>Hands-on experience defending against advanced persistent threats (APTs), credential stuffing, scraping botnets, or application-layer bypass attacks against major CDNs/WAFs.</li> <li>Relevant industry certifications, such as CISSP, CCNP/CCIE, or advanced GIAC credentials (e.g., GCIA, GCIH, GNFA).</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage o

title: Delivery Manager - Generation Flex
description: Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe! Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy. We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide. It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone. Kraken Generation Flex The energy industry is undergoing the largest transformation since industrialisation at an unprecedented rate of change and we are positioning ourselves to be at the heart of that change. Our aim is to be the leading global provider of solutions that enable customers to release £30bn of value per annum from distributed energy resources (DERs). We are building a Software as a Service (SaaS) subscription business with a global addressable market of £2.4 billion per annum, by digitally connecting hundreds of thousands of DERs with energy markets. We have already attained a market leading position and Kraken is a recognised thought leader and innovator in the industry. 🏠 Where you'll fit in: As we enter a stage of rapid commercialisation and growth, we're looking for a Generation Flex Delivery Manager to own the successful onboarding of flexible generation and energy assets onto KrakenFlex across the EU with a focus on Germany. This is a customer-facing delivery role with a strong technical bias. You'll manage an asset through the full onboarding journey, from initial discovery and technical analysis, through site design and gateway installation, to commissioning, testing and handover into live service. You'll sit at the intersection of our customers, Electrical Engineering, Product and Customer Success Engineering teams. You'll need to understand both the connectivity and control architecture of our customers' assets and how those assets connect to and operate through the KrakenFlex SaaS platform . You won't be expected to design the details of the integration solution or write the software yourself. Instead, you'll need enough technical depth across both areas to understand how they fit together, identify gaps and risks, challenge incomplete information and drive the right conversations to get a site successfully integrated. Your role is to bring together three perspectives throughout onboarding: Customer : What is the customer trying to achieve, and what do we need from them? Product : How will the asset operate within KrakenFlex, and what product capabilities and configuration are required? Engineering : How does the physical asset need to be integrated, connected and commissioned to make that solution work? Your job is to make sure those three come together as one successfully delivered customer solution . 🚀 What you'll own: Own the end-to-end onboarding and delivery of Generation Flex assets BESS (grid-scale and C&I) and RES (Wind and Solar), from initial onboarding through analysis, site design, installation, configuration, commissioning, testing and handover into live service. Build a strong understanding of the Generation Flex product and SaaS platform , including how assets are represented, configured, monitored and controlled within KrakenFlex. Understand how the physical site and its electrical/control systems connect into the KrakenFlex software architecture, and bring those two worlds together throughout onboarding. Work closely with Product and Software Engineering teams to understand the relevant GenFlex capabilities, product modules, configuration requirements and technical constraints for each customer and asset. Translate between customer requirements, electrical engineering requirements and SaaS/product requirements , making sure each group understands what is needed from the others. Understand the end-to-end data and control path from the physical asset through site controls, meters, PPCs, gateways and communications infrastructure into Kraken Flex, and from Kraken Flex back to the asset where control is required. Ensure that the customer's intended use of the GenFlex product is reflected in the technical onboarding solution, including the required telemetry, controls, configuration, integrations and product modules. Be able to explain to customers how their site will interact with KrakenFlex, both from a physical integration perspective and from a software/product perspective. Work with Product teams to identify where customer or asset requirements do not fit current product capabilities, and ensure gaps, constraints or product dependencies are surfaced early. Feed recurring onboarding challenges, customer requirements and technical integration pain points back into Product and Engineering teams to help improve and scale the GenFlex proposition. Be the primary delivery point of contact for customers during site onboarding, setting clear expectations around what we need from them, what Kraken is delivering and what needs to happen next. Work closely with our Electrical Engineering and Customer Success Engineering teams to ensure the technical information required to integrate a site is complete, accurate and available at the right stage of delivery. Review and interpret customer technical documentation including: Electrical Single Line Diagrams (SLDs) Network and communications diagrams Site and asset specifications PPC and controller documentation Modbus register maps IP addressing and network information Functional Design Specifications Metering and telemetry information Hardware and connectivity requirements Be confident discussing technical site architecture with customers and engineers, understanding how equipment such as generators, batteries, meters, PPCs, controllers, gateways and site networks fit together. Identify missing, inconsistent or technically unclear customer information early and drive it to resolution before it becomes a delivery blocker. Coordinate the preparation and review of Kraken integration documentation, including gateway architecture, communications diagrams, Kraken SLDs, integration designs and site configuration information. Coordinate the Kraken Gateway delivery and installation process , ensuring prerequisites such as power, networking, connectivity and installation arrangements are understood and ready. Manage readiness for key commissioning and testing activities, including: Gateway installation and connectivity Operational acceptance testing Kraken market and service testing Proactively manage delivery risks and communicate issues and mitigation plans clearly to internal and external stakeholders. Surface blockers early and drive the right people together to resolve them rather than allowing issues to sit between teams. Maintain clear visibility of the status and health of each site, including technical readiness, product readiness, customer actions, Kraken actions and upcoming milestones. Continuously improve the Generation Flex onboarding process, identifying recurring technical, product or customer blockers and working with Engineering, Product and Operations teams to remove them. 🧠 What you'll bring to the party: A strong technical background and the confidence to work closely with electrical, control systems, and networking. A practical understanding of industrial networking and communications , including concepts such as IP addressing, LANs, routers, switches, VPNs and site connectivity. Enough electrical engineering knowledge to understand concepts such as metering, breakers, transformers, generators, inverters, batteries and asset control systems. Experience delivering technical projects involving the integration, commissioning or onboarding of physical assets, ideally within energy, renewables, utilities, industrial automation, controls or a similar environment. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to take a complicated technical problem and clearly explain the issue, impact, owner and next action. Experience coordinating multiple teams and dependencies across customers, Electrical Engineering, hardware, installation partners and other third parties. A highly organised approach to delivery, with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple sites at different stages of onboarding simultaneously. The ability to proactively identify risk, remove blockers and maintain momentum in an environment where customer readiness and site timelines can change quickly. A customer-centric mindset and a drive to provide an outstanding onboarding experience without compromising technical quality. A pragmatic, collaborative approach and the confidence to operate in a fast-moving environment where processes and products are still evolving. A strong interest in understanding how a SaaS product works end-to-end , rather than treating the software platform as a black box. title: Ingénieur(e) Intégration & Validation Cryogénique
description: Quandela est un leader mondial de l’informatique quantique, qui conçoit, développe et déploie des solutions quantiques de pointe à destination de la recherche et de l’industrie. Son offre comprend notamment les ordinateurs quantiques les plus économes en énergie pour les data centers, des solutions complètes de calcul quantique accessibles via le cloud, ainsi que des services d’accès à des algorithmes pour les acteurs académiques et industriels. Avec une feuille de route pragmatique et progressive, Quandela déploie depuis 2023 des systèmes de niveau industriel, tout en développant les futures générations d’ordinateurs quantiques tolérants aux pannes, capables de passer à l’échelle grâce à l’intégration de milliers de composants photoniques. Quandela ambitionne de rendre l’informatique quantique accessible au plus grand nombre afin de contribuer à résoudre les défis industriels et sociétaux les plus complexes. En savoir plus : Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions Rejoignez-nous à la pointe de l’innovation en informatique quantique 🚀 À propos du poste Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités de production et d'intégration de processeurs quantiques photoniques (QPU), nous recherchons un(e) Ingénieur(e) Intégration & Validation Cryogénique pour rejoindre notre équipe Assemblage & Production, basée à Massy. Vous interviendrez principalement sur l'intégration et la validation des équipements et sous-ensembles au sein des cryostats utilisés dans nos systèmes. Ces opérations impliquent la manipulation de composants sensibles et délicats , nécessitant une grande précision, de la méticulosité et une attention particulière aux conditions de montage et d'intégration. Vous réaliserez les opérations de montage, de câblage, de thermalisation, de mise en service et de contrôle, en veillant au respect des contraintes cryogéniques et des protocoles de validation. Vous participerez également au suivi du fonctionnement et des maintenances des équipements cryogéniques, notamment les cryostats et leurs compresseurs associés. La compréhension et l'utilisation des systèmes de vide et de pompage feront partie de vos activités, en tant qu'éléments nécessaires au bon fonctionnement des installations cryogéniques. Au-delà de l'application des procédures, vous devrez être capable de comprendre le comportement des systèmes, d'analyser les anomalies et de contribuer à l'identification des actions nécessaires à leur résolution, en collaboration avec les experts techniques concernés. Selon les besoins, vous pourrez apporter un support technique à distance ou intervenir ponctuellement sur les systèmes installés chez nos clients, en France ou à l'international. Le poste s'inscrit dans un environnement de production en petite série , avec des équipements complexes et multidisciplinaires. La montée en échelle de la production est déjà engagée, notamment à travers la structuration progressive de nos méthodes et processus d'industrialisation. Une première base documentaire est déjà en place, et vous contribuerez à son amélioration afin de rendre les opérations plus robustes, reproductibles et adaptées à l'augmentation des volumes de production. Vous bénéficierez d'un accompagnement et de formations internes pour approfondir votre connaissance des équipements cryogéniques spécifiques à Quandela, avec la possibilité de devenir progressivement un interlocuteur technique de référence sur ces systèmes. Missions principales Intégration et validation des équipements dans les cryostats Vous réalisez l'intégration de composants et sous-ensembles, parfois sensibles et délicats, au sein des cryostats. Ces opérations nécessitent une grande précision et le respect des exigences de propreté, de manipulation et d'assemblage. À ce titre, vous : Préparez les cryostats, les composants et les équipements nécessaires aux opérations d'intégration. Manipulez et assemblez avec précision des composants sensibles , en appliquant les précautions et méthodes adaptées à leur fragilité et à leurs contraintes d'intégration. Réalisez le montage et l'intégration des composants et sous-ensembles dans les chambres de cryostats. Assurez le passage, le cheminement et la fixation des câbles et connexions à l'intérieur des enceintes cryogéniques, en veillant à préserver l'intégrité des composants et des connexions. Réalisez les opérations de thermalisation des câbles et composants, en tenant compte des contraintes thermiques et mécaniques. Veillez au respect des contraintes d'intégration : encombrement, interfaces mécaniques, compatibilité des matériaux, propreté et contraintes thermiques. Appliquez les bonnes pratiques de manipulation, de protection et de contrôle des composants tout au long des opérations d'intégration. Réalisez les opérations de contrôle et de validation de l'intégration selon les protocoles définis. Analysez les résultats des contrôles, identifiez les éventuelles non-conformités et participez à leur résolution. Rédigez les rapports de validation associés et assurez la traçabilité des opérations réalisées. Identifiez les difficultés d'intégration et proposez des améliorations adaptées. Requirements Compétences techniques – Indispensables Titulaire d’un diplôme Bac+5 (Master ou diplôme d’ingénieur) en photonique, optique, électronique, mécanique, physique appliquée, physique de la matière condensée ou dans un domaine connexe. Un doctorat (PhD) serait apprécié. Bonnes connaissances pratiques en cryogénie et compréhension des contraintes associées aux basses températures. Connaissance des principes de transfert thermique, de thermalisation et des contraintes mécaniques liées aux environnements cryogéniques. Capacité à réaliser des opérations de montage et d'intégration de composants dans des systèmes cryogéniques. Expérience dans la manipulation et l'assemblage de composants sensibles ou délicats, nécessitant précision et précautions particulières. Maîtrise des bonnes pratiques de manipulation, de propreté et de protection des composants lors des opérations d'intégration. Compréhension du fonctionnement général des cryostats et de leurs équipements associés. Connaissance des principes de mise sous vide et du fonctionnement des équipements de pompage nécessaires aux applications cryogéniques. Capacité à réaliser des opérations de mise en service, de refroidissement et de validation selon des procédures établies. Capacité à réaliser et valider des opérations d'intégration selon des protocoles définis, à analyser les résultats et à rédiger les rapports associés. Capacité à interpréter des mesures de température et de pression pour analyser le fonctionnement d'un système. Capacité à réaliser les premières investigations techniques, à analyser les symptômes observés et à contribuer à l'identification des causes d'un dysfonctionnement, en collaboration avec les experts lorsque nécessaire. Capacité à suivre des procédures tout en sachant identifier les situations nécessitant une analyse complémentaire ou l'intervention d'un expert. Capacité à assurer le suivi des échéances de maintenance et des interventions réalisées. Capacité à lire, appliquer et rédiger des procédures techniques et des rapports d'essais. Sensibilisation aux risques associés aux systèmes cryogéniques et aux équipements sous vide. Qualités recherchées Méticulosité et précision : capacité à réaliser des opérations d'assemblage délicates avec soin, patience et une attention constante aux détails. Rigueur et respect des procédures : attention portée à la qualité des montages, à la propreté des équipements et à la protection des composants sensibles. Autonomie et esprit d'initiative : capacité à prendre en charge les activités confiées, à identifier les difficultés et à solliciter les bons interlocuteurs lorsque nécessaire. Esprit d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes : capacité à comprendre le comportement des systèmes, à analyser les anomalies et à mener des investigations méthodiques. Pragmatisme et sens pratique : goût pour les manipulations techniques, l'intégration et la résolution concrète de problèmes. Organisation et traçabilité : capacité à documenter les opérations, suivre les essais et maintenir des historiques techniques fiables. Curiosité technique et volonté d'apprendre : intérêt pour le fonctionnement des équipements et l'acquisition progressive d'une expertise approfondie. Esprit d'amélioration continue : capacité à contribuer à la structuration des processus et à l'amélioration des méthodes de travail. Capacité à travailler en équipe avec des profils techniques variés et à solliciter les experts appropriés. Pédagogie et communication : capacité à transmettre des connaissances et à accompagner d'autres intervenants. Respect des règles de sécurité et conscience des risques associés aux systèmes cryogéniques et aux équipements de vide. Benefits Ce que nous offrons : Un rôle à fort impact, avec de réelles responsabilités dès votre arrivée Une équipe qui a envie de collaborer, de partager et de grandir avec vous Un modèle de travail hybride : 3 jours par semaine sur site à Massy, 1 jour à Paris et 1 à 2 jours en télétravail Une exposition quotidienne à l’ensemble de la stack quantique : des API haut niveau jusqu’au firmware bas niveau, et tout ce qui se trouve entre les deux Processus de recrutement : Entretien avec l’équipe Talent Acquisition (30 à 45 min) Entretien avec le Hiring Manager (45 min) Étude de cas : en direct ou à préparer chez vous puis à présenter Rencontre avec les équipes 2 prises de références Offre Ce processus est donné à titre indicatif et peut évoluer en fonction du poste. Chez Quandela, nous sommes convaincus que la richesse de notre équipe repose sur la diversité des expériences, des perspectives et des parcours. title: Forward Deployed Engineering Manager
description: <p>As the Forward Deployed Engineering Manager, you will lead the team that puts Auterion's robotic systems to work with customers in the field. We build complete systems: vehicles, sensors, onboard compute, radio links, autonomy software, and ground control. Your job is to understand how all of it fits together and to make it work in real missions.</p> <p>You will lead your team through the entire customer engagement, from discovery and integration to field trials and handover. You are not a hardware specialist. You are a systems engineer who can trace a problem across every layer of the system, lead people well, and earn the trust of demanding customers.</p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities and Duties</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Team Leadership & Mentorship:</strong> Lead and grow a cross-functional team of Forward Deployed Engineers covering systems integration and software. Hire, coach, and develop your engineers. Build a culture of ownership and proactive problem-solving.</li> <li><strong>Accountability:</strong> Keep the bar high for yourself and your team. Work directly with stakeholders across the company. You will have a close relationship with the CTO, CEO, VP of Engineering, and the engineering directors.</li> <li><strong>Field Deployment Oversight:</strong> Own technical delivery of customer deployments in demanding, non-standard environments. This covers system configuration, connectivity, mission readiness, and operation under environmental constraints.</li> <li><strong>System Integration:</strong> Act as the technical lead for high-stakes customer integrations. Ensure the full system works end to end: vehicle, payloads, onboard compute, communication links, autonomy software, and ground control.</li> <li><strong>Field Troubleshooting:</strong> Diagnose failures across hardware, firmware, software, and communications. Use logs, telemetry, and structured debugging to find root causes fast.</li> <li><strong>Stakeholder Management:</strong> Serve as the primary technical contact for defense and enterprise customers. Translate operational requirements into deployment plans that account for system performance, link quality, power, and mission constraints. Run technical meetings, demos, and field days.</li> <li><strong>Feedback Loop & Release Coordination:</strong> Work closely with Product and R&D to feed field results and real-world edge cases back into the product. Coordinate with R&D on platform releases so customer deployments stay current and stable.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Qualifications and Skills</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Systems Engineering:</strong> 7+ years in technical roles in robotics, drones, autonomous vehicles, or comparable complex embedded systems. You understand the full system end to end and how a change in one subsystem affects the others.</li> <li><strong>Leadership Experience:</strong> 3+ years managing a technical, customer-facing team (Field Engineers, Forward Deployed Engineers, Solutions Architects, or similar). You have dealt with underperformance and built team culture deliberately.</li> <li><strong>Software Skills:</strong> Comfortable working in Linux. You write Python, read C++, and use Git. You debug from logs and telemetry, not only at the bench.</li> <li><strong>Hardware Fluency:</strong> You understand hardware at integration level: power, sensors, interfaces, and RF basics. You do not need to be a hardware designer.</li> <li><strong>Field Deployment Expertise:</strong> Hands-on experience with field-deployed systems where "turning it off and on again" isn't always an option. Understanding of networking and radio communication is a major plus.</li> <li><strong>Crisis Management:</strong> Proven ability to troubleshoot critical failures in the field under high pressure and with limited physical access to the hardware.</li> <li><strong>Customer Presence:</strong> Composure and credibility in front of demanding customers. You communicate clearly with engineers and decision-makers alike.</li> <li><strong>Languages:</strong> Fluent English. German is a strong plus.</li> <li><strong>Work Authorization:</strong> Must hold EU citizenship and be eligible to work in the European Union without restriction.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice to Have</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience with PX4, ArduPilot, or ROS2</li> <li>Background in defense or government programs</li> <li>Eligibility for German security clearance</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Benefits</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Flexible working hours</li> <li>Stock Options</li> <li>Generous holiday allowance</li> <li>Pension plan </li> <li>Extended social security package </li> <li>Enhanced maternity & paternity leave</li> <li>Wellpass membership </li> </ul> <h3><strong>About Auterion</strong></h3> <p>We are building the leading software platform for AI-powered autonomous systems for enterprise and government customers. Our team is supporting the most important missions and solving the most challenging problems.</p> <p>At Auterion, we bring together the sharpest minds who love to solve the hardest problems. Join a vibrant team built on innovation, openness, and excellence, where you’ll be empowered to develop ideas, collaborate across all levels, and make an impact that matters.</p> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description: <p>As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Auterion, you will play a pivotal role in the successful development, integration and deployment of Auterion-powered drone systems. </p> <p>In this role, you will collaborate closely with the production, hardware engineering, and firmware/software teams, as well as operations, ensuring that every platform transitions smoothly from an airframe concept into a fully validated flying robot ready for deployment. You will serve as the primary technical interface for partners, work closely with them to understand their technical requirements, configure and adapt existing solutions, contribute to core software development, and ensure successful implementation. </p> <p>This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys combining hands-on technical work with customer collaboration and system-level problem solving, autopilot ecosystems, including sensor calibration, ESC tuning, and system bring-up.</li> <li>Provide deep avionics and airframe expertise, including autopilot tuning, sensor and payload integration, power systems and airworthiness considerations.</li> <li>Work independently to troubleshoot integration and flight-readiness issues while collaborating cross-functionally with hardware engineering, As a Product Manager, you will operate across multiple product streams under a clear vision, elevate execution standards and best practice, and turn customer and data insight into measurable business outcomes. You’ll be the connective tissue across engineering, design, research, commercial, and operations - raising the bar for strategy, delivery, and culture while helping coach other PMs to do their best work.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Scale strategy & vision: Connect adjacent product areas under a coherent strategy and outcome-based OKRs; We work closely with engineering, network, security, service delivery and commercial teams. Write precise technical requirements: API contracts, payload and metadata schemas, delivery guarantees, retry and failure handling, security controls and acceptance criteria. Lead large projects for our biggest compliance customers, onboarding their engineering and compliance teams with proper documentation, from scoping through rollout. Deep, hands-on knowledge of APIs: REST design, authentication, versioning, webhooks, pagination, error handling and idempotency. You read OpenAPI specs, test endpoints yourself and hold your own in design discussions with engineers. Solid understanding of file and message-based integrations such as SFTP, SMTP and object storage (for example AWS S3), including batch versus near real-time delivery, encryption and access control. A track record of leading large, cross-functional projects for enterprise customers with demanding technical, security and reliability requirements. Clear, precise writing: requirements, acceptance criteria and edge cases that engineering teams can build from without guesswork. A genuine interest in compliance products and enterprise integrations. You want to understand how regulated firms capture, retain and supervise communications, and why every record matters. Confident communication with engineers, customer technical teams, compliance officers and executives, in fluent written and spoken English. Nice to Have Telecom experience, for example mobile voice and SMS, MVNO platforms, SIP, call recording or CDRs. Compliance or regtech experience, such as communications recording, archiving or surveillance. Experience shipping AI features in production, such as speech-to-text, LLM evaluation or human-in-the-loop review. Benefits Why 1GLOBAL? title: Principal Software Architect
description: <h2><strong>About Graphcore </strong></h2> <p>Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute.  </p> <p>It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.  </p> <p>As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.  </p> <p>Graphcore’s teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore enjoys a culture of continuous learning and constant innovation.<br><br></p> <h2><strong>Job Summary</strong> </h2> <p>We are looking for a Principal Architect to define and drive the architectural vision of the software stack for the Graphcore ML accelerator.</p> <p>In this role, you will shape the architecture of our software ecosystem and maintain a deep understanding of the product’s hardware and software components, their interfaces, and how they interact.</p> <p>You are an excellent communicator, and you proactively convey the software architecture.</p> <p>You bring a pragmatic, trade-off-aware approach to decision-making, fully recognising the impact of architectural choices on product direction and engineering outcomes. </p> <h2><strong>The Team</strong> </h2> <p>The software architecture team is responsible for defining, maintaining and communicating the overarching architecture of our software stack, from firmware to ML frameworks.</p> <p>The team works within the wider software organisation, partnering closely with engineering teams who deliver against this architectural vision. </p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities and Duties</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Define & document the software architecture of the software stack.  </li> <li>Work across different software domains to ensure a coherent end too end architecture.</li> <li>Clearly communicate the software architecture to engineering teams.</li> <li>Ensure teams understand key software architectural components, interfaces, and guiding principles. </li> <li>Continuously maintain the software architecture as the product evolves. Communicate architectural changes proactively to all relevant stakeholders. </li> <li>Stay informed about trends and developments in the ML/software ecosystem.</li> <li>Assess the architectural impact of new technologies.</li> <li>Be aware of the usability, performance, reliability, maintainability, testability, security and observability constraints on the software architecture. </li> <li>Prototyping and validating architectural concepts through proof-of-concept implementations. </li> <li>Contribute to future and/or related product definitions with a forward-looking mindset, understanding and communicating the impact of future direction on software architecture. </li> <li>Work with the HW and Silicon architects to ensure product the needs of software stack. </li> <li>Ensure the software architecture meets the product requirements.  </li> <li>Work closely with engineering, product, leadership, and partners to ensure alignment between business goals and architectural direction. </li> </ul> <h2><strong>Candidate Profile</strong></h2> <h3><strong>Essential:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Expertise in one or more of these technologies; Firmware, Drivers, ML frameworks (PyTorch, Triton, etc), Collectives, HPC, Tooling, C & C++, CPU architectures.</li> <li>Technical expertise in the ML accelerator software space.</li> <li>Excellent communication skill, both written and verbal. </li> <li>Collaborative mindset and ability to influence. </li> <li>Pragmatic approach to decision making, being very aware of trade-offs and implications. </li> </ul> <h3><strong>Desirable</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Demonstrable experience in a previous architecture role. </li> </ul> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>In addition to a competitive salary, Graphcore offers flexible working, a generous annual leave policy, private medical insurance and health cash plan, a dental plan, pension (matched up to 5%), life assurance and income protection. We have a generous parental leave policy and an employee assistance programme (which includes health, mental wellbeing, and bereavement support). title: AI Research Engineer
description: <h3><strong>About Graphcore</strong></h3> <p><span data-teams="true">At Graphcore, we’re building the future of AI compute.We’re a team of semiconductor, software and AI experts, with deep experience in creating the complete AI compute stack - from silicon and software to infrastructure at datacenter scale.As part of the SoftBank Group, backed by significant long-term investment, we are delivering key technology into the fast-growing SoftBank AI ecosystem.To meet the vast and exciting AI opportunity, Graphcore is expanding its teams around the world.We are bringing together the brightest minds to solve the toughest problems, in a place where everyone has the opportunity to make an impact on the company, our products and the future of artificial intelligence.</span></p> <h3>Job Summary</h3> <p class="p1">As a research engineer at Graphcore, you will contribute to the advancement of AI research, investigating new ideas that push the limits on important AI/ML problems. Specialised hardware has been the key driver of the progress of AI over the last decade, and we believe that hardware-aware AI algorithms and AI-aware hardware developments will continue to be critical to advancing this exciting field. We are therefore looking for individuals who combine strong machine learning experience with practical engineering skills to deliver impactful AI research. We are seeking AI researchers with strong software engineering experience, particularly in lower-level programming and performance optimisation for hardware efficiency. Our research spans a broad range of topics, including efficient training and inference, world models, life sciences, reinforcement learning, and beyond. You will work closely with researchers to generate ideas and translate them into scalable implementations, contributing to publications and projects that help to steer the future of AI hardware.</p> <p> </p> <h3>The Team</h3> <p>Graphcore Research participates in both fundamental and applied research, to characterise the computational requirements of machine intelligence and to demonstrate how hardware can drive the next generation of innovative AI models. We publish at leading AI/ML conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR) as well as specialist workshops, and collaborate with other research teams and organisations across the world.</p> <p>We pride ourselves on being a supportive and collaborative team, where we organise around our individual research interests to solve problems together in domains such as efficient compute, model scaling and distributed training and inference of AI models for multiple modalities and applications, including for sequence- and graph-based data. We’re based across London, Cambridge and Bristol, with projects and discussions that involve all our locations.</p> <p>Perhaps the best way to get an idea of what we’re all about is to read one of our <a href="https://graphcore-research.github.io/publications/">papers</a> or an article on our <a href="https://graphcore-research.github.io/posts/">blog</a>. If you’re excited to work at the cutting edge of AI supported by new hardware and want to develop your skills in this area, we’d love to hear from you!<br><br></p> <h3>Responsibilities and Duties</h3> <ul> <li>Generate AI/ML ideas, design experiments, implement them & evaluate results.</li> <li>Prepare, submit & present your work to AI conferences and workshops.</li> <li>Provide technical insight to internal teams by designing experiments and delivering clear, actionable reports.</li> <li>Collaborate with researchers, silicon and software engineers at Graphcore to help define, build and test Graphcore’s next generation of AI hardware.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3>About you:</h3> <p>Essential:</p> <ul> <li> Master’s, PhD or equivalent experience in a technical discipline (e.g., Maths, Statistics, Computer Science, Physics, Chemistry).</li> <li>Python programming in a modern deep learning framework, e.g. PyTorch or JAX.</li> <li>Familiar with deep learning fundamentals: models, optimisation, evaluation and scaling.</li> <li>Capable of designing, executing and reporting from ML experiments.</li> <li>Lower-level programming for hardware efficiency, e.g. C++/CUDA/Triton.</li> <li>Practical familiarity with hardware capabilities for deep learning – threads, caches, vector & matrix engines, data dependencies, bus widths and throttling.</li> <li>Practical familiarity with software stacks for deep learning – compilation, kernel fusion, XLA/ATen ops, streams, and asynchronous execution</li> </ul> <p>Desirable:</p> <ul> <li class="p1">Mathematics skills to support the above: calculus, probability theory and linear algebra.</li> <li class="p1">Experience submitting papers to international scientific conferences or workshops.</li> </ul> <p> </p> title: Senior Software Engineer, Inference Performance
description: About Tensordyne AI is transforming our world. It can perform cognitive functions that previously only humans could do, such as perceiving interactions across different modalities and environments - with the ability to quickly learn and then solve complex problems. Tensordyne is an AI system solution company that builds very high-performance, low-power generative AI inference systems. Our mission, through the creation of custom silicon, hardware and software, is to enable multimodal Generative AI inference acceleration at scale, with safe, sustainable, high-performance systems for our hyperscaler and neocloud data center customers. We are at the leading edge of advancing the latest research and product improvements for generative Al inference solutions that will make Al even more advantageous for compelling new generative AI applications.Tensordyne is a well funded, fast-paced startup company with headquarters in both Sunnyvale, CA, and Munich, Germany. We also have many talented team members working remotely across North America and Europe. We take care of our people and their families with comprehensive benefits, competitive compensation, flexible spending options, and recognition programs, because building category-defining technology starts with a healthy, supported team. Come join us as we shape the future of multimodal generative artificial intelligence! The role You'll build the software stack that takes a model from code down to the hardware: the abstractions, kernels, libraries, and tools that engineers and agents use to reach peak performance. Help optimize the latest AI models on our silicon. Our hardware is designed to be straightforward to program, so the goal is not to hide it. The goal is to expose the right level of control at each layer, from our compiler-driven Python SDK to our low-level Rust programming stack, and to make every performance gap measurable and every fix permanent. We're looking for a builder who understands hardware deeply and develops with agents by default. You'll own substantial parts of one of these layers and work closely with engineers across models, compilers, runtime, and hardware. Your focus is performance: where cycles, bandwidth, and communication go, and how to win them back. Number formats and model accuracy are owned by our conversion and emulation team; you'll partner with them where precision and speed meet. What you'll do Build the stack. Design APIs, kernel abstractions, and libraries in our Python SDK or Rust stack so model engineers and agents can reach high performance at the layer that fits their problem. Make models fast. Take priority workloads, from LLMs to multimodal models, to peak performance on real silicon. Profile, find the bottleneck across kernels, compiler, runtime, and parallelism, and fix it at the right layer. Close the gap between model and measurement. Compare measured performance against analytical models and simulation. Explain every material gap, and turn the explanation into a fix or a better model. Build the agentic performance loop. Give agents the profilers, traces, counters, and benchmark harnesses to form a hypothesis, change code, and measure the result in minutes. Make the results trustworthy enough to act on. Set the bar for performance. Define how we measure, track regressions, and report results. Build for the next chip. Design abstractions that carry forward to future hardware generations. Work with hardware architects to test how architectural choices affect real workloads. What we need from you You understand hardware performance. You've optimized AI workloads on GPUs or custom accelerators and can reason about compute utilization, memory hierarchy, latency hiding, synchronization, and multi-chip scaling. You build excellent software. You've owned substantial systems from design through production. You're strong in Python and/or at least one systems language such as Rust, C++, or C, and rigorous about interfaces, abstractions, and testing. We care about engineering quality more than a specific language. You understand LLM inference end to end. You can read a new model's implementation and reason about prefill, decode, attention variants, KV caches, MoE, and parallelism, and how they map to compute, memory, and communication. You build with agents. Agentic development is how you work, not an experiment. You'd rather build the loop that finds the optimization than find it by hand, and you know when the loop still needs a human. You build things others succeed with. You've designed APIs, libraries, or performance tooling that other engineers adopted. You drive problems to resolution. You form clear hypotheses, measure, and follow the evidence across software and hardware boundaries. You take ownership of the result. If you hit a few of those boxes, we'd like to speak to you. We'd be thrilled if you had Experience with embedded, bare-metal, or low-level runtime programming. Experience with MLIR, other compiler frameworks, or kernel DSLs such as Triton, Pallas, NKI, or CuTe. Contributions to LLM serving stacks such as vLLM or SGLang, or a track record of taking end-to-end inference workloads to competitive performance on a hardware target. Why join us Your code will decide how fast models run on our hardware, and how easy it is for the next engineer, or the next agent, to make them faster. You'll own a layer of a new programming model, work directly with the people designing the hardware, and see your decisions tested on real silicon and carried into the next generation. Tensordyne Values Think big. Pursue ambitious technical and business goals. Aim for excellence. Quality matters in everything we build and deliver. Own it and get it done. Take responsibility and drive results. Operate with integrity. Be direct, transparent, and respectful. Win as a team. Make the people around you more effective. Value different perspectives. The strongest teams challenge assumptions and bring diverse experience to difficult problems. Tensordyne is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams are better equipped to solve complex problems and build exceptional technology. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, race, religion, pregnancy, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances. A note to recruitment agencies: Please do not contact Tensordyne employees or leaders regarding this role. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and are not responsible for fees associated with unsolicited submissions. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Data Analyst Marketing
description: HEY THERE! Ready to put our brand in front of millions of people worldwide? We’re looking for a Data Analyst, Marketing to turn raw campaign and engagement data into decisions — telling us which channels, markets, and customers to target next. This isn’t a dashboard-building role. You’ll build robust data products, of course — but the real impact comes from the reporting and insight you deliver, and the incremental value that creates for the marketing team. Let’s shape the future of nutrition together and make Yazio the most successful nutrition app worldwide! This role is 100% remote and open to candidates based in Germany, Spain, Portugal, or the U.K. YOUR MISSION Show our Performance Marketing team which campaigns to double down on — and which to scale back. Partner with our CRM team to learn what messaging resonates with each user segment, then run experiments to measure the uplift. Own the data transformation process, from raw channel and MMP data to curated, ready-to-use datasets in our self-service BI tool. Define requirements with Data Engineering to ingest new data sources. Work with the Analytics team to build a data-driven culture across Yazio. YOUR PROFILE Hands-on experience with performance marketing data for a native mobile app, covering channel-level or MMP data (ideally both). Solid grasp of attribution, incrementality, funnel and cohort analysis, plus marketing performance metrics like iROAS and CAC. High proficiency in SQL and working knowledge of Python. Solid experience in either analytics engineering (e.g., using dbt to transform data) or data science (e.g., geo-lift tests, holdout tests, A/B tests, media mix modeling). You don’t need both, but you should be strong in one. OUR CORE TECH STACK We use: Snowflake as our core Analytics data warehouse. dbt & Dagster to transform & orchestrate our data. Growthbook to power experimentation. Omni to provide self-service analytics. Prefect to handle our ML workflows. WHY US? title: Principal Software Engineer - XTM One
description: 🌀 The Company Founded in 2022, Filigran is a global cybersecurity company on a mission to empower defense teams to be proactive through open-source solutions that uncover threats and drive action. Filigran stands out in the cybersecurity ecosystem through its open-source, AI-powered and threat-informed approach to Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). Our eXtended Threat Management (XTM) platform brings together threat intelligence, exposure validation and cyber risk reduction, enabling organizations to better understand their threat landscape and take action. At the heart of Filigran is our open-source approach. Our vision is to unite defenders into a global community to make security more open, resilient and collaborative. As Filigran continues to scale globally, we are building the organization, infrastructure and capabilities needed for our next stage of growth. How we scale matters just as much as how fast we scale: our CORE values: Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity shape how we work together, make decisions and build for the future. 🎯 The Role We're looking for a Principal Software Engineer to define and drive the technical direction of XTM One , Filigran's AI platform for threat informed defense and the agentic core of the XTM Suite. XTM One creates and runs cybersecurity expert AI agents and dispatches their intelligence across OpenCTI, OpenAEV and OpenGRC. It also hosts the suite's shared commons (unified authentication, consolidated datasets, configuration) and ships both as SaaS and on premises. Every XTM product connects to it, which makes its architecture one of the most structuring technical decisions at Filigran. This is not a management role: no headcount, no sprints. You own the technical craft, standards and vision of XTM One, and you carry them into the XTM Foundation, where the engineering principles shared by all products are set for the 60+ engineers at Filigran. 💼 Your Responsibilities Vision & architecture Define and carry the technical vision of XTM One over the long term, with technical and product leadership. Own the platform architecture : agent runtime and orchestration, tool and MCP integrations, data and context layers, APIs, permission model, shared commons. Design for SaaS and on premises from day one: multitenancy, isolation, upgrade paths, configuration, operability in customer environments. Arbitrate key decisions on scalability, resilience, security, maintainability and cost, including LLM latency and inference cost. Standards & quality Define the team's technical principles (architecture patterns, code quality, tooling, CI/CD, testing, development with AI assistants) and get them applied through docs, reviews, pairing and example. Set the bar for observability and reliability of nondeterministic AI workloads: metrics, logs, traces, evaluations, and guardrails that make agent behavior measurable and debuggable in production. Keep the right balance between features, technical debt and innovation. Integration across products & XTM Foundation Define how OpenCTI, OpenAEV, OpenGRC and future products integrate with XTM One : contracts, authentication, data exchange, versioning. Be a full member of the XTM Foundation : bring the XTM One perspective in, carry its decisions back, and keep coherence with the other Principal and Staff Engineers. In the code Write production code, prototype new approaches before the team adopts them, review critical PRs so that feedback teaches, and unblock engineers. 🤝 Who You'll Work With Reports to: VP of Technology Key collaborators: XTM One engineering team and its verticals; XTM Foundation (Principal and Staff Engineers across OpenCTI, OpenAEV, OpenGRC); Product leadership; open source contributors. Working model: embedded in the XTM One team, with regular XTM Foundation work. 🧬 Profile We're Looking For 10+ years in software engineering, with technical leadership on complex production platforms. Strong fullstack background, with a backend and architecture focus. You master TypeScript and Python , the core languages of XTM One, and you can take a feature from the data model all the way to the UI. Strong system design : distributed systems, scalability, performance, security, observability. A 360° view of software engineering : product need, design, code and tests, CI/CD, packaging and release, infrastructure and deployment, production operations, monitoring, incident response. A container image or an upgrade path is as familiar to you as an API contract. Built and operated platforms delivered both as SaaS and on premises , including multitenancy and enterprise constraints. Strong AI affinity. You've been building with LLMs by choice for a year or two, with LLM systems in production : agent frameworks, tool calling, MCP, RAG and vector search, evaluation, and the discipline to make them reliable. Technical watch is part of the job. You keep up with your craft deliberately (reading, experimenting, prototyping) and turn what you learn into concrete proposals. You define and carry technical standards : you raise the bar on a team, you don't just follow it. Excellent written communication in English: design docs, ADRs and review comments that others learn from. Autonomous and at ease in a remote, asynchronous culture ; you drive problems to resolution and enable others instead of becoming a bottleneck. Bonus: cybersecurity domain knowledge (CTI, CTEM, MITRE ATT&CK, STIX/TAXII); extensible plugin or tool ecosystems; open source contributions or maintainership. 🛡️ About XTM One XTM One is Filigran's AI platform for threat informed defense . It is dedicated to creating and running cybersecurity expert AI agents and dispatching their intelligence across the products of the XTM Suite. Every product of the XTM Suite is connected to XTM One to leverage AI agents for a more proactive platform that is easier to use. Within XTM One, agents can use and correlate data across products to make the most meaningful assessments and take the most relevant actions. XTM One also hosts shared commons such as unified authentication and consolidated datasets and configuration. 🌱 Why Join Filigran? More than just a job. We are a fast-growing, global and remote-first company , and we believe the best work combines purpose, impact and innovation . You’ll work alongside talented people across the world who care about what they build, how they build it, and the impact they make on the broader cybersecurity ecosystem. ⭐ Be part of something bigger We believe we do work that matters. Our open-source approach means that work extends beyond Filigran. You’re contributing to technology and ideas that strengthen a global community of defenders and help make cybersecurity more open and collaborative. 💻 Work at the edge of what’s next We bring together cybersecurity, open source and AI — giving you the opportunity to work with emerging technologies, experiment with new ways of working, and contribute to how they are applied in practice. 🌍 Global opportunity without borders Be part of a fast-growing, truly international team — collaborating across Europe, North America, APJ and beyond, with the flexibility of a remote-first environment. As we grow, you’ll have opportunities to expand your scope, take ownership, learn quickly and grow with us. 🧭 A culture grounded in CORE Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity define how we work together — with openness, ownership, collaboration and respect. These are the principles that guide how we make decisions, treat people and grow together, especially when no one’s watching. 💰 What you can expect Competitive compensation + equity — everyone shares in our success Remote-first flexibility — work from wherever you’re based, with flexibility built into how we operate 25 days PTO baseline — real time to disconnect, recharge and enjoy life outside work Volunteer days — paid time to contribute to causes that matter to you Set up for success — choose the equipment that works for you, with additional support for your remote work and development needs as our programs evolve Two annual in-person get-togethers — one global company get-together and one team get-together, creating dedicated time to connect, collaborate and strengthen our culture beyond the screen 🌍 Equal Employment Opportunity We enable cybersecurity through inclusion — from code to culture. At Filigran, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe the diversity of our people makes our products and our team stronger. We welcome talent of every background, identity and lived experience, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability or veteran status. What matters here is what you bring, not what you look like, where you’re from or how you identify. 🚀 Ready to Join Us? At its core is a platform layer that unifies shared components such as health monitoring and logging. Every device type then works the same way, and product features build on one solid base. The role combines architecture and hands-on engineering: clean, object-oriented software, plus ownership of how it is built, deployed, updated and monitored across the fleet. It provides shared components such as health monitoring, logging, configuration, OTA updates and hardware abstraction. Software architecture: Define clear interfaces between the platform and the applications on top of it. Consolidate the codebase so that new device types and components plug in easily. Application development: Build Python services on top of the platform, inside our dockerized main application. Device integration: Connect peripherals such as modems, watchdogs, cameras and AI accelerators through existing drivers, SDKs and Linux interfaces, behind a clean hardware abstraction. Reliability and observability: Make our fleet secure, resilient and transparent through OTA updates, networking, inter-process communication and fleet-wide monitoring of device health. Debugging: Analyze and solve complex issues at application and system level, such as memory leaks, network instability or service failures. Ownership and mentoring: Take end-to-end responsibility, guide other engineers technically, and raise our engineering standards. Inspire us by Senior software engineering experience: 5+ years of professional software development, with a strong part of it on Linux-based devices or edge systems. Strong OOP skills: Deep experience with object-oriented design in (preferably) Python. Experience in another OOP language such as C++, Java or Rust is a plus. Architecture know-how: You have designed and evolved software architectures, applied design patterns, and made trade-off decisions you can explain clearly. Ideally you have built a platform, framework or shared library that other teams or services build on. IoT background: Hands-on experience building software for connected devices, ideally operated as a fleet in the field. Linux user-space expertise: Solid knowledge of Linux, systemd, networking, IPC, Bash and Docker, ideally across different hardware architectures (ARM and x86). Debugging skills: Experience troubleshooting system-level issues with tools such as GDB, tcpdump, Valgrind or profilers. Engineering mindset: Degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Language skills: Fluent English (C1). title: Finance & Legal Lead
description: 👷🏻‍♀️ What we do 👷🏻‍♀️ At Emidat, we get manufacturers back to manufacturing. Why it matters. Today, only 11% of employees in Germany are engaged at work , and knowledge workers spend 58% of their day on work about work . We want to live in a world where people do work they enjoy and that creates value. A physical world that improves everyday where manufacturers of physical products who build the world around us focus on making better, more sustainable materials. Today, low-value work is often done by people at a company because they’re the only ones who know where the data is - the current data sheet, the hand-issued declaration. EU regulation adds more every year, and when the paperwork is late, the product cannot be sold. International competition and an ageing workforce increase the problem. What we do. Emidat connects to a manufacturer’s own systems and builds one verified record per product and plant. On it runs AI applications that produce the documents: Environmental Product Declarations (EPDs), digital product passports, data sheets, tender answers. The experts approve. The software does the typing. Where we are. 250+ manufacturers in 60+ product groups and 25+ countries, among them Holcim, Sika and a long list of mid-sized family companies. We started automating sustainability data for front runners who already wanted to do the right thing - next is everyone else. Who we are. 50+ people in Munich, we run on ownership, action over complaint and low ego. We aim to become better everyday and reinvent ourselves quickly. Find out more about us, the team and our values here. What you will work on Your mission Build Emidat's finance engine and turn our numbers into the decisions that shape how we grow. As our Finance & Legal Lead, you own both topics at Emidat and take the function forward as we enter our next phase of growth. You make sure finance scales seamlessly with the company and turn our numbers into insights that steer decisions on both the growth and the tech side. At the same time, you keep the engine running: our books are clean, our contracts protect us and nothing falls through the cracks. You manage our external partners (tax advisors, legal counsel) and when something important is stuck, you're the one who follows up relentlessly until it's done. This role is about ownership. From day-to-day operations to the high-impact projects that shape how Emidat scales, it starts and ends with you, and you bring an exceptional attention to detail to all of it. Your core areas Finance Take our finance function to the next level: set up the processes and tools we need to scale, using automation and AI wherever it makes sense. Own RevOps and our revenue data (ARR, renewals, churn, upsells) and turn it into insights that help our growth, customer success and product teams serve our customers even better. Build and maintain financial planning, dashboards, investor reporting and relations. Own invoicing, contracts and payments with our customers and make working with Emidat smooth and transparent for them. Manage accounting operations and be the main point of contact for our tax advisors. Depending on your experience, you may also take over payroll. Support fundraising efforts: package up metrics, prepare materials and help shape the strategy. Drive non-dilutive funding such as grants. Legal Handle all non-employee legal matters (customer contracts, supplier agreements etc.) and be the point of contact to our external legal counsel. Own our customer contract framework (T&Cs, DPA) and work with our sales team on contract solutions that give our customers confidence and help close deals faster. Prepare legal due diligence in fundraising and make sure we stay compliant with regulatory requirements together with our information security team. Minimum Qualifications Language: Fluent in German (C2 / Native) and business proficiency in English (C1+). Finance & Legal Experience: Deep hands-on experience owning operational and strategic finance in a start-up / scale-up environment. You know German accounting and tax basics and are comfortable reviewing and negotiating commercial contracts. RevOps / CRM Experience: You have worked with CRM and revenue data (e.g. HubSpot) and know how deals, contracts and billing data should flow between systems. Analytical & Technical Skills: Demonstrated experience building financial models, dashboards or introducing data-driven decision making, and/or experience implementing AI-driven tools or automations that measurably reduced manual work. Project Execution and Ownership: A proven track record of owning and executing projects from A to Z in a high-ownership, self-managed position, ideally building up processes or a function from scratch. Extreme Detail-Orientation: Demonstrated ability to be in the weeds of the details to ensure success and accuracy. You have experience catching what others miss, making sure nothing falls through the cracks. Nice to haves Academic Background: Master's degree in business, finance, economics, law or a related quantitative field. High-Growth Experience: Prior experience in a fast-paced startup or equivalent high-performance environment (e.g. B2B SaaS, Consulting, PE, IB, VC). Fundraising Experience: You have been through a fundraise or due diligence process, on either side of the table. Payroll Experience: You have run payroll and worked with DATEV and tax advisors. How we support you Your Team Lead will be Florian (Co-Founder and CTO at Emidat) You will work with Lisa (Co-Founder and CEO at Emidat) Ajay (People & Talent Lead) Isabel (Team Lead, Go-to-Market) Janos (Team Lead, Growth & Sales Development) Sina (Team Lead, Customer Success) Benedikt (Team Lead, LCA) Your mentors can be Legal and Finance: Lisa Gradow (Co-Founder & CEO at Fides, Sequoia Arc '22, prev. Co-Founder and CPO at Usercentrics) Sales: Theresa Hauck (Co-Founder at econos — sustainable finance, ex-BCG, United Nations) Company Building, Network: Markus Linder (Founder & CEO inoqo, prev. zoovu) Meet the rest of the team HERE . title: Senior Data Scientist
description: In 2018, Bitvavo launched the first version of its digital assets trading platform, to bridge the gap between traditional currencies and digital assets. By offering transparent fees, a wide range of assets and an easy to use platform, Bitvavo is making the currency of the future accessible for everyone. In eight years time, Bitvavo has established itself as the market leader in the Netherlands and one of the largest in Europe, with over two million users exchanging tens of billions of digital assets a year. About the Opportunity We are an exchange. The speed of good decisions matter in everything that we do. Our data domain is committed to making sure the decisions this business makes on spend, pricing, product, risk and financial crime rest on evidence rather than intuition. We're seeking exceptional talent to join us in making this a reality. The Problems You'll Get to Solve Growth & causal inference. Measure true incrementality, own our marketing mix model, and turn that into spend allocation under a budget. Product & personalization. Rank and surface what is relevant to each customer's behaviour and holdings, from asset discovery to order form defaults, without drowning users in noise Markets, pricing & execution. Model fee and spread elasticity to find the revenue-versus-volume trade-off, and improve execution quality: slippage, order routing, liquidity provider selection. Risk & financial integrity. Model risk exposure across a volatile asset book, forecast liquidation risk, and detect reconciliation breaks across internal ledgers, on-chain data and partner reporting. Financial crime & compliance. Detect account takeover, payment fraud and mule networks in real time, combining business rules and models that work together while staying explainable and auditable. What You'll Be Doing Own problems end to end: frame the question with the stakeholder, build the model or experiment, ship it, and follow it into production. Work backwards from the decision. Start from what someone needs to decide and what it costs to get it wrong, not from the data that happens to be available. Stay accountable for your models once they are live: monitoring, drift, retraining, and the day they start behaving differently. Tell senior stakeholders things they do not want to hear, including that a campaign, a feature or a rule did not work. Support your teammates in growing every day by setting the standard for how we do causal inference, reviewing their work, and sharing knowledge. What We Look For Strong applied experience turning a messy business question into a model or a measurement: causal inference where that fits, predictive and ranking models where it does not. You know when a result is not real. Fluency in Python and SQL, and comfort working independently rather than waiting for data to be handed to you. We use Snowflake, dbt, Airflow and Looker, on top of technologies like MySQL, Druid, Kafka and Flink. A track record of models that made it into production and changed a decision, not just notebooks and slide decks. Sound statistical judgement, and the honesty to quantify and communicate uncertainty rather than hide it. Exceptional communication skills. We expect you to talk to various stakeholders to derive requirements, drive discussions, and facilitate decision-making processes effectively. Extraordinary sense of ownership. We are committed to empowering people with freedom and accountability. Nice to have: Experience building with agentic tooling such as MCP or agent frameworks, or automation platforms like n8n. At Bitvavo, we believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation, foster creativity, and lead to better outcomes. We are committed to building a team that reflects the diversity of the communities we serve and creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. Regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, ability, or any other characteristic. Join us and be part of a team that values and celebrates your unique contributions. Bitvavo does not accept resumes from staffing, search, or recruitment firms without a signed agreement. If you send us a resume without such an agreement, we may contact the candidate directly without any obligation whatsoever and no fee of any kind will be paid should we hire the candidate. What We Offer At Bitvavo, we believe in attracting, motivating and retaining talented people through market-competitive offerings that go beyond compensation alone.
