title: Field Sales Representative - Amsterdam
description: Lightspeed is driven by building the restaurant platform that helps restaurants adapt, take control, and get back to what they do best: building the businesses they love. As a Field Account Executive, you will be part of a team that is transforming the way restaurants operate. Using a consultative approach, you will prospect, build relationships, and sign up new restaurateurs in your local area. By understanding their unique needs, you will develop a customised solution that helps their business thrive. We need your passion and sales expertise to help us build the Lightspeed brand in your area. Your responsibilities: Generate lists of prospective restaurants and manage the entire sales cycle from initial outbound call/ walk in to close (experience with self-sourcing clients is a huge plus) Conduct demos and develop a solution that best meets the prospect’s needs Partner with teams across the business to ensure that expectations set during the sales process are met in delivery Leverage Salesforce (our CRM) to manage all sales activities Understand the competitive landscape and determine how to best position Lightspeed in the market What you will bring to the team: Dutch fluency is a must Experience in a sourcing or closing customers, restaurant operations, or a relatable field and industry Since this is a field position, you will be out and about on a daily basis in your territory Strong communication, organisational and presentation skills with the ability to sell and negotiate at all decision-making levels Proven track record of success in meeting and exceeding goals Ability to work in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial and team environment Self-motivated, creative, and flexible General technical proficiency with software Experience with Salesforce CRM is a plus What’s in it for you? Come Live the Lightspeed Experience…. Genuine career growth opportunities based on performance within a company that's continuously expanding. Uncapped commission Work with highly skilled people who are as passionate about sales & marketing as you are An environment that encourages initiatives and leadership Work in a team big enough for growth but lean enough to make a real impact; and enjoy a range of benefits that’ll keep you happy, healthy and (not) hungry: Lightspeed equity scheme (we are all owners) Health & Wellness Credit- expense up to 400 EUR per year towards your gym membership, yoga classes, a new bike or whatever else you do for your health Mental Health Support through the Modern Health App- whether it is meditation, coaching or counseling you need - each employee gets access to this platform People Experience - Our PX benefit allows you to work from pretty much anywhere in the world for 60 days a year LinkedIn Learning: At Lightspeed we believe in having a growth mindset, we provide free access to LinkedIn learning along with your career GPS to help you learn & grow Subsidy to annual travel pass if you travel by public transport to the office Regular breakfast or lunches, drinks & snacks in our Amsterdam office To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. Where to from here? Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here . Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs. Who we are: Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks. Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries. Lightspeed handles your information in accordance with our Applicant Privacy Statement . Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Strategic Account Executive - France
description: France-based | French required | English required | Additional languages are a plus | Approximately 30% travel About Rescale Rescale is pioneering the future of engineering and scientific discovery. As the leader in digital engineering, we help the world’s most advanced organizations develop better products faster through intelligent automation, applied AI, data management, and access to the world’s largest network of engineering and R&D applications. Rescale brings together elastic, enterprise-grade HPC with advanced modeling and simulation, agentic engineering, AI Physics, and the software and data workflows that connect them. Our customers use Rescale to modernize R&D, accelerate simulation, automate engineering processes, and turn engineering data into faster, better decisions across industries including automotive, manufacturing, aerospace, energy, life sciences, and semiconductors. Joining Rescale means becoming part of a diverse, collaborative, and mission-driven team solving complex challenges that traditional HPC alone cannot address. The Role We are looking for a high-performing Strategic Account Executive to lead direct enterprise sales and account growth across France. This is an entrepreneurial, field-based role focused on building and expanding strategic relationships with key and enterprise accounts. You will own a defined portfolio of named accounts, create demand, develop executive relationships, win new business, and expand Rescale’s footprint from foundational HPC into advanced modeling and simulation, agentic engineering, and AI Physics. You will operate as the commercial owner of your territory: setting the account strategy, identifying business problems, building internal champions, creating compelling value cases, and leading complex sales cycles from first engagement through renewal and expansion. This is a direct-sales role, not a channel-led position. You will work closely with Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Marketing, Sales Development, Product, and Rescale leadership, while retaining ownership of the commercial strategy and outcome. France is a priority market, with particular emphasis on automotive and manufacturing enterprises where engineering organizations are investing in digital engineering transformation. Success requires the ability to sell both into existing strategic relationships and into new enterprise accounts where Rescale can create meaningful business impact. What You’ll Do Own and grow a focused portfolio of strategic key and enterprise accounts across France. Build account and territory plans that identify the highest-value expansion paths, whitespace, executive relationships, and competitive risks. Expand existing Rescale customers by introducing additional capabilities across the platform, from Rescale HPC to Advanced Modeling and Simulation, Agentic Engineering, and AI Physics. Develop new enterprise relationships and win new logos where Rescale’s platform can transform engineering and R&D workflows. Generate pipeline through proactive prospecting, account-based engagement, executive networking, customer insight, and disciplined market development. Engage senior stakeholders across engineering, R&D, simulation, IT, digital transformation, finance, procurement, and executive leadership. Lead the full enterprise sales cycle, including account planning, discovery, qualification, value engineering, business-case development, solution alignment, negotiation, procurement, and close. Position Rescale as a strategic platform for HPC modernization, simulation acceleration, engineering workflow transformation, and AI-driven product development. Articulate how Rescale’s offerings work together: HPC as the scalable foundation; Advanced Modeling and Simulation as the workflow layer; Agentic Engineering as the automation layer; and AI Physics as the intelligence layer that turns simulation data into predictive insight. Build trusted relationships across the customer organization, from end users and technical champions to business sponsors, procurement leaders, and C-level decision-makers. Orchestrate internal teams to deliver coordinated account plans, executive engagement, technical validation, pilots, and commercial proposals. Maintain rigorous Salesforce hygiene, forecast accuracy, opportunity inspection, and pipeline coverage, with clear weekly visibility into commit, likely, best case, and risk. Represent Rescale in customer meetings, industry events, and executive forums across France, with travel expected at approximately 30%. What Success Looks Like Consistent achievement and overachievement of quarterly and annual revenue targets through a healthy mix of account expansion and net-new enterprise business. Durable growth within strategic accounts, including broader adoption of Rescale’s platform and expansion into new teams, workloads, geographies, and use cases. A high-quality, self-generated pipeline across automotive, manufacturing, and other engineering-intensive industries. New enterprise logos and meaningful strategic wins in the French market. Executive-level credibility with customers navigating HPC modernization, simulation, AI, and digital engineering transformation. Clear customer value cases that connect technical outcomes to business priorities such as faster product development, higher engineering productivity, improved infrastructure flexibility, and better R&D economics. Consistent operating discipline, urgency, ownership, resilience, and transparency in a high-growth environment. Who You Are An entrepreneurial enterprise seller who creates opportunity rather than waiting for inbound demand. Equally comfortable expanding an established strategic account and opening a new enterprise relationship. A strong hunter with the persistence and commercial judgment to create access, build consensus, and win competitive deals. Confident engaging technical practitioners while earning credibility with senior business leaders and executives. Resilient and resourceful in long, complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles. Commercially disciplined and accountable for your number, account strategy, forecast, pipeline quality, and execution. Consultative, curious, and able to translate complex technology into compelling business outcomes. Collaborative and low-ego, with the influence to mobilize cross-functional teams without losing ownership of the result. Motivated by the opportunity to help define a new category at the intersection of cloud HPC, digital engineering, automation, and AI. Key Qualifications 5+ years of success in enterprise or strategic account sales, ideally selling complex technical, cloud, SaaS, platform, engineering, or scientific-computing solutions. Demonstrated success growing enterprise accounts and/or winning new business in France. Experience selling to large organizations in automotive, manufacturing, industrial technology, engineering software, simulation, HPC, cloud, or adjacent technology environments. A track record of managing long, complex, multi-threaded enterprise sales cycles from discovery through close and expansion. Ability to engage credibly with engineering, R&D, IT, digital transformation, procurement, finance, and executive stakeholders. Strong skills in consultative discovery, value selling, negotiation, executive communication, and closing. Experience using Salesforce or a similar CRM with disciplined opportunity management and forecasting. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in French and English . Additional languages are an advantage. Strong organization, prioritization, and account-planning skills. Must be based in France and able to travel regularly to customer sites and industry events across the country. Why Rescale Rescale serves many of the world’s most advanced engineering organizations and is helping define the next generation of digital engineering. For the right sales leader, this is an opportunity to shape strategic accounts in a category where cloud HPC, advanced simulation, agentic engineering, and AI Physics are converging to change how products are designed, tested, and brought to market. If you are energized by building executive relationships, creating demand, expanding strategic accounts, and helping engineering organizations move from traditional infrastructure and fragmented workflows to an intelligent digital engineering platform, this role offers significant strategic and commercial upside. Rescale is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applications from all qualified persons regardless of race, sex, disability, religion or belief, sexual orientation, age, or any other protected characteristic. Employment with Rescale is contingent upon successful completion of a comprehensive background check. For details on the information Rescale collects during the application process, please see the Applicant Privacy Notice . Compensation: €150K – €177K • Offers Equity • Offers Commission • On-Target Earnings €150K – €177K • Offers Equity • Offers Commission Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Customer Journey & App Analytics Apprentice
description: Hi, we’re Back Market. We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new . We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new. Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have. Are you ready to join us? JOB DESCRIPTION: Back Market is on a mission to make refurbished tech the new norm. To achieve this, we use data to better understand our customers, improve their experience, and make smarter product and business decisions. Within the Data Division, the Customer Experience Analytics team supports teams working across the customer journey, CRM, and Services. We help the business understand customer behaviors, identify opportunities to improve the experience, and measure the impact of new initiatives. As a Customer Journey & App Analytics Apprentice , you will primarily support the Customer Journey and App Analytics scope. You will work closely with Product, Tech, UX, and Business teams to analyze customer behavior, support experimentation, and turn data into actionable insights. This apprenticeship is a great opportunity for a curious, structured, and business-oriented student who wants to develop strong skills in product analytics, experimentation, customer journey analysis, and mobile app analytics. YOUR MISSION (IF YOU ACCEPT IT): 🥇 Support the analysis of customer journeys across Back Market’s website and mobile applications, from discovery and purchase to delivery, return, and after-sales service Contribute to the preparation, analysis, and monitoring of Customer Journey experiments, including A/B tests and other experimentation initiatives Help formulate analytical hypotheses, define success metrics, analyze experiment results, and identify actionable recommendations Investigate customer behavior across different touchpoints, segments, markets, and devices Build and maintain recurring dashboards, reports, and analyses for key stakeholders Contribute to the improvement of event tracking plans and analytics documentation Present findings and recommendations in a clear and accessible way to both technical and non-technical stakeholders YOU ARE IN THE RIGHT PLACE IF: ⭐ You are pursuing a Master’s degree, or equivalent, in data analytics, data science, business analytics, economics, engineering, marketing analytics, or another quantitative field You have a strong interest in customer behavior, product analytics, experimentation, and digital products You have solid SQL skills and are comfortable writing, reviewing, and improving analytical queries You have an analytical mindset and enjoy investigating the reasons behind changes in customer behavior or business performance You communicate clearly in written and spoken English You are curious, rigorous, organized, and willing to ask questions You enjoy working in a fast-paced, international, and collaborative environment Bonus point if : You have experience with analytics tools such as Amplitude, GA4, Mixpanel, or similar platforms You have already worked on A/B testing, experimentation, or product performance analysis You are familiar with mobile app analytics, event taxonomies, or tracking plans ABOUT THE APPRENTICESHIPℹ️ Starting date: January 2027 Duration: Ideally for 12 months (24 months to be discussed). Location: Bordeaux, France Contract: You must already be enrolled in a work-study program in a French school (contrat d'alternance / d'apprentissage) RECRUITMENT PROCESS: 📅 Skills fit/Tech interview with the direct manager Cultural fit interview with another person in the team Video-call Interview with the Campus Talent Acquisition Specialist WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US ? ✌🏼 At Back Market, we’re committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives — it’s one of the reasons we’re such a high-scoring certified B Corp company (93.2). No matter your role and seniority level, you’ll enjoy impact-driven work with hands-on career development in an innovative, driven, and fast-paced environment — with benefits to match, like: - A mission driven work environment where your day to day makes an impact on the planet. Seriously. - Hybrid work environment, with 2 remote days a week and 1 remote work week per quarter, plus 3 flex days. - Employee Resource Groups, including mentorship programs, comprehensive accessibility policies, and cultural competency training. At Back Market, we strive to create a workplace that embodies the world we’re trying to change. title: Senior Business Controller (Operations)
description: Would you like to work closely with the business as a Senior Business Controller and use your financial expertise to make a real impact on decisions? You will bring financial structure and insight, while keeping a forward-looking perspective: where can we improve, which decisions will make a financial difference, and what will they mean for our results? HG is a compact, international organisation. This means considerable responsibility, direct contact with decision-makers and room to drive change yourself. We are therefore looking for someone who takes ownership, works pragmatically and is not afraid to challenge existing ways of working. You will be based at our head office in Almere. Hybrid working opportunities are limited: regular office attendance is important in this role because of the close collaboration with Finance, Operations and other stakeholders. You will also travel to the United Kingdom or Germany several times a year. About the role As Senior Business Controller, you will be responsible for business control within Operations and will also support our subsidiaries in the United Kingdom and Germany. You have a clear vision of what the best operational business control model looks like and have proven experience in realizing this. The Senior Business Controller plays a key role in strengthening financial control, transparency and decision-making across Operations. The scope covers procurement and product costing, as well as warehouse and transport operations. Working closely with Finance, Procurement and Operations, the Senior Business Controller translates operational developments and improvement initiatives into clear financial insights and P&L impact Our business is undergoing significant change. HG has recently changed its logistics service arrangements, consolidating most local warehouses into one central location as part of a cost-saving initiative. At the same time, a new ERP system is being implemented. This creates an interesting and dynamic environment in which existing budget models, cost allocation models, reporting and financial processes need to be further developed to reflect the new operating model and provide a solid basis for financial control and decision-making. What you will do Your responsibilities will include: Owning the operational cost lines between Net Sales and Contribution Margin for the whole group and . act as a strong Finance business partner to the Chief Operating Officer and his team, translating operational developments into actionable financial insights; Identifying and driving continuous improvements to the operational business, improving insights while reducing costs. Being the financial business partner for the country managers in the UK and Germany, including reviewing commercial deals and business cases. Analyzing budget versus actuals and explaining significant variances. Developing a clear understanding of budgeted versus actual purchase prices and identifying the key drivers behind price variances. Providing insight into raw material and purchase price developments and translating these into expected P&L impact. Quantifying and tracking the financial impact of Procurement and product-costing initiatives and other savings programmes. Establishing and further developing standard COGS based on expected cost developments. Build a thorough understanding of the warehouse and distribution budget, operational performance and key savings initiatives. Track whether the expected savings from the recently implemented warehouse and transport provider change are being realized in the P&L. Further developing cost allocation models for individual markets, using meaningful drivers, and working towards more complete and reliable management reporting. Ensuring the Operations P&L, budget and actual costs are consistently captured and reported in the same structure. Translating inventory developments into financial impact and creating a clear link between stock levels, budget assumptions and cost allocation. Supporting and improving an efficient month-end closing process, ensuring Operations costs are accurately and consistently booked, allocated and reconciled. E stablish or improve proper accounting entries together with Finance Administration and relevant operational partners. Co-lead the annual budget cycle and budget presentations to the Board. Using and improving Power BI, ERP data and financial processes to reduce manual work and increase transparency. You will report directly to the Chief Financial Officer and work closely with colleagues in Finance, Procurement and Operations. You will also have regular contact with the Germany and UK country managers. This position requires more than strong analytical skills. You will need to explain your insights clearly, engage stakeholders and constructively challenge where necessary. You will be a knowledgeable sparring partner who asks questions, brings structure and takes responsibility from analysis through to implementation. You proactively identify opportunities to improve financial processes, controls, reporting and transparency across Operations. HG is a compact, fast-growing and international organization where you can directly see the impact of your work. This requires ownership, initiative and a pragmatic, results-oriented mindset. The team culture is open, pragmatic and focused on results, encouraging you to bring ideas forward, challenge constructively and take responsibility. Everything we do is guided by our three core values: Aim High, Be Brave, Be Connected. What you bring We are looking for a financially strong, hands-on and improvement-oriented controller who combines analytical capability with a practical understanding of Operations. The ideal candidate is comfortable working across Finance, Procurement and Operations and is able to turn complex cost drivers into clear insights and concrete actions. You bring a proactive mindset, strong stakeholder-management skills and a natural drive to simplify and improve processes. You are comfortable challenging existing ways of working, creating structure in a changing environment and taking ownership from analysis through implementation. You will also have: A completed university master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration or a related field. A Registered Controller (RC) qualification is a strong advantage. Around 10 years of relevant experience in business control, operations control or a comparable financial role. Experience in a manufacturing environment is important, including knowledge of production processes, procurement and cost calculations. A sound understanding of business control, financial controls and treasury. Experience with ERP systems and an understanding of how financial data and accounting flows are structured. Good knowledge of Power BI. You do not need to build everything from scratch, but you can independently investigate, improve and develop analyses. Experience working with consolidation tools. Strong analytical, communication and stakeholder management skills. A proactive, hands-on and improvement-oriented mindset, with the ability to create structure in a changing environment. Fluency in English. Knowledge of Dutch is desirable, and German is an advantage. Experience with AI tools, such as Copilot. Willingness to travel to the United Kingdom and Germany several times a year. Please note that we do not offer visa or work permit sponsorship for this position. You must therefore hold a valid EU work permit What do we offer At HG, you will not be stepping into a role where everything is already set in stone. Changes in our logistics operations, systems and reporting create opportunities to further professionalize financial control and implement improvements yourself. You can expect: a senior role with broad responsibility and direct influence on financial and operational decision-making; a salary appropriate to the seniority of the role, with an indicative range of €85,000 to €100,000 gross per year; an annual on-target bonus of 25% of your gross annual salary; full-time employment with 30 days of annual leave; a pension scheme; a commuting allowance; a full-time role based at our head office in Almere. Hybrid working is possible on a limited basis, with office attendance being an important part of the role; a dynamic and ambitious working environment where initiative and ownership are valued; a friendly, welcoming team, with a free shared lunch every Monday and monthly social drinks. We are HG HG is a leading European brand in specialist cleaning and maintenance products. We believe a home should be a place where people can live carefree, with confidence in the products they use to care for the spaces and belongings around them. Our products are developed to do exactly what they promise: deliver effective, reliable and specialist cleaning solutions that help consumers solve real household problems. HG’s mission is to help people enjoy their homes without worrying about what might go wrong. We do this through high-quality products, specialist expertise, clear advice and a relentless focus on performance. We are dedicated to delivering superiority, innovation, quality and customer satisfaction. With a strong presence across Europe and beyond, we are continuously investing to make an even bigger impact. HG does what it promises. Do you have any questions? Our colleague Ilse de Groot, Corporate Recruiter, will be happy to answer any questions. You can contact her at . Would you like to apply for the senior business controller position at HG? You can apply directly by uploading your CV. We aim to respond within 5 working days. Acquisition in response to this vacancy is not appreciated. title: Post-doctorante ou Post-doctorant en transmission et détection sur fibres à cœurs creux - CDD de 18 mois
description: Qui sommes-nous ? Télécom Paris, école de l’IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) et membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, est une grande école du top 6 des écoles d’ingénieurs généralistes françaises. La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement. Nous recherchons une Post-doctorante ou un Post-doctorant en transmission et détection sur fibres à cœurs creux pour rejoindre le département COMELEC à Télécom Paris. Les fibres à cristaux photoniques à cœur creux (Hollow-Core Photonic Crystal Fibers, HCPCF) ont récemment franchi une étape technologique majeure, avec des pertes de propagation pouvant atteindre 0.1 dB/km à 1550 nm, comparables, voire inférieures, à celles des fibres télécoms standards [1–2]. La lumière se propageant principalement dans l’air, les HCPCF présentent une latence réduite de 30 à 40 %, une dispersion ultra-faible et des non-linéarités optiques négligeables. Ces propriétés uniques en font des technologies particulièrement prometteuses pour les systèmes de télécommunications de nouvelle génération, la distribution quantique de clés (Quantum Key Distribution, QKD) sur longue distance et les applications de détection distribuée. Le projet proposé vise à développer et démontrer la prochaine génération de fibres à cristaux photoniques à cœur creux (HCPCF) pour la transmission de données à haut débit et les applications de détection. La propagation de la lumière dans l’air plutôt que dans le verre permet aux HCPCF d’offrir une latence réduite et des non-linéarités optiques négligeables par rapport aux fibres de silice, répondant ainsi à certains des enjeux majeurs des futurs centres de données et réseaux optiques. Notre ambition est de démontrer une transmission à 400 Gbit/s sur quelques kilomètres à travers des échantillons de fibres issus de nouvelles architectures, et d’étudier le potentiel de ces HCPCF pour des applications de détection. La réalisation de ces objectifs nécessite de répondre à des spécifications exigeantes en matière de guidage monomode, de contrôle de la polarisation, ainsi que de faibles pertes par courbure et par couplage. Deux équipes complémentaires assureront conjointement l'encadrement de ces travaux : le GPPMM, reconnu internationalement pour ses activités de conception et de fabrication de HCPCF [3–5], et le GTO, leader dans la démonstration de systèmes de communication optique et de détection à haut débit [6–8]. Un processus itératif entre la fabrication des fibres et leur caractérisation au niveau système permettra de s'assurer que leurs propriétés répondent aux exigences opérationnelles en matière de transmission et de détection. Sur le plan méthodologique, le projet combinera modélisation numérique, caractérisation et validation expérimentale dans la bande C. Les méthodes de modélisation et de traitement du signal développées au GTO pour le suivi de la polarisation contribueront à évaluer et à optimiser les performances de transmission des HCPCF conçues et caractérisées au GPPMM. À propos du projet PLEIADES Le projet PLEIADES s'inscrit dans le cadre du programme PEPR « Réseaux du futur », financé par l'ANR, et réunit un consortium de 14 partenaires. L'un des axes de travail porte sur les fibres à cœur creux de nouvelle génération et rassemble plusieurs laboratoires académiques, notamment LTCI, XLIM et PHLAM. Vos principales missions seront de : Assurer des missions de recherche dans le domaine de la photonique Assurer des missions d’encadrement et de tutorat Participer à la notoriété de l’Ecole, de l’Institut Mines-Télécom et de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris Vous êtes titulaire d’un doctorat ou équivalent en génie électrique, communications, photonique, traitement du signal ou dans un domaine connexe. Vous disposez de solides connaissances en systèmes et réseaux de transmission optique ainsi qu’en traitement numérique du signal (DSP) appliqué aux systèmes de communication ou aux capteurs à fibre optique. La maîtrise de MATLAB et/ou Python pour le développement d’algorithmes DSP sera appréciée. Vous manifestez un intérêt marqué pour la recherche appliquée et êtes à l’aise dans un environnement multiculturel, notamment pour encadrer des stagiaires et/ou des étudiants. Une bonne maîtrise de l’anglais est indispensable. Vous disposez également de bonnes qualités relationnelles et pédagogiques, d’un bon esprit d’équipe et d’une capacité à synthétiser et à communiquer des informations complexes. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Vous travaillerez dans un environnement en plein développement, agréable, verdoyant et accessible (notamment pour les personnes en situation de handicap) à seulement 20 km de Paris (RER B et C, proximité des grands axes routiers). Vous bénéficierez de : 49 jours de congés annuels (CA + RTT) flexibilité des horaires de travail (en fonction de l'activité du service) télétravail 1 à 3 jours/semaine possible Remboursement abonnement transports en commun à 75% Proximité de nombreuses infrastructures sportives, conciergerie, parking souterrain, restauration interne... A savoir : nos cotisations sociales sont moins élevées que dans le secteur privé Informations diverses : Date limite de candidature : 30 novembre 2026 Type d'emploi : CDD de 18 mois Description de poste ici Rémunération : 36 000 euros brut/an Nos recrutements sont fondés sur les compétences, sans distinction d’origine, d’âge, d'identité de genre et d’orientation sexuel et tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap. title: Senior AI Engineer - VLA Foundation Model

We believe that achieving general physical intelligence requires solving real customer problems in the real world, where robots can learn from rich operational data at scale. Following our acquisition by Amazon in March 2026, we are continuing this mission with greater reach and speed. By combining custom robot hardware, onboard autonomy, and cloud-based coordination, RIVR, part of Amazon is building the next generation of safe, reliable autonomous robots for last-mile delivery Job Description Our fleet of delivery robots operates globally today, generating vast amounts of robotic real-world data. By utilizing state-of-the-art Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, large-scale generalist models (like Transformers), generative AI, and similar methods, we can leverage this pool of data to significantly enhance its autonomy, navigation, and manipulation skills. In this role, you will develop multi-modal models that enable robots to autonomously generate actions from demonstrations, real-time sensor data, and natural language commands. Streamline the data collection and training workflow to efficiently expand model capabilities with new tasks and data sources. Collaborate with the reinforcement learning team to innovate methods that leverage both simulated and real-world data. Optimize and distill networks for real-time deployment on the edge (e.g. Nvidia Jetson Thor). Build, lead and mentor an exceptional team of software engineers. Provide expert guidance to product managers and executives for strategic decision-making. Create and maintain documentation, guidelines, and best practices to streamline knowledge sharing. A minimum of three years of industry or research experience, with PhD experience applicable. Strong deep learning fundamentals including supervised learning, self-supervised learning, Transformer-based architectures, policy optimization algorithms, imitation learning, and generative AI techniques (including Diffusion Models). Proven experience in developing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models or large-scale generalist robot models (e.g., RT-2, Octo, etc.). Strong background in robotics including autonomy, navigation. Experience with deploying artificial neural networks on hardware platforms. Ability to prototype algorithms and train deep neural networks in Python (Pytorch) Get some bonus points PhD degree in Robotics, Engineering, Computer Science, Machine Learning or a similar discipline, or an equivalent amount of research experience. Publications at top-tier conferences. Experience in managing a software team. Ability to write production-level code in modern C++ RIVR, part of Amazon is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team that values every perspective. If you’re passionate about driving innovation in robotics and creating meaningful impact, we encourage you to apply and bring your unique self to our team. title: Principal Growth Marketing Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>Austin, US</li> <li>New York, US</li> <li>San Francisco, US</li> </ul> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>As a Principal Growth Marketing Manager on the Product Led Growth team, you set the growth strategy for a major set of audiences and product areas. You decide where Cloudflare should invest to win customers, how product-led and sales-assisted motions connect, and how marketing adapts as people increasingly discover and evaluate tools through AI.</p> <p>You still build. title: Senior Airspace Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>About Electra</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Air travel is about to become something more: more direct, more accessible, and more connected to the places where people live, work and want to be. Every day in the U.S., people make 35 million trips of 50–500 miles, stuck in traffic or routed through crowded hubs. Chances are, you've been one of them. At Electra, we're changing that with the EL9, a nine-passenger, hybrid-electric aircraft that takes off and lands in just 150 feet. Our Ultra Short technology opens up thousands of new places to fly, beyond conventional runways, congested airports and long drives. We're backed by Lockheed Martin, Honeywell and Safran. Operators worldwide have signed intent-to-purchase agreements for the first 2,200 aircraft we produce, and we're moving toward first test flights in 2027.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Getting a new kind of aircraft airborne takes more than ambition. It takes our kind of bold: people who think big while working in the real world. Who move ideas into action and collaborate without silos. Who put people first and make room at the table for everyone. Who challenge one another without diminishing one another.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Sound like you? Then look beyond what you thought were your own limits, and help us take flight beyond runways.</span></p></div><p><strong><span style="font-size: 12pt;">The Role</span></strong></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Electra.aero is seeking an experienced <strong>Senior Airspace Engineer</strong> to develop the methods, operational concepts, procedures, airspace solutions, and policies needed to safely integrate Ultra Short operations into the national airspace system, including at major airports and novel, distributed access points.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">The engineer will shape flight demonstrations, tabletop exercises, simulations, and data collection to inform Ultra Short policy, guidance, and standards development in the US and Europe. Collaboration with the FAA, NATCA, and industry standards development organizations is central to the role.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">This role requires a deep understanding of how aircraft performance, flight operations, airspace design, VFR/IFR procedures, PBN, RNAV/RNP operations, obstacle evaluation, navigation systems, FAA/EASA regulations, and real-world operational constraints intersect. The successful candidate will translate new aircraft capabilities and operational concepts into safe, certifiable, and operationally useful flight-path infrastructure.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">The ideal candidate understands airspace design and air traffic management concepts, tools, and workflows across congested terminal and en route airspace, and has led or contributed to research translating novel aircraft capabilities into operational procedures. They are comfortable working directly with the FAA, international civil aviation authorities, air navigation service providers, airport authorities, and local stakeholders to advance integration projects. Firsthand experience in procedure design, airspace design, or air traffic control is valuable; working familiarity with the FAA’s 8260-series Orders is expected.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">The engineer will collaborate with Electra and FAA teams through Electra’s Cooperative Research and Development Agreement (CRADA) with the FAA Tech Center, the FAA eIPP program, the Virginia Smart Airspace Program, and the International Test Arena in Norway, as well as through company-led testing and procedure development.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Translate EL9 performance characteristics into Ultra Short operational capabilities, including ground footprint, obstacle clearance, and maneuvering.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Collaborate with aircraft performance engineers to model EL9 capabilities under normal, degraded, and contingency conditions, incorporating system safety analysis to define feasible Ultra Short procedures.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Develop candidate procedures for novel urban access points and existing airports, taking into account EL2/EL9 Ultra Short performance, instrument procedure design criteria, airport traffic flows, and the obstacle environment.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Review FAA, EASA, ICAO, and national standards—including fixed-wing, heliport, and vertiport frameworks, FAA 8260-series Orders, and international equivalents—to identify regulatory and policy gaps affecting proposed procedures.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Evaluate candidate procedures with Electra’s product team, the FAA, airport operations teams, and local air traffic control to prepare for flight demonstrations, tabletop exercises, simulations, and future policy and standards development.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Define learning objectives and data collection requirements for flight demonstrations and simulations to validate operational concepts.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Synthesize flight test results, lessons learned, and operational insights to inform regulatory workstreams developing Ultra Short policy and standards.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Support Electra’s commercial and infrastructure partnerships teams in assessing the feasibility of candidate access points in urban settings and at airports.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Develop thought leadership materials that clearly explain novel Ultra Short operational concepts to regulators, local stakeholders, and airport authorities.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Represent Electra in FAA, EASA, and ICAO working groups and industry standards development organizations to help shape standards, guidance, and policy for Ultra Short airspace integration and operations.</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>What you Bring</strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Master’s degree or PhD in aerospace engineering, aviation management, airport planning, or a related field.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">5+ years of experience in airspace management research, policy and regulatory development, airspace or procedure design, or a related domain.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Strong working knowledge of FAA and/or EASA regulatory frameworks, including the AC 150 series, Part 135, Part 23, TERPS/PANS-OPS, 8260-series Orders, and relevant airport design standards.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Experience working with regulators, air navigation service providers, airport operators, and industry partners.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Strong technical writing and verbal communication skills.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Ability to thrive in a fast-moving, entrepreneurial environment with evolving requirements and limited precedent.</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Bonus Points</strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Experience leading or contributing to airspace integration research, including FAA, NASA, or MITRE airspace modernization initiatives.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Experience as an air traffic controller or with a non-FAA service provider specializing in instrument procedure design and development.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Private or commercial pilot experience.</span></li> </ul> title: Account Management Lead - Editions France
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Our Global Structure</strong></p> <p><br>Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.</p></div><p><strong>Editions, our network of delivery-only kitchens, is a key differentiator in France commercial ambition. </strong>The Account Management Lead – Editions France role is created as part of a wider reorganisation of the Editions business as part of our regional strategy. The role reports to Paris regional leadership and is designed to combine strategic partner leadership, P&L ownership and organisation building across the Editions network.</p> <p><strong>The Role</strong></p> <p>As <strong>Account Management Lead – Editions France</strong>, you will lead the Editions commercial team for France constituted of Senior Account Managers, Account Managers and Sales Managers. You will be the guardian of the Editions strategy for France, accountable for its coordination and its execution on the ground, growing the performance and profitability of our sites while driving occupancy and the differentiation Editions brings to the French market.</p> <p>You will own a portion of the Editions P&L. That means holding the commercial scorecard for new kitchens, making financial decisions with a clear view of both partner and Deliveroo profitability, and steering your team's portfolio towards sustainable growth rather than volume alone.</p> <p>You will be accountable for the development plan for your team, their success and learning curve at Deliveroo; setting the right KPIs and OKRs to monitor the business. Your role will be commercially focused, however Editions is as much a project management discipline as a commercial one: you will work hand in hand with Food Safety, Compliance, Site Construction, Kitchen Layout, Site Operations, Marketing and the International Editions team to bring kitchens live and keep them performing.</p> <h3><strong>What You’ll Be Doing</strong></h3> <ul> <li> <p>Editions Strategy & Growth</p> <ul> <li> <p>Act as the guardian of the Editions strategy for France, ensuring its coordination across teams and its disciplined execution site by site</p> </li> <li> <p>Lead your team's portfolio strategy, growing the performance and profitability of each Editions site in line with agreed targets</p> </li> <li> <p>Develop the business so that it fits within, and contributes to, the wider regional strategy, bringing the specificity of the French network to regional and international forums</p> </li> <li> <p>Build and deliver joint business plans with restaurant partners, identifying growth and profitability opportunities, defining mutual goals and finding compelling ways to solve them (menu optimisation, virtual brands, pricing, packaging, catchment expansion)</p> </li> <li> <p>Coordinate with the Media team to identify and negotiate revenue opportunities to generate additional value from Editions sites</p> </li> </ul> </li> </ul> <ul> <li> <p>Occupancy & Commercial Performance</p> <ul> <li> <p>Own the occupancy trajectory of the French network, partnering closely with Local teams to positively drive occupancy and secure signed contracts within agreed timelines</p> </li> <li> <p>Own and enforce the Editions commercial scorecard for new kitchens, profitability checks against P&L guidelines, launch package, site specificities, ensuring the process is applied consistently across the team</p> </li> <li> <p>Steer the lead generation and pipeline process, mapping high-potential restaurants and cuisine gaps by site, and mobilising other commercial stakeholders to qualify interest</p> </li> <li> <p>Lead commercial negotiations with business owners and C-suite operators, supporting proposals with a robust P&L rationale</p> </li> </ul> </li> </ul> <ul> <li> <p>P&L Ownership & Governance</p> <ul> <li> <p>Own a portion of the Editions P&L, accountable for revenue, profitability and the financial health of your perimeter</p> </li> <li> <p>Set, own and deliver performance targets across occupancy, partner health, site profitability and Deliveroo output metrics</p> </li> <li> <p>Run a clear operating rhythm on reporting, velocity, sign-to-live, occupancy and sales reviews, and use it to make decisions, not just to describe results</p> </li> </ul> </li> </ul> <ul> <li> <p>Kitchen Launches & Cross-functional Execution</p> </li> <li> <p>Work with Site Managers, Food Safety, Compliance, Site Construction and Kitchen Layout teams to secure the successful build and launch of new kitchens</p> </li> <li> <p>Coordinate with Global team on kitchen implementation, and with Marketing and Operations on launch packages, so that every opening lands on time and performs from week one</p> </li> <li> <p>Manage and oversee project execution end to end, including B2B communication and cross-business-unit workshops</p> </li> <li> <p>Propose process optimisation and automation: Deliveroo moves fast, and you will improve the processes that let Editions scale</p> </li> </ul> <ul> <li> <p>Senior Stakeholder Management</p> <ul> <li> <p>Act as the senior point of contact and face of Deliveroo Editions for top restaurant partners, building trusted, long-term relationships and representing Deliveroo at partner events</p> </li> <li> <p>Establish a strong operating rhythm with partners, including quarterly business reviews and monthly performance check-ins</p> </li> <li> <p>Serve as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, providing strategic insights on Deliveroo, competitors and broader industry trends</p> </li> </ul> </li> </ul> <ul> <li> <p>Team Leadership: Support and coach your Account Managers and Sales Managers to build and execute strong commercial and operational plans, and to raise the standard of account management across the Editions network</p> </li> </ul> <div style="min-height: 1.2em; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0;"> </div> <h3><strong>What You’ll Need to Thrive</strong></h3> <ul> <li> <p>7+ years working in commercially focused roles</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience managing medium-sized commercial or account management teams</p> </li> <li> <p>Highly analytical, with proven P&L ownership or strong financial decision-making experience</p> </li> <li> <p>Solid project management skills, with a track record of delivering complex, cross-functional projects on time</p> </li> <li> <p>Mix of both strategy and execution experience</p> </li> <li> <p>Comfortable handling negotiations with business owners or C-suite operators</p> </li> <li> <p>Effective collaborator, able to influence internal stakeholders across functions and geographies, including global teams</p> </li> <li> <p>Relationship-building and communication skills whether face-to-face, through phone or email</p> </li> <li> <p>Adaptable and comfortable working in a rapidly changing environment; proactive and creative problem solver</p> </li> <li> <p>Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for food and operations</p> </li> <li> <p>You will be in the field often, which will require travel (depending on the needs)</p> </li> <li> <p>Previous general management experience, or experience running your own business would be desirable</p> </li> <li> <p>Fluent in French and English is required</p> </li> </ul> <div style="min-height: 1.2em; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0;"> </div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Diversity, Equity and Inclusion</strong><br><br>At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.</p> <p>We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.</p> <p>If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.</p> <p>If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!</p> <p><em data-renderer-mark="true"><br>Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at</em> <a class="_ymio1r31 _ypr0glyw _zcxs1o36 _mizu194a _1ah3dkaa _ra3xnqa1 _128mdkaa _1cvmnqa1 _4davt94y _4bfu18uv _1hms8stv _ajmmnqa1 _vchhusvi _kqswh2mm _2rkolb4i _ect4ttxp _syaz13af _1a3b18uv _4fpr8stv _5goinqa1 _f8pj13af _9oik18uv _1bnxglyw _jf4cnqa1 _30l313af _1nrm18uv _c2waglyw _1iohnqa1 _9h8h12zz _10531ra0 _1ien1ra0 _n0fx1ra0 _1vhv17z1" href="http://careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness" data-renderer-mark="true" data-is-router-link="false" data-testid="link-with-safety"><em data-renderer-mark="true">careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness</em></a><em data-renderer-mark="true">.</em></p></div> Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Head of AI - NLP Healthtech
description: Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales ont le potentiel de transformer le système de santé. Mais seulement si elles sont accessibles. Plus de données accessibles → moins de charge administrative, une meilleure coordination des soins et des découvertes scientifiques plus rapides. Depuis 2015, notre mission est de libérer ce potentiel. Nos solutions basées sur l'IA permettent aux professionnels de santé de partager les informations médicales sans effort et aux chercheurs d'accélérer les découvertes cliniques : avec un impact sur des millions de patients en France chaque jour. Alors que nous nous préparons à nous développer en Europe, 2 choses déterminent notre succès : nos équipes et notre mission. Aujourd'hui, plus de 150 personnes travaillent depuis nos bureaux et à distance pour libérer le potentiel des données de santé. Nous avons connecté 800 hôpitaux et 150 000 professionnels de santé, et nous ne faisons que commencer. Nous recherchons des personnes qui embrassent la complexité, veulent résoudre des problèmes difficiles et sont prêtes à construire le futur de la collaboration en santé. ⚡ Notre équipe AI La santé est un monde de données complexe, fragmenté et hétérogène. L’IA représente une formidable opportunité de dépasser cette limite structurelle, qui freine l’innovation, l’efficience opérationnelle des hôpitaux et les diagnostics médicaux. Avec les algorithmes d’IA de Lifen, la donnée médicale circule mieux, les soignants consacrent moins de temps aux tâches administratives, les parcours de soins gagnent en fluidité et la recherche clinique peut avancer plus vite. Notre équipe AI travaille à la fois sur des produits qui facilitent la prise en charge des patients au quotidien et sur des projets qui permettent de structurer des données de santé à grande échelle pour accélérer la recherche. Cela veut dire entraîner et faire évoluer nos propres modèles, notamment autour du traitement du langage et des grands modèles de langage, sur des données complexes, hétérogènes et sensibles. L’équipe réunit des machine learning engineers autonomes et exigeants. Elle a déjà construit des fondations solides. Le prochain cap est clair : donner une direction commune aux sujets liés aux soins et à la recherche, faire des choix ambitieux et transformer des avancées techniques en produits utiles. Nous cherchons un·e Head of AI capable de tenir ce rôle de chef d’orchestre : proche des enjeux techniques ; à l’aise avec le produit et le business ; capable de faire grandir une équipe. Le poste est basé à Paris, avec un fonctionnement hybride et une présence régulière attendue aux côtés de l’équipe. 🎯 Ce que tu feras chez nous Définir une stratégie AI lisible et ambitieuse : clarifier les priorités, construire une roadmap, arbitrer entre développement interne, partenariats et solutions existantes, puis donner un cap cohérent aux initiatives liées aux soins comme à la recherche clinique. Faire émerger des produits utiles à partir de sujets techniques complexes : par exemple, améliorer la structuration de documents médicaux pour réduire la charge des équipes de soins, ou rendre des données cliniques exploitables pour faire progresser la recherche. Orchestrer les priorités d’une équipe très transverse : les besoins viennent de plusieurs produits, avec des horizons et des contraintes différents. Tu apporteras le point de vue AI nécessaire pour choisir où investir, ce qui doit être amélioré et ce qui mérite d’être exploré. Faire grandir l’équipe et ses référents techniques : installer des objectifs clairs, du feedback utile et des espaces de décision réels, afin que chacun puisse prendre de l’ampleur sans perdre la qualité d’exécution qui fait la force de l’équipe. Garder l’équipe connectée aux évolutions du domaine : challenger les approches établies, lancer des POC, faire évoluer les pratiques et décider avec pragmatisme quand une nouvelle technologie mérite d’être adoptée. Porter la vision AI de Lifen auprès des équipes Produit, Tech et de la direction, mais aussi auprès de clients, partenaires et de l’écosystème. ⭐️ Ce que nous recherchons Must-have Tu as déjà défini et mis en mouvement une stratégie AI, machine learning dans une entreprise technologique, une scale-up ou un environnement comparable. Tu as au moins deux ans d’expérience de management direct d’une équipe Data, AI, Machine Learning ou Engineering. Tu as une expérience sur le traitement automatique du langage, les grands modèles de langage, l’extraction d’information ou la structuration de données homogènes qui te donne une une crédibilité technique solide auprès de l’équipe. Tu relies naturellement les choix technologiques aux usages, aux utilisateurs et aux résultats attendus pour le produit et l’entreprise. Tu sais embarquer des interlocuteurs techniques comme non techniques. Nice-to-have Tu as déjà travaillé dans la santé, les données cliniques, la medtech, la biotech ou un secteur soumis à de fortes contraintes réglementaires. Tu as collaboré avec des équipes de recherche appliquée, publié, contribué à des conférences ou porté des prises de parole sur des sujets AI. Tu as évolué dans une organisation où les données sont sensibles et où les enjeux de souveraineté, de confidentialité et de conformité font partie des décisions techniques. Soft skills Tu aimes les problèmes qui ne se résolvent pas avec une recette toute faite. Tu es à l’aise dans l’ambiguïté, curieux·se par nature et assez exigeant·e pour remettre en question les habitudes quand elles ne servent plus l’objectif. Tu sais manager des personnes senior : leur donner du cadre, de la reconnaissance et de l’autonomie. Nos valeurs Embrace Complexity : tu sais composer avec des données imparfaites, des contraintes réglementaires fortes et des arbitrages techniques qui changent vite. Bienveillance : tu crées un environnement de confiance, où l’exigence va de pair avec l’écoute, le feedback et le droit de questionner. Real Impact : tu gardes en tête ce que chaque décision peut changer pour les soignants, les chercheurs et, au bout de la chaîne, les patients. 👥 Process de recrutement Échange de préqualification avec Laura, Talent Acquisition Manager, 30 minutes . Nous faisons connaissance, revenons sur ton parcours, tes attentes et les grandes lignes du poste. C’est aussi le moment de répondre à tes premières questions sur Lifen, l’équipe et le contexte. Entretien avec Alexandre, CTO, environ 45 minutes Nous approfondissons ton expérience de management, ta capacité à construire une stratégie AI et ta manière de faire le lien entre technologie, produit et enjeux business. Étude de cas et échanges avec l’équipe AI, environ 1 h 30 En amont, nous te partagerons un cadre de réflexion. Tu présenteras ensuite ton approche à plusieurs membres de l’équipe, lors de deux échanges. L’objectif n’est pas de tester ta connaissance d’une stack précise, mais de comprendre comment tu structures une vision, priorises dans un contexte complexe et crées l’adhésion. Entretien final avec la direction Tech et Research, environ 1 h à 1 h 30 Nous échangeons sur ta lecture des enjeux de Lifen, ton ambition pour l’AI appliquée à la santé et ta capacité à porter cette vision au-delà de l’équipe. Nous nous engageons à te faire un retour dans les 72 heures après chaque étape. Des prises de références pourront être demandées en fin de process, avec ton accord. description: About Airwallex Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own. We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. You’ll turn complex network rules and payment data into accurate configurations, actionable analysis and decisions that improve cost visibility and margin performance. Own payment-cost analysis across scheme fees, interchange and network rules, identifying changes and translating them into clear financial, product and operational requirements. Maintain accurate fee tables, eligibility criteria and transaction-level logic with Product and Engineering, ensuring payment-cost calculations and customer billing reflect current network rules. Build models and reporting across markets, products, payment methods and transaction types to identify margin drivers, anomalies, leakage and opportunities to improve payment economics. Support cost and margin optimisation through transaction qualification, BIN routing, cost configuration and related levers, contributing to pricing, product design, market launches and commercial decisions. Strengthen governance, testing, reconciliation and controls by comparing expected costs with actual network charges and helping drive root-cause resolution. Partner with Finance, Product, Engineering, Data, Operations and external payment partners to resolve scheme pricing, interchange and rule-related questions. You’ll work from our Amsterdam office three days a week. What we're looking for Essentials Experience in payments, acquiring, issuing, card networks, payment infrastructure or a related role, ideally within a global PSP, acquirer, scheme, issuer or fintech. Strong knowledge of card payment economics, particularly Visa and Mastercard interchange, scheme fees, transaction qualification and network rules. Experience translating complex payment rules, fee schedules or network requirements into system logic, configurations and controls. Experience working with payment-cost systems or controls, including interchange tables, scheme fee logic, BIN-based rules, transaction attributes or similar payment configurations. Strong analytical and quantitative capabilities, including experience working with transaction-level data, economic modelling and reconciliation of expected versus actual payment costs. Commercial judgment and the ability to connect payment mechanics to pricing, product decisions and margin optimisation. Exceptional attention to detail and ownership, with the discipline required to manage complex rules where small errors can create meaningful financial impact at scale. Strong cross-functional execution, with the ability to work effectively across Product, Engineering, Finance, Data, Operations and external payment partners. Preferred Experience partnering directly with Visa, Mastercard or other payment networks. Experience applying AI or advanced analytics to rule interpretation, anomaly detection or payment-cost optimisation. title: Engineering Manager, Bots & Fraud
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>Austin, TX; Denver, CO; Washington D.C.; New York City</p> <h3>About the Team</h3> <p>Our team builds the products that answer "Can we trust this traffic?" Knowing who's human, who's an agent, and who's a malicious actor is core to Cloudflare's strategy, and one of the primary values we deliver to our customers.</p> <p>Our products address a broad and evolving range of traffic integrity challenges. Examples include managing unwanted scraping, controlling access for bots and AI agents, and identifying fraud and abuse while minimizing friction for legitimate users. Our products make probabilistic decisions in an adversarial environment, using Cloudflare's global network signals, threat intelligence, and machine learning. We turn those signals into analytics and controls that customers can understand, trust, and act on. These are challenging engineering problems at the intersection of distributed systems, data, security, and customer experience.</p> <h3>Who You Are</h3> <ul> <li>You have a track record of leading engineering teams, including hiring, onboarding, coaching, and supporting professional growth. Your past teams respect you as both a technical leader and a people manager.</li> <li>You have a strong foundation in software engineering, with experience designing, building, and operating large-scale distributed systems and services.</li> <li>You have taken projects from inception to production and overseen execution to meet commitments in a fast-paced, iterative engineering environment.</li> <li>You connect business goals with technical decisions, explain both the "why" and the "how," and make thoughtful tradeoffs when requirements are uncertain.</li> <li>You work effectively across Product, Engineering, and other functions to align priorities, remove blockers, and deliver shared outcomes.</li> <li>You communicate clearly with engineers, customers, and senior leadership, adapting the level of technical detail to your audience.</li> <li>You use AI fluently in engineering workflows and have the judgment to know where it accelerates the work and where it falls short.</li> <li>You are curious about web security, bot management, fraud and abuse, and the evolving role of AI agents on the Internet. You do not need to know our exact stack, but you should be eager to go deep in the domain.</li> </ul> <h3>What You'll Do</h3> <p>We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a team building and scaling Cloudflare's products for bot management, fraud detection, and abuse mitigation. You will recruit, mentor, and grow talented engineers, provide technical leadership, and partner closely with Product Management to shape and deliver the engineering roadmap.</p> <p>You will partner with detection and research teams to turn their signals into reliable, performant, and easy-to-use customer solutions. Our systems span real-time services running across Cloudflare's global network, APIs and configuration, and high-volume data and analytics pipelines. You will collaborate across engineering and product teams to bring new capabilities into production and continuously improve the customer experience.</p> <h3><strong>Key responsibilities:</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Lead and grow the team.</strong> Hire, mentor, and empower engineers through clear feedback, thoughtful career development, and a culture of ownership and technical excellence.</li> <li><strong>Shape and deliver the engineering roadmap.</strong> Partner with Product Management to translate customer problems into incremental deliverables, balancing new capabilities with reliability, performance, and maintainability.</li> <li><strong>Provide technical leadership.</strong> Participate in design discussions and guide decisions about scalable distributed services, product integrations, APIs, and analytics.</li> <li><strong>Turn detection signals into customer capabilities.</strong> Partner with detection and research teams to deliver actionable analytics and configurable controls, helping customers balance security, user experience, and privacy.</li> <li><strong>Measure and improve customer outcomes.</strong> Work with Product and detection partners to use feedback and production data to improve effectiveness, reduce unnecessary friction, and make products easier to adopt.</li> <li><strong>Own operational health.</strong> Ensure your team's services have effective observability, safe releases, incident response, and follow-through on improvements.</li> <li><strong>Drive cross-team execution.</strong> Resolve dependencies, align priorities across teams, and work with customer-facing partners to address recurring product problems at their roots.</li> </ul> <h3>Additional Experience We Value</h3> <ul> <li>Experience building bot management, fraud detection, application security, or other products that make decisions in an adversarial environment.</li> <li>Familiarity with HTTP, browser technologies, JavaScript, and the tradeoffs between security, privacy, and user experience.</li> <li>Experience integrating machine learning models into production systems or partnering closely with data science and machine learning teams.</li> <li>Experience with high-volume data pipelines, analytics services, or columnar databases such as ClickHouse.</li> <li>Experience with technologies used in our systems, such as Go, Rust, Python, Kafka, Kubernetes, and PostgreSQL.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For Washington D.C. & New York City based hires: Estimated annual salary of $190,000 - $261,000</span></li> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For Denver based hires: Estimated annual salary of $170,000 - $233,000</span></li> </ul> <p>Applications will be accepted until November 30, 2026.</p> <p><strong>Equity</strong></p> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time Off</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver.
