title: Senior Technical Sales Manager - AI-Driven Software Engineering
description: About CREATEQ CREATEQ is a Swiss software engineering company with more than 30 years of experience in delivering custom software solutions and modernizing complex legacy systems. We work with leading international companies across industries such as banking and fintech, insurance, aviation and transportation, telecommunications, and energy. We design, build, and run high-quality software solutions, combining strong engineering expertise, modern technologies, AI-enabled approaches, and proven delivery practices. Our teams work across Java, .NET, PHP, mobile, and web development, helping clients modernize their technology landscapes, improve their software capabilities, and build solutions that are reliable, scalable, and ready for the future. We are fully dedicated to long-term partnerships, working as one organization with our customers and taking ownership from the first idea through to reliable execution and smooth operation. With nearshore delivery centers across Europe, we bring together experienced engineering and delivery teams who combine technical excellence, business understanding, and a strong sense of ownership. People, engineering excellence, and strong client relationships are at the heart of what we do. The opportunity We are looking for an experienced, entrepreneurial Senior Technical Sales Manager to drive new business for CREATEQ with full revenue responsibility. In this role, you will win new clients, shape their entry into AI-driven software engineering, and turn it into long-term engineering engagements delivered by our teams. Many companies still develop software the traditional way, mostly on Java and .NET. They want to benefit from AI-driven development but lack the know-how, processes, and capacity to do so. This is where you come in: you understand the client's starting point, develop the right approach together with them – from assessment and proof of concept to dedicated nearshore teams – and close the deal. You will work closely with management, Business Development, and our engineering leads, and you will be the face of CREATEQ to CIOs, CTOs, and Heads of Engineering in Switzerland [and the DACH region]. What you'll do Build and close your own pipeline with mid-sized and large companies in Switzerland [and the DACH region]. Assess clients' development processes, technology stacks, and AI maturity, and run workshops with engineering teams, IT leadership, and executive management. Develop solution concepts and proposals – from assessment and proof of concept to dedicated nearshore engineering teams. Lead commercial negotiations through to contract signature. Grow existing client relationships and secure follow-on business. Work closely with our engineering leads on team set-up, project kick-off, and quality assurance. Track pipeline, order intake, and revenue against agreed targets and report on progress to management. What we're looking for This is a senior role with clear revenue responsibility. We are looking for someone who has successfully sold IT services before, brings a strong network in the Swiss market, and is equally credible in conversations with developers and with executive management. Requirements At least 8 years of experience selling IT services, software engineering, or nearshore/offshore capacity, including several years with personal revenue responsibility. A proven track record in acquiring new clients and closing multi-year service engagements. A strong network among CIOs, CTOs, and Heads of Engineering in the Swiss market. A technical background (computer science, business informatics, or equivalent practical experience) with a solid understanding of Java and/or .NET environments and modern engineering practices (CI/CD, automated testing, DevOps). A solid understanding of AI-driven software development (AI coding assistants, agentic development tools) and a realistic view of its benefits and limitations. An entrepreneurial, closing-oriented mindset and the ability to work independently. Native/Fluent German and excellent written and spoken English. Swiss or EU citizenship, or a valid Swiss work permit. Benefits A key role with direct impact on CREATEQ's growth. An offering that is high on clients' agendas: AI-driven software engineering, delivered by experienced engineering teams. A compensation package with a fixed salary and a performance-based component. Direct collaboration with management and short decision paths. Freedom to shape the role, bring your ideas, and make a visible impact. A long-term perspective in an international software engineering company with a strong presence in the European market. Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

description: <p><strong>The role of a Telecommunications Field Engineer at Canonical</strong></p> <p>The telco industry is moving to software-defined services. Canonical Ubuntu is a key platform for telco innovation, and we are growing our team of specialists who work in the industry to accelerate the change.</p> <p>Canonical enables operators and communications service providers to embrace this new world, with a focus on platforms such as Ubuntu, OpenStack, and Kubernetes, and reusable, high quality automation for operations at scale.</p> <p>As part of the Canonical Field Engineering organization, you will lead customers through the design and delivery of OpenStack, Kubernetes, and software-defined networking solutions. Your passion for open-source technologies will enable customers to understand and operate advanced infrastructure substrates to meet the demands of 5G, sovereign AI, and beyond.</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"> Remote-based, Americas and EMEA</span></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>What your day will look like</strong></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: telco market</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></p> <ul> <li>A thorough technical understanding of the telco NFVi (VIM), NFVO, VNFM and MEC space and key telco optimization, predictive maintenance, unified communication, and customer experience improvement</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Exposure to frameworks such as 3GPP, TM Forum ODA, eTOM, ETSI NFV, ONAP, O-RAN, or similar is a plus</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>What we offer you</strong></p> <p>Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.</p> <p>In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, you can ask in the later stages of the recruitment process.</p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Fully remote working environment - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Annual compensation review</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Recognition rewards</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">40 days annual leave per annum, including public holidays and our All Company holiday periods</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Parental Leave</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Employee Assistance Programme</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at ‘sprints’</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>About Canonical</strong></p> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. title: Global Trainee Program - Outperformer Software Business Track (HILTI)
description: <div><strong>4PS is part of the Hilti Group</strong>, which gives our people access to international opportunities and development programs within the wider Hilti organization. This vacancy is part of Hilti’s Global Trainee Program. Interested in joining the program? Please submit your application directly via <a href="https://careers.hilti.group/de-ch/stellenangebote/19051-en/global-trainee-program-outperformer-software-business-track-m-f-x/">Hilti Careerpage</a></div> <h2>Construction technology is being reinvented. Be part of it.</h2> <p>Construction is one of the world's largest industries, and one of its least digitized. That is changing fast. At Hilti, we are not only developing software products - we are building and growing digital businesses around them. Hilti is at the centre of that shift, with a growing portfolio of software products that connect jobsites, offices, teams, and tools across the entire construction lifecycle. We are looking for ambitious, internationally mobile early-career talents with a global mindset who are excited about technology but see their future in business and leadership rather than in a purely technical software career.<br><br>The Software & Digital Business Track of Hilti's Outperformer Program is a two-year accelerated development program that prepares you for a commercial, international leadership career in our software and digital businesses. You will learn how technology becomes customer value, how software businesses grow, how products are brought to market, and how commercial decisions are made. This is not a rotation program where you shadow senior leaders. From day one, you carry real responsibility.</p> <h2>What You'll do</h2> <p>The Software Track is designed to build the next generation of software business leaders at Hilti – Business Owners, Business Directors, Segment Managers and ultimately Senior Management Team members. If you want a structured path to running a business, this program is built for that outcome.<br><br>The program places you inside one of two business units:<br><br>Construction Software: Home to Fieldwire (Field Software for project and workforce management), ON!Track (asset management), and 4PS (construction business management). You will work directly with customers, product teams, and business leadership across Europe and beyond.<br><br>Fastening & Protection Solutions: Where design & engineering software for structural connections (e.g. PROFIS Engineering Suite), MEP supports and passive fire protection systems are developed and brought to market across a global customer base of structural and mechanical engineers.<br><br><br>For the Construction Software business unit, the program is structured to provide a balanced foundation in customer and market exposure, software product understanding, and business experience, while giving you the opportunity to work with at least two software products during the program:</p> <ul> <li>​Year 1: Begin with a 12-month sales assignment, developing direct customer insight and understanding the business challenges addressed by our software solutions.</li> <li>​Year 2: Undertake three rotations of 3–6 months each across product and business teams, including exposure to an international project.</li> </ul> <p>​For the Fastening & Protection Solution business unit, the program provides exposure to product management , software development, exposure to customers and start-ups and international project experience:</p> <ul> <li>​Year 1: Begin with a 12-month product management assignment, building product understanding and market insight.</li> <li>​Year 2: Undertake three rotations of 3–6 months each, involving international projects that broaden your business perspective and global exposure.</li> </ul> <p>You will have a dedicated senior mentor from the start, direct exposure to executive leadership, and a peer cohort of Global Trainees across all Hilti business tracks globally.</p> <h2>What You’ll Bring</h2> <p>You are close to graduating or have recently completed a Master's degree - your degree is likely to be in construction management, civil engineering, or mechanical engineering with a focus on construction, Computer Science, or also Business study programs with an affinity for Software and construction. About the role Axle has quickly become the leader in our operational markets, and we’re now looking to expand our reach in France. At the core of our market expansion plans is market analysis. To maximise future revenue, we spend a lot of time understanding the value of flexibility in power markets around the world. We are looking for a technical individual (data scientist, analyst or engineer) with strong knowledge of the French electricity markets and an instinct for commercial value. You will become Axle’s internal expert on French power markets: understanding the market rules, modelling the value, and building relationships with system operators and regulators. We’re scrappy about method and rigorous about conclusions. You will speak fluent French and English. Other European languages will also be an asset. What you will be doing Developing a deep understanding of French energy markets and grid dynamics to understand how trading, compensation, penalties and cash flow work Jumping on the phone with grid operators, regulators and market stakeholders to validate hypotheses and make sense of data Building and optimising models of wholesale/NEBCO, capacity, balancing, ancillary services and local flexibility markets in France to forecast what different assets can earn Sizing the revenue opportunity across markets and products to shape where we expand next Building and evaluating different strategies for cycling a battery or load-shifting an EV charger Monitoring and shaping energy regulation to accelerate the growth of flexibility. This is an opportunity to gain unique domain expertise and build the quantitative case for first-of-a-kind projects across the world. What we think you need to be successful Deep quantitative and modelling ability (Python, SQL) Exceptional communication and the ability to turn data into actionable commercial insights Comfort moving fast and making decisions in an evolving environment Deep knowledge of French electricity markets (NEBCO, Mécanisme de Capacité, Mécanisme d’Ajustement, ancillary services…) Relationships with regulators, grid operators and other stakeholders (CRE, DGEC, RTE, Enedis, etc.) are a plus What’s in it for you This is a 12 month fixed-term contract (CDD). Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose. You’ll be based in France. To maximise collaboration, we ask that you spend ~1 week per month working from our London office. description: Ben jij op zoek naar een uitdagende IT-stage waarin je jouw technische kennis in de praktijk kunt brengen én jezelf verder kunt ontwikkelen? title: Junior Business Data Analyst

title: Senior Linux Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Linux Engineer</strong></h3> <p>An engineering role at Cloudflare provides an opportunity to address some big challenges, at scale. We believe that with our talented team, we can tackle some of the biggest security, reliability and performance problems facing the Internet.</p> <p>We are searching for Linux engineers to make our flavour of Linux fast, resilient and reliable across the many use cases that a distribution saving the Internet requires. </p> <p>Our Engineers come from a variety of technical backgrounds and work across a broad range of environments and codebases. Common qualities across all of our performance-focused engineers include a passion for analysis, optimization, scaling, networking, cross-team collaboration and hard problem solving.</p> <p><strong>What you would be doing</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Keep Cloudflare Linux platforms secure and up-to-date</p> </li> <li> <p>Help with quick and safe deployment and delivery of the Linux kernel and basic operating system to Cloudflare Datacenters in more than 335 cities in over 100 countries</p> </li> <li> <p>Continuously monitor and resolve kernel bugs and performance regressions</p> </li> <li> <p>Design tools and frameworks for other engineering teams to successfully embrace and enable the latest Linux kernel features and optimizations</p> </li> <li> <p>Help porting the Cloudflare software stack to new hardware platforms and architectures</p> </li> <li> <p>Research and adopt the latest Linux kernel security features and performance improvements</p> </li> <li> <p>Build tools and CI/CD pipelines for safe and automated operating system continuous deployment</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Requisite skills:</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Experience with the Linux kernel and Linux software packaging</p> </li> <li> <p>CS fundamentals and comfortable working in multiple programming languages and codebases; Comfortable working in Go, Rust, C, Bash, and Python.</p> </li> <li> <p>Familiarity with constructing and using eBPF programs.</p> </li> <li> <p>Understanding of Linux and POSIX operation systems concepts: processing, files, syscalls, and networking</p> </li> <li> <p>Containerization technologies in Linux (e.g Docker, Namespaces, Cgroups)</p> </li> <li> <p>Configuration management (e.g Saltstack, Chef) and CI/CD pipelines</p> </li> <li> <p>Version control systems (git)</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Performance analysis and debugging</p> </li> <li> <p>Time series databases such as OpenTSDB, Graphite, Prometheus or Grafana</p> </li> <li> <p>Key/Value stores</p> </li> <li> <p>Network fundamentals DHCP, ARP, subnetting, routing, firewalls, IPv6, BGP</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience in a DevOps team structure</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Points</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Experience with programming in C, Rust, Go, or similar languages</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience with rapid release engineering</p> </li> <li> <p>Upstream community contribution</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong tooling and automation development experience</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Some tools that we use </strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Consul</p> </li> <li> <p>Docker</p> </li> <li> <p>Grafana</p> </li> <li> <p>Kubernetes</p> </li> <li> <p>Nginx</p> </li> <li> <p>Nomad</p> </li> <li> <p>PostgreSQL</p> </li> <li> <p>Prometheus</p> </li> <li> <p>Salt</p> </li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Brand Designer / Art Director
description: International Brands is a fast-growing Swiss company in the Personal Care / FMCG space. With our brands, we bring products into tens of thousands of retail locations worldwide, from drugstores and leading retail chains to e-commerce. We build brands that work on shelf. Not just on slides. Not just on Instagram. Fast. Visible. Tangible. Scalable. We develop and scale brands that combine design, product and performance without compromise and win exactly where it matters most: in the market. More than 90,000 retail locations worldwide. And we are nowhere near our limit. We are looking for an Art Director (100%). Not a traditional designer. We are looking for the creative mind behind our entire brand powerhouse. From packaging and brand worlds to the smallest details that ultimately make the difference. Someone who challenges existing ideas, wants to improve things and does not accept “the way it has always been done.” This role is demanding, fast-paced and highly hands-on. We are not looking for an administrator. We are looking for a builder. Someone who takes ownership, moves fast and executes with high quality. Someone who wants to actively shape and grow brands. Not only conceptually, but all the way through to finished products in the market. Aufgaben You own everything that moves our brands visually and creatively forward with a clear focus on FMCG performance in the market. Develop and execute creative concepts across all brands with a focus on visibility, recognition and impact Build, sharpen and continuously evolve strong brand worlds with a consistent visual identity Challenge existing approaches and actively improve things instead of simply maintaining them Design packaging with clear FMCG logic: attention-grabbing, brand-right and built to convert at shelf Develop web, social and marketing assets focused on performance, not aesthetics alone Turn ideas into reality quickly, pragmatically and efficiently without getting stuck in endless feedback loops Actively leverage AI and modern tools to improve workflows, speed and creative output Lead projects independently from idea to finished product in market Manage freelancers and external partners with a high quality standard Work closely with the Head of Brands and the broader team Think beyond design with a holistic perspective from products and communication to the physical environment Turn design into products that sell. Turn creativity into performance. Qualifikation 2–5+ years of experience in a creative role (Design, Art Direction or similar) Strong portfolio with real FMCG or retail work and proven execution Very strong Figma skills with experience in UI and web Experience across packaging, social media, web and print Deep understanding of FMCG design, retail and consumer behavior You challenge things and constantly look for ways to improve them You do not only think about aesthetics, but about impact, performance and results You are independent, hands-on, fast and solution-oriented You take initiative and actively drive projects forward You take ownership instead of waiting for instructions You use AI as a practical tool in your daily creative workflow German & English What does not fit this role: Purely aesthetic thinking without understanding market dynamics, consumers and commercial impact Creative profiles without genuine interest in FMCG, retail and market-driven design Very rigid or overly process-driven ways of working People who wait for instructions instead of taking ownership People who love concepts but struggle with execution and speed Benefits Direct collaboration with the Head of Brands Real impact on brands, products and their success in market Fast decisions instead of endless alignment rounds High ownership and the opportunity to truly build and shape things If you want to build something meaningful, this is the place. You will not simply design. You will build brands. You will develop products that get noticed. Products that stop consumers at shelf. Products that win. Products that people buy. If you are someone who wants to create things that are not just beautiful, but successful, we should talk. Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Treasury Capital Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍Dublin, Ireland | 💰€100,000 - €130,000,  Incentive Awards tied to your performance➕ benefits </p> <p><strong>⭐Our Finance team</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a dynamic Treasury Capital Manager in Dublin to become a key part of the team building the new Monzo European entity. Reporting into the Director of Treasury and Capital, you will shape, develop and implement the Capital management process and infrastructure in tandem with supporting the growth and strategic development of the business. As well as skills and experience in Treasury and Capital Management, the ability to adapt, be creative and work in a fast paced environment with wider Group colleagues will be essential talents as the business grows.</p> <p>As part of a new and growing team, the Treasury Capital Manager will be responsible for ensuring that Monzo effectively manages its capital and ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements in Europe. This is an opportunity to be part of something from the start and make a real difference.</p> <p><strong>🔑</strong><strong>You’ll play a key role by…</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead the planning and production of Monzo Europe’s ICAAP in line with regulatory capital requirements.</li> <li>Develop capital plans and forecasts, including stress testing and scenario analysis.</li> <li>Lead the planning and implementation work in line with Monzo’s recovery and resolution requirements including the Recovery Plan and Solvent Wind Down Plan.</li> <li>Identify the impact of prudential regulatory change and supporting relevant teams to assess and adapt to the challenges.</li> <li>Optimise the capital structure and allocation to support growth and strategic objectives.</li> <li>Prepare and present regular financial reports and forecasts to senior management.</li> <li>Building strong relationships with internal teams such as the business/product collectives to optimize the bank's capital structure and funding strategies.</li> <li>Provide operational coverage for the Director of Treasury and Capital during holidays.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩We’d love to hear from you if you have…</strong></p> <ul> <li>A bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, or a related field. A Master’s degree or professional qualification (e.g., CFA, ACA, ACCA) is preferred.</li> <li>A minimum of 5 years of experience in Treasury Capital management, within the banking sector, a consultancy, or regulatory body.</li> <li>Have detailed knowledge/experience of the European regulatory requirements, and the ability to interpret what that means for the relatively unique circumstances of our bank.  </li> <li>Have the ability to coordinate, participate and lead projects to produce regulatory deliverables and maintain the Bank’s set of prudential documentation and supporting materials.</li> <li>Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.</li> <li>Strong leadership abilities and experience in working across dispersed teams.</li> <li>Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills.</li> </ul> <p>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!</p> <p><strong>🙌What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰A salary range of €100,000 - €130,000 ➕Incentive Awards tied to your performance.</p> <p>📍This role will have a hybrid working model, based in our Dublin office 2 - 3 days a week.</p> <p>⏰We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>🏝 Annual Leave - 34 days including public holidays (24 holiday days + 10 public holidays)</p> <p>📚€1,200 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏥Private healthcare scheme</p> <p>💰Pension scheme: the minimum contribution is 4% and Monzo matches any additional contributions that you make up to a maximum of 6%</p> <p>💛Wellbeing benefits: financial education, women’s and men’s health support, mental health benefits, including coaching and counselling</p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>An introductory call with a member of the Monzo Recruitment team</li> <li>An initial call with the hiring manager</li> <li>A series of role specific, behavioural & leadership principles interviews</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. </p> <p>#LI-ÉS1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: Data Center Architect
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Location: Austin, San Francisco or New York</strong></h3> <h3>About the role</h3> <p>Cloudflare is hiring a Data Center Architect to define and deliver the physical infrastructure behind high-density compute and GPU deployments across our global network. You'll own 3 connected domains: the liquid cooling chain, the low-voltage connectivity layer, and the MV/LV electrical architecture that powers both.</p> <p>This is a senior individual-contributor role spanning architecture, detailed design, technical qualification, design governance, commissioning, and operational readiness. You're Cloudflare's owner-side technical lead in these domains: the person who connects what our hardware needs with what colocation providers, equipment manufacturers, and delivery partners can actually build.</p> <p>Scope runs from a single rack in commercial colocation to multi-megawatt compute deployments. You'll design power, cooling, and cabling as one system so they don't fight each other at the rack, in the white space, or during maintenance.</p> <p>If your background is only HVAC design, only cold-plate research, or only utility-scale generation, this role will be wider than you expect. We need someone who can hold the electrical, cooling, and cabling layers together.</p> <h3>About the team</h3> <p>We work with engineering, capacity planning, network strategy, supply chain, and operations to grow Cloudflare's data center and PoP footprint. With colocation providers, hardware suppliers, and delivery partners worldwide, we turn infrastructure requirements into deployments that come online faster, cost less, and work the first time.</p> <h3>What you'll do</h3> <h4>Architecture and reference designs</h4> <ul> <li><strong>Own the physical-infrastructure architecture.</strong> Build reference designs for power, liquid cooling, and connectivity for AI and high-density compute, including how they interface at rack, row, and site level. Maintain the standards, templates, and libraries that deployment, operations, and partner teams build from.</li> <li><strong>Translate hardware and capacity needs into engineering requirements.</strong> Turn heat loads, electrical loads, port counts, network topologies, and growth plans into power, cooling, and connectivity requirements and into site and rack qualification criteria.</li> <li><strong>Qualify sites and facility interfaces.</strong> Assess provider power and cooling availability, utility and backup capacity, water supply and return conditions, hydraulic capacity, upstream heat rejection, expansion headroom, maintenance constraints, and contractual boundaries. Give go/no-go recommendations with the risks written down.</li> </ul> <h3>Electrical power architecture (MV/LV)</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Lead MV and LV electrical architecture:</strong> single-line diagrams, power distribution, switchgear and UPS topology, busway and PDU design, grounding and bonding.</li> <li><strong>Design physical power infrastructure,</strong> AC and DC, including power conversion, backup generation, energy storage, and distribution, with attention to fault levels, selectivity, and maintainability.</li> <li><strong>Validate designs with modeling:</strong> load-flow, short-circuit, arc-flash, and selectivity studies, checked against measured performance where possible.</li> <li><strong>Define digital power requirements</strong> for monitoring, metering, protection coordination, and control. Work with controls and operations teams on alarm thresholds, trend retention, remote monitoring, and BMS/SCADA integration.</li> <li><strong>Fold emerging standards</strong> (NEC, NFPA, UL, OCP power and rack specs) into forward-looking electrical designs.</li> </ul> <h3>Liquid cooling</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Own the liquid-cooling architecture and roadmap.</strong> Develop repeatable direct-to-chip designs and evaluate liquid-to-liquid, liquid-to-air, rear-door, and other approaches against deployment needs.</li> <li><strong>Design and validate the hydraulic system.</strong> Flow and pressure-drop calculations, pipe sizing, pump selection, balancing, and control requirements. Validate at partial load, during expansion and maintenance, and in failure scenarios, not just at nameplate.</li> <li><strong>Specify equipment and rack integration.</strong> Qualify CDUs, heat exchangers, pumps, manifolds, hoses, quick-disconnects, valves, and instrumentation. Coordinate rack access, piping routes, service clearances, and installation sequencing with the electrical, cabling, hardware, and structural disciplines.</li> <li><strong>Own coolant integrity and serviceability.</strong> Set manufacturer-aligned requirements for fluid quality, material compatibility, cleanliness, filtration, corrosion control, condensation prevention, and leak detection. Make isolation, fluid handling, component replacement, and servicing safe and maintainable.</li> </ul> <h3>Low-voltage connectivity and structured cabling</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Own the physical-layer architecture.</strong> Reference designs for rack, row, cage, and site connectivity: copper and fiber distribution, patch-panel placement, cross-connect demarcations, diverse routes, and reserved expansion capacity.</li> <li><strong>Engineer fiber and copper connectivity.</strong> Specify media, connectors, trunks, cassettes, and patching for equipment reach and performance. Validate optical loss budgets, connector counts, polarity, breakouts, bend radius, and compatibility across hardware generations.</li> <li><strong>Produce buildable designs.</strong> Pathway layouts, fiber schedules, port-to-port patching plans, cable-length schedules, bills of materials, and installation specs.</li> <li><strong>Connect to colocation and carrier infrastructure.</strong> Qualify meet-me-room access, provider pathways, cross-connect options, demarcation points, and route diversity. Define handoffs with data center providers, carriers, ISPs, and Cloudflare's network strategy team.</li> </ul> <h3>Integration, controls, and resilience</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Coordinate white-space interfaces.</strong> Layouts that account for rack access, airflow, liquid-cooling pipes and manifolds, power segregation, pathway capacity, and expansion. Coordinate supports, bonding, grounding, and firestopping with the responsible disciplines and providers.</li> <li><strong>Design for resilience and controlled failure.</strong> Evaluate redundancy, shared failure dependencies, cooling and power interruptions, and thermal ride-through. Agree protective responses with hardware and operations teams for pump or CDU failure, loss of facility cooling, leaks, sensor faults, control failures, and power events.</li> <li><strong>Define controls and operational visibility:</strong> temperatures, pressures, flows, power metering, leak alarms, equipment status, and capacity telemetry.</li> </ul> <h3>Governance, delivery, and acceptance</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Be Cloudflare's owner-side design authority.</strong> Own basis-of-design documents, single-line diagrams, P&IDs, cabling and equipment schedules, interface requirements, scopes, responsibility matrices, review gates, and acceptance criteria. Review partner designs and contractor submittals, resolve RFIs and technical disputes, and drive deviations to documented closure.</li> <li><strong>Lead delivery and live-site changes.</strong> Guide contractors and remote hands through new deployments, expansions, migrations, and remediation. Work with deployment and operations on installation sequencing, methods of procedure, change controls, and rollback plans that protect running services.</li> <li><strong>Lead commissioning and acceptance.</strong> Define factory and site acceptance tests across electrical, cooling, and connectivity: cleanliness and leak-test evidence, flow balancing, loaded performance tests, failure-mode testing, and copper and fiber certification (fiber inspection and cleaning, insertion-loss testing, OTDR where appropriate). Track deficiencies and verify corrective work before sign-off.</li> <li><strong>Keep the physical source of truth accurate.</strong> Define labeling and connectivity-record standards. Make sure as-builts, power and cooling records, patching schedules, cross-connect inventories, and test records reconcile with Cloudflare's infrastructure inventory and DCIM.</li> <li><strong>Oversee handover:</strong> deficiency closure, operator training, maintenance procedures, spares, and turnover documentation before production.</li> </ul> <h3>Cost, efficiency, and standards</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Support sourcing.</strong> RFPs, technical bid evaluation, technical negotiations, supplier qualification, and lifecycle cost analysis. Partner with supply chain on prefabricated assemblies, preterminated cabling, rack integration, lead times, and alternatives that cut field labor without cutting quality.</li> <li><strong>Reduce energy and water use.</strong> Evaluate phased deployment, consumption, and retrofit options.</li> <li><strong>Evolve standards from evidence.</strong> Investigate incidents and recurring installation defects with network and operations teams. Feed commissioning and operating results back into designs, standards, and quality checks.</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll bring</h2> <ul> <li>8+ years in data center mechanical, electrical, or physical-layer infrastructure, c

title: Senior Engineering Manager — Network Connectivity
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: Lisbon, Portugal or London, United Kingdom or Austin, Texas or New York City</strong></p> <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>The Egress team was formed to own a very important aspect of Cloudflare's <a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/connectivity-cloud/">Connectivity Cloud</a>: egress connectivity for our vast portfolio of products. The team build and operate cutting edge network software infrastructure used by a growing number of Cloudflare products to connect to any destination from Cloudflare's network. Among the products powered by this technology is <a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/smart-shield/configuration/dedicated-egress-ips/how-it-works/egress-ips/">Dedicated Egress IP Connectivity</a>, WARP, Cloudflare One/Zero Trust, and Cloudflare's egress proxy for the<a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/icloud-private-relay/"> iCloud Private Relay</a> product.</p> <h4><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h4> <p>As an Engineering Manager on the Egress team you will hire, mentor, and coach a distributed team of Software Engineers. You will play a key role in developing the team and shaping its culture and technical vision. This includes:</p> <ul> <li>Working closely with Product Managers and other Engineering leaders to communicate the vision, prioritize the team's roadmap, and achieve cross-functional objectives.</li> <li>Understanding the technical implications of work across a distributed software network infrastructure to influence scope, work across teams, and help unblock projects: from data planes responsible for delivery of critical customer traffic to distributed control-plane services.</li> <li>Applying technical experience to evaluate tradeoffs, contribute to design decisions, and help drive resolution to customer-facing issues, while creating space for engineers to lead design, implementation, and delivery.</li> <li>Taking responsibility for the team's production services by organizing on-call rotations, handling customer escalations, and overseeing incident response and follow-up.</li> <li>Driving reliability and automation improvements across the platform</li> <li>Using tools and processes to convey project status and resolve blockages.</li> </ul> <p>You are a growth-oriented individual who enjoys being outside of your comfort zone. You are comfortable in a fast-paced but sensible work environment. You value curiosity and empathy and lead with these values.</p> <h4><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:</strong></h4> <ul> <li>5+ years experience as an Engineering Manager for a team of Software and Systems Engineers.</li> <li>Demonstrate a track record of managing a team including hiring, onboarding, and professional development. You inspire your team to reach higher. You're as good at explaining "why" as you are "how".</li> <li>Excel at planning and overseeing execution to meet commitments and deliver with predictability.</li> <li>Experience/interest in Layer 3 and Layer 4 networking</li> <li>Experience/interest in network performance monitoring and tuning.</li> <li>Experience with monitoring, alerting, and debugging distributed systems.</li> <li>Experience participating in and/or managing an on-call rotation for production services with direct customer impact.</li> <li>Willingness to adopt and integrate AI tools and systems into your workflow.</li> <li>Clarity in written and verbal communication.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For Portugal based hires: Estimated annual salary of €89,000-122,000. </span></li> </ul> <p><strong>Equity</strong></p> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Senior Account Executive, Hotels - France & Netherlands (12M FTC)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.</span></p></div><p><strong>The Community You Will Join:</strong></p> <p>The Airbnb Hotels team is a fun, fast-growing group leading Airbnb’s expansion into the hotel sector. Operating with an entrepreneurial spirit, this team combines the simplicity, product excellence, and guest-centered ethos that define Airbnb. This team’s mission is to deliver the smoothest, most intuitive hotel booking experience for guests, while helping independent, boutique hotels easily drive incremental bookings so they can focus on delivering the best hospitality. The ultimate aim is to help more people discover high-quality hotels, creating value for guests and our hotel partners.</p> <p><strong>The Difference You Will Make</strong></p> <p>As a Senior Account Executive, you will be responsible for converting leads into net‑new supply to support new-market launches and at pace to hit quarterly goals. Working the full sales funnel, you will proactively turn cold leads into warm sales opportunities helping to build the Hotels category’s market presence in the process through collaboration with other teams. This includes partnering, strategizing, and running daily operations directly with independent, boutique hotels , and ensuring that Airbnb sources  the best hotel inventory available to our guests.</p> <p>This role is based in Paris (hybrid, 2 days a week in the office).  It will start off as a 12-month FTC with the potential for conversion depending on individual performance. </p> <p><strong>A Typical Day</strong></p> <ul> <li>Meet and exceed KPIs by owning the performance and success of assigned region</li> <li>Prospect new potential hotels through external research, networking, and use of Airbnb tools.</li> <li>Securing new hotels involves targeted sales strategies and negotiating and closing the deals</li> <li>Develops acquisition strategies and scalable, localised supply strategies for established and emerging markets</li> <li>Expertly position and communicate Airbnb’s value proposition to new partners via phone, email, and in-person</li> <li>Add net new hotels by qualifying and moving leads through the funnel as quickly as possible, achieving defined quarterly goals</li> <li>Find supply in and launch new markets: Own market launches including supporting lead generation and coordinating cross functionally</li> <li>Support hotel onboarding as needed from won sales opportunities</li> <li>Effectively promote and build strong relationships with hotels by demonstrating comprehensive knowledge of our platforms and confidently pitching their value</li> </ul> <p><strong>Your Expertise</strong></p> <ul> <li>8+ years of professional experience, preferably in a fast growing startup tech or hospitality company working in sales and/or account management</li> <li>Previous hospitality experience is a plus</li> <li>Proficiency in both English and French.</li> <li>CRM required; Proficiency in Salesforce, Gong and other scalable AI Sales prospecting tools is a plus.</li> <li>The ability to get things done with constantly changing priorities, projects and deadlines</li> <li>Excellent communication, organizational, and analytical skills, detail-oriented but moves fast</li> <li>Ability to establish strong relationships with and influence partners </li> <li>Capacity to balance day-to-day responsibilities with longer-term strategic execution</li> <li>You’re a quick learner and you’re fearless about doing whatever it takes to get the job done, even if it means making mistakes along the way</li> <li>Able to travel up to 25-30% of the time</li> <li>Passion for Airbnb and travel</li> </ul> <p><strong>How We’ll Take Care of You:</strong></p> <p>Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for variable incentive pay, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.</p> <p>The On-Target Earnings (“OTE”) range for this role is €98,000 to €115,000 gross per year, which includes a split of 80% (base pay) / 20% (variable incentive). Of this OTE amount, the annual gross base salary range is €78,400 to €92,000. </p> <p>The OTE reflected on this job posting is the target cash compensation a candidate could earn in a year if they achieve 100% of their performance or sales goals. The variable incentive is not guaranteed and is governed by the terms of Airbnb’s Hotels Variable Compensation Plan (the “Plan”). The actual payouts depend on performance against targets set under the “Plan” and may be higher or lower than the range listed on this job posting.</p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong>Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;">Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p> </p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Reasonable Accommodations:</strong> We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong>A Note on Recruiting Scams:</strong> Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @<a href="http://airbnb.com">airbnb.com</a> or @<a href="http://ext.airbnb.com">ext.airbnb.com</a> email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing.  We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Paris is one of our most iconic and competitive markets, and our job on the Demand side is to make sure the right guests find the right Experience at the right moment, whether they are visiting Paris or live nearby.</p> <p>We are looking for a curious, organized and data-friendly student who loves the craft of CRM and Operational Marketing: a sharp brief, a well-built email, a smart audience, and an analysis that tells us what to do next. You are comfortable juggling several campaigns at once, working with different teams, and turning numbers into clear recommendations.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>The difference you will make:</strong></p> <p>You will support the Paris Experiences Demand lead on the day-to-day CRM and marketing activity that drives bookings. You will see a campaign from the first brief to the final analysis, and you will own your own projects along the way. During your internship, you will:</p> <p><em>Run email campaigns end to end</em></p> <ul> <li>Write briefs for email campaigns (audience, objective, key messages, timing) and coordinate with copy, design and CRM partners</li> <li>Execute campaigns through our internal tools and planning process, including setup, QA and send follow-up</li> <li>Analyze results after each send (opens, clicks, bookings, incrementality) and share clear learnings and next steps</li> </ul> <p><em>Support listing promotion and audience targeting</em></p> <ul> <li>Analyze cohorts of guests (new vs. returning, local vs. traveler, International vs Domestic) to understand behavior over time</li> <li>Build simple, readable dashboards and recurring reports to select and prioritize listings based on quality, availability, performance and fit with the campaign</li> <li>Work with Market and Supply teams to make sure what we promote is bookable and best-in-class</li> <li>Turn insights into concrete recommendations for audiences, timing and messaging</li> </ul> <p><em>Follow local activations</em></p> <ul> <li>Provide operational support and follow-up on field campaigns such as flyering, partnerships, events or more: briefing, logistics, timing, partners and results tracking</li> <li>Help measure what works locally and recommend future iterations</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>The intern experience:</strong></p> <p>As an intern, you will be part of a team where you contribute to real projects with real business impact. Your manager, your team and our wider employee community will strive to be superhosts to you during your internship. We provide the support, mentorship and hands-on experience you need to learn quickly and make an impact. </p> <p>You’ll get a front-row seat on how a global marketplace builds demand for a destination, with real ownership from day one: your campaigns go live and your analyses shape decisions. You’ll do it alongside a team that cares about craft, curiosity and human connection. You can expect to:</p> <ul> <li>Collaborate with Marketing, Market Management and Acquisition partners to deliver projects</li> <li>Present your analyses and recommendations to stakeholders</li> <li>Seek and give feedback throughout the internship</li> <li>Take part in the Experiences and broader Airbnb community</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Your expertise:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Current student or recent graduate</strong> (degree completed within the last 12 months) from a leading business school, engineering school or equivalent program in France, looking for a 6-month internship starting in January 2027</li> <li><strong>Fluent in French and English</strong>, with excellent written communication: you can write a clear brief and a clear recap. You also have an eye for great copy and for what makes a message feel human</li> <li><strong>A strong interest in marketing, CRM or growth</strong>, and in travel, hospitality or community-driven products</li> <li><strong>Curious about data and performance metrics</strong>, with an interest in using insights and quantitative analysis to evaluate campaigns, track performance, and inform decision-making. title: Senior Talent Partner, Tech
description: About Dust Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it. With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done. With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast. We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026. Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50 . Why this role exists We are about to hire the people who will define the next phase of this company. Not backfill a plan someone else wrote — define it. The quality of who joins Dust over the next eighteen months is the single highest-leverage variable in whether we build the category or watch someone else do it. That work needs a recruiter who treats hiring as a craft rather than a queue. Someone who can hold a real point of view on what "great" looks like for a role, defend it with a hiring manager who disagrees, and then go find that person themselves — from a cold start, without a lead gen team, a sourcing pod, or a playbook waiting for them. You'll be an early member of a small Talent team. That means you own roles end to end, and you also help build the thing itself: the assessment design, the interview loops, the calibration, the data we use to know whether any of it is working. We're looking for someone who cares about the candidate experience for all parties internal and external. And prioritizes protecting Dust's culture by being thoughtful, thorough and leading by example in being a true team player. What you'll own Full-cycle hiring, end to end. You run your own searches from role kickoff to close. Sourcing, outreach, screening, interviewing, offer strategy, negotiation. You are the owner of the outcome, not a coordinator of other people's opinions. Assessment design, not just assessment delivery. For every role you open, you help define what evidence would actually predict success — then you build the loop that surfaces it. You'll push back on interview stages that exist out of habit and replace them with ones that test something real. Hiring manager partnership with a spine. You'll spend as much time calibrating hiring managers as you do talking to candidates. When a manager says "not quite the right feel," you'll ask what they mean until there's a defensible answer, and you'll say so when there isn't one. Market intelligence. You'll know your talent market better than anyone else in the building — who's good, where they are, what moves them, what compensation actually looks like right now — and you'll bring that back into how we scope roles and design offers. The candidate experience. Our hiring process is the first honest sample of what working here feels like. You'll make it expedient, direct, well-communicated, and worth a candidate's time whether or not they get an offer. Building the function. Process, tooling, structured scorecards, funnel data, quality-of-hire signal. You'll leave the system better than you found it, and you'll be trusted to change it without asking permission first. title: Systems Engineer, Product Platform Tools
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>The Product Platform Tools team builds and operates Cloudflare's internal support and admin platform, which customer-facing and operational teams across the company use to do their jobs. It includes the API gateway and authorization layer that control access to those teams' internal applications.</p> <p>We're hiring a hands-on backend engineer to build and evolve the services, APIs, and gateway for the platform. You'll set a high standard for how applications onboard onto the platform, taking an API-driven approach to contracts, access, and integration. You'll work with the engineering teams who onboard their apps and with the non-engineering teams who use the platform daily. You'll need curiosity about how Cloudflare works under the hood, a security-first mindset, and the communication skills to turn operational needs into reliable platform capabilities.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>API and gateway development: </strong>design and build the backend services, APIs, and gateway capabilities (routing, authentication, request handling, upstream integration) at the core of the internal admin platform.</li> <li><strong>API-driven onboarding: </strong>set and raise the standard for onboarding applications onto the platform. Use clear API contracts, well-governed access, and a repeatable integration path so teams can onboard quickly and consistently.</li> <li><strong>Stakeholder partnership: </strong>work directly with Support, Legal, and Security to turn operational needs into maintainable platform features.</li> <li><strong>Security and authorization: </strong>own the platform's authorization model. Work with Security and Legal to implement and enforce access control, governance, and compliance requirements in code.</li> <li><strong>Reliability of what you build: </strong>build observability and resilience into your services, take part in on-call for them, respond to incidents, and lead post-incident reviews.</li> <li><strong>Engineering excellence: </strong>ramp quickly into unfamiliar and legacy codebases and make incremental improvements that reduce toil. Keep a high bar through code review and design docs.</li> <li><strong>AI-assisted engineering: </strong>use AI coding tools as a normal part of how you design, build, and debug. Review their output with the same rigor you'd apply to any other code.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</strong></p> <p><em>These are examples of what a strong candidate brings:</em></p> <p><strong>Must-Have Skills</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Professional experience: </strong>5+ years building and operating production backend services at scale.</li> <li><strong>Languages: </strong>strong proficiency in Go and/or TypeScript.</li> <li><strong>API gateway and API design: </strong>hands-on experience building or operating an API gateway or similar edge/proxy layer, and designing REST APIs. This covers routing, request lifecycle, authentication, and versioning.</li> <li><strong>Authentication and authorization: </strong>strong understanding of OAuth 2.0, OIDC, JWT, RBAC, and policy-based access (such as OPA/Rego), with a security-first approach to design.</li> <li><strong>Data: </strong>hands-on experience with PostgreSQL and Redis, including schema design, query optimization, and caching strategies.</li> <li><strong>Cross-team collaboration: </strong>comfortable working with engineering, Security, Legal, and non-technical stakeholders, and explaining technical detail to each.</li> <li><strong>Ownership and autonomy: </strong>confident in legacy code, self-directed, and able to drive ambiguous problems to resolution across team boundaries.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice-to-Have Skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience building internal tooling, admin consoles, or case-management systems for non-engineering users.</li> <li>Exposure to security governance or compliance workflows, or working closely with a dedicated Security or Legal team on access control.</li> <li>Familiarity with Cloudflare's platform (Workers, Access, Zero Trust, Gateway).</li> <li>Experience running containerized services (Docker, Kubernetes), infrastructure as code (Terraform), and CI/CD with GitLab.</li> <li>Observability experience: distributed tracing, structured logging, and dashboards (Grafana, Kibana, Jaeger).</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration.
