title: Staff Software Engineer, Security Platform: Authentication
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>As a Staff Software Engineer on GitLab's Authentication team, you'll be the technical lead for how every user, application, token, and automated agent proves who it is on GitLab.com, Self-Managed, and Dedicated.</p> <p>We're an OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect (OIDC) provider for millions of users. We also accept identity from enterprise identity providers through Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML) and Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP). Behind that sit more than ten token types and several session methods that grew inside the Ruby on Rails monolith. You'll help us move this work onto GATE, GitLab's new authentication and authorization platform. GATE exchanges external credentials for short-lived tokens at the edge through a Secure Token Service written in Go.You'll set our technical direction, lead the hardest protocol and migration work yourself, and help senior engineers own the rest.</p> <p>Our projects include:</p> <ul> <li value="1"><strong><strong class="textBold">OAuth across Cells:</strong></strong> Making OAuth clients, grants, and tokens work when users and organizations live in different cells</li> <li value="2"><strong><strong class="textBold">Global identities:</strong></strong> One user identity that works across organizations and cells</li> <li value="3"><strong><strong class="textBold">Token consolidation:</strong></strong> Reducing the number of token types and moving token issuance and validation out of the monolith</li> <li value="4"><strong><strong class="textBold">Identity for artificial intelligence (AI) agents and workloads:</strong></strong> OAuth for Model Context Protocol (MCP) clients, workload identity federation, and service identities with narrow scopes</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Own the technical direction for authentication protocols at GitLab, including OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, and token exchange, across the Rails monolith and GATE services.</li> <li value="2">Write and drive design documents and architecture decision records (ADRs) for multi-quarter work, then break that work into increments that ship behind feature flags.</li> <li value="3">Lead migrations that must not break existing customers: token formats, client and grant state, and session behavior on GitLab.com, Self-Managed, and Dedicated.</li> <li value="4">Be hands-on in the most complex parts of the code, in Ruby on Rails and Go, and review the designs and merge requests of other engineers.</li> <li value="5">Agree interface contracts with the GATE Core, GATE Infra, Authorization, and Tenant Scale (Cells and Organizations) teams, and keep them current as the architecture changes.</li> <li value="6">Treat authentication as a security and availability boundary: threat-model new flows, add rate limits and abuse controls, and lead the technical response to authentication incidents.</li> <li value="7">Mentor senior and intermediate engineers on the team and raise the protocol and security knowledge of the whole group.</li> <li value="8">Work asynchronously with engineers in India, Europe, and the Americas, with most decisions made in writing.</li> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.</span></li> </ul> <h2>What you'll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Significant experience building and running production authentication or identity systems at scale, with technical leadership across teams that moves unclear problems to written decisions and shipped code.</li> <li value="2">Deep, hands-on knowledge of OAuth 2.0 and OIDC: authorization code with Proof Key for Code Exchange (PKCE), refresh token rotation, token exchange, client registration, scopes, and JSON Web Tokens (JWTs) with signing keys and key rotation.</li> <li value="3">Working knowledge of SAML 2.0 single sign-on and enterprise identity integration (LDAP, System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM), or similar).</li> <li value="4">Strong production experience in Ruby on Rails or Go, willingness to work in both, and experience with careful refactors, feature-flagged rollouts, and backward-compatible migrations in large, long-lived codebases.</li> <li value="5">A security mindset. You think about token theft, replay, revocation, and blast radius before you think about elegance.</li> <li value="6">Experience with multi-tenant software as a service (SaaS) systems, including data isolation and performance under high request volume.</li> <li value="7">Clear, concise written English and comfort working in an all-remote, asynchronous company.</li> <li value="8">Optional experience: authentication libraries (Doorkeeper, Devise, or OmniAuth), passkeys or multi-factor authentication, workload identity, gateways or policy engines, AI agent authentication, or multi-region architectures. Contributions to identity standards or open source identity projects are also welcome.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>The Authentication group is part of the Security Platform stage, alongside Authorization, GATE Core, GATE Infra, Secrets Manager, and other security teams. We own sign-in, single sign-on, OAuth, and personal and service tokens. Our work touches every GitLab customer, and much of it is on the critical path for Cells and for GitLab's AI agent platform.</p> <p> </p> <h2> </h2><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. title: Senior Territory Account Executive, Korea
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>Seoul, South Korea</li> </ul> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>The Cloudflare APAC sales organisation operates as one integrated revenue system. Account Executives, Customer Engineers, Partner Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, Customer Experience Managers, Professional Services and Revenue Operations work as a continuous engine — winning, deploying, adopting, expanding, and scaling platform commitments across the full customer lifecycle.</p> <p>The system is supported by an AI-embedded operating model. The work itself, however, remains human. The role of every seller at Cloudflare is to bring critical thinking, judgment, and trust to customer relationships and outcomes.</p> <p>In this role, you will be responsible for driving significant growth by landing and expanding a portfolio of assigned customers in your assigned territory. The ideal candidate possesses a strong blend of sales acumen and technical understanding, enabling them to engage effectively with both technical and non-technical buyers. As a Senior Territory Account Executive, you will drive revenue velocity by utilizing foundational sales data layers for accurate forecasting, proactive pipeline management, and consistently exceeding attainment targets.</p> <p>You are the kind of operator who uses AI as a force multiplier every day, cares more about customer outcomes than job boundaries, and demonstrates curiosity, judgment, and high agency.</p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>Own and execute a comprehensive territory plan to consistently achieve and exceed sales and revenue targets.</li> <li>Cultivate long-term strategic relationships with key accounts and partners. Lead executive-level transformation narratives that earn the right to be in the architecture conversation.</li> <li>Leverage top partners as an extension of the sales team to co-sell alongside where they bring customer relationships, services capability, or procurement leverage. Drive regular forecast & pipeline cadences with top partners.</li> <li>Understand customer network architectures, the problems that Cloudflare can solve and effectively translate Cloudflare’s solutions to drive successful platform sales, ensuring clients can secure and scale their own AI-driven workloads.</li> <li>Manage contract negotiations and structure platform-level commercial commitments (multi-year, multi-product, outcome-anchored) rather than point-product deals.</li> <li>Stay engaged through onboarding, adoption, and the first renewal. Partner with Customer Engineers, Professional Services on a deployment plan with milestones tied to measurable outcomes.</li> <li>Proactively build and manage a robust sales pipeline by leveraging internal tools, AI-assisted research and pipeline sources (BDR, Channel, Marketing).</li> <li>Maintain high standards in pipeline discipline, CRM hygiene and forecasting accuracy.</li> </ul> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree or equivalent with at least 8+ years of relevant work experience.</li> <li>Experience selling technology solutions in high-growth technology firms.</li> <li>Demonstrated track record of consistently meeting and exceeding multi-million dollar quota targets.</li> <li>Proficient in discovery, positioning, competitive selling, negotiation, closing, and multi-threaded land and expand strategies.</li> <li>Strong understanding of computer networking, cloud security technology, and how enterprise infrastructure adapts to automated data workflows.</li> <li>Exceptional interpersonal communication skills and value selling skills.</li> <li>Proficiency in modern sales software, customer data environments, and core systems (e.g., Salesforce, Tableau, G-suite).</li> <li>Thinks critically rather than reacting, exercises judgment under uncertainty, names risks honestly, shows genuine empathy for customers as people, can point to relationships built over time on trust, and demonstrates visible curiosity in how they prepare, sell, and learn.</li> <li>Willingness to actively engage with AI tools and experiment.</li> <li>Ability to travel as required.</li> <li>Cultural fluency for assigned markets; language proficiency where required.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. title: HR Medewerker Senior (m/v/x)
description: Een ervaren HR-professional die graag complexe HR-vraagstukken oppakt, kennis deelt, overzicht houdt en bijdraagt aan een goede HR-dienstverlening. Voor onze volop in beweging zijnde HR administratie/HR-support team zoeken we een ervaren HR-professional die goed thuis is in HR operatie en graag meedenkt over uiteenlopende HR-vraagstukken. Je bent een inhoudelijke vraagbaak voor collega’s en steekt zelf graag de handen uit de mouwen. Met een proactieve blik kijk je verder dan de dagelijkse praktijk en zie je kansen om processen te verbeteren. Herken jij jezelf hierin en bouw je graag mee aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze afdeling? Solliciteer dan snel! Wat ga je doen? Jij zorgt er samen met je hr-collega’s voor dat de basis van onze HR-administratie op orde is, maar jouw meerwaarde zit vooral in het behandelen van complexere operationele HR-vraagstukken, het ondersteunen van HR collega’s en het samen met de teamleider verder ontwikkelen van onze dienstverlening. Je bent een inhoudelijke vraagbaak voor het HR-team en een vertrouwd aanspreekpunt voor NLR medewerkers en HR-adviseurs. Als senior HR medewerker heb je een veelzijdige rol waarin HR-administratie, dienstverlening, inhoudelijke expertise en procesverbetering samenkomen. Jouw HR collega’s houden zich bezig met de dagelijkse HR-processen, waarbij jij je richt op vooral vraagstukken die meer ervaring, inzicht en zelfstandigheid vragen. Daarnaast deel je actief je kennis met collega's, denk je mee over een slimme verdeling van het werk en draag je bij aan de kwaliteit van onze dienstverlening. Jouw werkzaamheden in het kort: Vraagbaak voor het HR-team : je behandelt tweedelijns HR-vraagstukken over bijvoorbeeld arbeidsvoorwaarden, personeelsregelingen en HR processen, detachering, inleen en deelt je kennis en ondersteunt collega’s. Samenwerken met de teamleider HR : je werkt aan HR-projecten, verbetert processen en bewaakt de voortgang, met name bij piekmomenten. Ondersteunen van de HR Adviseurs en managers : je helpt bij operationele HR-vraagstukken en zorgt voor een goede aansluiting tussen HR-processen en de praktijk. Zorgen voor goede HR-dienstverlening : je bewaakt de kwaliteit van de HR-administratie en hebt contact met medewerkers. Je draagt bij aan een juiste en tijdige verwerking van personeelsgegevens en ondersteunt waar nodig bij eerstelijnsvragen. Bouwen aan de HR-afdeling : je signaleert knelpunten, denkt mee over praktische/operationele verbeteringen, helpt werkprocessen te uniformeren en deelt je kennis met collega's. Wat breng je mee? We zoeken iemand die senioriteit laat zien in zowel gedrag als HR-kennis. Je hoeft niet alles te weten, maar je hebt een stevige basis, durft verantwoordelijkheid te nemen en weet wanneer je zelfstandig kunt handelen en wanneer afstemming nodig is. First time right is het devies, kwalitatieve en zorgvuldige HR administratie en dienstverlening vinden wij belangrijk. Verder breng je mee: Afgeronde opleiding in HRM of een vergelijkbare richting met minimaal vijf jaar relevante ervaring binnen HR, bij voorkeur in een brede HR-administratieve functie en kennis van AFAS. Je hebt gedegen kennis van HR administratie en support en ervaring met het zelfstandig behandelen van HR-vraagstukken over bijvoorbeeld arbeidsvoorwaarden en personeelsregelingen. Je bent communicatief sterk, toegankelijk en klantgericht. Je maakt gemakkelijk contact met medewerkers en collega’s op verschillende niveaus. Je werkt graag samen, durft je eigen perspectief in te brengen en staat open voor feedback en andere inzichten. Je werkt nauwkeurig, hebt oog voor details en houdt overzicht en helpt collega’s om werkzaamheden goed en tijdig af te ronden. Je bent gewend en krijgt er energie van om in een snel groeiende en veranderende organisatie te werken. Je beheerst het Nederlands en Engels goed, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk op C1 niveau. Wat bieden wij jou? Bij NLR krijg je de ruimte om impact te maken én jezelf te ontwikkelen. Je werkt in een innovatieve nationale en internationale hightechomgeving waar nieuwsgierigheid, samenwerking en vakmanschap centraal staan. We geloven dat mensen het beste presteren als ze de vrijheid krijgen om initiatief te nemen, zich te blijven ontwikkelen en een gezonde balans te vinden tussen werk en privé. Verder bieden we je onder andere: Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 4400,- en € 5000 (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek) , afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring; 45 verlofdagen (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek); 8% vakantiegeld én een vaste eindejaarsuitkering van 8%; De kosten voor reizen met het openbaar vervoer worden volledig vergoed. Reis je met eigen vervoer? Dan ontvang je een kilometervergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer. Een zorgtoelage van €145,- bruto (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek) via onze collectieve zorgverzekering bij OHRA als extra ondersteuning voor jouw zorgkosten; Extra betaald ouderschapsverlof; Volop kansen om te blijven leren met opleidingen, trainingen, coaching en andere ontwikkelmogelijkheden; De mogelijkheid om 32-40 uur per week te werken inclusief thuiswerken. Jouw nieuwe werkomgeving Je wordt onderdeel van een breed HR-team met verschillende expertises, van HR-advies en beleid tot recruitment en Learning & Development. We sparren graag met elkaar, houden elkaar scherp en inspireren elkaar om verder te komen. Er is volop ruimte voor jouw ideeën, kennis en initiatief, met oog voor elkaar en het gezamenlijke resultaat. Samen werken we aan HR-dienstverlening die aansluit bij de behoeften van de organisatie en bijdraagt aan onze strategische ambities. Onze HR-afdeling is volop in ontwikkeling en werkt aan verdere professionalisering en verbetering van processen en samenwerking. Dat biedt kansen, maar vraagt ook iets van jou. Je komt terecht in een HR-afdeling waar we volop werken aan het verbeteren van onze dienstverlening. We brengen meer structuur aan, maken onze processen eenvoudiger en werken steeds nauwer samen. Dat betekent dat niet alles al vastligt en dat er ruimte is om mee te denken en dingen slimmer te organiseren. Je standplaats is Amsterdam of Marknesse , maar je bent ook regelmatig op onze andere locatie voor overleg en samenwerking met collega’s. Wat betekent werken bij NLR? Koninklijke NLR is al meer dan 100 jaar een toonaangevende kennisinstelling voor toegepast onderzoek in de lucht- en ruimtevaart. Samen met meer dan 1000 professionals werken we aan innovatieve oplossingen voor een duurzamere, veiligere en efficiëntere lucht- en ruimtevaart. We willen dat iedereen bij NLR de ruimte krijgt om zichzelf te zijn, talenten te ontwikkelen en ideeën in te brengen. Door verschillen te waarderen en van elkaar te leren, creëren we samen een inclusieve werkomgeving. Wil jij meer weten? Mail dan met Christel Bouwers (Recruiter) via Onze collega’s vertellen jou graag hoe het is om bij NLR te werken. Vergeet trouwens ook niet eens een kijkje op onze socials te nemen zoals ons YouTube kanaal . Solliciteren? Mooi, we zijn benieuwd naar jou! Stuur je motivatiebrief en CV via de ‘Solliciteren’ button. Een positieve uitkomst van een veiligheidsonderzoek (VGB) is een voorwaarde voor indiensttreding. Meer informatie daarover lees je op de website van de MIVD. Acquisitie wordt niet op prijs gesteld! Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Project Manager, Government Projects Team
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3>Position Location: Lisbon, Portugal or London, UK (Hybrid)</h3> <h3><strong>Citizenship:</strong> U.S. or UK Citizenship Required (due to government security clearance requirements)</h3> <h3 class="" data-path-to-node="0">About the Role</h3> <p data-path-to-node="1">We are looking for a dedicated Program/Project Manager to spearhead the execution of mission-critical federal technology engagements within our Government Projects team. title: Software Engineer, Knowledge Engine  – Data Infrastructure
description: The Knowledge Platform team builds Exa's knowledge engine. We continuously synthesize information from across the web and beyond into one of the world's largest open-domain knowledge graphs, with hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims. The work has two halves: construction pipelines that decide what to trust, and retrieval engines that decide how best to search it. Our goal is to give agents answers to any factual question about the world with unprecedented precision and completeness. In this role, you'll build the knowledge construction pipelines : turning everything from a 100k docs/s web crawl to vendor datasets into a graph of what is true about the world, and keeping it correct as data changes. This is greenfield work with a massive scope. There is no off-the-shelf system for building a model of the world from the open web, so you'll make foundational decisions, from how claims are represented and resolved to how trust is assigned and how the graph evolves over time, that everything built on top of it depends on. What you'll do Continuously synthesize the live web crawl, vendor deliveries and APIs, and other off-the-web sources into one typed graph: extraction that turns pages and records into ontology-shaped claims, each carrying its provenance, timestamp and confidence. Bring every new source in cleanly: versioned, append-only history with schema evolution, late-arriving and corrected records, and replayable cursors, so every claim traces back to the exact delivery that produced it. Decide what to trust: entity resolution across billions of records (blocking, pairwise scoring, clustering) into canonical people, companies, places and publications, then truth discovery that weighs source reliability, recency and corroboration to reconcile conflicting claims. Keep that picture current and convergent: streams arrive continuously, out of order and at very different rates, so the graph is eventually consistent by design. You'll build incremental computation over change data feeds, where each update is a diff of what changed and every job is idempotent and resumable, so the graph converges to the same state however runs interleave, fail or replay, and readers only ever see committed, consistent versions. Measure precision and completeness: labeled evals for extraction and resolution, per-source coverage and correctness metrics, and lineage that pinpoints which source or stage broke and why. What we're looking for You've built and operated large-scale distributed data pipelines in production over petabytes of structured and unstructured data, with Spark over a lakehouse format (Delta Lake, Iceberg, Hudi). You understand incremental processing deeply: change data capture, idempotent writes, backfills and reprocessing. Strong in Python and at least one systems language; you can read and tune Spark query plans. You obsess over correctness, reliability and data quality as much as scale. Bonus Entity resolution, record linkage, knowledge graphs or ontologies Information extraction or truth discovery at scale Lance or other columnar/vector-native formats Example projects Take a new billion-row dataset from first delivery to queryable entities in days, not months. Keep a graph of hundreds of billions of claims current with incremental updates, so a fact that changes on the web reaches it in minutes. Build a system that knows every company and person in the world, with one evidence-backed record each, resolved across the web and every source we ingest. Exa is an equal opportunity employer. title: Senior Customer Solutions Engineer
description: Life at Plume At Plume, we believe that technology isn't about moving faster, it's about making life's moments better. Which is why we've built the world's first, and only, open and hardware-independent service delivery platform for smart homes, small businesses, enterprises, and beyond. Our SaaS platform uses WiFi, advanced AI, and machine learning to create the future of connected spaces—and human experiences—at massive scale. We now deliver services to over 60 million locations globally and have managed over 3 billion devices on our platform. We're expanding rapidly, pioneering a new category, and we achieved our Series F funding in just four years. Our customers include many of the world's largest Internet Service Providers (ISPs) who look to Plume to help them evolve their smart home offerings while gleaning insights from their own data. With a bias for action and a love for being trailblazers, the team at Plume embodies a combination of relentless curiosity and imaginative innovation. We challenge ourselves to think in ways that other companies don't, work to do what should be done (rather than what can), and if we can't do it exceptionally well, we don't do it. It's how we've assembled a team of world-class builders, thinkers, and doers. And it's how we're reinventing what's possible every day. Plume is seeking an experienced and highly motivated Senior Customer Solutions Engineer to join our dynamic team. As a key technical advisor, you'll work directly with Internet Service Providers (ISPs), acting as the bridge between their business needs and our cutting-edge solutions. You'll play a crucial role in the sales process, from initial discovery to successful deployment, ensuring our partners achieve maximum value from our products. This is a fantastic opportunity for a technically adept individual with a passion for networking, cloud, and AI who thrives in a customer-facing role. Responsibilities Technical Trusted Advisor: Engage with ISPs to deeply understand their technical and business requirements, and then effectively demonstrate how Plume's solutions can meet and exceed those needs. Product Demos & Trials: Conduct compelling product demonstrations and manage complex proof-of-concept (PoC) and field trials, showcasing the tangible benefits of Plume's technology. System Integration: Collaborate with our internal Customer Engineering, Product Management, and Operational teams to understand and deliver Plume's solutions within a customer's ecosystem. You'll work to integrate our solutions into their existing BSS/OSS, CRM, ticketing, and AI platforms using APIs and other integration methods. Sales Enablement: Work closely with the sales organization to drive revenue, achieve sales quotas, and contribute to the overall growth of the business. Presentations & Events: Prepare and deliver high-impact presentations, including Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), and represent Plume at industry events and conferences. Product Development Input: Provide valuable feedback to our product and engineering teams based on customer requirements and market trends, helping to inform the development of new features and solutions. Technical Support: Offer prompt local and remote technical support for PoCs, lab trials, and deployment ramp-ups, ensuring a smooth and successful customer journey. Industry Expertise: Continuously research and stay up-to-date on the latest industry standards and emerging technologies in networking, cloud architectures, and AI. Experience & Qualifications Hands-on Technical Experience: Strong hands-on experience in the configuration and deployment of software and hardware, including Wi-Fi, networking equipment, and cloud services. A fundamental understanding of cloud architectures and AI principles is essential. Deep understanding and knowledge of Residential and SMB Gateways is a big plus. ISP SaaS Experience: Proven experience working with ISPs to deploy large-scale SaaS network solutions to millions of endpoints. Communication & Collaboration: A track record of developing and maintaining professional, cooperative relationships with all levels of staff and customers. Networking & Cloud Certifications: Relevant certifications such as CWNA, CCNA, or AWS Solutions Architect are highly preferred. Problem-Solving: Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues in a fast-paced environment. Qualification Requirements Experience: 5+ years of related experience working with network, security, SaaS, and/or AI industries. Education: A BS/BA degree in a relevant field or equivalent work experience. Industry Knowledge: In-depth industry knowledge and a strong understanding of SDN and wireless technologies, solutions, and product offerings are preferred. Communication Skills: Advanced written and oral communication skills. Travel: Ability to travel >70% of the time. Location/Language: This is a remote position. Candidates must be based in United Kingdom or Netherlands and be fluent in English. About Plume As the creator of the only open, hardware-independent, cloud-controlled experience platform for ISPs and their subscribers, Plume partners with over 400 ISP customers, including some of the world's largest such as Charter, Liberty Global, and J:COM. Using OpenSync, the most widely supported open-source, silicon-to-cloud framework for smart spaces, Plume's software-defined network allows ISPs to decouple their service offerings from hardware and rapidly curate and deliver new services over a multi-vendor, open-platform architecture. title: AI Builder
description: The short version Plenty of companies are still running AI pilots. We moved past that a while ago: AI agents and human experts create, localise, check and refresh content for global B2B brands every day, across markets and languages. The next question is a harder one: not how to make content, but which content a client should make at all. That's where you come in. As an AI Builder, you work on both sides of that. About half your time goes to bringing new clients live. The rest goes to building the intelligence that tells each client what to make next: where competitors outrank them, which pages are losing ground and need a refresh, which topics are an opening nobody has claimed yet, and whether they show up when people ask ChatGPT or Google instead of searching. We've built our own CRM; our teams work with agents that do everything from setting up a tailor-made demo for a prospect to preparing sales calls and routing client feedback to the right person, and people across the company build their own tools. If you want to do serious work with AI, this is a good place for it. Everyone here is already building. What Contentoo does Most content tools make the client the editor. Most agencies make them the project manager. We'd rather make them the approver: they brief, review, and approve, and we run everything in between, inside their own workflow and tools. That makes us a product with a large service layer, sitting where SaaS, service and AI overlap. None of that works without good foundations, so that's where we start. Before any agent runs, we capture what makes a client's content theirs: strategy, tone, terminology, compliance rules and hero pieces, per language and market, confirmed by the client. Every agent, expert and signal draws on that brand context. Skip it, and you get generic content, faster. There's no shortage of software that tells a client what to write. The difference is that we get those foundations right first and then actually do the work. We've been doing that for ten years: 300+ brands, 300,000+ completed projects and 49 languages. What you'll do A suite of Workflows already runs in production, from localisation and creation to brand checks and content refresh. Each one combines AI agents with human experts and works from the client's brand context. In practice, your week splits two ways. Half of it is implementation: getting new clients live, finding out where their situation is different from the last client's, and building the fix quickly, whether that's a new skill for their agent, a connection to their CMS, or a check only their market needs. Then you make that whole process faster and more automated on our side, so the next client goes live with less hand work. The other half is the layer on top, which we're building right now: brand intelligence. Today most marketing teams guess what to write next. We want every client to know. Their own search data shows which pages are slipping, and a page that slips already gets a one-click refresh. Competitor rankings show where others win the topics the client should own. Strategy gets drafted from search data in each market and confirmed by the client, so every piece has a reason to exist. And every week we ask ChatGPT, Gemini, and Google's AI to answer the questions their buyers ask, to see whether the client is named or a competitor is. Every expert fix and every client comment flows back into the brand context, so the platform gets better with each piece. What works for one client becomes a feature for all of them. And our own teams are clients too. Sales asks the CRM and the agents for a prospect's history before a call. Anyone in the company can ask Conny, our assistant on top of KIWI, our company knowledge base, how billing works or what a package includes. Product feedback from clients gets sorted and routed to the right owner by an agent. When one of those tools needs to get better, you build that too, with Claude Code, the Claude and GPT APIs, MCP servers and agent skills: whatever does the job. The team You join the Product team under Olivier (CPO) and report to Joost (AI Lead), in our growing AI team. You'll work closely with Jorge (Product Lead), Cesar (Tech Lead) and our development hub in Valencia. Around you are the Connies: our people in Amsterdam and in our growing Valencia office. Once a month we stop for Success & Drinks, a company update with no slides and lots of energy, where anyone can take the floor to show what they've built. Wins get celebrated in #shoutout, from a sales call that nailed it to the talent team finding the right experts for a client's healthcare content. We play a padel tournament every year, run the city business run together (the ones who don't run come for the drinks afterwards), and take honest feedback seriously enough to train for it. Who you are You're a builder who gets energy from seeing a client actually use what you made. Three things come together in you: Judgement. You quickly see what's really going on with a client, and you're as credible talking ROI with a CFO as architecture with an engineer. You build. You prototype fast and ship, and you're at home with LLM APIs, agents, MCP, skills, and tools like Claude Code. You've built AI tools that real people use, and you can tell us what happened after launch. Hands in the mud. You love being close to clients: fixing what gets in their way, building what solves their next problem, and owning what you ship. Under the hood, it has to work, stay up, and be safe. Your best hours go to the client. You might come from strategy, product, solutions engineering, or technical implementation. Or you became the AI person at your last company and want a lot more of it. Fluent English is a must; Dutch is a plus. We are looking for someone available 32-40h per week. If seeing a client use something you built last week excites you more than perfecting the architecture behind it, you'll love it here. You'd be building on a business that's doing very well, with a large network of expert freelancers behind it: clients, data, and experts from day one, and an operation that keeps running while we scale. If you'd rather start from a blank page, a startup will suit you better. But if you want to make AI fly at scale, this is the place. What you’ll get A competitive salary based on experience 25 vacation days per year Pension contribution Hybrid work environment (great office at the Houthavens, 2-3 days in office, plus remote flexibility) A small AI team with a mandate to grow: real leadership opportunities, an L&D budget and direct exposure to the MT and founders Laptop of choice (Mac or HP) A monthly Alleo budget A learning budget Lunch and a bar in the office. Who doesn’t want a bar in their office?! A fun, inclusive team, regular company events, boat days, and more Why Contentoo, why now You'll build things people keep using. In client conversations, in the code and in the product, every week. The foundations are already there. 300+ clients, real integrations, structured brand context, Workflows in production, and real budget committed to AI. You build on top, not from zero. The market is wide open. Most enterprises are stuck somewhere between "we bought ChatGPT licences" and "our content still isn't better". We're building the bridge, and there's no playbook for it yet. What you build compounds. A win for one client becomes a feature for all of them. Sounds interesting? Let’s have a virtual coffee to get to know each other! :) Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Product Engineer - Booking Management
description: Hi! 👋 I'm Sam , Engineering Manager for Team Booking Management at WeTravel. I joined WeTravel to help simplify how group travel businesses handle payments and bookings. Our Booking Management team owns the journey from the moment a traveler decides to book: checkout flows, order management, tax management, and everything that enables travelers to easily make a reservation and manage it afterwards. Last year alone, over a million travelers booked adventures through our platform! As we streamline and localize our booking experience, I'm looking for engineers who are excited about making complex booking and commerce flows feel simple for our global users. About WeTravel: Think of the most incredible adventures imaginable: trekking to Machu Picchu, cycling through Tuscany, or going on a safari in Kenya. For years, the small businesses and local experts who run these trips have been stuck using messy spreadsheets, countless emails, and complicated payment methods. WeTravel is changing that. We build the tools that empower any entrepreneur to launch and grow their own travel business. Our platform makes it simple for organizers to create beautiful trip proposals, securely process payments, and manage their customers, so they can focus on what they do best: creating amazing experiences. This is one of the last great frontiers of travel to come online, and as the category leader, we are at the forefront of this change. Last year alone, our platform was trusted by 8,000 organizers to lead over a million travelers on adventures in 150+ countries. Now, we're on an exciting journey to grow from powering $1B to $10B in travel experiences per year. We believe that every trip, when done right, can be a force for good - and we're building the engine to make more of that possible. What's the role: You will join the Booking Management team to lead critical projects across checkout, order management, tax management, and traveler self-service. Upcoming work includes: Checkout experience: streamlining and localizing our checkout flows so travelers in every market can complete a reservation in just a few clicks. Order management: building the foundational systems for organizers and travelers to view, modify, and manage reservations end-to-end - changes, transfers, cancellations, and everything in between. Tax management: expanding our tax capabilities across jurisdictions so organizers can sell compliantly wherever their travelers are. Reliability and structural improvements: scaling our booking flows to support 10x growth. What you'll do day-to-day: Lead booking projects end-to-end: discovery with Product and Customer teams, solution design, build, rollout, monitoring, and incident response. Partner with the Product team to gain insight into organizer and traveler challenges, building booking experiences that convert and delight. Own the reliability of our booking and order management systems Contribute to WeTravel's engineering practices and excellence. How we work: We're focused on the impact. We don't subscribe to any one framework or execution ideology, and we adapt based on what's impactful. We're using the latest hardware and constantly on the look out for better tools & ways to work. We have AI-first development experience and work with the latest models and agentic dev tools. Stack: We're developing React/TypeScript, Ruby on Rails and Kotlin Microservices. Our services run on Kubernetes. We also use and love MongoDB, MySQL, Postgres, Snowflake and we're working with the major LLM providers. You should apply if you have: Basic qualifications: 7+ years of product engineering expertise, with 4+ years dedicated to architecting complex e-commerce, booking, or order management systems. Proven track record within a high-scale consumer checkout, marketplace, travel, or e-commerce platform team. Broad practical expertise in building and troubleshooting production-level checkout and order flows: conversion-critical funnels, pricing and tax calculation, availability and inventory, cancellations, modifications, and refund flows. You possess deeply ingrained expertise in order state machines, multi-step form UX, and the operational tooling that keeps commerce systems running. Strong backend mastery in Ruby on Rails, Kotlin, Python, Go, Java, or Node.js with the agility to ramp up on Ruby quickly. Full-stack comfort: you can build the React interface for the booking flows you architect. Deep expertise in architecting robust, resilient distributed systems, including order and reservation state machines, idempotency, exactly-once semantics, event-driven architectures, webhooks, and reliable consumer patterns. Direct production on-call experience, including authoring post-mortems and leading incident response. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including cross-functional collaboration experience, and the ability to thrive in a distributed, multicultural environment. Pragmatic adoption of AI tools to optimize your engineering workflow, including the ability to mentor and train others on AI concepts. Technical Skills Strong background in cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP), containerization, and modern CI/CD practices. Experience in handling critical systems with precision: you will handle pricing and tax logic directly within the application layer. Bonus: Direct experience with tax engines or multi-jurisdiction tax compliance (VAT, GST, sales tax), or with travel-industry reservation systems. Preferred qualifications: Experience launching or significantly redesigning a checkout or booking flow end-to-end. Experience building tax calculation or compliance capabilities across multiple jurisdictions. Experience in marketplace or two-sided platform commerce (orders spanning buyers, sellers, and modifications over time). You might not be the right fit if you: Your commerce expertise is limited to plugging in off-the-shelf checkout or cart solutions. We need someone who operates deeply beneath that abstraction layer. You are hesitant to take full ownership of mission-critical booking flows or participate in the on-call rotation when systems fail. You prioritize greenfield development over the complex challenge of scaling and refining an existing system with significant booking volume. You are looking for a siloed IC position without the need for cross-functional collaboration or product-level discovery. You require a rigid, pre-defined roadmap; we prefer to sharpen our strategy and direction as we scale the team. Why join us? Solve real commerce problems at real volume: over a million travelers booking adventures in 150+ countries, and growing. Make a real impact: you'll help build the operating system for the multi-day group travel industry, empowering thousands of organizers and millions of travelers worldwide. Solve meaningful technical challenges at scale, from designing robust systems to improving real-time user experiences in a complex domain. Be part of building the best engineering team: you'll help shape culture, mentor others, and contribute to high standards of excellence and collaboration. Enjoy flexibility and balance, with competitive compensation, generous PTO, and remote-friendly work culture. title: Senior Solutions Engineer
description: Behind every unforgettable trip is a travel business that needs its tools to just work. Our Solution Engineering team makes that possible: we connect WeTravel to the way organizers already run their business, so growing from ten trips to a thousand never means drowning in manual work. As a Senior Solution Engineer, your role spans both pre- and post-sale: from technical evaluation and solution design with high-value prospects, to driving adoption and long-term implementation with existing customers. Every integration you deliver will teach us what to build next, and you’ll turn those lessons into better public interfaces for all our organizers! For years, the small businesses and local experts who run these trips have been stuck using messy spreadsheets, countless emails, and complicated payment methods. WeTravel is changing that. Our platform takes care of the business behind the trip: proposals, bookings, payments and customer management. That lets organizers focus on what they do best: designing and leading unforgettable experiences. What's the role As organizers grow, WeTravel stops being a standalone tool and becomes part of their stack. A tour operator wants bookings to flow into their own tools, payments to land in their accounting system, and leads to sync with their CRM. We want Solution Engineering to be the voice of our customers' integration needs inside engineering, and a stakeholder for WeTravel's public interfaces. You'll spot the patterns across deals, decide what should become a platform capability instead of a one-off, and work with product engineering teams to make it happen. A few areas where we'll need you: Public API and webhooks: bring input in the roadmap of our APIs based on what customers actually try to build Integration playbooks: turn recurring setups into reusable guides, templates and reference implementations Pre-sales at scale: create demos, sample and solution blueprints that help our sales team answer technical questions confidently, without needing an engineer on every call Our success here will make WeTravel easy to adopt for larger and more complex organizers, and will let our team support many more customers without growing linearly. What you'll do day-to-day Your time will be split roughly evenly between helping us win deals and helping customers succeed after they sign. Pre-sales Join Account Executives on discovery and demo calls, uncover the prospect's technical requirements, and map their workflows to WeTravel Scope integrations and migrations, answer security and technical questionnaires, and give honest answers on what's possible today and what isn't Build tailored demos and quick proofs of concept that show how WeTravel plugs into the prospect's existing tools Implementation and support Guide customers and their developers through integrations with Google Analytics, Zapier, QuickBooks, our public APIs and webhooks, as well as data migrations, complex inventory setups and go-live Troubleshoot complex integration issues with customers, and make sure what you learn flows back into our docs, playbooks and product Write scripts, prototypes and sample apps (Python, JavaScript, Postman collections, Zapier flows) that unblock customers and can be reused by others Shaping the platform Represent customer integration needs in product and engineering planning, backed by data from deals and tickets Build and maintain our integration documentation, playbooks and internal knowledge base Use AI tools to automate the repetitive parts of the job, from ticket triage to generating integration code What success looks like First month: you know our product, APIs and the most common integration setups. You've shadowed sales calls and resolved your first technical tickets end-to-end. First three months: you run technical discovery and demos on your own, own customer implementations through go-live, and have shipped reusable assets . First six months: you own a clear picture of what our customers try to build with WeTravel, and bring data-backed proposals into engineering planning. Your playbooks and tools mean the team takes on more customers with less custom work. How we work You'll be part of the Solutions Engineering team within our Engineering organisation. You'll work closely with Sales, Onboarding, Account Management, Product and Engineering, and have a seat at the table in deal reviews. We're focused on impact. We move quickly, value clarity, and adapt our processes based on what works. We'd rather build something once and automated than solve it ten times by hand. We use the latest hardware and are constantly on the lookout for better tools and ways to work, including AI assistants and agents. Our tools: REST APIs, Postman, Zapier, HubSpot, Snowflake. Our platform runs on React/TypeScript, Ruby on Rails, Python and Go microservices on Kubernetes. You can read API docs, debug a failing request and explain why it failed Familiarity with integration tools like Zapier: you can design, troubleshoot and optimise automated workflows Comfort writing scripts and prototypes in at least one language (JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Ruby or Go) Experience leading technical discovery and demos with prospects, and owning implementations through go-live The ability to explain complex technical topics to non-technical people, and to translate customer needs into clear requirements for engineers Good judgment about when to solve a problem for one customer and when to push for a platform solution Excellent communication skills in English and experience working in multicultural, distributed teams Experience using AI assistants like Claude, Cursor or ChatGPT to speed up your work Preferred qualifications Experience in travel, tourism or booking platforms, including inventory and availability setups Knowledge of payments, accounting, analytics or CRM integrations (e.g. QuickBooks, Xero, Google Analytics, HubSpot, Salesforce) Experience influencing API design or a developer platform roadmap Don’t tick every box? Work at the intersection of tech and business: you'll partner with Sales, Customer Success and Engineering every week, and see the direct impact of your work on deals won and customers launched. title: Professional Services Consultant, Zero Trust
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Available Locations: </strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Austin, TX</strong></li> <li><strong>New York, NY</strong></li> <li><strong>Washington DC</strong></li> <li><strong>San Francisco Bay Area</strong></li> </ul> <hr> <h3><strong>About the role:</strong></h3> <p>Cloudflare provides consultative and hands-on-keyboard implementation and migration services for enterprise customers. title: Senior Customer Engineer, Majors - NE
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Available Location: Northeast</strong></h3> <h3><strong>What you will do as a Customer Engineer</strong></h3> <p>The Customer Engineer (CE) is the core driver of our technical go-to-market strategy: a trusted technical advisor and primary architect of the customer journey. You will bridge the gap between technical strategy and business value—guiding enterprise clients from initial pre-sales technical validation through onboarding, deployment architecture, and full lifecycle expansion. Sitting within the GTM organization and reporting to a Customer Engineering Leader, you will not hand off your customers once an initial agreement is reached. Instead, you will operate as a quota-carrying technologist, leveraging AI-augmented workflows to eliminate administrative toil so you can focus on high-value architectural design and driving measurable business outcomes across the entire customer journey.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Technical Validation: </strong>Partner closely with Account Executives to lead technical deep-dive discovery, capture business requirements, and map complex customer infrastructure - DNS, CDN, Zero Trust, Network Security, Workers - to fit-for-purpose Cloudflare architectures and bespoke solutions. . Define, scope, success criteria, and technical evaluations plans for Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and Technical Validations. Deliver tailored technical presentations, architectural diagrams, and demonstrations that show how Cloudflare solves specific performance, security, and reliability challenges. Proactively address complex technical objections, security compliance questions, and edge-case architectural requirements during the sales cycle. Take accountability for a suitable solution deployment strategy (Customer, Partner or Cloudflare Professional services) being an integral part of all proposals.</li> <li><strong>Customer Adoption & Value Realization: </strong>Provide oversight to technical onboarding and implementation, but not execute the implementation, serving as the primary executive and engineering contact for the customer. Design structured migration and onboarding blueprints tailored to the customer’s environment (e.g. DNS migrations, Zero Trust rollouts, WAF tuning guidance), and act as the lead consultant for customer engineering teams, walking them step-by-step through configuration best practices.  Partner with Account Executives to own discovery, demos, onboarding, technical health, risk, and expansion strategy. Proactively monitor customer health scores and telemetry to ensure rapid time-to-value, resolve integration bottlenecks, and reduce deployment risk.</li> <li><strong>Commercial Accountability & Expansion: </strong>Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. Be commercially accountable for ensuring deep platform adoption, retaining revenue, and identifying strategic cross-sell and up-sell opportunities based on product usage data. Lead technical Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to translate platform capabilities into return on investment for C-level executives.</li> <li><strong>Trusted Advisory: </strong>Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion. Provide thought partnership on architecture, AI control layers, security posture, and deployment confidence. Identify potential deployment risks or integration bottlenecks early, and provide remediation strategies to de-risk customer outcomes. </li> <li><strong>AI Orchestration & Workflow Automation: </strong>Leverage AI agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), and internal platforms to automate routine tasks such as RFP/Security Questionnaire responses, sandbox provisioning, basic telemetry monitoring, and internal/external documentation, reclaiming your time for strategic customer advisory.</li> <li><strong>Education & Enablement:</strong> Partner closely with the Enablement Team to design, build, and govern technical resources. title: Director of Sales, Named (Toronto)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: Toronto, Ontario</strong></p> <p><strong>About the Department</strong></p> <p>The Cloudflare sales team is comprised of Account Executives, Business Development Representatives, Solution Engineers, Customer Success, and Sales Operations - all working together to acquire customers and help them adopt Cloudflare technologies to create great Internet-enabled experiences.</p> <p>The sales team at Cloudflare helps customers solve real security and performance challenges while creating the revenue streams that help the company provide free services to millions in our community.</p> <p><strong>What you'll do</strong></p> <p>We are looking for an experienced <strong>Sales Director</strong> to lead and grow the Enterprise and Public Sector  business in Ontario with responsibility for driving Cloudflare's revenue and brand awareness in the region. Based in the Greater Toronto Area and reporting directly to the Canadian VP, the Sales Director will require both strategic and hands-on leadership skills to lead the go-to-market strategy, including hiring, leading and growing the sales team, building pipeline, and driving sales to grow the business in the region. In this role you will work actively with prospects, customers, partners and field sales professionals to sell and close deals to build the region.</p> <p><strong>Additional responsibilities will include:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design, build and execute strategies for the Region in collaboration with regional and global functional leaders</li> <li>Lead and grow the Central Canada Enterprise and Public Sector (Named) sales team working with global functional leaders and recruiting resources.</li> <li>Serve as the local point person for all Named functions in Canada including customer relationships, pipeline development, account management, sales and partnerships.</li> <li>Drive business cadence for forecast calls, business  reviews, deal reviews, customer account reviews, weekly team meetings and periodic company-wide meetings.</li> <li>Lead programs and campaigns - working across sales, marketing, customer success, solutions engineering, business development and support - to drive awareness, pipeline and sales results.</li> <li>Drive sales growth through successful leadership, organizational planning, customer service and outstanding execution of all regional sales and go-to-market strategies.  </li> <li>Represent Cloudflare as the single point of contact for all Regional operational concerns, ensuring proper and timely escalation and resolution.</li> <li>Ensure that corporate policy and regulatory initiatives are consistently applied and followed by team members.</li> <li>Outstanding leadership that inspires interpersonal effectiveness, develops talent and effects change. Willing and able to be a “doer” and “influencer”.</li> <li>Represent Cloudflare at external conferences and events.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree required.</li> <li>10+ years of direct B2B sales experience, selling to large Enterprise accounts </li> <li>5+ years of direct sales management experience leading an Enterprise field sales team.</li> <li>Experience managing and coaching long, complex, high value Enterprise sales cycles </li> <li>Experience selling into top tier accounts in key verticals including Financial Services, Retail, Industrial. Energy and Media.</li> <li>Understanding of IaaS, Networking and Information Security services.</li> <li>Aptitude for learning technical concepts/terms (Technical background in engineering, computer science or MIS a plus).</li> <li>Strong leadership, presentation, interpersonal communication (verbal and written) and organizational skills.</li> <li>Self-motivated; entrepreneurial spirit.</li> <li>Comfortable working in a fast paced dynamic environment.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

Sterke analytische en organisatorische vaardigheden. Het vermogen om technische mogelijkheden te vertalen naar concrete operationele verbeteringen. We zoeken juist iemand die begrijpt hoe je AI en automatisering succesvol inzet binnen een operationele IT-organisatie en medewerkers hierin weet mee te nemen. Wat kun je verwachten? Een informele en professionele werkomgeving met korte lijnen. Een betrokken team van collega's dat samenwerkt aan verbetering en innovatie. Waarom is dit een interessante functie? Wat deze rol bijzonder maakt, is de combinatie van peoplemanagement, operationele verantwoordelijkheid en AI-innovatie. Je krijgt niet alleen de opdracht om een bestaande supportorganisatie goed te laten functioneren, maar ook om deze klaar te maken voor de toekomst.
