title: Data Center Operations Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: Boston, MA | Dallas, TX | Salt Lake City, UT  (This role requires you to be onsite 5 days a week in one of our locations)</strong></p> <h1>About the Department</h1> <p>Infrastructure Operations builds and manages the data center infrastructure behind Cloudflare's global network. The organization brings together engineering, operations, hardware and logistics teams that plan, deploy, operate and maintain our footprint in hundreds of cities worldwide. In this role, you'll help extend that footprint with a new generation of data center sites across the United States.</p> <h1>About the Role</h1> <p>We're looking for Data Center Engineers to be the hands, eyes and judgment on the ground at our new sites. You'll work on-site every day at your home data center, helping bring it online and keeping its hardware healthy once it's in production.</p> <p>You'll rack, cable and replace equipment, troubleshoot servers and network gear well past a simple parts swap, and keep every asset accurately documented from the moment it arrives. You'll work alongside colocation staff, integrators and partner teams, and support other sites remotely when the team needs you. Experienced engineers will have room to act as the technical lead for their site, mentor others, and help set the standards the team uses everywhere.</p> <p>We're building these sites to run with less manual effort than traditional data centers. When something breaks, we expect you to fix it for good, not just for today, and to use AI and automation to make the fix stick, whether that means a better runbook, a script, or a change to how the team works.</p> <p>This role is hands-on at the physical layer: hardware, cabling, and Layer 1/Layer 2 connectivity. You'll use the command line to troubleshoot servers and Layer 2 network issues, but network configuration and server provisioning are owned by partner engineering teams.</p> <h1>What You'll Do</h1> <h2>Site Builds</h2> <ul> <li>Support integrated site builds: receive and inspect hardware, rack and stack equipment, and run and dress structured cabling to standard.</li> <li>Verify integrator and contractor work against build specifications, drive defects to resolution, and make sure sites are production-ready before handoff.</li> </ul> <h2>Break/Fix and Troubleshooting</h2> <ul> <li>Triage and troubleshoot server hardware using BMC/IPMI, hardware logs, diagnostics and firmware tools. Find the root cause instead of swapping parts until something works.</li> <li>Replace components and whole systems, including servers, switches and optics, safely and with minimal disruption.</li> <li>Troubleshoot Layer 1 and Layer 2 issues: console into network devices, read interface and link state from the command line, inspect and clean optics, check light levels, and test fiber with a light meter or OTDR.</li> </ul> <h2>On-Call and Incidents</h2> <ul> <li>Take part in an on-call rotation and respond on site to incidents affecting hardware at your data center.</li> <li>Document what happened and what you did, and contribute to root-cause analysis and follow-up actions.</li> </ul> <h2>AI, Automation and Continuous Improvement</h2> <ul> <li>Solve problems for good. When an issue repeats, find the underlying cause and change the process, runbook or tooling so it doesn't come back.</li> <li>Use AI tools as part of your daily work: to speed up troubleshooting, interpret hardware and network logs, draft and improve documentation and runbooks, and summarize incidents.</li> <li>Find repetitive manual work and remove it with scripting, automation or AI-assisted workflows, or turn it into clear requirements for tooling teams.</li> <li>Share what works so the rest of the team can adopt it across every site.</li> </ul> <h2>Documentation and DCIM</h2> <ul> <li>Keep DCIM records accurate in real time, including rack elevations, cabling, power and asset location, from receipt through decommissioning.</li> <li>Follow and improve runbooks and build standards so work is repeatable across sites.</li> </ul> <h2>Logistics and Hardware Lifecycle</h2> <ul> <li>Own receiving, shipping and spares inventory at your site, and process RMAs end to end.</li> <li>Perform on-site decommissioning: unracking, serial number verification and chain of custody through handoff for secure destruction.</li> </ul> <h2>Vendors, Partners and Compliance</h2> <ul> <li>Escort and supervise colocation remote-hands staff, contractors and integrators working at your site, and hold them to our quality and safety standards.</li> <li>Work directly with partner teams to coordinate access, maintenance and escalations for your site.</li> <li>Follow physical security, access control and compliance procedures without exception, and help produce accurate evidence for audits.</li> </ul> <h2>Supporting Other Sites</h2> <ul> <li>Support other sites remotely, for example by guiding remote hands or reviewing documentation, and travel occasionally to help with builds or surges.</li> </ul> <h1>Who You Are</h1> <p><strong>Careful and precise.</strong> Clean cabling, correct labels and accurate records matter to you. If it isn't documented, it isn't done.</p> <p><strong>Dependable on your own.</strong> You're often the only Cloudflare person on site. You work independently, communicate clearly with a remote team, and know when to escalate.</p> <p><strong>Security-minded.</strong> You understand that access rules and chain of custody exist for a reason, and you follow them every time.</p> <p><strong>A troubleshooter, not a parts swapper.</strong> You want to know why something failed, and you use logs, diagnostics and the command line to find out.</p> <p><strong>Someone who makes the team better.</strong> You share what you learn, help newer teammates get up to speed, and take ownership of your site's outcomes.</p> <p><strong>AI-fluent and automation-first.</strong> Your first instinct is to solve a problem for good, not work around it again. You reach for AI tools and automation to troubleshoot faster, document better and improve how the team works, and you check the output before you trust it.</p> <h1>Required Experience</h1> <ul> <li>Hands-on experience in data center, network or server hardware operations, including working independently on site.</li> <li>Experience racking, stacking and cabling servers and network equipment, and replacing whole systems and components.</li> <li>Solid working knowledge of structured cabling standards, fiber and copper, and optics.</li> <li>Hardware troubleshooting beyond parts swaps, including BMC/IPMI, hardware logs, diagnostics and firmware.</li> <li>Comfort with the Linux command line and with network device CLIs to troubleshoot Layer 1 and Layer 2 issues.</li> <li>Experience with fiber inspection, cleaning and testing, including light meters or OTDR.</li> <li>Regular, hands-on use of AI tools in your technical work, such as troubleshooting, log analysis or documentation, and examples of improving a process instead of repeating a workaround.</li> <li>Experience with asset tracking, DCIM or inventory systems, and with receiving, shipping and RMA processes.</li> <li>Experience working in colocation facilities and with third-party vendors or contractors.</li> <li>Willingness to take part in an on-call rotation and respond on site.</li> <li>Clear written and verbal communication, including documenting work and updating tickets.</li> <li>A valid driver's license, reliable transportation, and proximity to your assigned data center.</li> <li>Ability to travel occasionally to other sites.</li> </ul> <h1>Preferred Qualifications</h1> <ul> <li>Experience as a technical lead or primary on-site contact for a data center, including leading on-site incident response.</li> <li>Experience mentoring or training other technicians or engineers.</li> <li>Experience writing runbooks, build standards or checklists used across multiple sites.</li> <li>Experience supporting or leading new data center builds or integrated rack deployments.</li> <li>Scripting experience (for example Bash or Python), or experience building automation or AI-assisted workflows that reduced manual work.</li> <li>Certifications such as CompTIA A+, Network+ or Linux+, CCNA, BICSI, or data center certifications (for example CDCP or CDCTP).</li> <li>Experience with DCIM and source-of-truth tooling such as NetBox or Nlyte, and Jira-based workflows.</li> <li>Experience at a hyperscaler, cloud provider, major CDN or similarly large infrastructure operator.</li> <li>Experience with ITAD and secure destruction processes.</li> </ul> <p>We also consider candidates earlier in their careers who bring strong fundamentals and a drive to learn.</p> <h1>Physical Requirements</h1> <ul> <li>Lift and move equipment up to 50 lbs, and handle heavier equipment with a team or lift assist.</li> <li>Stand, walk, bend, kneel and work in tight or elevated spaces for extended periods.</li> <li>Work in loud, cold, and tightly controlled data center environments.</li> <li>Use ladders, lifts and carts safely.</li> </ul> <p><em>These are essential functions of the role. Reasonable accommodations are available for qualified individuals with disabilities.</em></p

title: Senior China Research Analyst
description: Datenna is a fast-growing tech scale-up combining cutting-edge OSINT and AI technologies to provide governments with critical insights into China's techno-economic landscape. Our platform transforms open-source intelligence into actionable insights through advanced data processing and analysis. The Role: Do you enjoy turning complex data into strategic insights that drive critical decisions? As a Senior China Research Analyst, you will lead analytical research projects for our government clients. You'll turn their most pressing questions about China's technology, industrial, and defence-industrial landscape into data-driven reports and the datasets behind them. You'll work with Datenna's data on patents, procurement, research funding, and companies, and go beyond it when a question demands, to find the patterns and connections that inform high-stakes policy and security decisions. You'll independently manage several client research projects at a time, from scoping through final delivery, using both qualitative and quantitative analysis across China's corporate, academic, defence, and technology sectors. Client questions often start ambiguous and open-ended, and topics range widely, from advanced materials to semiconductors and aerospace. You'll work through uncertainty, get up to speed quickly on unfamiliar technologies, design creative analytical approaches when the path isn't obvious, and refine your research direction as new information emerges. The role needs strong China expertise, Chinese-language research skills, the ability to work autonomously, and clear communication with senior government stakeholders. Your mission at Datenna: Lead end-to-end research delivery: Take full ownership of research projects, from initial scoping and analysis through to final deliverables. Design the research: Turn open-ended client questions into sound research design, and build new analytical frameworks when standard methods don't fit. Build and analyse the evidence base: Work directly with Chinese-language sources and Datenna's data on entities, patents, procurement, and research funding to map the actors, links, and trends that answer the client's question. Set the quality bar: Review colleagues' deliverables independently, verify findings against the underlying data, and guide Analysts on their research approach. Work with AI, with judgement: Use AI-assisted research tools to work faster and at greater scale. You own the interpretation and verify every output. Contribute to the China Research Lab: The Lab is our exploratory research track. It develops the methods, tools, and data sources that shape where China research at Datenna is heading, and tests them through internal R&D. You will dedicate part of your time to Lab initiatives, such as prototyping a new analytical approach, scouting and testing new sources, or contributing to webinars and publications. Strengthen the data and product: Turn what you learn on client projects into data and product improvements, working with the Product and Data teams. What makes you a great candidate: Core requirements Experience: 5–8 years of professional experience in China-focused research, analysis, or related fields. Deep China expertise: Strong knowledge of Chinese industry, economy, policy, the defence-industrial base, and the technology and research landscape. Analytical excellence: Exceptional pattern recognition and analytical skills to connect the dots between corporate, state, and military actors in China's techno-economic landscape. Comfort with ambiguity: Proven ability to tackle research questions where the analytical path isn't predetermined, designing creative approaches and adapting as you learn. Chinese language proficiency: Professional reading proficiency in Chinese (minimum HSK5, HSK6 preferred) to work directly with Chinese-language sources such as technical literature, patents, procurement notices, and policy documents, and to build and verify Chinese technical terminology for data retrieval. Self-directed project management: Proven ability to independently break down complex research questions, run several multi-week projects in parallel against fixed client deadlines, and deliver high-quality output with minimal oversight. Quality ownership: An evidence-first approach. You trace every claim back to its source records, catch inconsistencies in data and drafts, and review others' work independently and constructively. Communication skills: Strong written and verbal communication, including precise, concise English writing for an international readership. You are comfortable presenting complex analysis to senior government stakeholders and refining requirements through client dialogue. Methodological versatility: Proficiency in both qualitative and quantitative research methods. Technical skills Working proficiency in SQL and/or Python to query, clean, and structure large datasets, plus advanced Excel. Hands-on experience using LLM-based tools in research, with a clear sense of where their output needs human verification. Familiarity with data-quality work such as deduplication and entity resolution. Nice to have Experience in the technology, science, and research sector within governmental organisations, think tanks, or international corporate settings. Background conducting research for external clients or stakeholders. Experience analysing patents, public procurement, research funding, or corporate registry data. Experience collecting web data from Chinese-language sources, or with BI tools such as Metabase. A technical or scientific background (for example materials science, engineering, or physics) relevant to dual-use technology topics. *Please know that applicants may be subject to a screening process.* Work on globally impactful projects in geopolitical intelligence Lead innovation in OSINT and AI technologies Competitive compensation and benefits Dynamic, international team environment Significant growth opportunities in a scale-up When you apply to this position, we will process your personal data according to our Recruitment Privacy Notice . title: Dev Experiences and Community Lead (SF)
description: ABOUT SUPABASE Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. ABOUT THE ROLE Supabase is looking for a Dev Experiences and Community Lead (SF) to help grow and scale our developer community initiatives and industry event programs. You’ll work closely with the Head of Global Events and Field Marketing to build programs that connect Supabase with developers and the broader ecosystem. This includes initiatives such as meetups, workshops, hackathons, and community activations that bring Supabase into the spaces where developers learn, build, and collaborate. As an early member of the events team, you’ll help shape how Supabase shows up in person around the world while building the playbooks and frameworks that allow these programs to scale globally. This role sits within Field Marketing and works cross-functionally across Marketing, DevRel, Partnerships, Sales and Design to support programs that deepen developer engagement, strengthen ecosystem relationships. You will also support programming around Supabase Select, our flagship user conference, including partner and community programming connected to the event. We’re a lean, remote-first team, so this role requires someone who is comfortable operating independently, experimenting with new ideas, and helping build the systems that will power Supabase’s events program as it grows. WHAT YOU’LL DO Own and Scale Community Programs - Scale Supabase developer meetups, workshops, and hackathons globally - Partner with DevRel to align community events with product launches and developer education initiatives - Coordinate community meetups around major industry events and Launch Week - Support community programming connected to Supabase Select - Support the SupaSquad advocate network through community activations Support Industry Event Activations - Support Supabase’s presence at conferences such as AWS re:Invent, KubeCon, Stripe Sessions, Dash, and other events - Coordinate developer-focused side events, meetups, and partner activations around major conferences - Collaborate with Partnerships on co-hosted events Turn Experiments Into Scalable Programs - Build playbooks and frameworks for community and ecosystem programs - Identify opportunities to scale successful initiatives across regions - Standardizing event formats and processes as program grow Collaborate Across the Events Team - Partner with the events team on logistics and execution for community programs - Support promotion and event readiness with Marketing - Help ensure strong attendee experiences and post-event follow-up WHO YOU ARE - 5–7+ years in field marketing, developer marketing, community programs or partner marketing - Experience working with developer communities or technical audiences - Strong project management and organizational skills - Comfortable collaborating cross-functionally - Curious about developer ecosystems and the communities around modern infrastructure - Able to manage multiple initiatives in a fast-moving environment Comfortable working remotely and independently - Willing to travel for events as needed NICE TO HAVE - Experience supporting developer meetups, hackathons, or workshops - Experience with community-led growth or developer advocacy programs - Experience running ecosystem or partner-led event programs WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

Leverage company-wide learnings to improve department and team execution. Serve as a leader within Cloudflare, making significant contributions while elevating the work of others by bringing diverse perspectives and strategic long-term thinking.</li> </ul> <h2>Desirable We build bridges to groundbreaking advancements in rare disease, and develop life-changing medicines for patients with unmet needs as fast as humanly possible. </span> <br><span data-contrast="auto"> </span> <br><span data-contrast="auto">Together we define white space, push boundaries, and empower people to solve problems. At BridgeBio, we value curiosity and experimentation—including the ethical & thoughtful use of AI to improve clarity, speed, and quality of work.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":true,"134233118":true,"201341983":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></p></div><p><strong><u>What You’ll Do</u></strong></p> <p>The Sr Director, Head of Quality & Responsible Person, International, leads quality for infigratinib, and will be the designated Responsible Person on the entity's wholesale distribution authorisation. title: Business Analyst - Enterprise & AI Solutions
description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Who We Are</strong></h4> <p>WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.</p></div><h3>Working in technology & innovation with WPP Enterprise Solutions</h3> <p>At WPP Enterprise Solutions Netherlands, we create connected brands to drive growth. Our expertise spans the full customer journey, with deep capabilities in commerce, consultancy, CRM, CX, data, production, technology, content, media and more. We deliver end-to-end solutions for ambitious B2B and B2C brands, supported by the wider WPP network.</p> <p>Our work combines strategy, product thinking, experience design, data, engineering and AI to solve real business problems, from enterprise commerce modernisation and digital shelf excellence to AI-enabled content operations, marketing automation, GEO, workflow orchestration and custom AI agents.</p> <h3>About the team</h3> <p>You’ll join the Product Management & AI Solutions team: the group that bridges business strategy, customer experience and technology to deliver scalable commerce and enterprise solutions. We work closely with UX/CX, Data & AI, SEO/GEO, Content, CRM, Paid and Retail Media, Engineering and Delivery teams.</p> <p>Our ambition is to move beyond isolated skills and build repeatable, outcome-led propositions around commerce growth topics such as Search & Discovery, Personalisation, CRO & Experience Optimisation, Product Data/PIM & Digital Shelf, Content Supply Chain & AI Content Operations, CRM & Lifecycle Growth, Performance & Retail Media, SEO/GEO and Composable Commerce Modernisation. Alongside this, we are growing our applied AI work: shaping and delivering custom AI agents and AI-enabled workflows for clients, from discovery and pilot through to production and continuous improvement.</p> <h3>Why this role exists</h3> <p>Clients are increasingly asking for integrated solutions rather than isolated delivery capacity. They need people who can understand the business problem, shape the product direction, define the right solution, translate it into clear specifications and guide teams through delivery. At the same time, AI is changing how commerce, content, marketing and operations work, creating a need for analysts who can combine structured requirements thinking with product ownership, enterprise technology understanding and the design of AI-enabled workflows and agents.</p> <p>This role is designed for someone who can operate as a strong Business Analyst, step into Product Owner responsibilities when needed, advocate for product thinking inside the organisation and help turn our AI and commerce capabilities into scalable client value. You will work across both our commerce and enterprise product work and our applied AI work. The mix depends on client demand, and we expect the AI share to grow over time.</p> <h3>The role</h3> <p>As Business Analyst, Enterprise & AI Solutions, you bridge business needs, product direction and technical delivery across enterprise digital commerce and martech ecosystems. You analyse business processes, clarify user and stakeholder needs, define requirements and support solutioning across the commerce stack: CMS, Search, PIM/PXM, DAM, ERP, OMS, CDP, CRM, analytics, marketing automation, paid/media platforms and integration layers.</p> <p>You will also work on AI initiatives such as custom AI agents (for example for pricing, search or customer service), content and marketing automation, product/content enrichment, GEO and organic discoverability, AI orchestration and workflow automation. You do not need to be a machine learning engineer or a domain expert, but you must be technically curious and comfortable working with APIs, data flows, automation tools, LLM-based workflows, AI quality evaluation, governance requirements and human-in-the-loop processes.</p> <p>Depending on your experience and the project context, you may act as a hands-on BA, a product-minded discovery partner, a proxy Product Owner or a work stream lead. In all cases, your job is to make ambiguity manageable, decisions explicit and delivery focused on measurable value.</p> <h3>What you will do</h3> <ul> <li>Collaborate with Solution Architects and Product Owners and translate business goals into clear requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, tech architecture, data flows and integration specifications that delivery teams can act on.</li> <li>Work across commerce, martech and enterprise ecosystems, including CMS, Search, PIM/PXM, DAM, ERP, OMS, CDP, CRM, analytics, marketing automation and media platforms.</li> <li>Identify, shape and specify practical AI, automation and workflow orchestration opportunities across content, marketing, commerce and operational processes, from process mapping and readiness checks to a scoped pilot with a clear business case.</li> <li>Specify AI agents and LLM-based workflows: define the task, data sources, tools and integrations, guardrails, human-in-the-loop steps and escalation paths, plus the evaluation criteria that decide when a solution is ready to go live. After launch, help measure quality, adoption and business impact.</li> <li>Act as a Business Analyst or proxy Product Owner when needed by supporting prioritisation, backlog refinement, sprint planning, UAT, release preparation and stakeholder alignment.</li> <li>Connect business, UX, data, SEO/GEO, content, engineering, legal and delivery teams to make sure solutions are valuable, feasible, scalable and well governed.</li> <li>Help make our AI work repeatable and sellable: contribute to proposals, scoping and estimates, and build reusable assets such as discovery templates, requirement patterns, evaluation sets and playbooks.</li> <li>At the senior end of the role, independently lead workstreams, own parts of the client relationship and coach junior analysts or product team members.</li> </ul> <h3>Who you are</h3> <ul> <li>A structured problem-solver who starts with the business problem, not only the requested feature.</li> <li>A product-minded Business Analyst who can move between discovery, specification, prioritisation and delivery support.</li> <li>Comfortable acting as a proxy Product Owner when a project needs stronger product ownership.</li> <li>Technically fluent enough to discuss APIs, data flows, integrations, platform dependencies and implementation trade-offs with engineering teams.</li> <li>Curious and pragmatic about AI: you use AI tools in your own work and understand the opportunity, but also the need for governance, quality, reliability and human oversight.</li> <li>Comfortable with fast-moving technology: you focus on the problem and the outcome rather than a specific tool, and you pick up new platforms quickly.</li> <li>Strong in workshops, stakeholder alignment and decision-making, with the confidence to challenge constructively.</li> <li>Able to represent the Product Management & AI Solutions team inside WPP and help other teams understand the value of product thinking and applied AI.</li> <li>Commercially aware: you can connect requirements and solutions to client value, efficiency, scalability, conversion, discoverability or operational impact.</li> <li>Collaborative and low-ego, with the ability to work across Commerce, UX/CX, Data, SEO/GEO, Content, CRM, Media, Engineering and Delivery.</li> </ul> <h3>What you’ll need</h3> <h4>The basics</h4> <ul> <li>3-5 years of experience as a Business Analyst, Product Owner, Solution Analyst or similar role, ideally in commerce, martech, enterprise platforms, consulting or a digital agency environment.</li> <li>Experience with digital commerce ecosystems, preferably B2B and/or B2C enterprise environments.</li> <li>Working knowledge of platforms and domains such as CMS, Search, PIM/PXM, DAM, ERP, OMS, CDP, CRM, analytics, marketing automation and paid/media technology.</li> <li>Strong experience writing user stories, acceptance criteria, functional specifications, process flows and integration requirements.</li> <li>Good technical understanding of REST APIs, web platforms, data flows, system integrations and common delivery dependencies.</li> <li>Hands-on familiarity with generative AI tools and a working understanding of how LLM-based solutions behave, including their limitations and how to test the quality of their output.</li> <li>Experience working in Agile delivery environments with tools such as Jira, Confluence or similar.</li> <li>Excellent communication, facilitation, documentation and stakeholder management skills.</li> <li>Fluent professional English.</li> <li>Currently residing in the Netherlands with a valid work permit.</li> </ul> <h3>Bonus points</h3> <ul> <li>Hands-on experience with automation tools such as n8n, Zapier or similar.</li> <li>Experience shaping AI, LLM, agentic or workflow orchestration use cases in a business or delivery context, ideally including at least one that went live.</li> <li>Familiarity with AI and agent platforms such as Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI or the OpenAI and Anthropic APIs, and with concepts such as retrieval (RAG), tool use and evaluation.</li> <li>Familiarity with AI governance and regulation, such as the EU AI Act, and with responsible AI practices.</li> <li>Experience with search and personalisation platforms, composable commerce, PIM/PXM, CDP, CRM or marketing automation platforms.</li> <li>Experience with GA4, BigQuery, SQL, Python, Postman, Figma, Miro or similar tools.</li> <li>Proficiency in Dutch.</li> </ul> <h3>In return, this is what we offer</h3> <p>You’ll get access to an international network of clients, colleagues, technology partners and resources. We have a listening ear for ambitious ideas, and together we keep stretching our boundaries. We want you to follow the path you’re building, and we invest in your personal development in a dynamic, collaborative workplace.</p> <h2>Our compensation</h2> <ul> <li>A monthly salary between <strong>€4,800 and €5200</strong> gross, depending on your experience, seniority and fit with the role.</li> <li>A gross annual 8% holiday allowance.</li> <li>Access to our commuting package to suit your individual needs.</li> <li>Competitive pension benefits.</li> <li>A choice of a Mac or Windows laptop.</li> </ul> <h2>Our culture</h2> &

title: Business Development Representative
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Location: </strong>Dubai, UAE</p> <p><strong>About the Team:</strong></p> <p>In this role, you will contribute to Cloudflare's revenue generation engine by delivering pipeline at scale to the Sales counterparts. You will do this through a maniacal focus on people, process, and tools. The Business Development organization is anchored in a culture focused on the development & training of its employees, incubating talent across the company, teamwork, and celebrating success. With flawless execution, we believe the Business Development organization will be a competitive differentiator for Cloudflare.</p> <p>This is a great opportunity to be a member of our high performing Sales team at a hyper-growth technology company. The Business Development Representative (BDR) will:</p> <ul> <li>Be the first point of contact for customers that need help finding solutions</li> <li>Develop your customer centric sales skills to deliver a stellar customer experience</li> <li>Learn Cloudflare’s products and services in detail</li> </ul> <p>Similar to other roles that Cloudflare, this role has a tenure requirement of 18-24 months before you may be eligible to apply for another role within the company.</p> <p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p><strong>Languages required: English</strong></p> <p>This is a great opportunity to be an early member of a high performing sales team at a fast growing technology company. We are looking for ownership-oriented team members with excellent communication skills and technical curiosity. As the Business Development Representative (BDR), you will: </p> <ul> <li>Create excellent customer experiences</li> <li>Learn customer-centric sales skills</li> <li>Become an expert in Cloudflare’s product</li> <li>Team members have opportunities to move into roles across the organization, especially in mid-market sales, customer success, solutions engineering, and sales operations</li> </ul> <p>Day in the Life of BDR at Cloudflare</p> <ul> <li>Own and meet target quota related to number of qualified opportunities, response SLA, value of sales pipeline, and revenue</li> <li>Develop new business opportunities from inbound and marketing-generated leads</li> <li>Discover pain points and use case, map them to broad set of Cloudflare solutions and qualify for Enterprise sales opportunities</li> <li>Work cross-functionally with stakeholders (account executives, marketing, sales operations, fellow BDRs)</li> <li>Report, track, and manage sales activities and results using SFDC</li> <li>Play an active role in the creation and iteration of team processes</li> </ul> <p>Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience</p> <ul> <li>2+ years of experience working as a BDR in a similar capacity in technology industry in the Africa & South Africa region (experience in SaaS will be a plus)</li> <li>Self-motivated; entrepreneurial spirit</li> <li>Ability to work as part of a team or independently</li> <li>Analytical, organization and time management skills</li> <li>Comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment</li> <li>Strong interpersonal communication skills</li> <li>Customer-oriented mindset with empathy and curiosity</li> <li>Aptitude to learn technical concepts/terms</li> <li>Ability to manage multiple tasks/projects simultaneously</li> <li>Experience in Outreach and Salesforce is a plus</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: ML Infrastructure & Acceleration Engineer - LLMs
description: Who We Are You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today. We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover. Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI. Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate. Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale. Who we're looking for We're seeking an experienced ML Infrastructure & Acceleration Engineer to own the GPU infrastructure that powers our LLM training and serving, and to make every workload on it faster and cheaper. You'll run our H200 cluster end to end, deploy models to production, and profile and optimize our training and inference pipelines down to the kernel level when it matters. You understand GPUs from the cluster scheduler to the memory hierarchy, you measure before you optimize, and you're motivated by turning raw compute into faster iteration for our ML team. You thrive in environments where infrastructure reliability and efficiency directly shape how quickly research reaches millions of users. What you'll do GPU Cluster & Infrastructure: Own our H200 GPU cluster end to end: Kubernetes and Slurm for training and inference workloads, with multi-tenant scheduling, quotas, and resource isolation Keep large distributed training runs healthy: node health checks, NCCL and interconnect debugging, automated job recovery, and checkpoint management Track and optimize GPU utilization and cost across training and inference, with dashboards and budget alerting Manage infrastructure-as-code and provisioning for GPU environments Define and monitor SLIs/SLOs for cluster availability and production model serving Deployment & Serving: Deploy LLMs to production using vLLM or SGLang, with CI/CD, model versioning, and safe rollouts and rollbacks Monitor serving latency, throughput, errors, and cost, and act on regressions ML Acceleration: Profile training and inference end to end (PyTorch Profiler, Nsight Systems, Nsight Compute) to find and remove bottlenecks Improve training throughput and MFU: parallelism strategies (FSDP, tensor and pipeline parallelism), communication/compute overlap, mixed precision and FP8, activation checkpointing, torch.compile Optimize inference: quantization (FP8, INT8, INT4), speculative decoding, prefix caching, continuous batching, KV cache tuning, and parallelism layouts Write or integrate fused and custom kernels (Triton, CUDA) where off-the-shelf implementations fall short Build benchmarking tooling so every optimization ships with measured gains Enablement & Best Practices: Partner with ML engineers and researchers to make training and serving efficient by default Establish best practices for using the cluster and guide teams in their adoption Minimum qualifications 5+ years in ML infrastructure, MLOps, HPC, or platform engineering with focus on GPU workloads Hands-on experience operating multi-node GPU clusters with Kubernetes and/or Slurm, including debugging hardware, networking (NCCL, InfiniBand/RoCE), and job failures Production experience deploying and optimizing LLM inference with vLLM, SGLang, or TensorRT-LLM Proven track record of profiling and accelerating GPU workloads, with measured results in throughput, latency, MFU, or cost Solid understanding of monitoring and observability for GPU systems (Prometheus, Grafana, DCGM, or similar) Naturally curious with a track record of proactively identifying and implementing improvements Preferred qualifications Experience writing custom kernels in Triton or CUDA, and familiarity with fused kernels such as FlashAttention Performance tuning of distributed training frameworks: FSDP, Megatron-LM, or DeepSpeed Experience with low-precision training and inference (**FP8**, INT4) and model compression for production deployment Deep knowledge of GPU architectures: memory hierarchy, tensor cores, roofline analysis Experience with multi-tenant GPU scheduling and fair-share resource allocation Contributions to open-source projects such as vLLM, SGLang, PyTorch, or Triton What we offer Critical infrastructure ownership for high-impact AI projects that are strategically vital to the company, with direct visibility to senior leadership including the CEO State-of-the-art GPU infrastructure: H200 fleet, vLLM serving stack, and the freedom to optimize it end to end Expert ML team who have released top Hugging Face models, published at NeurIPS, and built production systems that will run on your infrastructure Significant autonomy in choosing tools and shaping our infrastructure and performance strategy Modern tooling: Latest ML frameworks, coding assistants, best-in-class development environment Hybrid work model with our Amsterdam office - home to the AI House, bringing together 200+ AI professionals through events and collaborations Competitive compensation, top-spec MacBook Pro, and an environment genuinely built for professional growth and learning If you're excited to own the GPU infrastructure behind cutting-edge LLMs and make every training run and every request faster, let's talk. Why Prosus? At Prosus, your colleagues include 60,000 AI agents… and your job is to figure out what that actually means. We're one of the largest operators of agentic AI on the planet, inside a $100B+ portfolio across 100+ companies and two billion people. The humans here own what AI can't do alone: judgment, creativity, and the call on what gets built next. Own the impact. Work the ecosystem. Earn your growth. Build with backing. description: Warum Ovivamed? Wir bei Ovivamed haben uns eine klare Mission gesetzt: Wir machen eine nachhaltige, personalisierte und klinisch wirksame Versorgung für alle zugänglich. Hierzu bauen wir Europas führende KI-gestützte Plattform für die Behandlung chronischer Krankheiten auf. Unsere digitalen Programme unterstützen Menschen dabei, gewichtsbedingte Erkrankungen langfristig erfolgreich zu managen, indem wir uns auf das konzentrieren, was am meisten zählt: die Gesundheit zu verbessern, das Selbstvertrauen zu stärken und die Lebensqualität nachhaltig zu steigern. Bisher haben wir bereits über eine Million Menschen in der Schweiz, in Deutschland und in Grossbritannien erfolgreich begleitet. Werde Teil unseres engagierten Teams und gestalte die Zukunft der digitalen Gesundheitsversorgung aktiv mit! In dieser vielseitigen und verantwortungsvollen Rolle führst du ein engagiertes Team von Medizinischen Praxisassistent*innen und Medizinstudierenden. Einsatzplanung : Du koordinierst die Einsatzpläne des Teams, delegierst Aufgaben effektiv und stellst jederzeit eine optimale Abdeckung der Praxisaktivitäten sicher. B. als Leitende MPA oder Stellvertretung) sowie ausgeprägte Führungsqualitäten mit der Fähigkeit, ein diverses Team zu coachen, zu motivieren und zu befähigen. Organisationstalent : Exzellente Organisations- und Problemlösungskompetenzen, um in einem dynamischen Praxisumfeld stets den Überblick zu behalten. Digitale Affinität : Eine ausgeprägte Stärke und Begeisterung für die Nutzung moderner digitaler Gesundheitstools und Softwarelösungen. Kommunikation : Ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten für eine reibungslose Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Schnittstellen wie der ärztlichen Leitung und dem Praxismanagement. title: Senior Account Manager
description: Op duizenden werkvloeren in Nederland wordt dagelijks gewerkt met gevaarlijke stoffen. Dat kan veilig, als je weet wat je in huis hebt, wat het doet en welke regels erbij horen. Daar helpt Sdu Toxic organisaties bij. Toxic is de meest complete SaaS-oplossing voor wet- en regelgeving rond gevaarlijke stoffen in Nederland. Organisaties registreren er hun stoffen mee, beoordelen blootstelling, leggen maatregelen vast en informeren hun medewerkers. Zo helpen we QHSE-professionals om mensen veilig te laten werken en aan de arbowetgeving te voldoen. Achter Toxic staat een team met diepgaande kennis van chemische producten en de regels die erbij horen. En een succesvol marketing- en salesteam dat zorgt dat steeds meer organisaties ons vinden. Toxic is onderdeel van Lefebvre Sdu, dat al 200 jaar bouwt aan juridische en fiscale kennis, en van Lefebvre Group, de Europese leider op dat gebied. De vraag groeit. Onze Commercieel Medewerkers Binnendienst en marketing plannen meer afspraken in dan we nu kunnen afronden. Daarom zoeken we een Senior Accountmanager die van die gesprekken klanten maakt. HOE JIJ ONS VERDER BRENGT Jij bent het gezicht van Toxic. Voor de veiligheidskundigen, managers en directies die met ons werken, word jij degene die ze kennen en vertrouwen. Je leert hun organisatie kennen, luistert naar wat er speelt en denkt mee over wat ze nodig hebben. Zo bouw je relaties die jaren meegaan, en groeit Toxic met je klanten mee. Je leert je klanten kennen: hun mensen, hun processen en wat er bij hen speelt. Zo word je hun vaste gesprekspartner en denk je mee over de volgende stap. Elke nieuwe relatie begint met een goed gesprek. De binnendienst en marketing plannen de afspraken, jij bereidt je voor en ontdekt wat een organisatie nodig heeft. Daarnaast zoek je zelf nieuwe kansen. In je demo's laat je zien hoe Toxic werkt en wat het oplevert. Gaat de vraag verder dan het standaardplatform? Dan werk je met collega's een oplossing op maat uit, met API-koppelingen en AI-toepassingen. Je bouwt relaties met veiligheidskundigen, inkopers en directie, brengt hun belangen samen in 1 voorstel en sluit deals met een hogere dealwaarde. Met strategische accountplannen houd je overzicht op je belangrijkste klanten. Je ziet kansen voor up- en cross-sell en herkent retentierisico's vroeg. Samen met Customer Success zorg je dat nieuwe klanten goed starten. Je houdt je pipeline en forecast actueel in Salesforce en deelt wat je bij klanten hoort met marketing en product. Als senior ben je mentor en sparringpartner voor collega-accountmanagers. DIT ZOEKEN WIJ Je bent iemand bij wie klanten zich gehoord voelen. Je luistert goed, stelt de juiste vragen en vertaalt een complex vraagstuk naar een helder voorstel. De markt van gevaarlijke stoffen hoef je nog niet te kennen. Wat je wel meebrengt, is ervaring met het opbouwen van klantrelaties en interesse in software. Je hebt meerdere jaren ervaring als accountmanager, bij voorkeur in SaaS of met digitale oplossingen. Je hebt interesse in software en wilt begrijpen hoe een platform als Toxic werkt, inclusief API-koppelingen en AI-toepassingen. Je bouwt relaties met meerdere stakeholders tegelijk en beheerst het volledige salesproces, van eerste kennismaking tot getekend contract. Je stuurt op data en haalt je targets, met nieuwe klanten en binnen je eigen portefeuille. Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands. Je hoeft de markt nog niet te kennen. Klanten, stoffen en regelgeving leer je bij ons, van collega's die het vak door en door kennen. HIER TEKEN JE VOOR Je tekent voor een rol die past bij je ambitie. Je werkt aan grotere deals, bouwt je eigen netwerk op en ontwikkelt je in een groeiend SaaS-team. Dat doe je binnen Lefebvre Sdu, een legaltechbedrijf met 200 jaar kennis en de energie van een scale-up. Dit krijg je ervoor terug: Een inwerkperiode waarin je Toxic, de markt en onze klanten leert kennen. Een plek waar je vanaf dag 1 invloed hebt op de aanpak, de processen en de richting. Collega's met diepgaande kennis van stoffen en regelgeving, van wie je elke dag leert. Doorgroeimogelijkheden naar Teamlead, Key Accountmanager of Propositiemanager. Een salaris vanaf €4.477 per maand, op basis van een werkweek van 36 uur. Een variabele bonusregeling die kan oplopen tot 30% van je jaarsalaris. 23 vakantiedagen en een persoonlijk keuzebudget van 12%, waarvan 8% vakantiegeld en 4% vrij besteedbaar aan extra vakantiedagen of salaris. Een goede pensioenregeling via PGB, inclusief aanvullende partnerverzekering. Een leaseauto of een reiskostenvergoeding van €0,25 per kilometer, en een aantrekkelijke fietsregeling. Voor een reisafstand onder de 10 km of boven de 60 km geldt een aangepaste regeling. Thuiswerkvergoeding en hybride werken: reken op 2 dagen per week op kantoor in Den Haag. MEER WETEN? Benieuwd hoe Toxic werkt? Kijk alvast op toxic.nl/en. We vertellen je graag meer over het team en de rol. Stuur je cv en je hoort binnen 2 werkdagen van ons. Eerst nog vragen? title: Internship - UAV Robotics/Mechatronics (Drone Prototyping, Integration & Field Testing)
description: Opening WE CANNOT PROVIDE VISA SPONSORSHIP Details Preferred starting date: ASAP Weekly availability: full-time (5 days/week) Period: 6 months Location: Aerospace Innovation Hub, Delft, the Netherlands About the company Fiducial is a young but fast-growing deep-tech start-up with big ambitions at the frontier of autonomy, perception, and defence. Currently, we are developing software for advanced on-board UAV situational awareness in military applications. Using low-cost and widely available sensors and compute, our solutions are built for scalability. From there, we plan to develop a line-up of interconnected solutions to safeguard European safety. Our team consists of engineers that are passionate about the technology and solutions they develop. The only time most of us are not thinking about the technology is when we are asleep, and sometimes even then. Our team members have a background in different fields such as Aerospace Engineering, Computational Science and Engineering, Robotics and Computer Graphics. Our office is located in the Aerospace Innovation Hub, a start-up hub located on the TU Delft campus in the faculty of Aerospace Engineering. We work closely with top-tier partners, ranging from government agencies and prime contractors to academic research institutes and other start-ups. Our projects span from large tender orders in collaboration with partners to low TRL research with government agencies. Whether through formal R&D programs or rapid prototyping tracks, we operate at the intersection of innovation and deployment. Your role If you’ve ever spent a weekend building a drone, tuning a flight controller, soldering a power harness, or figuring out why your FPV setup won’t arm, this internship is literally designed for you. We’re looking for a hands-on builder who loves working with real hardware: wiring sensors mounting compute boards setting up flight controllers testing drones outdoors fixing whatever breaks and making it better If phrases like ArduPilot, PX4, Jetson, ESCs, power distribution, 3D printing, or FPV gear make you smile, you’re the kind of person we want. This is not a “sit behind a desk” internship. You will be on the drones. You will be in the field. You will fly. What you’ll do Build and integrate hardware onto real drone platforms used in active R&D. Work hands-on with flight controllers (ArduPilot) and compute boards (Jetson, Orange Pi). Deploy and debug embedded perception software. Solder, assemble, and prototype wiring, adapters, mounts, and housings. 3D-print parts and quickly turn ideas into working physical prototypes. Support and participate in drone flight tests (you’ll fly regularly). Troubleshoot issues, iterate fast, and improve our hardware setups. You’ll see your work fly, literally! Who you are You’ve built or flown drones / RC systems (any level counts). You tinker with electronics, FPV, embedded software, or robotics. You enjoy making physical things work. You like fast iteration and getting your hands dirty. Linux doesn’t scare you. You are independent, curious, and resourceful. We don’t care about grades, we care about what you’ve made. Please include photos/links of: your drone builds FPV rigs electronics projects CAD/3D-printed parts GitHub repos anything that shows you build things If you’ve ever crashed something, fixed it, and sent it back into the sky — you’ll fit right in. Requirements Enrolled in a relevant study (Aerospace, Robotics, Electrical, Mechatronics, Engineering etc.). Linux basics. Interest in UAVs, robotics, embedded systems, or autonomy. English proficiency. Organized and proactive. Bonus: driver’s license, drone pilot license, CAD, 3D printing, soldering, or flight experience. What we offer 1000 euro monthly compensation. 10 vacation days during internship period. (Really) flexible working hours and option to work from home 2 days per week. Have a direct and significant influence on highly innovative products. The opportunity to iterate quickly with tight feedback loops, close to the product. We are innovating, learning is to be expected. Responsibility over the things you implement, you are the expert on what you build. The application procedure If after reading the above you are convinced you are the right person for the job, send us some information about yourself; this can be a resume, website or other source, as long as we get a clear impression of your background and skills. We’ll get back to you ASAP. If we feel you could be a fit for the position, we’ll invite you for an informal introduction so we can get to know you, and equally important, you can get to know us. After this, a technical focused interview could follow. If at this point we feel you are the person we are looking for, we’ll discuss the specifics (starting date and period). Welcome to the team!
