description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available location: </strong>Singapore</p> <p>Cloudflare is one of the most dynamic and innovative companies providing services on the Internet. Regulation of the Internet is exploding -- across a number of subject areas and jurisdictions -- at a rate previously unseen in the history of the Internet. We’re looking for a new team member who can help foster and promote our corporate philosophy and approach, in which the security and privacy of our customers are paramount. </p> <p>We are looking for an exceptionally talented and energetic person to join our Public Policy team in Singapore, with a strong background in India policy. You will work on some of the most complicated and rapidly evolving policy issues in the world, such as content moderation, user privacy, and intermediary liability, and you’ll help us develop and communicate real-world solutions to addressing these challenges. You will also build and run programs that further Cloudflare’s reputation and standing in the region by partnering with governments, trade bodies, and civil society organisations. This person has a deep understanding of technology as well as regulatory environments. The ideal candidate can seamlessly go from a technical conversation with engineers to a high-level discussion with regulators and policymakers regarding where Cloudflare fits in the Internet stack. This person should be an expert at presenting technical topics at a level any audience will be able to understand.</p> <p>This role has non-standard working hours.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Engage with policymakers, regulators, trade associations, industry partners, civil society groups and others in India and across the APJC region, to educate stakeholders on Cloudflare’s trust & safety processes and policy positions.</li> <li>Lead programs and advocacy campaigns that showcase our policy principles  to demonstrate what a better Internet looks like in practice.</li> <li>Develop talking points, policy narratives and presentation materials for use at external events and meetings and for other communication purposes (company blog, position papers, etc.).</li> <li>Coordinate with cross-functional teams to address government and law enforcement requests, as appropriate.</li> <li>Provide timely updates to colleagues from the Cloudflare Public Policy, Legal, Trust & Safety Teams and other internal stakeholders.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum Qualification</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree or preferably master's degree in public policy, law, economics </li> <li>8+ years of related experience handling law enforcement matters at a large technology company and experience handling public policy issues. </li> <li>Strong understanding of the Indian political, regulatory and legal system and protocols, particularly as they relate to digital services.</li> <li>Experience in designing, running, and managing stakeholder, community, or partnership programs and events (for example, workshops, hackathons, or training programs)</li> <li>Ability and willingness to work off hours, including weekends and holidays, to support emergency matters and interact with globally-based company employees</li> <li>Right to work in Singapore, or eligibility and willingness to relocate to Singapore</li> <li>Ability to analyze technical data and present to a less technical audience</li> <li>An ambitious mindset that enables you to successfully work independently with little guidance, but also to use good judgment and escalate / call out issues when needed.</li> <li>A sense of humor.</li> </ul> <p>Preferred Qualification</p> <ul> <li>Knowledge of Cloudflare products and the broader technology industry, including security, networking, Zero Trust, and AI services.</li> <li>Experience in reviewing, processing, and tracking legal documents, particularly in India (e.g., civil and criminal subpoenas, court orders, and search warrants, and legal notices under Indian law)</li> <li>Willingness to travel to India and elsewhere in the region.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Site Reliability Engineer, Cells Infrastructure
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>We're looking for an Intermediate Site Reliability Engineer to join the Cells Infrastructure team in GitLab's Scale & Architecture organization. In this role, you'll help build and operate Cells, the architecture that lets GitLab.com scale horizontally. Cells splits GitLab.com into many independent units, each with its own application and data stack, behind a shared routing layer.</p> <p>This is a build-it-and-run-it role. You'll provision cells, route traffic to them, deploy them safely, and keep them reliable in production. You'll also help move customer organizations onto Cells, one of GitLab's most important scaling initiatives.</p> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Operate Cells in production: join the on-call rotation, respond to incidents, lead post-incident reviews, and drive corrective actions to completion.</li> <li value="2">Define and monitor service level objectives (SLOs) for routing and cell health, and build the dashboards, alerts, and runbooks behind them.</li> <li value="3">Provision and operate cell infrastructure on Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including Kubernetes, networking, Identity and Access Management (IAM), PostgreSQL, Redis, and object storage.</li> <li value="4">Develop infrastructure as code with Terraform, Helm, and GitOps tooling such as Argo CD.</li> <li value="5">Operate and extend the global routing layer, built on Cloudflare Workers, Envoy, and a Go service backed by Cloud Spanner, and expand routing to more protocols and services.</li> <li value="6">Improve the continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines behind ring-based deployments, covering promotion, database migrations, quality assurance validation, and rollback.</li> <li value="7">Support organization migrations by preparing destination cells and helping with dry runs and production cutovers.</li> <li value="8">Work with product teams to make their services cell-compatible, and write documentation so others can operate Cells with confidence.</li> <li value="8">Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Professional experience running production infrastructure at scale on AWS, GCP, or both, including Kubernetes, along with strong Terraform and Helm skills.</li> <li value="2">Proficiency in Go, or strong experience in another systems language and willingness to work in Go daily.</li> <li value="3">Solid grounding in site reliability engineering (SRE) best practices: SLOs and error budgets, blameless post-incident reviews, reducing toil through automation, capacity planning, and designing for graceful degradation.</li> <li value="4">Experience owning services in production, including on-call, incident response, and monitoring with tools such as Prometheus and Grafana.</li> <li value="5">Practical knowledge of progressive delivery: how to roll changes safely across a fleet and how to roll them back.</li> <li value="6">A strong understanding of distributed-systems fundamentals, such as request routing, proxies, consistency, and failure domains.</li> <li value="7">Experience working effectively in distributed, all-remote teams: you default to asynchronous, written-first communication, document decisions in issues and merge requests, hand off work cleanly across time zones, and stay transparent about progress and blockers.</li> <li value="8">Experience with Cloudflare, Spanner, Argo CD, TypeScript, or operating GitLab at scale is a plus, not a requirement.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>Every team in our organization owns its services end to end, from design through on-call.We own the control plane that tracks cells and decides where each request belongs, and keep the fleet in step with GitLab's release cadence.We work closely with delivery, database, migration, and product teams across GitLab. Feature teams own how their services behave on the platform; we own the underlying infrastructure.We're an all-remote, asynchronous team. We make decisions in GitLab issues, use directly responsible individuals (DRIs) to own technical direction, demo our work weekly, and use AI-assisted workflows every day.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#equal-employment-opportunity-policy" target="_blank">GitLab’s EEO Policy</a> and <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/labor-and-employment-notices/#eeoc-us-equal-employment-opportunity-commission-notices" target="_blank">EEO is the Law</a>. If you have a disability or special need that requires <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#reasonable-accommodation" target="_blank">accommodation</a>, please let us know during the <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/interviewing/#adjustments-to-our-interview-process" target="_blank">recruiting process</a>.</p></div>

title: Security Engineer (Remote - Netherlands)
description: Our Vision & Products 🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World 50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next At EverAI , we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting , we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories. Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform , redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first . And we’re only just getting started! Our Team We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO. Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO] • 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership • Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO) • Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23 Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO] • 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM • Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands) Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO] • 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth • Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal] • 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A • Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone) • Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited) • Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited) Your Role As a Security Engineer , you’ll own application security for a fast-growing AI companionship platform. This is a hands-on AppSec role: you’ll review code, find real vulnerabilities and drive fixes across the stack. You’ll be the main security person in the company, reporting directly to our CTO and Co-Founder. You’ll set direction yourself and explain risk clearly to non-security colleagues. Our product includes AI-generated content, including NSFW content, and you’ll also keep an eye on AI-specific threats like prompt injection. Real ownership from day one. This isn’t an infrastructure, networking or DevSecOps role: we’re looking for application security depth. title: Stage Bouw
description: Hé stage topper! Kom jij, net als vele andere stagiaires, stagelopen bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Hengelo? Bij ons krijg jij de kans om mee te denken, werken én ontwikkelen aan gave projecten binnen Noord, Midden en Oost-Nederland. Wij hebben weer volop stageplekken vanaf Februari 2027 op onze bouwen en op kantoor! Dit wordt jouw stage Als stagiair bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Hengelo ga je aan de slag op ons kantoor of op één van onze projecten. We kijken in overeenstemming welke afdeling of welk project het beste bij jou en/of de opdracht past. Tijdens je stage word je goed begeleid door één van onze collega’s en krijg je de ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen! Jij staat aan het stuur van je eigen ontwikkeling tijdens je stageperiode: Hoe meer jij wil leren, hoe meer jij kan leren! Naast dat je zelfstandig aan een opdracht kan werken wordt je ook begeleidt door een senior collega die jou alle kneepjes van het vak gaat leren. We hebben door heel ons werkgebied verschillende bouwen waar we ruimte hebben voor een stagiaire, stuur ons vooral een berichtje zodat we samen kunnen kijken wat passend is! Meer bij Dura Vermeer Dura Vermeer is een familiebedrijf. Een onafhankelijke bouwonderneming actief in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek in Nederland. Al sinds 1855 vormen onze onafhankelijkheid en langjarige continuïteit de basis voor onze strategie. Met een omzet van circa € 1,8 miljard en ruim 3.000 medewerkers behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Samen realiseren we prachtige projecten. Iconische, en soms ook alledaagse projecten waarmee we nieuwe antwoorden bieden op maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Waarmee we de beste oplossingen voor morgen garanderen en het verschil maken voor Nederland, juist op de langere termijn. We hebben stevige ambities – en daarvoor geldt dat we die alleen kunnen waarmaken dankzij onze mensen. Als beste werkgever maken wij ons er daarom hard voor dat jij elke dag opnieuw kiest voor Dura Vermeer. Dat jij net zo trots bent op wat we maken als wij dat zijn. Dat iedereen die bij ons werkt gelukkig is. Dat je bij ons jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je kunt uitspreken. En dat je tot je recht komt. En het beste uit jezelf kunt halen. Hier zit je goed! Wij zijn Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Hengelo, een ontwikkelende bouwer in het werkgebied Noord-, Oost- en Midden-Nederland. Als onderdeel van de divisie Bouw & Vastgoed combineren we de kracht van een groot bedrijf, met de fijne sfeer en cultuur van een kleinere organisatie. Bij ons vind je echte doeners en waarmakers. We ontwikkelen en bouwen, samen met onze klanten, partners en collega’s. Wat ons ons maakt? Gewoon dóen en gewóón doen. Dat zit er nou eenmaal in, en zie je terug in alles wat we doen. Wil jij nou werken op een plek waar vakmanschap, samenwerking en heel veel plezier samenkomen? Mooi! Wij zoeken nieuwe collega’s binnen onze disciplines ontwikkeling, woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, renovatie & transformatie en beheer & exploitatie. Dit breng je mee Je volgt een MBO, HBO of WO opleiding (pre: opleiding Bouwkunde); Je bent proactief, nuchter en een harde werker, net als wij! Dit bieden wij jou Een stagevergoeding van €700 per maand op basis van 40 uren per week; Je krijgt ruimte voor eigen initiatieven; De beste collega’s om het vak van te leren en zij zorgen voor een ongekende goede werksfeer; Een familiebedrijf waarin we voor elkaar klaarstaan! Meer weten? Wij beantwoorden je vragen graag of denken graag met je mee voor het invullen van je stagewens. Schroom niet om contact op te nemen met Nikki Koehorst via 0628362285 of Hopelijk spreken we elkaar snel! Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

description: Lead technically by doing. Join our Design Engineering team as a highly experienced individual contributor. You develop solutions, perform engineering calculations and make the decisions needed to create robust industrial hardware. You apply calculations, tolerance analysis, design reviews and testing to reduce uncertainty. You manage complex interfaces, packaging constraints and design changes so the complete system works together. You produce and maintain high-quality 2D manufacturing drawings, including appropriate GD&T, tolerances, materials, finishes and manufacturing requirements. You support prototype fabrication, assembly and testing, investigate issues and incorporate the learning back into the design. Mechanical Design Experience : You bring 15+ years of hands-on mechanical design experience, ideally developing complex industrial equipment from concept through manufacture, assembly and testing. You understand bending, welding and joining methods, forming, tolerances, material and thickness selection, and how design choices affect tooling, cost, assembly and quality. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>Seattle, WA , Los Angeles, CA or Austin, TX</li> </ul> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>We are looking for a Director of Sales to manage a team of Commercial Account Executives for the West region. This leadership role within the Enterprise team focuses on both the acquisition of new accounts and the expansion of existing customer accounts. The ideal candidate will possess a strong sales management background and a technical foundation, enabling them to drive engagement with both technical professionals and executive buyers. As a Sales Director, you will have the opportunity to position and differentiate the Enterprise platform experience for Cloudflare while reinforcing strong pipeline and automated forecast management practices across Security, Network, Development, and Infrastructure teams.</p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>Accurately forecast commits by month and quarter, leveraging automated internal data layers and predictive metrics to consistently deliver attainment to quarterly and annual sales targets.</li> <li>Oversee, coach, and motivate a team of 8 Account Executives, measuring success against overall quota attainment, new logo acquisition, and expansion tactics.</li> <li>Develop and uplevel team selling abilities through consistent focus on enablement, solution selling, and interpreting automated, data-led customer insights.</li> <li>Assist in the continued codification and execution of product-focused playbooks to connect platform data to Cloudflare solutions that solve critical business challenges.</li> <li>Collaborate with Sales Enablement, Product, and Product Marketing to optimize sales training and accelerate execution around newly launched features and products.</li> <li>Maintain a robust funnel of new hire candidates by continuously interviewing and building a strong network of potential talent.</li> <li>Hold regular 1x1s with team members, maintaining open and transparent communication while monitoring the proficiency and adoption of sales enablement tooling and resources.</li> </ul> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <ul> <li>5+ years of Sales Management experience leading high-performing sales teams at a high-growth SaaS company.</li> <li>Proven record of high performance in consistently meeting and exceeding team plan through strategic acquisition and expansion tactics.</li> <li>Experience developing relationships with highly technical customers and selling through modern, data-driven Product-Led Growth (PLG) models.</li> <li>Coaching-level knowledge of Gap Selling, Sandler, Challenger, or other structured sales methodologies.</li> <li>Strong talent for multi-threading across business units to identify, engage, and close new divisional buyers, as well as driving consensus among internal and external stakeholders.</li> <li>Excellent written communication, presentation, and pipeline management skills.</li> </ul> <h2>Bonus Points</h2> <ul> <li>Experience leading sales teams specifically within Cloud Security or Hyperscaler ecosystems.</li> <li>Experience navigating complex accounts undergoing Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A) to expand the partner ecosystem.</li> </ul> <h2>Compensation</h2> <ul> <li>Compensation will be adjusted based on location and level.</li> <li>For Washington and California (excluding Bay Area) based hires: Estimated annual salary of $328,000 - $451,000</li> </ul> <p><strong>This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation under Cloudflare’s Sales Compensation Plan. The estimated annual salary range includes the on-target incentive compensation that may be attained in this role under the Sales Compensation Plan.</strong></p> <h3>Equity</h3> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <h3>Benefits</h3> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <h3>Health & Welfare Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <h3>Financial Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <h3>Time Off</h3> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</spa

In this role you'll partner closely with the sales team from the very start of the cycle — joining early discovery calls, qualifying opportunities from the get-go, and embedding yourself in customer Slack channels and working sessions. You'll lead technical discovery, deliver compelling demos and architecture discussions, run proof-of-concept builds, and evangelize the Cloudflare Developer Platform as the foundation for our customers' next products and AI initiatives.<br>Responsibilities<br>Specifically, we are looking for you to:<br> <ul> <li>Lead technical discovery within the cloud-developer vertical — asking the right questions to uncover how a customer builds, what they're trying to ship, and where Cloudflare fits.</li> <li>Engage early and often: join sales-led discovery calls from the outset, help qualify deals from the get-go, and stay embedded with customer teams (including in their Slack channels and working sessions) throughout the cycle.</li> <li>Identify and map customer initiatives and business problems — especially around new product development and AI initiatives — to the Cloudflare platform.</li> <li>Build relationships and technical champions within customer accounts, from founding engineers and developers up to the CTO.</li> <li>Develop and present tailored technical content and demos for both hands-on developer audiences and senior technical leadership.</li> <li>Lead demo and proof-of-concept / build activities for Cloudflare prospects and customers.</li> <li>Evangelize the Cloudflare Developer Platform (Workers, Workers AI, Durable Objects, R2, D1, KV, Vectorize, Queues, Pages and more) — making the case for customers to <em>build on</em> Cloudflare, not just use it for storage or CDN.</li> <li>Demonstrate your expertise with your peers through the creation of professional content, including reference architectures, demos, blog posts and other knowledge-sharing activities.</li> <li>Represent and evangelize Cloudflare externally at Developer, Community, Technology and Industry events with thought leadership and expertise.</li> <li>Apply in-depth vertical knowledge or domain expertise. Advise on best practices.</li> </ul> Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience<br> <ul> <li>Previous experience as a Solutions Engineer or other customer-facing technical role, ideally selling to or working with developer-led, cloud-native, or startup organizations.</li> <li>A genuine "builder" mindset and the personality to match: you enjoy talking to developers, you're curious, and you naturally gravitate toward technical problem-solving conversations.</li> <li>The ability to speak engineers' language credibly — you can hold your own on architecture, APIs, and platform design — <strong>without</strong> this being a hands-on, code-every-day developer role.</li> <li>Strong technical discovery instincts: you know how to draw out requirements, qualify fit early, and separate real needs from noise.</li> <li>A good mix of pre-sales / technical sales experience and comfort operating in an agile, fast-moving environment (joining Slack channels, iterating quickly, engaging in early-stage calls, and qualifying deals from the start).</li> <li>Solid communication, written and presentation skills, with the range to talk to both a hands-on developer and a CTO in the same day.</li> <li>Ability to work on several projects and activities concurrently.</li> <li>Highly driven, curious, team-oriented, and able to work with a sense of urgency.</li> <li>You've built web applications before, or contributed to existing web applications in a meaningful way — enough to have real empathy for how developers work.</li> <li>Polished communication and executive presentation skills with the ability to drive a discussion with a broad range of stakeholders (from the web developer to the CTO/CISO).</li> <li>Relationship building: a proven track record of building deep technical relationships with engineers and technical founders. Experience managing various stakeholder relationships to build consensus on technical solutions/projects.</li> <li>Experience managing technical sales within accounts, including developing champion-style relationships, driving technical wins, and assisting with technical validation.</li> <li>Bachelor's Degree or equivalent in relevant work experience.</li> <li>The role requires up to 50% travel to attend meetings with prospects or customers, attend conferences and other industry events, and to collaborate with your Cloudflare teammates.</li> </ul> A deep understanding of the Cloudflare Developer Platform and core industry components (and a desire to learn more):<br> <ul> <li><strong>The Cloudflare Developer Platform</strong> — serverless compute and application development with Workers, Durable Objects, Workers AI, R2, KV, D1, Vectorize, Queues, and Pages. Familiarity with building or architecting applications on a serverless/edge platform is a strong plus.</li> <li>AI/GenAI application patterns — inference at the edge, RAG, vector databases, and how startups are operationalizing AI initiatives.</li> <li>HTTP technologies including reverse proxy (e.g., WAF and CDN), forward proxy (secure web gateway), and serverless application development.</li> <li>Internet security technologies including DDoS and DDoS mitigation, Firewalls, TLS, VPN, DLP.</li> <li>Networking technologies including TCP, UDP, DNS, IPv4 + IPv6, BGP routing, GRE, SD-WAN, MPLS, Global Traffic Management.</li> <li>Zero-trust network access (ZTNA & SASE) concepts including identity management and authentication.</li> <li>Cloud computing technologies such as AWS, GCP, Azure and others.</li> <li>Some scripting or programming familiarity with one or more of JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Golang, BASH — enough to read code, build a demo, and converse with engineers (not to ship production software).</li> <li>Understanding of, or experience with, regulatory requirements such as FedRAMP, GDPR, PCI DSS, HIPAA, SOC-2, ISO/IEC.</li> <li>An undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field. In an acceleratingly dangerous world, the scope of that mission has changed. We are becoming something more: critical infrastructure. Banks run their payment rails on us. Governments run public services on us. Media companies depend on us during live events. Health systems depend on us to provide care. Reliability for these customers is no longer a feature of our product. It is a mission.</p> <p>Serving that customer base demands a different operating model. Traditional support organizations route tickets. Traditional engineering organizations ship features. Neither alone is enough when the stakes are this high. We are pivoting to something different: a customer-facing engineering organization, directly engaged with our customers at scale. This is work a central dev team cannot do from the inside of the network.</p> <p>The Customer Reliability Engineering function is the spine of that pivot. CRE is SRE applied outward, the same engineering discipline, applied to the reliability of the systems our customers run on Cloudflare. You are the engineer who owns the problems that matter most to the customers who matter most, and you contribute directly to our products and tooling, in partnership with Product Engineering, to hold that standard across the entire customer base.</p> <h3><strong>The Role</strong></h3> <p>CRE is a rapid response team and a proactive engineering team. Iterate.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3> <p><strong>Rapid incident response and root cause analysis.</strong> Own the most complex, high-severity customer issues end-to-end, from first signal through confirmed resolution. business questions into analysis frameworks, converting results into business recommendations, and presenting those to stakeholders</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice-to-Have Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience and/or a keen interest in internet security, protocols, and edge-development</li> <li>Analytics experience in a fast-growing technology, SaaS, or subscription-based business</li> <li>Experience with statistical analysis programming languages (Python, R etc.)</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Austin, TX</strong></li> <li><strong>Atlanta, GA</strong></li> <li><strong>Denver, CO</strong></li> <li><strong>Seattle, WA</strong></li> <li><strong>Washington, DC </strong></li> </ul> <p><strong></strong></p> <p><strong>Application Deadline: December 16, 2026</strong></p> <p><strong></strong></p> <p><strong>Position Overview</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare is looking for an Automation Specialist to transform how our global Data Center Security Compliance (DCSC) team operates. This critical role is part of the Infrastructure Operations organization, which is responsible for building, scaling, and running Cloudflare's data center and network infrastructure across 700+ sites worldwide.</p> <p>The DCSC team manages physical access control and compliance auditing across one of the most complex and distributed infrastructure footprints in the industry, spanning more than 105 vendor portals, hundreds of non-portal carrier-neutral and edge partner sites, and multiple regulatory frameworks including SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP, ISMAP, and IRAP. The operational burden of this work is substantial and largely manual: user lists are pulled by hand, access control lists are reconciled by eye, evidence packages are assembled ticket by ticket, and attestation cycles consume weeks of coordinator time every quarter.</p> <p>This role exists to change that. The DCSC Automation -Specialist will design, build, and operate AI-assisted and automated workflows that eliminate the most time-consuming manual work in the DCSC operating model, freeing compliance coordinators to focus on exception handling, stakeholder relationships, and regulatory judgment rather than data gathering and reconciliation.</p> <p>This is a builder role. You will interview the team to understand each workflow, identify the highest-leverage automation targets, and ship tooling that demonstrably reduces the time it takes to close a QAR cycle, produce an audit evidence package, or manage a batch of access provisioning requests. You will work in close partnership with the DCSC coordinators, and existing automation developers, and will own the DCSC operational tooling roadmap.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ol> <li><strong> Portal Automation & User List Extraction</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Browser Automation: Design and maintain automated scripts (Playwright, Puppeteer, or equivalent) that log into vendor data center portals, extract user access lists, and feed structured output into the DCSC Portal and comparison pipelines replacing manual portal-by-portal data collection across 105+ portals covering 338+ sites.</li> <li>Resilience & Coverage: Build fallback handling for portals that block or rate-limit automated access; document exceptions and maintain a coverage registry tracking automation status per portal.</li> <li>Scheduled Execution: Operationalize extraction jobs on a recurring cadence aligned to QAR and MAR cycles, with alerting for failures and drift.</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong> ACL Reconciliation & Diff Engine</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Automated Comparison: Build tooling that ingests portal-extracted user lists and compares them against the master Access Control List (ACL), automatically surfacing discrepancies: users present in a portal but absent from the ACL, users on the ACL without active portal access, and role or access-level mismatches.</li> <li>Exception-Only Output: Route confirmed discrepancies directly to pre-populated Jira tickets for human review and action, eliminating the need for coordinators to perform full manual review of every user record each quarter.</li> <li>Audit Trail: Ensure all comparison runs produce immutable, timestamped records suitable for SOC 2, ISO 27001, and FedRAMP evidence requirements.</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong> Attestation & Evidence Automation</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Attestation Module: Own and extend the attestation workflow within the DCSC Portal, including automated cycle triggering, manager notification, time-stamped confirmation capture, and exception escalation, replacing manual screenshot-based evidence gathering.</li> <li>Evidence Package Builder: Build automated pipelines that compile audit-ready evidence packages for SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP, ISMAP, and IRAP control cycles, pulling attestation logs, portal extraction results, diff reports, and correspondence into structured packages keyed to specific control IDs.</li> <li>GRC Alignment: Work directly with GRC counterparts to validate that automated evidence formats meet auditor and regulatory requirements before deployment.</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong> AI-Assisted Anomaly Detection & Triage</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Access Pattern Analysis: Implement LLM-based review passes over QAR cycle output to surface patterns warranting human escalation: former employees retaining access, access creep over time, dormant accounts, and anomalous role assignments across sites.</li> <li>Ticket Intelligence: Build automation that reads incoming Jira onboarding and offboarding tickets and generates structured, portal-specific action checklists reducing coordinator cognitive load and preventing missed steps across multi-portal provisioning workflows.</li> <li>Continuous Improvement: Monitor automation output quality over time, retrain or recalibrate models as portal structures change, and maintain a feedback loop with coordinators on false positives and missed detections.</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong> DCSC Portal Ownership & Tooling Roadmap</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Platform Stewardship: Own the DCSC Portal as the operational runtime for all automation and workflow tooling ensuring it remains stable, documented, and usable by coordinators without engineering support for day-to-day tasks.</li> <li>Roadmap Management: Maintain a prioritized backlog of automation opportunities, assessed by time savings, compliance impact, and implementation complexity; present quarterly progress and priorities to DCSC leadership.</li> <li>Documentation: Produce runbooks for every automation, ensuring that no operational capability lives only in one person's head or on a local machine.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable skills / Experience:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Automation Engineering: Demonstrated experience building browser automation (Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium, or equivalent) against real-world web applications, including handling authentication flows, dynamic content, and anti-bot mitigations.</li> <li>TypeScript Proficiency: Strong skills for scripting, data wrangling, structured file I/O, and API integration. Ability to write maintainable, documented code that non-engineers can operate.</li> <li>LLM Integration: Hands-on experience integrating LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or equivalent) into production workflows for classification, drafting, summarization, or anomaly detection tasks.</li> <li>Data Engineering Fundamentals: Comfort working with structured and semi-structured data at scale, diffing datasets, normalizing inconsistent formats, and producing clean outputs for downstream audit use.</li> <li>API & Workflow Integration: Experience building integrations with ticketing or ITSM systems (Jira preferred) via REST API, including automated ticket creation, status updates, and attachment handling.</li> <li>Systems Thinking: Ability to map an end-to-end manual workflow, identify the highest-leverage automation insertion points, and ship incrementally without waiting for a perfect solution.</li> <li>Workflow Archaeology: Comfortable extracting process knowledge from subject-matter experts through structured interviews turning tribal knowledge into documented, automatable workflows.</li> <li>Bias Toward Simplicity: Strong product intuition for the minimum viable automation that delivers real time savings, rather than over-engineering for edge cases.</li> <li>Compliance Awareness: Appreciation for the stakes of accuracy in a compliance context, understanding that an incorrect ACL diff or a missing evidence artifact has real audit consequences.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Soft Skills:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Communication: Able to explain automation design decisions and tradeoffs clearly to non-technical stakeholders including compliance coordinators and GRC partners.</li> <li>Ambiguity Tolerance: Vendor portals don't come with documentation. Workflows are passed down verbally. You need to be energized by figuring things out from scratch.</li> <li>Preferred Qualifications</li> <li>Experience with Cloudflare Workers or similar edge compute platforms</li> <li>Familiarity with GRC/compliance frameworks (SOC 2, FedRAMP, ISO 27001) at an operational level — not as an auditor, but enough to understand why evidence integrity matters</li> <li>RPA tooling experience (UiPath, Power Automate) as fallback for portals that defeat headless browsers</li> <li>Prior work in infrastructure operations, data center, or physical security environments</li> <li>Experience building internal tooling or developer-facing portals (not just scripts)</li> </ul> <p></p> <h3 data-path-to-node="0"><strong data-path-to-node="0" data-index-in-node="0">Compensation</strong></h3> <ul data-path-to-node="1

Qualified candidates will demonstrate depth in at least four of the technical areas below:</li> <ul> <li>Internet fundamentals: Deep understanding of how the Internet works, including OSI Model layers 1–7, BGP, GRE, TCP/UDP, DNS (authoritative and recursive), HTTP(S), and SSL/TLS.</li> <li>Security: Expertise in the security of Internet properties, including WAF, Bot Management, Firewalls, Rate Limiting, (M)TLS, Zero Trust, and SASE concepts.</li> <li>Performance: Expertise in the performance of Internet properties, including speed, latency, caching, video streaming, HTTP/2, and TLS 1.3.</li> <li>AI Proficiency: Familiarity with prompt engineering, AI-assisted scripting and log analysis, LLM utilization, and workflow automation to augment everyday CE workflows.</li> <li>Coding/Scripting: Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, Bash, Lua, Go, or similar languages to write custom integration scripts, API connectors, and edge computing functions.</li> <li>Developer Platform Fluency: Experience designing, building, deploying or scaling applications using RESTful/GraphQL APIs, SDKs, webhooks, and developer tooling in cloud-native environments. Structured Finance is responsible for making sure Cloudflare has the right capital, on the right terms, to keep building one of the world’s largest networks.</p> <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare is looking for a Director of Structured Finance to lead the structuring and execution of financings that support our global network and infrastructure strategy. Our infrastructure spans hundreds of cities worldwide, and as we continue to scale — including the servers, GPUs, and data center capacity that power our network, Workers AI, and our Developer Platform — how we finance that build-out is a strategic lever for the business.</p> <p>You will own financing workstreams end-to-end: structuring, counterparty engagement, term negotiation, documentation, and close. You will partner closely with our Infrastructure, Hardware Sourcing, Treasury, Legal, Accounting, Tax, and FP&A teams to turn infrastructure plans into investable, well-priced transactions. The role will also extend to broader capital markets and capital structure work as the company grows.</p> <p>This is a high-visibility, high-ownership role on a lean team. It combines hands-on transaction execution with financial analysis, relationship building with the financing community, and strategic decision support for senior leadership and the Board. We hold a very high bar on rigor and judgment, and we are AI-native in how we work.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <p><strong>Infrastructure and asset financing</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own financing workstreams end-to-end for Cloudflare’s network and data center infrastructure — including equipment and hardware financing, leasing, vendor financing, and other structured solutions — from structuring and counterparty engagement through term negotiation, documentation, and close.</li> <li>Translate infrastructure requirements and capex plans into clear, investable frameworks and materials for lenders, lessors, and other financing counterparties.</li> <li>Represent Cloudflare independently in negotiations with external counterparties, exercising sound judgment on risk allocation, collateral, covenants, and commercial terms.</li> <li>Evaluate lease vs. buy vs. finance trade-offs and recommend the structures that best balance cost of capital, flexibility, and risk.</li> <li>Build repeatable internal frameworks, playbooks, and processes for evaluating, approving, and executing financing transactions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Capital markets and capital structure</strong></p> <ul> <li>Collaborate with Cloudflare’s Treasury team on the company’s broader capital markets strategy, including debt, convertible, and other structured transactions, and contribute analysis on capital structure, liquidity, and cost of capital.</li> <li>Develop and maintain a credible network of financing counterparties — banks, private credit funds, private equity, lessors, infrastructure investors, and OEM/vendor finance teams.</li> <li>Monitor market conditions, pricing, and emerging financing structures, and bring new ideas to leadership.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Modeling, analysis, and decision support</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build and maintain rigorous financial models supporting transaction structuring, pricing, returns, and capital allocation decisions.</li> <li>Prepare analysis and materials that distill complex financing decisions into clear recommendations for the CFO, senior leadership, and the Board.</li> <li>Partner with Accounting, Tax, and Legal on accounting treatment (e.g., lease classification), tax implications, disclosure, and documentation.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Cross-functional partnership and execution</strong></p> <ul> <li>Partner with Infrastructure, Sourcing, Treasury, Legal, and leadership teams to keep transaction terms aligned with network build-out plans and broader company priorities.</li> <li>Own post-close management of financing arrangements, including covenant compliance, reporting obligations, and ongoing counterparty relationships.</li> <li>Use AI-native tooling and automation to scale the function — models, trackers, and workflows that let a small team operate with speed and accuracy.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>10+ years of experience</strong> across structured or project finance, infrastructure investing, private credit, equipment leasing, private equity, investment banking, and/or corporate capital markets — ideally including time in-house at a high-growth technology or infrastructure company.</li> <li><strong>A track record of leading complex financing transactions through to close</strong>, including direct negotiation and documentation with external counterparties.</li> <li><strong>The ability to run a financing workstream independently</strong>, without close supervision, and to represent the company credibly with senior external counterparties.</li> <li><strong>Deep structuring expertise</strong> — e.g., equipment finance, leasing and sale-leaseback, asset-backed and project finance, Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3>Hiring Locations: <strong>Atlanta, GA, Austin, US, New York, NY, San Francisco, CA, Seattle, WA, Washington DC, US</strong></h3> <h3>About the Department</h3> <p>Infrastructure Operations builds and manages the data center infrastructure behind Cloudflare's global network. The organization brings together engineering, operations, hardware and logistics teams that plan, deploy, operate and maintain our footprint in hundreds of cities worldwide. In this role, you'll help extend that footprint with a new generation of data center sites across the United States.</p> <h3>About the Role</h3> <p>We're looking for an experienced Data Center Operations manager to build and run the team that brings these new sites online and keeps them running around the clock.</p> <p>You will build a distributed team of Data Center Engineers from the ground up. You'll own sites across their full lifecycle: delivering greenfield builds through third-party vendors and colocation partners, running them in production, and retiring hardware securely at end of life. You'll be accountable for production hardware availability, 24x7 on-site response, and the operating model that lets this footprint scale.</p> <p>The role means balancing competing demands every day: build deadlines against build quality, dependence on partners against high standards, and fast incident response against careful compliance. You need to keep both sides of each in view.</p> <p>This role covers the physical layer: hardware, cabling, and Layer 1/Layer 2 connectivity. It works closely with network engineering and server provisioning teams but does not own them.</p> <h3>What You'll Do</h3> <p>Team Leadership</p> <ul> <li> <p>Hire, develop and manage Data Center Engineers based on-site at data centers across the US. Set clear expectations, career paths and a culture of ownership across a team spread over many sites.</p> </li> <li> <p>Build and take part in a 24x7 on-call rotation with your team. Define coverage models, handover protocols and incident SLAs that hold up as the footprint grows.</p> </li> <li> <p>Serve as the escalation point for on-site incidents. Coordinate engineers, colocation providers and vendors to restore service quickly, and lead root-cause analysis after major incidents so the same problem doesn't happen again.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Site Delivery</p> <ul> <li> <p>Own build timelines from site readiness through hardware delivery, rack-and-stack, cabling, validation and handoff to production.</p> </li> <li> <p>Run greenfield builds as multi-workstream programs. Coordinate third-party integrators, contractors and colocation providers to hit dates without cutting corners.</p> </li> <li> <p>Be on-site during key build phases to oversee vendor work, verify quality and make sure sites are production-ready.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Production Operations</p> <ul> <li> <p>Be accountable for availability targets for production hardware at your sites. Run break/fix, repairs, RMAs and spares strategy so that availability is measured, reported and improving.</p> </li> <li> <p>Manage colocation providers and vendors day to day: escalations, remote-hands quality, power and cooling issues, and performance against contractual commitments.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Documentation and DCIM</p> <ul> <li> <p>Make sure every site is fully documented in DCIM from day one. That covers rack elevations, power and cabling, asset location, and lifecycle status, all recorded as hardware arrives rather than filled in later.</p> </li> <li> <p>Treat infrastructure records as a source of truth that both operations and dependent teams rely on, giving them accurate, current visibility into where hardware is and what state it's in.</p> </li> <li> <p>Partner with tooling teams to bring DCIM online at new sites, and define documentation standards that hold up as the footprint grows.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Decommissioning and Hardware Lifecycle</p> <ul> <li> <p>Own on-site decommissioning end to end: unracking, physical collections, serial number verification, chain of custody, and handoff for secure destruction.</p> </li> <li> <p>Partner with vendor management on IT asset disposition (ITAD) vendors. Make sure destruction certificates and compliance evidence are filed and audit-ready.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Security and Compliance</p> <ul> <li> <p>Make sure your sites and team meet Cloudflare's physical security, access control, chain-of-custody and compliance obligations.</p> </li> <li> <p>Follow established physical access procedures, and work with security and compliance teams to develop new ones where these sites need them.</p> </li> <li> <p>Support audits with accurate, timely evidence. Treat audit readiness as a continuous standard, not something you prepare for once per audit cycle.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Automation and Operational Efficiency</p> <ul> <li> <p>Find manual, repetitive work in build, break/fix, decommissioning and evidence collection. Influence tooling and automation teams to remove it.</p> </li> <li> <p>Evaluate and adopt AI-assisted workflows for incident triage, root-cause analysis, documentation and compliance evidence generation.</p> </li> <li> <p>Scale the operation through tooling, not just headcount.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Business Reporting</p> <ul> <li> <p>Own weekly business reviews and monthly and quarterly reporting on availability, build progress, incidents and operational health to the Director and peer leaders.</p> </li> <li> <p>Partner with network, systems, hardware, supply chain and infrastructure engineering teams to make sure physical operations support what runs on top of them.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Who You Are</h3> <p><strong>A builder who stays to operate.</strong> You've stood up sites and teams, and you take ownership of what happens after go-live. Delivering a build is where your job starts. If it isn't documented, it isn't done.</p> <p><strong>A leader of distributed teams.</strong> You've hired and built trust with on-site engineers spread across many locations, most of whom you won't see day to day. You know how to create accountability, consistent standards and a shared culture across sites, both remotely and in person.</p> <p><strong>Firm with partners.</strong> You hold colocation providers and vendors to high standards without becoming adversarial. You know the contract, you track performance, and you escalate when it's warranted.</p> <p><strong>Compliance-minded without being a compliance specialist.</strong> You understand why access controls and decommissioning chain of custody are audit controls. You treat compliance as part of doing the work well, not as overhead.</p> <p><strong>Automation-first.</strong> When something hurts, your first instinct is to fix the process or the tooling, not add people. You can turn an operational pain point into requirements engineering teams can act on.</p> <h3>Required Experience</h3> <ul> <li> <p>6+ years in data center operations, including 3+ years directly managing on-site technical teams. This role is a great fit for you if:</p> <ul> <li>You have led and developed a high-performing engineering team(s) and can point to what that team shipped and how the people on it grew.</li> <li>You are technically credible with experienced blockchain and systems engineers. title: Interconnection Manager, Network Strategy Americas
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations:</strong> San Francisco, CA; Austin, TX; New York, NY; Washington D.C.</p> <h4>About the Role</h4> <p>The Interconnection Manager for the Americas is the network strategy leader for one of Cloudflare's most important and most contrasted regions — a mature, high-volume United States market alongside a fast-growing, infrastructure-constrained South America. You will own the strategy that scales our connectivity with the largest ISPs and eyeball networks in the U.S. while solving the harder, less-charted problem of building resilient, cost-effective network reach across South America.</p> <p>This role operates on an AI-first model. You won't just consume reports — you'll use AI agents and tooling to analyze traffic, model capacity and cost scenarios, surface peering and transport opportunities, and automate the operational work that historically slowed interconnection teams down. AI is the force-multiplier that lets a single strategist see the whole region clearly and act on it quickly, shifting your time from reactive task processing to proactive architecture. The decisions you make will directly shape Cloudflare's standing as the network leader across the Americas.</p> <p>You will work in close partnership with the Regional Network Acquisition Manager, who executes high-volume sourcing, contract lifecycle, and vendor management under your strategic direction — freeing you to lead the complex, high-stakes work.</p> <h4>What You'll Do / Responsibilities</h4> <p><strong>Regional Network Strategy — Americas</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own and execute the interconnection and backbone strategy for the Americas, balancing the distinct realities of the U.S. and South American markets.</li> <li><strong>United States:</strong> Drive interconnection scale and depth with the largest U.S. ISPs and eyeball networks (e.g., Comcast, Charter, AT&T, Verizon, T-Mobile), expanding private interconnect, peering, and capacity to keep pace with traffic growth.</li> <li><strong>South America:</strong> Solve the region's unique build challenges — a sparse and uneven IXP fabric, terrestrial and subsea transport economics, regulatory and market fragmentation, and heavy reliance on local partners — to establish durable, performant reach (with particular focus on Brazil, the region's largest market).</li> </ul> <p><strong>AI-First Operating Model</strong></p> <ul> <li>Use AI-driven analytics to interpret regional traffic patterns, peering opportunities, and performance/cost trade-offs, and to inform interconnection and capacity decisions.</li> <li>Leverage and help shape automated, agentic workflows for LOAs, ticketing, contract tracking, and data hygiene — partnering with the support layer to push routine execution to automation.</li> <li>Build models and scenario analyses (capacity, cost, resiliency) that let you make faster, better-evidenced strategic calls and clearly defend them to leadership.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Interconnection & Backbone Management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Formulate and execute plans to optimize traffic flow across the region, balancing backbone, partner, transit, IX, and peer connections.</li> <li>Develop and execute strategies for the expansion, optimization, and maintenance of Cloudflare's backbone across the Americas, planning capacity for scalability and high performance.</li> <li>Lead negotiations for high-value, complex interconnection agreements and Tier-1 partnerships.</li> <li>Advise budget planning cycles to ensure proper resource allocation for regional growth and scaling.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Partnership with the Regional Network Acquisition Manager</strong></p> <ul> <li>Set the strategy and priorities the Network Acquisition Manager executes against; review and approve sourcing recommendations for new and existing transport services.</li> <li>Lead complex, high-value negotiations directly, while the Acquisition Manager runs high-volume requirements, contract lifecycle support, inventory, and first-level billing response.</li> <li>Ensure a clean handoff model so strategic intent translates into reliable, well-documented execution.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Relationship Management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with ISPs, IXPs, carriers, and partners across the Americas.</li> <li>Act as the regional expert for interconnection relationships, focused on availability, capacity, effectiveness, and cost efficiency.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Cross-Functional Collaboration</strong></p> <ul> <li>Collaborate with Data Center Strategy, Network Engineering, Capacity Planning, and Infrastructure Operations to align on network strategy and implementation.</li> <li>Engage internal stakeholders to plan requirements and deliver cross-functional projects, communicating clearly throughout.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Industry Engagement</strong></p> <ul> <li>Represent Cloudflare in regional and global industry forums and conferences, contributing to best practices and standards.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:</strong></h4> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience in network infrastructure, ideally within a Telco, ISP, CDN, or cloud environment.</li> <li>Strong understanding of networking protocols and technologies, including BGP, DWDM, and IP networking.</li> <li>Proven experience negotiating and managing interconnection agreements.</li> <li>Working knowledge of the Americas connectivity landscape — the U.S. wholesale/peering market and the transport, IXP, and partner dynamics of South America (including subsea and terrestrial considerations).</li> <li>Fluency with AI tools in daily work, and a genuine appetite to use AI/agentic tooling to scale decision-making and eliminate manual toil.</li> <li>Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.</li> <li>Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.</li> <li>Experience with capacity planning, cost modeling, and operations research.</li> </ul> <h4>Bonus Points</h4> <ul> <li>Professional proficiency in <strong>Spanish and/or Portuguese</strong>, to support relationship-building and network expansion across South America.</li> <li>Hands-on experience building or scaling network presence in emerging or infrastructure-constrained markets.</li> <li>Experience designing AI-assisted analytics or automation for network/commercial operations.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For Bay Area based hires: Estimated
