If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Available Locations: Austin, TX | New York City, NY | San Francisco, CA</strong></h3> <h3 data-path-to-node="2">About AI Gateway</h3> <p data-path-to-node="3">AI inference is becoming core infrastructure. Every serious application will need access to many models across many providers, with reliability, observability, security, cost control, and routing built in from the start. AI Gateway is Cloudflare's bet that this layer belongs at the network edge: close to users, close to compute, and simple enough that a developer can adopt it with one API change.</p> <p data-path-to-node="4">Developers using AI Gateway need answers to two questions. Is the model I'm calling working the way you say it does? And which model should I be using at all? You'll lead the models team that answers both.</p> <p data-path-to-node="5">You'll start with model operations. That's the work behind every model in the catalog: provider integrations, capability testing, pricing and metering, capacity, security reviews, docs, health, and deprecations. Sometimes a launch needs to go live within minutes of a lab's announcement. Sometimes the right call is to hold it. Cloudflare is an infrastructure company at heart, so reliability and accuracy come first; speed comes from preparation and automation.</p> <p data-path-to-node="6">Then you'll bring model intelligence online. That means turning what we learn from Gateway traffic into decisions for customers: capability maps, per-task rankings, auto-routing profiles that pick the right model for each request, evals and regression detection, and market intelligence developers can trust.</p> <p data-path-to-node="7">This is a people-management role reporting to the AI Gateway Engineering Manager. You'll hire, develop, and lead the team, and you'll stay hands-on: writing code, building agent-driven workflows, and getting into the details of a failed launch or a suspicious eval SLO. Expect to manage people, projects, model stock, and operations all at once.</p> <h3 data-path-to-node="9">About the Role</h3> <ul> <li><strong data-path-to-node="10,0,0" data-index-in-node="0">Build and lead the models team:</strong> Hire, coach, and grow the people who run the catalog today and build its intelligence over time. Give people real ownership, give direct feedback, and grow leads who can run their own areas.</li> <li><strong data-path-to-node="10,1,0" data-index-in-node="0">Run model launches end-to-end:</strong> Scope integrations, coordinate testing and evals, confirm pricing, metering, capacity, and security, and get docs and announcements ready. Prepare day-zero launches in advance so they can ship in minutes.</li> <li><strong data-path-to-node="10,2,0" data-index-in-node="0">Keep the catalog true:</strong> Make sure what we publish (capabilities, limits, versions, prices) matches what developers actually get. Catch silent regressions, such as broken tool calling, truncated streams, quantization changes, or usage and pricing mismatches, before customers do.</li> <li><strong data-path-to-node="10,3,0" data-index-in-node="0">Build model intelligence:</strong> As it comes online, own the evals, capability maps, and per-task rankings behind our auto-routing profiles and model recommendations. Make sure they measure what they claim to, and connect regressions to routing decisions so customers who chose "auto" aren't the ones who discover a problem.</li> <li><strong data-path-to-node="10,4,0" data-index-in-node="0">Treat the catalog and intelligence as products:</strong> Have a point of view on which models belong in the catalog, which routing profiles to ship, and what market intelligence to publish. Base it on usage, quality, reliability, and cost data. Turn what you learn into roadmap input.</li> <li><strong data-path-to-node="10,5,0" data-index-in-node="0">Run a lightweight operating cadence:</strong> Keep one source of truth for what's in flight, who owns it, what's blocked, and what ships next. Keep Engineering, Product, Partnerships, and other stakeholders aligned and informed without status meetings.</li> <li><strong data-path-to-node="10,6,0" data-index-in-node="0">Automate relentlessly:</strong> Turn repeatable steps into scripts, tools, and agent workflows: endpoint validation, eval runs, catalog and pricing reconciliation, regression detection, and provider follow-ups. Manual effort per launch should fall as the catalog grows.</li> </ul> <h3 data-path-to-node="12">Responsibilities</h3> <ul> <li data-path-to-node="13,0,0"><strong data-path-to-node="13,0,0" data-index-in-node="0">Day-Zero & Quality Launches:</strong> Ensure new models launch on day zero with tested capabilities, accurate pricing, docs, and a clear call on routing eligibility.</li> <li data-path-to-node="13,1,0"><strong data-path-to-node="13,1,0" data-index-in-node="0">Catalog Reliability & Health:</strong> Ensure the catalog reflects reality, and proactively identify when a model or provider is underperforming before customers notice.</li> <li data-path-to-node="13,2,0"><strong data-path-to-node="13,2,0" data-index-in-node="0">Auto-Routing & Optimization:</strong> Deliver auto-routing that measurably beats a fixed model choice on cost or quality for users.</li> <li data-path-to-node="13,3,0"><strong data-path-to-node="13,3,0" data-index-in-node="0">Developer Trust & Methodology:</strong> Build and maintain trusted rankings and recommendations grounded in solid methodology.</li> <li data-path-to-node="13,4,0"><strong data-path-to-node="13,4,0" data-index-in-node="0">Partner & Stakeholder Management:</strong> Set clear expectations for providers, while keeping Engineering, Product, Partnerships, and other stakeholders aligned.</li> <li data-path-to-node="13,5,0"><strong data-path-to-node="13,5,0" data-index-in-node="0">Team Leadership & Growth:</strong> Provide clear ownership and direction so the team knows what's next, who owns it, and how to grow into bigger roles.</li> <li data-path-to-node="13,6,0"><strong data-path-to-node="13,6,0" data-index-in-node="0">Operational Scalability:</strong> Continually drive down the human effort required for each launch, eval, and routing update through tools and automation.</li> </ul> <h3 data-path-to-node="15">Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h3> <ul> <li data-path-to-node="16,0,0"><strong data-path-to-node="16,0,0" data-index-in-node="0">People Leadership:</strong> Experience hiring, managing, and growing engineers or operators, giving direct feedback, delegating real ownership, and expanding scope without becoming a bottleneck.</li> <li data-path-to-node="16,1,0"><strong data-path-to-node="16,1,0" data-index-in-node="0">Technical & Shipping Capabilities:</strong> Proven track record of taking technical launches or integrations from ambiguity to production across teams and partners. Automation AI Agents & Continuous Innovation</strong></p> <ul> <li>Leverage Autonomous AI Tools: Champion the use of Cloudflare OS and AI tools (Agent PAT and Agent Echo) to automate standard, repeatable technical tasks, optimizing operational efficiency and freeing up bandwidth for high-touch, strategic partner engagements.</li> <li>AI & CF1 Product Enhancement Feedback Loop: Engage partner champions in the Partner Technical Advisory Council (PTAC) to give them early access to beta software, capture raw product feedback, and drive joint co-innovation on CF1 features and emerging AI products.</li> <li>Cross-Functional Enablement: Participate in continuous cross-training programs to maintain peak proficiency in both pre-sales scoping and post-sales service deployment across the entire Cloudflare One and AI ecosystem.</li> </ul> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <ul> <li>8+ years of technical, partner-facing experience (e.g., Systems Engineer, Solutions Architect, or Technical Account Manager) in cybersecurity, cloud infrastructure, or networking.</li> <li>Strong technical depth in Cloudflare One (CF1) or equivalent SASE/SSE architectures, Zero Trust, DNS, and application security, alongside hands-on familiarity with AI deployment, AI Gateway, LLM orchestration frameworks, or vector databases.</li> <li>Proven track record of developing technical talent or building "champion" programs within partner organizations, specifically driving adoption of complex cloud networks and AI technologies.</li> <li>Enterprise Architecture & Project Management: Deep understanding of enterprise IT, multi-cloud, and hybrid cloud environment while managing complex projects with multiple stakeholders</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to manage the technical lifecycle of a deal from initial pre-sales discovery and CF1/AI PIO generation through post-sale service delivery.</li> <li>Strong communication skills with a track record of presenting complex CF1 architectures and AI-driven use cases to partner leadership and technical teams alike.</li> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.</li> Several of us maintain or regularly contribute to the Linux kernel, and our default is to fix problems in mainline rather than carry private patches. This role is built on that principle.</p> <p><strong>The problem you would own</strong></p> <p>Using memory efficiently is one of the highest-leverage problems we have. At our scale, how the kernel's memory-management subsystem behaves under pressure has direct consequences for both performance and cost. As DRAM prices climb, getting more out of the memory we already own is a real lever on infrastructure spend.</p> <p>Using custom low-overhead instrumentation on production servers, we have identified several scalability bottlenecks in the kernel memory layer that show up under real workloads. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>Switzerland</li> </ul> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <p>The Customer Engineer (CE) is the core driver of our technical go-to-market strategy: a trusted technical advisor and primary architect of the customer journey. You will bridge the gap between technical strategy and business value—guiding enterprise clients from initial pre-sales technical validation through onboarding, deployment architecture, and full lifecycle expansion. Sitting within the GTM organization and reporting to a Customer Engineering Leader, you will not hand off your customers once an initial agreement is reached. Instead, you will operate as a quota-carrying technologist, leveraging AI-augmented workflows to eliminate administrative toil so you can focus on high-value architectural design and driving measurable business outcomes across the entire customer journey.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Technical Validation: </strong>Partner closely with Account Executives to lead technical deep-dive discovery, capture business requirements, and map complex customer infrastructure - DNS, CDN, Zero Trust, Network Security, Workers - to fit-for-purpose Cloudflare architectures and bespoke solutions. . Define, scope, success criteria, and technical evaluations plans for Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and Technical Validations. Deliver tailored technical presentations, architectural diagrams, and demonstrations that show how Cloudflare solves specific performance, security, and reliability challenges. Proactively address complex technical objections, security compliance questions, and edge-case architectural requirements during the sales cycle. Proactively monitor customer health scores and telemetry to ensure rapid time-to-value, resolve integration bottlenecks, and reduce deployment risk.</li> <li><strong>Commercial Accountability & Expansion: </strong>Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. Lead technical Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to translate platform capabilities into return on investment for C-level executives.</li> <li><strong>Trusted Advisory: </strong>Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion. Provide thought partnership on architecture, AI control layers, security posture, and deployment confidence. Identify potential deployment risks or integration bottlenecks early, and provide remediation strategies to de-risk customer outcomes. </li> <li><strong>AI Orchestration & Workflow Automation: </strong>Leverage AI agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), and internal platforms to automate routine tasks such as RFP/Security Questionnaire responses, sandbox provisioning, basic telemetry monitoring, and internal/external documentation, reclaiming your time for strategic customer advisory.</li> <li><strong>Education & Enablement:</strong> Partner closely with the Enablement Team to design, build, and govern technical resources. Define, document, and educate both internal teams and customers on deliverables such as Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), architectural best practices, and technical guides to continuously raise the technical baseline across the organization.</li> <li>This role may require travel up to 20–50% to attend customer meetings, conferences, industry events, and in-person team collaboration.</li> </ul> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <ul> <li>Experience: Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, Professional Services,  Sales Engineering, Technical Account Management, or as a Forward Deployed Engineer (years of experience required will vary based on Associate, Senior, Staff, or Principal leveling).</li> <li>Architectural Mindset: Ability to white-board, design, and articulate complex enterprise network and security architectures clearly.</li> <li>Consultative & Advisory Skills: Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate deeply technical concepts into business outcomes for both hands-on engineers and C-level executives.</li> <li>Commercial Mindset: Proven track record of operating in a quota-carrying or revenue-aligned environment, with a strong understanding of SaaS metrics, business value translation, and enterprise sales cycles.</li> <li>Communication: Exceptional presentation and stakeholder management skills, capable of bridging the gap between deep technical implementation details and high-level C-suite business strategy.</li> <li>Technical Breadth: We do not expect every candidate to be an expert in every domain. Qualified candidates will demonstrate depth in at least four of the technical areas below: <ul> <li>Internet fundamentals: Deep understanding of how the Internet works, including OSI Model layers 1–7, BGP, GRE, TCP/UDP, DNS (authoritative and recursive), HTTP(S), and SSL/TLS.</li> <li>Security: Expertise in the security of Internet properties, including WAF, Bot Management, Firewalls, Rate Limiting, (M)TLS, Zero Trust, and SASE concepts.</li> <li>Performance: Expertise in the performance of Internet properties, including speed, latency, caching, video streaming, HTTP/2, and TLS 1.3.</li> <li>AI Proficiency: Familiarity with prompt engineering, AI-assisted scripting and log analysis, LLM utilization, and workflow automation to augment everyday CE workflows.</li> <li>Coding/Scripting: Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, Bash, Lua, Go, or similar languages to write custom integration scripts, API connectors, and edge computing functions.</li> <li>Developer Platform Fluency: Experience designing, building, deploying or scaling applications using RESTful/GraphQL APIs, SDKs, webhooks, and developer tooling in cloud-native environments. operates, with the opportunity to make a meaningful impact across the business.</p> <h2><strong>What You'll Do</strong></h2> <h3><strong>GTM Business Operations & Executive Priorities</strong></h3> accountable and work moves forward.</li> <li>Help manage competing priorities, bringing recommendations and solutions rather than simply escalating problems.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>GTM Communications & Engagement</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own the execution and quality of GTM-wide communications, including the weekly GTM Rollup, leadership updates, and organizational announcements.</li> <li>Work across functions to gather, validate, prioritize, and translate information into clear, actionable communications for the field.</li> <li>Drive planning and execution of GTM leadership engagement programs, including All Hands and Leadership Unplugged, from content development and stakeholder coordination through delivery and follow-up.</li> <li>Partner with executive stakeholders and content owners to ensure messaging is relevant, engaging, and aligned with GTM priorities.</li> <li>Ensure communications are accurate, timely, and appropriate for their intended audiences.</li> <li>Continuously improve how information reaches the field, reducing unnecessary noise while making important updates easier to find and act on.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Field Advisory Board (FAB) Program Leadership</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own and continuously improve Cloudflare's global Field Advisory Board (FAB) program, ensuring it serves as a meaningful two-way feedback channel between field teams and GTM leadership.</li> <li>Manage the Americas and International boards, including member engagement, quarterly meetings, agendas, executive participation, and follow-through on commitments.</li> <li>Partner with Sales, Product, Enablement, Revenue Operations, and other teams to turn field feedback into actionable recommendations and improvements.</li> <li>Identify recurring themes, challenges, and opportunities from the field, and bring forward insights that help inform GTM priorities and decisions.</li> <li>Strengthen the program's effectiveness by improving how feedback is collected, prioritized, communicated, and acted upon.</li> <li>Ensure FAB members see tangible outcomes from their input, building trust and sustained engagement in the program.</li> <li>Establish clear measures of program impact and regularly assess what's working, what's not, and where the program needs to evolve.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Cross-Functional Execution</strong></h3> ensure commitments are delivered.</li> <li>Identify risks and dependencies early, recommend solutions, and escalate when necessary.</li> <li>Build strong relationships across the organization and influence outcomes without formal authority.</li> <li>Step into ambiguous or urgent situations and bring structure, clarity, and momentum.</li> <li>Balance the needs of multiple stakeholders while keeping the broader GTM organization's priorities in focus.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Operational Excellence & Scale</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Identify opportunities to simplify processes, eliminate unnecessary work, and improve how the GTM organization operates.</li> <li>Leverage AI, automation, and internal tools to reduce manual effort and improve execution.</li> <li>Create lightweight systems for tracking priorities, decisions, and follow-through.</li> <li>Establish practical quality-control processes to ensure work is accurate and complete before delivery.</li> <li>Continuously improve the quality, consistency, and efficiency of work coming out of the Office of the President of Revenue.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What We're Looking For</strong></h2> <ul> <li>7+ years of experience in business operations, GTM strategy and operations, executive operations, Chief of Staff support, or similar roles in a fast-paced technology environment.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience working with senior executives and navigating complex, cross-functional organizations.</li> <li>Proven ability to independently own programs or initiatives from planning through execution, including driving stakeholder alignment and measurable outcomes.</li> <li>Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail, with a track record of managing multiple priorities without losing sight of the details.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to turn complex information into clear, concise, executive-ready materials.</li> <li>Excellent judgment and the confidence to make recommendations, challenge assumptions, and know when to escalate.</li> <li>A proactive mindset. You don't wait to be told what to do, and you're comfortable taking ownership of problems that don't have obvious answers.</li> <li>Strong execution skills. You follow through, close loops, and take responsibility for outcomes.</li> <li>Comfort with ambiguity, changing priorities, and tight timelines.</li> <li>Experience using AI and automation to improve productivity and operational workflows.</li> <li>A low-ego, collaborative approach and willingness to roll up your sleeves, regardless of the task.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What Success Looks Like</strong></h2> <p>Within your first six months:</p> <ul> <li>You've become a trusted extension of the Revenue Chief of Staff, able to independently represent the office and move work forward.</li> <li>GTM communications and leadership engagement programs run smoothly, with strong quality control and minimal oversight.</li> <li>The Field Advisory Board operates as an effective, trusted feedback mechanism, with strong member engagement, actionable insights, and visible progress against field recommendations.</li> <li>You anticipate needs, identify potential issues, and bring solutions before problems escalate.</li> <li>Cross-functional stakeholders trust you to drive decisions, follow through on commitments, and keep work moving.</li> <li>You've identified and implemented meaningful improvements to how the team operates, including opportunities to use AI and automation.</li> <li>The Revenue Chief of Staff has more capacity to focus on strategic priorities because you're independently managing critical aspects of the business.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who Will Thrive Here</strong></h2> <p>You're naturally curious, resourceful, and comfortable figuring things out. title: Principal Product Manager, Certificate Authority
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: Austin or London</strong></p> <h3 id="PrincipalProductManager,CertificateAuthority-AbouttheRole">About the Role</h3> <p>TLS is the connective tissue of the Internet, and Cloudflare terminates a large fraction of it. Cloudflare sits in front of more than 20 percent of global Internet request traffic and terminates TLS for millions of domains. Every day, our network handles certificate operations across products like Universal SSL, SSL for SaaS, Origin CA, Cloudflare Access, and Cloudflare Tunnel.</p> <p>That scale has taught us how the WebPKI ecosystem works from the consuming side.  As certificate lifetimes shorten, agentic activity increases, and post-quantum certificates move toward production, the number of certificates the Internet depends on will grow dramatically. </p> <p>Cloudflare is building a certificate authority for the whole Internet: a public, redundant, transparent CA that provides another trusted source of automated certificates and helps make the encrypted web more resilient. We intend to be ACME-first, automation-first, and transparent by design. We also intend to lead where the ecosystem is going, including post-quantum certificates and Merkle Tree Certificates, while continuing to support the classic WebPKI customers rely on today.</p> <p>As Principal Product Manager for Cloudflare's Certificate Authority business, you will define the product strategy, roadmap, customer experience, and commercial model for this new venture. You will work across product, engineering, security, compliance, legal, operations, sales, marketing, and the WebPKI ecosystem to turn Cloudflare's CA from a major technical commitment into a product customers trust and adopt.</p> <p>This is an early-days role on a growing team. It is not a role for someone who only manages backlog. The right person will be comfortable with high-consequence infrastructure, deep customer discovery, ecosystem trust, compliance scrutiny, and zero-to-one product building. The decisions you make in the first year will shape how Cloudflare participates in the certificate authority market for years to come.</p> <h3 id="PrincipalProductManager,CertificateAuthority-Responsibilities">Responsibilities</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Define the product strategy for Cloudflare's CA business</strong> across publicly trusted certificates, certificate lifecycle automation, ACME issuance, renewal workflows, revocation, Certificate Transparency, customer controls, developer experience, and integrations with Cloudflare's broader platform.</li> <li><strong>Build for the whole Internet</strong> by understanding the needs of developers, site owners, platform teams, SaaS providers, enterprise security teams, infrastructure operators, and partners who depend on certificates for availability, security, and compliance.</li> <li><strong>Make resilience a product principle.</strong> Help design product requirements that fail small, reduce customer blast radius, support automated recovery, and make certificate replacement fast enough to handle compliance issues, revocation events, or ecosystem incidents.</li> <li><strong>Drive an ACME-first customer experience</strong> that makes it easy for users of existing free or automated CAs to adopt Cloudflare with minimal tooling changes.</li> <li><strong>Partner closely with engineering</strong> on systems that manage certificate lifecycles, automate issuance and renewal, integrate with HSMs, protect keys, support auditability, and operate within strict reliability and correctness requirements.</li> <li><strong>Partner with compliance, legal, security, and operations</strong> to ensure product decisions align with CA/Browser Forum Baseline Requirements, WebTrust audits, root store program policies, Certificate Policy and Certification Practice Statement commitments, and public incident response expectations.</li> <li><strong>Own go-to-market strategy</strong> including packaging, pricing, launch sequencing, competitive positioning, customer segmentation, sales enablement, developer messaging, and adoption metrics.</li> <li><strong>Represent the customer and the ecosystem</strong> in product decisions where trust, transparency, uptime, security, and commercial adoption must all be balanced.</li> <li><strong>Work across Cloudflare product teams</strong> including SSL/TLS, Application Security, Zero Trust, Workers, Registrar, DNS, Load Balancing, SaaS products, and infrastructure teams that consume or expose certificate services.</li> <li><strong>Help make Cloudflare Customer Zero</strong> by ensuring our own usage of the CA exercises the product at Cloudflare scale and informs the roadmap before customers depend on it.</li> </ul> <h3 id="PrincipalProductManager,CertificateAuthority-DesirableSkills,KnowledgeandExperience">Desirable Skills, Knowledge and Experience</h3> <ul> <li><strong>10+ years of product management experience</strong> building technical products for developers, security teams, infrastructure teams, enterprises, or cloud platforms.</li> <li><strong>Experience with security, identity, infrastructure, or developer platform products</strong> where correctness, reliability, compliance, and trust are core product requirements.</li> <li><strong>Working knowledge of PKI and certificate lifecycle management</strong> including TLS certificates, X.509, ACME, public and private CAs, revocation, Certificate Transparency, mTLS, HSMs, and enterprise certificate automation.</li> <li><strong>Strong business judgment</strong> with experience defining product strategy, pricing and packaging, customer segmentation, and go-to-market plans for technical B2B products.</li> <li><strong>Ability to operate in ambiguity</strong> and create structure around a new business, including market definition, customer discovery, roadmap tradeoffs, launch planning, and executive alignment.</li> <li><strong>Technical fluency with engineering teams</strong> and comfort discussing APIs, distributed systems, key management, audit trails, reliability, operational failure modes, and security tradeoffs.</li> <li><strong>Strong written communication</strong> for strategy documents, product requirements, launch narratives, customer-facing messaging, and high-stakes internal decisions.</li> <li><strong>Comfort with high-consequence work.</strong> A mis-issued, mis-revoked, or unavailable certificate can become a public, ecosystem-visible event. You need the judgment to move quickly and the discipline to be careful.</li> </ul> <h3 id="PrincipalProductManager,CertificateAuthority-BonusPoints">Bonus Points</h3> <ul> <li>Direct experience working on certificate authority, PKI, certificate lifecycle management, cloud security, identity, or trust services products.</li> <li>Experience with publicly trusted CAs, private PKI, managed certificate services, or platforms such as AWS Certificate Manager, AWS Private CA, Google Trust Services, DigiCert, Sectigo, Let's Encrypt / ISRG, Entrust, Microsoft PKI, HashiCorp Vault PKI, step-ca, or CFSSL.</li> <li>Familiarity with CA/Browser Forum requirements, browser root programs, WebTrust for CAs, WebTrust Baseline Requirements, or public CA incident reporting.</li> <li>Experience building API-first developer products, especially products involving ACME, SDKs, CLI workflows, Kubernetes, service mesh, mTLS, or infrastructure-as-code integrations.</li> <li>Experience launching new businesses or zero-to-one products inside a larger platform company.</li> <li>Familiarity with certificate automation challenges created by 90-day and shorter certificate Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>New York, NY</li> </ul> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>Account Executives, Channel Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, Solution Engineers, Customer Success, and Sales Operations - all working together help our customers adopt Cloudflare and create great Internet-enabled experiences. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. We are looking for a senior technical architect to help define the systems, protocols, and security architecture behind it.</p> <p>This role spans applied cryptography, Web PKI, distributed systems, security engineering, compliance, and Internet standards. It will help Cloudflare build a CA that operates safely at Internet scale while establishing a credible path from today's X.509 ecosystem toward post-quantum authentication using Merkle Tree Certificates (MTCs).</p> <h2>Mission</h2> <p>Define and guide the end-to-end architecture of Cloudflare's public Certificate Authority: a high-assurance, highly available system capable of issuing conventional publicly trusted certificates at Cloudflare scale while supporting Merkle Tree Certificates (MTCs) and the evolution toward a post-quantum Web PKI.</p> <p>You will help determine not only how the CA is implemented, but also its trust boundaries, key hierarchy, issuance architecture, auditability, failure modes, incident response mechanisms, and long-term cryptographic evolution.</p> <h2>Key Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>Define and maintain the end-to-end technical architecture of Cloudflare's public CA across certificate issuance, key management, transparency, revocation, renewal, and relying-party integration.</li> <li>Design root and intermediate CA trust hierarchies, signing systems, HSM integration, key ceremonies, key rotation, backup, recovery, migration, and key-compromise response.</li> <li>Architect secure, resilient, and highly available issuance services capable of operating at Internet scale and across multiple geographic and failure domains.</li> <li>Design certificate lifecycle systems around ACME, domain and IP validation, CAA, Certificate Transparency, pre-issuance linting, revocation, renewal, and large-scale certificate replacement.</li> <li>Integrate Cloudflare’s MTC infrastructure, including CA logs, landmarks,, cosigning or mirroring, and interactions with relying parties.</li> <li>Develop practical architectures for coexistence and migration between classical X.509 certificates and post-quantum authentication mechanisms.</li> <li>Define trust boundaries, security properties, and threat models covering key compromise, unauthorized issuance, software supply-chain compromise, operator error, malicious insiders, infrastructure failure, split views, and cryptographic migration.</li> <li>Design systems that make CA behavior observable and independently verifiable through transparency mechanisms, reproducible builds, cryptographic attestations, public operational telemetry, tamper-evident evidence, and audit controls.</li> <li>Design failure containment and recovery mechanisms that support safe certificate replacement, revocation, key rotation, and incident response without creating avoidable Internet availability failures.</li> <li>Translate CA/Browser Forum requirements, browser and operating-system root-program policies, audit criteria, and certification requirements into concrete technical and operational controls.</li> <li>Review protocols, architecture, and implementations with an adversarial mindset, identifying assumptions and failure modes that do not hold at Internet scale.</li> <li>Work closely with Cloudflare's cryptography, TLS, security, networking, infrastructure, compliance, product, and operations teams.</li> <li>Provide architectural direction, design review, and technical mentorship to engineers implementing and operating the CA platform.</li> <li>Represent Cloudflare in relevant standards and industry work, collaborating with browser vendors, root programs, researchers, auditors, CA operators, and the wider Web PKI community.</li> </ul> <h2>What You'll Bring</h2> <ul> <li>Substantial experience designing or operating security-critical systems, with deep expertise in at least one of: public Certificate Authorities, Web PKI, applied cryptography, TLS and Internet security protocols, Certificate Transparency, hardware-backed key management, or large-scale distributed security systems.</li> <li>Strong knowledge of certificate trust chains, issuance and validation, revocation, key lifecycle management, and the security and availability implications of CA design decisions.</li> <li>Experience defining system trust boundaries, threat models, security invariants, and failure-handling strategies.</li> <li>Ability to reason about systems in which a subtle architectural or operational mistake can affect a significant fraction of the Internet.</li> <li>Experience leading architecture across multiple engineering teams without relying solely on organizational authority.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain cryptographic and architectural tradeoffs to engineers, auditors, standards participants, and senior stakeholders.</li> <li>Comfort operating with substantial autonomy in an evolving technical and policy environment.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>San Francisco, US</li> <li>We are only considering locally based candidates OR candidates looking to move to the Bay Area.</li> <li> <p>Senior Customer Engineer - (AI & Start-Ups) </p> <ul> <li>For San Francisco based hires: Estimated annual salary of  <strong class="rQesXe MPyX" data-sfc-cp="" data-sfc-root="ep" data-epip="" data-complete="true" data-processed="true">$213,500 – $335,500 </strong>OTE, Base + Commissions.</li> <li><br>About the Role<br>Digital Native SEs at Cloudflare work with the most innovative and cutting-edge companies on the planet — the startups and high-growth, cloud-native businesses that are building the next generation of Internet products. These are companies where the developers <em>are</em> the decision makers, and where the CTO is often personally responsible for shipping new products and getting the company's AI initiatives off the ground.<br>This role is for a technologist who genuinely enjoys being in the room with builders. You'll be equally comfortable jumping into a Slack channel with a founding engineer, whiteboarding an architecture with a lead developer, and stepping into a strategic conversation with a CTO about their platform and AI roadmap. You speak the language of engineers fluently and can hold a credible, detailed technical conversation — but this is <strong>not</strong> a software developer role, and you won't be writing production code every day. You'll be expected to go deep on the Cloudflare Developer Platform — Workers, Durable Objects, Workers AI, R2, KV, D1, Vectorize, Queues, Pages, and the broader developer ecosystem — far beyond basic storage, and to make the case for Cloudflare as <em>the</em> place to build. This role covers both the acquisition of new Digital Native accounts and the expansion of existing ones. The ideal candidate is a "builder" personality with a strong mix of pre-sales/technical customer-facing experience who thrives in an agile, fast-moving environment.<br>What you'll do as a Senior Solutions Engineer<br>The Pre-Sales Solution Engineering organization owns the technical sales of the Cloudflare solution portfolio, ensuring maximal business value, fit-for-purpose solution design and adoption roadmap for our customers. Solution Engineering is made up of individuals from a wide range of backgrounds including but not limited to Sales Consultants, Technical Consultants, Technical Support and Program Managers.<br>You are a customer-facing technologist within the Cloudflare Solutions Engineering team, focused on the developer-first, digital-native segment. You have experience in a pre-sales or other technical customer-facing role, and you're at your best when engaging directly with engineering teams and technical founders. In this role you'll partner closely with the sales team from the very start of the cycle — joining early discovery calls, qualifying opportunities from the get-go, and embedding yourself in customer Slack channels and working sessions. You'll lead technical discovery, deliver compelling demos and architecture discussions, run proof-of-concept builds, and evangelize the Cloudflare Developer Platform as the foundation for our customers' next products and AI initiatives.<br>Responsibilities<br>Specifically, we are looking for you to:<br> <ul> <li>Lead technical discovery within the cloud-developer vertical — asking the right questions to uncover how a customer builds, what they're trying to ship, and where Cloudflare fits.</li> <li>Engage early and often: join sales-led discovery calls from the outset, help qualify deals from the get-go, and stay embedded with customer teams (including in their Slack channels and working sessions) throughout the cycle.</li> <li>Identify and map customer initiatives and business problems — especially around new product development and AI initiatives — to the Cloudflare platform.</li> <li>Build relationships and technical champions within customer accounts, from founding engineers and developers up to the CTO.</li> <li>Develop and present tailored technical content and demos for both hands-on developer audiences and senior technical leadership.</li> <li>Lead demo and proof-of-concept / build activities for Cloudflare prospects and customers.</li> <li>Evangelize the Cloudflare Developer Platform (Workers, Workers AI, Durable Objects, R2, D1, KV, Vectorize, Queues, Pages and more) — making the case for customers to <em>build on</em> Cloudflare, not just use it for storage or CDN.</li> <li>Demonstrate your expertise with your peers through the creation of professional content, including reference architectures, demos, blog posts and other knowledge-sharing activities.</li> <li>Represent and evangelize Cloudflare externally at Developer, Community, Technology and Industry events with thought leadership and expertise.</li> <li>Apply in-depth vertical knowledge or domain expertise. Advise on best practices.</li> </ul> Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience<br> <ul> <li>Previous experience as a Solutions Engineer or other customer-facing technical role, ideally selling to or working with developer-led, cloud-native, or startup organizations.</li> <li>A genuine "builder" mindset and the personality to match: you enjoy talking to developers, you're curious, and you naturally gravitate toward technical problem-solving conversations.</li> <li>The ability to speak engineers' language credibly — you can hold your own on architecture, APIs, and platform design — <strong>without</strong> this being a hands-on, code-every-day developer role.</li> <li>Strong technical discovery instincts: you know how to draw out requirements, qualify fit early, and separate real needs from noise.</li> <li>A good mix of pre-sales / technical sales experience and comfort operating in an agile, fast-moving environment (joining Slack channels, iterating quickly, engaging in early-stage calls, and qualifying deals from the start).</li> <li>Solid communication, written and presentation skills, with the range to talk to both a hands-on developer and a CTO in the same day.</li> <li>Ability to work on several projects and activities concurrently.</li> <li>Highly driven, curious, team-oriented, and able to work with a sense of urgency.</li> <li>You've built web applications before, or contributed to existing web applications in a meaningful way — enough to have real empathy for how developers work.</li> <li>Polished communication and executive presentation skills with the ability to drive a discussion with a broad range of stakeholders (from the web developer to the CTO/CISO).</li> <li>Relationship building: a proven track record of building deep technical relationships with engineers and technical founders. title: Senior Customer Engineer, Majors
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>Germany</li> </ul> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <p>The Customer Engineer (CE) is the core driver of our technical go-to-market strategy: a trusted technical advisor and primary architect of the customer journey. You will bridge the gap between technical strategy and business value—guiding enterprise clients from initial pre-sales technical validation through onboarding, deployment architecture, and full lifecycle expansion. Sitting within the GTM organization and reporting to a Customer Engineering Leader, you will not hand off your customers once an initial agreement is reached. Instead, you will operate as a quota-carrying technologist, leveraging AI-augmented workflows to eliminate administrative toil so you can focus on high-value architectural design and driving measurable business outcomes across the entire customer journey.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Technical Validation: </strong>Partner closely with Account Executives to lead technical deep-dive discovery, capture business requirements, and map complex customer infrastructure - DNS, CDN, Zero Trust, Network Security, Workers - to fit-for-purpose Cloudflare architectures and bespoke solutions. . Define, scope, success criteria, and technical evaluations plans for Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and Technical Validations. Deliver tailored technical presentations, architectural diagrams, and demonstrations that show how Cloudflare solves specific performance, security, and reliability challenges. Proactively address complex technical objections, security compliance questions, and edge-case architectural requirements during the sales cycle. Take accountability for a suitable solution deployment strategy (Customer, Partner or Cloudflare Professional services) being an integral part of all proposals.</li> <li><strong>Customer Adoption & Value Realization: </strong>Provide oversight to technical onboarding and implementation, but not execute the implementation, serving as the primary executive and engineering contact for the customer. Design structured migration and onboarding blueprints tailored to the customer’s environment (e.g. DNS migrations, Zero Trust rollouts, WAF tuning guidance), and act as the lead consultant for customer engineering teams, walking them step-by-step through configuration best practices.  Partner with Account Executives to own discovery, demos, onboarding, technical health, risk, and expansion strategy. Proactively monitor customer health scores and telemetry to ensure rapid time-to-value, resolve integration bottlenecks, and reduce deployment risk.</li> <li><strong>Commercial Accountability & Expansion: </strong>Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. Be commercially accountable for ensuring deep platform adoption, retaining revenue, and identifying strategic cross-sell and up-sell opportunities based on product usage data. Lead technical Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to translate platform capabilities into return on investment for C-level executives.</li> <li><strong>Trusted Advisory: </strong>Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion. Provide thought partnership on architecture, AI control layers, security posture, and deployment confidence. Identify potential deployment risks or integration bottlenecks early, and provide remediation strategies to de-risk customer outcomes. </li> <li><strong>AI Orchestration & Workflow Automation: </strong>Leverage AI agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), and internal platforms to automate routine tasks such as RFP/Security Questionnaire responses, sandbox provisioning, basic telemetry monitoring, and internal/external documentation, reclaiming your time for strategic customer advisory.</li> <li><strong>Education & Enablement:</strong> Partner closely with the Enablement Team to design, build, and govern technical resources. Define, document, and educate both internal teams and customers on deliverables such as Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), architectural best practices, and technical guides to continuously raise the technical baseline across the organization.</li> <li>This role may require travel up to 20–50% to attend customer meetings, conferences, industry events, and in-person team collaboration.</li> </ul> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <ul> <li>Experience: Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, Professional Services,  Sales Engineering, Technical Account Management, or as a Forward Deployed Engineer (years of experience required will vary based on Associate, Senior, Staff, or Principal leveling).</li> <li>Architectural Mindset: Ability to white-board, design, and articulate complex enterprise network and security architectures clearly.</li> <li>Consultative & Advisory Skills: Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate deeply technical concepts into business outcomes for both hands-on engineers and C-level executives.</li> <li>Commercial Mindset: Proven track record of operating in a quota-carrying or revenue-aligned environment, with a strong understanding of SaaS metrics, business value translation, and enterprise sales cycles.</li> <li>Communication: Exceptional presentation and stakeholder management skills, capable of bridging the gap between deep technical implementation details and high-level C-suite business strategy.</li> <li>Technical Breadth: We do not expect every candidate to be an expert in every domain. Qualified candidates will demonstrate depth in at least four of the technical areas below: <ul> <li>Internet fundamentals: Deep understanding of how the Internet works, including OSI Model layers 1–7, BGP, GRE, TCP/UDP, DNS (authoritative and recursive), HTTP(S), and SSL/TLS.</li> <li>Security: Expertise in the security of Internet properties, including WAF, Bot Management, Firewalls, Rate Limiting, (M)TLS, Zero Trust, and SASE concepts.</li> <li>Performance: Expertise in the performance of Internet properties, including speed, latency, caching, video streaming, HTTP/2, and TLS 1.3.</li> <li>AI Proficiency: Familiarity with prompt engineering, AI-assisted scripting and log analysis, LLM utilization, and workflow automation to augment everyday CE workflows.</li> <li>Coding/Scripting: Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, Bash, Lua, Go, or similar languages to write custom integration scripts, API connectors, and edge computing functions.</li> <li>Developer Platform Fluency: Experience designing, building, deploying or scaling applications using RESTful/GraphQL APIs, SDKs, webhooks, and developer tooling in cloud-native environments. Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi), CI/CD pipelines, and observability for developer-led deployments.</li> </ul> </li> <li><strong>Business Fluency in German</strong></li> </ul> <h2>Bonus Points</h2> <ul> <li>Technical Enablement: Track record of creating and delivering technical enablement - workshops, code samples, documentation, or developer onboarding - that accelerates customer adoption of complex platforms. </li> <li>Applied AI Knowledge: Experience with LLM orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, and model-access controls.</li> <li>Regulatory Knowledge: Understanding of regulatory requirements such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, and SOC 2.</li> <li>Hyperscaler / Digital Native Background: Talent coming out of hyperscalers, digital natives, distributed systems environments, or startups is strongly valued for its deeper cloud fluency and advanced architecture depth.</li> </ul> <h2>Compensation</h2> <p>For Germany based hires: Estimated annual salary is between €116,000 - €182,000.</p> <p>This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation under Cloudflare's Sales Compensation Plan. The estimated annual salary range includes the on-target incentive compensation that may be attained in this role under the Sales Compensation Plan.  </p> <p>Equity: This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare's equity plan.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: W

description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>Cincinatti, OH</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you will do as a Customer Engineer</strong><br>The Customer Engineer (CE) is the core driver of our technical go-to-market strategy: a trusted technical advisor and primary architect of the customer journey. You will bridge the gap between technical strategy and business value—guiding enterprise clients from initial pre-sales technical validation through onboarding, deployment architecture, and full lifecycle expansion. Sitting within the GTM organization and reporting to a Customer Engineering Leader, you will not hand off your customers once an initial agreement is reached. Instead, you will operate as a quota-carrying technologist, leveraging AI-augmented workflows to eliminate administrative toil so you can focus on high-value architectural design and driving measurable business outcomes across the entire customer journey.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Technical Validation: </strong>Partner closely with Account Executives to lead technical deep-dive discovery, capture business requirements, and map complex customer infrastructure - DNS, CDN, Zero Trust, Network Security, Workers - to fit-for-purpose Cloudflare architectures and bespoke solutions. Define, scope, success criteria, and technical evaluations plans for Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and Technical Validations. Deliver tailored technical presentations, architectural diagrams, and demonstrations that show how Cloudflare solves specific performance, security, and reliability challenges. Proactively address complex technical objections, security compliance questions, and edge-case architectural requirements during the sales cycle. Take accountability for a suitable solution deployment strategy (Customer, Partner or Cloudflare Professional services) being an integral part of all proposals.</li> <li><strong>Customer Adoption & Value Realization: </strong>Provide oversight to technical onboarding and implementation, but not execute the implementation, serving as the primary executive and engineering contact for the customer. Design structured migration and onboarding blueprints tailored to the customer’s environment (e.g. DNS migrations, Zero Trust rollouts, WAF tuning guidance), and act as the lead consultant for customer engineering teams, walking them step-by-step through configuration best practices.  Partner with Account Executives to own discovery, demos, onboarding, technical health, risk, and expansion strategy. Proactively monitor customer health scores and telemetry to ensure rapid time-to-value, resolve integration bottlenecks, and reduce deployment risk.</li> <li><strong>Commercial Accountability & Expansion: </strong>Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. Be commercially accountable for ensuring deep platform adoption, retaining revenue, and identifying strategic cross-sell and up-sell opportunities based on product usage data. Lead technical Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to translate platform capabilities into return on investment for C-level executives.</li> <li><strong>Trusted Advisory: </strong>Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion. Provide thought partnership on architecture, AI control layers, security posture, and deployment confidence. Identify potential deployment risks or integration bottlenecks early, and provide remediation strategies to de-risk customer outcomes. </li> <li><strong>AI Orchestration & Workflow Automation: </strong>Leverage AI agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), and internal platforms to automate routine tasks such as RFP/Security Questionnaire responses, sandbox provisioning, basic telemetry monitoring, and internal/external documentation, reclaiming your time for strategic customer advisory.</li> <li><strong>Education & Enablement:</strong> Partner closely with the Enablement Team to design, build, and govern technical resources. Define, document, and educate both internal teams and customers on deliverables such as Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), architectural best practices, and technical guides to continuously raise the technical baseline across the organization.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Minimum Qualifications</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Experience: Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, Professional Services,  Sales Engineering, Technical Account Management, or as a Forward Deployed Engineer (years of experience required will vary based on Associate, Senior, Staff, or Principal leveling).</li> <li>Architectural Mindset: Ability to white-board, design, and articulate complex enterprise network and security architectures clearly.</li> <li>Consultative & Advisory Skills: Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate deeply technical concepts into business outcomes for both hands-on engineers and C-level executives.</li> <li>Commercial Mindset: Proven track record of operating in a quota-carrying or revenue-aligned environment, with a strong understanding of SaaS metrics, business value translation, and enterprise sales cycles.</li> <li>Communication: Exceptional presentation and stakeholder management skills, capable of bridging the gap between deep technical implementation details and high-level C-suite business strategy.</li> <li>Technical Breadth: We do not expect every candidate to be an expert in every domain. Qualified candidates will demonstrate depth in at least four of the technical areas below:</li> <ul> <li>Internet fundamentals: Deep understanding of how the Internet works, including OSI Model layers 1–7, BGP, GRE, TCP/UDP, DNS (authoritative and recursive), HTTP(S), and SSL/TLS.</li> <li>Security: Expertise in the security of Internet properties, including WAF, Bot Management, Firewalls, Rate Limiting, (M)TLS, Zero Trust, and SASE concepts.</li> <li>Performance: Expertise in the performance of Internet properties, including speed, latency, caching, video streaming, HTTP/2, and TLS 1.3.</li> <li>AI Proficiency: Familiarity with prompt engineering, AI-assisted scripting and log analysis, LLM utilization, and workflow automation to augment everyday CE workflows.</li> <li>Coding/Scripting: Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, Bash, Lua, Go, or similar languages to write custom integration scripts, API connectors, and edge computing functions.</li> <li>Developer Platform Fluency: Experience designing, building, deploying or scaling applications using RESTful/GraphQL APIs, SDKs, webhooks, and developer tooling in cloud-native environments. Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi), CI/CD pipelines, and observability for developer-led deployments.</li> </ul> </ul> <h4><strong>Strongly Preferred Qualifications (The "Good-to-Haves")</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Technical Enablement: Track record of creating and delivering technical enablement - workshops, code samples, documentation, or developer onboarding - that accelerates customer adoption of complex platforms. </li> <li>Applied AI Knowledge: Experience with LLM orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, and model-access controls.</li> <li>Regulatory Knowledge: Understanding of regulatory requirements such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, and SOC 2.</li> <li>Hyperscaler / Digital Native Background: Talent coming out of hyperscalers, digital natives, distributed systems environments, or startups is strongly valued for its deeper cloud fluency and advanced architecture depth.</li> </ul> Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>Minnesota</li> </ul> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. As the architectural complexity of enterprise solutions scales, we are evolving how we partner with our customers. The Customer Engineer (CE) represents the core driver of our technical go-to-market strategy: a trusted advisor who owns the technical relationship from the initial discovery phase through to long-term adoption and ongoing account expansion.</p> <p>Sitting within the GTM organization and reporting to the Regional Customer Engineering Leader, you will not hand off your customers once an initial agreement is reached. Instead, you will operate as a quota-carrying technologist, utilizing AI-augmented workflows to eliminate administrative toil so you can focus on high-value architectural design and driving measurable business outcomes across the entire customer journey.</p> <h2><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Technical Validation:</strong> Partner closely with Account Executives to lead technical discovery, build bespoke architectures, and deliver compelling product demonstrations and Proof of Concepts (PoCs) across Cloudflare’s portfolio (Security, Networking and Developer Platforms).</li> <li><strong>Customer Adoption & Value Realization:</strong> Lead and/or provide oversight to technical onboarding and implementation, serving as the primary executive and engineering contact for the customer. Lead technical Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to translate platform capabilities into return on investment for C-level executives.</li> <li><strong>Trusted Advisory: </strong>Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion.</li> <li><strong>AI Orchestration & Workflow Automation:</strong> Act as an "AI-Augmented" engineer. Leverage AI agents and internal platforms to automate routine tasks such as RFP/Security Questionnaire responses, sandbox provisioning, and basic telemetry monitoring, reclaiming your time for strategic customer advisory.</li> </ul> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Experience:</strong> Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, Sales Engineering, or as a Forward Deployed Engineer (years of experience required will vary based on Associate, Senior, Staff, or Principal leveling).</li> details and high-level C-suite business strategy.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Points</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Cloudflare AI Stack Experience:</strong> Hands-on experience building, deploying, or architecting solutions using Cloudflare's developer platform and AI ecosystem, specifically Workers AI, AI Gateway, and Vectorize.</li> <li><strong>Applied AI Knowledge:</strong> Experience with prompt engineering, Large Language Model (LLM) orchestration, or Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures.</li> <li><strong>Coding/Scripting:</strong> Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, or similar languages to write custom integration scripts, API connectors, and edge computing functions.</li> </ul> <h3>Compensation</h3> <p>This role features a competitive base salary and a variable commission structure tied directly to the successful execution of full-lifecycle commercial targets, including new business acquisition, ongoing adoption milestones, and overall account expansion.</p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location. This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation under Cloudflare’s Sales Compensation Plan. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. You will bridge the gap between technical strategy and business value—guiding enterprise clients from initial pre-sales technical validation through onboarding, deployment architecture, and full lifecycle expansion. Sitting within the GTM organization and reporting to a Customer Engineering Leader, you will not hand off your customers once an initial agreement is reached. Define, scope, success criteria, and technical evaluations plans for Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and Technical Validations. Proactively monitor customer health scores and telemetry to ensure rapid time-to-value, resolve integration bottlenecks, and reduce deployment risk.</li> <li><strong>Commercial Accountability & Expansion: </strong>Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. Be commercially accountable for ensuring deep platform adoption, retaining revenue, and identifying strategic cross-sell and up-sell opportunities based on product usage data. Lead technical Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to translate platform capabilities into return on investment for C-level executives.</li> <li><strong>Trusted Advisory: </strong>Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion. Provide thought partnership on architecture, AI control layers, security posture, and deployment confidence. Identify potential deployment risks or integration bottlenecks early, and provide remediation strategies to de-risk customer outcomes. </li> <li><strong>AI Orchestration & Workflow Automation: </strong>Leverage AI agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), and internal platforms to automate routine tasks such as RFP/Security Questionnaire responses, sandbox provisioning, basic telemetry monitoring, and internal/external documentation, reclaiming your time for strategic customer advisory.</li> <li><strong>Education & Enablement:</strong> Partner closely with the Enablement Team to design, build, and govern technical resources. Proactively address complex technical objections, security compliance questions, and edge-case architectural requirements during the sales cycle. Take accountability for a suitable solution deployment strategy (Customer, Partner or Cloudflare Professional Services) being an integral part of all proposals.</p> <p><strong>Customer Adoption & Value Realization:</strong> Oversee technical onboarding and implementation without executing it yourself, serving as the primary executive and engineering contact for the customer. Design structured migration and onboarding blueprints tailored to the customer's environment (e.g. DNS migrations, Zero Trust rollouts, WAF tuning guidance). Guide customers in taking AI applications and agents from prototype to production in a way that is reliable, safe, and affordable. Develop relationships with incubators, accelerators, venture capital firms, founder communities, and developer meetups to generate new pipeline alongside Account Executives. Represent Cloudflare at startup events, demo days, and hackathons, and identify high-potential AI startups early in their journey.</p> <p><strong>Trusted Advisory:</strong> Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with founders, CTOs, engineering leaders, and other key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion.
